BANANA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}anywhere on lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, explodes in small area

{FLAVOR}It's important to avoid stereotyping as much as possible. Stereotypes are often flat-out wrong. And also hurtful. But honestly ... Banana Launcher is TOTALLY bananas.
BANANA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Banana Launchers can fire explosive bananas at any tile on the lawn.
BANANA_TOOLTIP: Tap on banana, then a tile, to launch explosive banana
BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Blastberry Vine snickers to himself. He imagines lobbing bomblets. He’s been reading up on it and he knows it’s gonna make a big splash when it happens. "Soon," he whispers.
BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blastberry Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide increased defense and an additional attack in the form of lobbed projectiles that break into explosive bomblets.
BLASTBERRY_TOOLTIP: Protects a plant inside and lobs damaging berries
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannot be dug by Excavator Zombie or pulled by Fisherman Zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks flying zombies

{FLAVOR}Blockoli isn't afraid of being eaten, that's life on the battlefield. What he does fear however, is not being tasty when it does eventually happen. He fancies himself as quite a delicious plant when prepared right, and to deny that potential would be a great insult. As a matter of fact, he's willing to offer tips and suggestions on how it could be done during his off time. His fellow greens aren't as enthusiastic as him on the topic of how they could be prepared for a dish in some water cooler talks, however.
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blockoli dual-wields two sturdy floret shields, slamming them down to stun and block approaching zombies.
BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}As the first new member to your home defense team, Bloomerang enjoys long walkabouts with his friend, Koala Bear, and listening to his Bob Barley albums out back.
BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bloomerangs can hit multiple targets in their lane, twice each coming and going!
BLOOMERANG_PLANTFOOD: Throws many boomerangs that hit all the zombies to the left, right, above, and below.
BLOOMERANG_TOOLTIP: Hits up to three targets in its lane, twice
BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}40 (projectile), 15 per damage stack
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}damage increases across multiple Blooming Hearts

{FLAVOR}Blooming Heart loves zombies. She gets guff from her fellow plants over it, but she stands firm. She's into zombies and makes no apologies about it.
BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blooming Hearts lob projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing increasing damage the more they hit.
BLOOMINGHEARTS_TOOLTIP: Lobs projectiles that do more damage the more they hit
BLOVER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows away all flying zombies

{FLAVOR}The luckiest stunt clover around, Blover is the most recent recipient of the Stunty Award. You can see his work in "Bulb Fiction," "Rooty," and "Finding Flower." He also teaches a stunt class on Tuesdays at the community center.
BLOVER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blovers blow away all zombies in the air.
BLOVER_TOOLTIP: Blows away all flying and floating zombies
BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}heavily damages various grid items
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}destroys critters

{FLAVOR}Boingsetta's a springy plant whose positive outlook is infectiously delightful! The chilling effect is merely a secondary consequence.
BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Boingsettas slam the ground in a "boing" that heavily damages grid items and chills zombies.
BOINGSETTA_TOOLTIP: Damages grid items and chills zombies
BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Bombard-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Banana Launcher
{STAT}Berry Blaster
{STAT}Bombegranate
{STAT}Cherry Bomb
{STAT}Dandelion
{STAT}Escape Root
{STAT}Explode-O-Nut
{STAT}Ghost Pepper
{STAT}Grapeshot
{STAT}Potato Mine
{STAT}Primal Potato Mine
{STAT}Strawburst

{FLAVOR}"Explosions are fun," says Bombard-mint with an impish twinkle in her eye. "In the context of eliminating zombies, a cascade of detonations not only clears much of the board, but leaves a lovely fragrance in its wake. It smells like... victory."
BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bombard-mints set off a massive explosion on board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.
BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Bombegranate is explosive, but she likes to think there's more to her than that. She's also deciduous and exarillate!
BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bombegranates explode and leave 3x3 grids of exploding seeds that damage zombies.
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can attack ahead or behind

{FLAVOR}A freelance dentist on the side, he's offering a special this month - he'll knock two of your teeth out for the price of one!
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bonk Choys rapidly punch nearby enemies that are ahead or behind them.
BONKCHOY_PLANTFOOD: Attacks with a flurry of fists, doing massive damage to anything on nearby tiles.
BONKCHOY_TOOLTIP: Rapidly punches enemies ahead or behind
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap or drag from Boom Balloon Flower to move a balloon to a tile
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}balloons gain an additional 300 damage per stack

{FLAVOR}Boom Balloon Flower's balloons are inflated with hydrogen and aerosolized kerosene. It's an anti-safety measure.
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Boom Balloon Flowers spawn exploding balloons that can be placed anywhere on the lawn as traps for zombies.
BOOMFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Tap to place a mine, mines can be stacked for more damage
BOOST_ALREADY_ACTIVE: This plant is already boosted! Use it in a level!
BOOST_DETAIL_BOUNTY_HUNTER: Zombies defeated by this plant drop coins. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_EXTRA_TOUGH: Extra protection from zombies. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_FAST_RECHARGE: Recharges more quickly. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_FIRST_STRIKE: Gets free Plant Food effect when planted. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_RAPID_FIRE: Attacks at a faster rate. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_SHOVEL_BOMB: Explodes when shoveled. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_SUN_DISCOUNT: Costs less sun to plant. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOSS_BUSTER_CANNON_DESCRIPTION: Inflicts up to {DAMAGE} damage to bosses every {TIME} seconds!
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage Details: {STAT}larger bulbs do more damage

{FLAVOR}Guess which team has won the League Championship for five years running now? Team Bowling Bulb, that's who. They are on a ROLL. You and your pals think you got what it takes to stop 'em? Yeah, sure. Keep dreamin, bub.
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bowling Bulbs roll shots that can bounce into multiple zombies.
BOWLINGBULB_TOOLTIP: Rolls bouncing shots that can hit multiple zombies
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}can pull the armor off certain zombies when trapped
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}berry clusters show traps remaining

{FLAVOR}Many friends and family members advised him to pursue a different career, something more along the lines of viticulture along with the other vines, with him being told that his current career is a trap. He never thought they were so literal about it until he graduated, but he never had the best hindsight.
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bramble Bush traps and damages a zombie.
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates buttering butter splats

{FLAVOR}Buttercup's sweet as can be, but she packs a wallop! "I'm not cheap," she says, referring to her flat 25 sun cost. "I'm reasonable."
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Buttercup butters butter onto attacking zombies, stunning them with butter. Butter!
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Cabbage-pult received his doctorate in pulting from Harvest University. He knows a thing or two about launching his way to the top. He also makes a mean soup.
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cabbage-pults hurl cabbages at the enemy.
CABBAGEPULT_PLANTFOOD: Hits every zombie on the lawn with a large cabbage.
CABBAGEPULT_TOOLTIP: Hurls cabbages over obstacles at the enemy
CACTUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hides and does ground damage when zombies are near

{FLAVOR}Things have really changed for Cactus lately. Book deals, movies, truck show appearances... she’s just trying to focus on staying humble and launching thorns like always.
CACTUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cactus fires a penetrating thorn that can damage multiple enemies!
CACTUS_TOOLTIP: Fires a penetrating thorn, hides for ground damage
CALENDAR_STREAK_RETENTION_CALL_TO_ACTION: Yowsers, your calendar streak's at risk! Spend gems to keep it?
CALENDAR_UNLOCK_DESCRIPTION:
- Earn rewards each day by opening Plants vs Zombies 2!
- Earn extra rewards during Seasonal Events.
- This feature requires a network connection.
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_1: Tap on a zombie to flip its panel
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_2: Great! Now tap on another one
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_3: Awesome! Keep matching symbols to win the game
CANNON_TUTORIAL_1: Tap on the coconut cannon to make it fire
CANNON_TUTORIAL_2: Great! Now blow up as many zombies as you can
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Caulipower's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.
CDN_DOWNLOAD_DESCRIPTION: We need to update game data. This may take a short while. The game will return to the Main Menu when the update is complete.
CDN_DOWNLOAD_PROGRESS_DESCRIPTION: Downloading update data. The game will return to the Main Menu when the download is complete.
CDN_ERROR_DISABLED: The download has been disabled. Try again later.
CDN_ERROR_GENERIC: There is an error with the download. Try again later.
CDN_ERROR_IN_PROGRESS: There is already a download in progress.
CDN_RETRY_DESCRIPTION: You can retry the download, or cancel and not proceed to the feature.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Celery Stalker resents the implication that there’s anything unsavory about his attack style. He simply believes that discretion is the better part of vegetation.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Celery Stalkers wait until zombies pass, then pop up and bash them from behind.
CELERYSTALKER_TOOLTIP: Pops up and bashes zombies from behind
CELLULAR_PERMISSION_BODY: Do you want to use cellular data to download additional content? You can change this setting in the options menu later.
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}You might remember Chard Guard from his days in the WWF (that's World Wrestling Foliage). When he was in the ring – boy-oh-boy – he was something to behold! His moves! His style! His attitude! The crowd loved him. He was quite the star for a while there. Sure, those days are behind him. But if you watch carefully, when Chard Guard is fighting zombies, you'll see him use the wrestling move he made famous. The ol' Knock 'Em Dead maneuver – it gets 'em every time.
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Chard Guards are defensive blockers that can hurl zombies backwards.
CHARDGUARD_PLANTFOOD: Returns to full health, then damages and pushes back zombies in 6 adjacent tiles.
CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}The Cherry Bomb Brothers attempted to start their own band. "We tried to figure out what the sound would be, but we kept explodonating speakers, stages, fans, and of course, zombies. Look for our LP next year."
CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cherry Bombs can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.
CHERRY_BOMB_TOOLTIP: Blows up all zombies in a medium area
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}eating zombie is destroyed and releases stunning gas
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't affect mechanical zombies

{FLAVOR}He's not blushing, he's trying to hold it in.
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Chili Beans deliver a crippling bout of gastrointestinal distress.
CHILIBEAN_PLANTFOOD: Launches out 3 Chili Bean clones to random locations on the lawn.
CHILIBEAN_TOOLTIP: Zombies that eat it are defeated and release gas
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes 12 seconds to swallow a zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be devoured

{FLAVOR}Everyone appreciates what Chomper does. His appetite has saved them on numerous occasions. But truth be told, Chomper's friends think that eating zombies is gross. And his breath! No one has the heart to tell him, and he never gets the hint when you offer him a mint.
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Chompers can devour a zombie whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.
CHOMPER_TOOLTIP: Devours a zombie, then chews on it for a while
CITRON_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}As the owner and primary user of "Vitamin C-U-Later" 20-hour energy shots, Citron is always on and always ready for action. "Let's make this happen!!"
CITRON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Citrons shoot powerful balls of plasma.
CLAIM_X_JOUST_FREE_PLAYS_DESC: Claim {COUNT} Arena Free Plays, get gems!
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, explodes in medium area

{FLAVOR}Sure, he's a hairy old man, but Coconut Cannon can still fire on all cylinders. The reason he's so hairy: he's in-between waxings.
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Coconut Cannons fire down a single lane, causing a medium explosion on impact.
COCONUTCANNON_PLANTFOOD: Fires a huge cannonball that pushes the zombies it hits to the right side of the lawn and then explodes.
COCONUTCANNON_TOOLTIP: Tap on the cannon to fire an explosive coconut
COIN_STORE_TEXT: You need more coins.  Choose a package below.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Area: {STAT}slows and damages zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it

{FLAVOR}Cold Snapdragon gets chilly when anyone brings up his cousin Snapdragon. "We just view temperature very differently, and I'd really rather not discuss it," he says. Yikes.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cold Snapdragons breathe icy mist into 6 adjacent tiles.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_TOOLTIP: Breathes icy mist in an area in front of it
COMMUNITY_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_1: Treasure Yetis are overrunning Feastivus! Defeat them to win 100 Cold plant seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_GRAPESHOT_DESC_60: Play with Grapeshot to win 60 Grapeshot seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_INZANITY_DESC: Play a fresh crop of inzane, organically-grown levels and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_TOADSTOOL_DESC_60: Play with Toadstool to win 60 Toadstool seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Conceal-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Dusk Lobber
{STAT}Grimrose
{STAT}Moonflower
{STAT}Murkadamia Nut
{STAT}Nightshade
{STAT}Shadow Peashooter
{STAT}Shadow-shroom

{FLAVOR}Conceal-mint ducks ninja-like out of the party without telling a soul. "Where's Conceal-mint?" ask the other plants. They don't know. Nobody does. Conceal-mint is just that sneaky.
CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Conceal-mints power up all shadow plants on the lawn, drag some number of zombies to their doom, and provide an additional temporary boost to Conceal-mint Family plants.
CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Contain-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Apple Mortar
{STAT}Blover
{STAT}Chili Bean
{STAT}Dazey Chain
{STAT}Fanilla
{STAT}Grave Buster
{STAT}Hurrikale
{STAT}Magnet-shroom
{STAT}Olive Pit
{STAT}Sap-fling
{STAT}Solar Tomato
{STAT}Spring Bean
{STAT}Stallia
{STAT}Stunion
{STAT}Tumbleweed

{FLAVOR}"Go easy, there," says Contain-mint. "No need to be in such a rush all the time. Movement is totally overrated."
CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Contain-mints stun all zombies on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Contain-mint Family plants on the lawn.
CONTINUE_GAME_OR_RESTART: Do you want to continue your current game or restart the level?

DAILY_ACTIVITIES_DESC: Complete Daily Activities for fruitful rewards!
DAILY_QUEST_COMPLETED: All Daily Goals have been completed! Great job!
DAILY_QUEST_COMPLETED_TIMER: New Daily Goals unlock in {VARIABLE HOURS}h {VARIABLE MINUTES}m
DANDELION_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, in order of priority "middle - below - above"
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}may react to certain strong winds

{FLAVOR}"Look," says Dandelion, shaking his head. "I’m not a leprechaun and I’m not a genie. You can blow my seeds off all you want, but I can't make your wish come true. I don’t even know how that rumor got started."
DANDELION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dandelions send explosive seeds down three different lanes, one lane at a time.
DANDELION_TOOLTIP: Attacks multiple lanes, one lane at a time
DANGER_ROOM_COWBOY_TITLE_WELCOME: Welcome to the Big Bad Butte!
DANGER_ROOM_EGYPT_TITLE_WELCOME: Welcome to the Pyramid of Doom!
DANGER_ROOM_FUTURE_TITLE_WELCOME: Welcome to the Terror from Tomorrow!
DANGER_ROOM_HOLLOW_TITLE_WELCOME: Welcome to the Absolute Zero Plateau!
DANGER_ROOM_LOSTCITY_TITLE_WELCOME: Welcome to the Temple of Bloom!
DANGER_ROOM_MODERN_LEVEL_NAME: Highway to the Danger Room - Level {LEVEL_NUMBER}
DANGER_ROOM_MODERN_TITLE_WELCOME: Welcome to Highway to the Danger Room!
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_FLAME_THROWER: Adds a free use of Power Flame
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_FLICK_ZOMBIE: Adds a free use of Power Toss
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_FOURTH_CARD_DESC: Use coins to show fourth choice
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_MOWER_DESC: Restores up to {MOWER_COUNT} missing lawn mowers at the start of the level
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_MOWER_DESC_SINGULAR: Restores one missing lawn mower at the start of the level
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_PLANTFOOD_DESC: Starts you off with {PF_COUNT} extra Plant Foods
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_PLANTFOOD_DESC_SINGUL: Starts you off with an extra Plant Food
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_SNOWBALL: Adds a free use of Power Snow
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_SUN_DESC: Starts you off with an extra {SUN_COUNT} sun
DANGER_ROOM_REWARD_WIZARD_FINGER: Adds a free use of Power Zap
DANGER_ROOM_TITLE_PICK_REWARD: Select a card to add to your progression!
DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}will target stronger specials in its lane before other zombies
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}has a limited supply of darts, then must recharge

{FLAVOR}"Why waste shots on foot soldiers when you can win the battle with one well-chosen dart to the dome?" wonders Dartichoke. "Why would you do it? Why would ANYONE do it?"
DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dartichokes fire high-damage darts down the lane, prioritizing especially dangerous zombies such as Wizards, Octo Zombies, and Fishermen.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}grows and releases stalling gas every fifteen shots, can grow a maximum of twice

{FLAVOR}"I use they/them pronouns," says Dazey Chain. "Duh," they add.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dazey Chains grow through stages, becoming more powerful and releasing a stalling puff of gas at each stage.
DAZEYCHAIN_TOOLTIP: Grows flowers from time to time and stalls zombies
DEFEAT_ALLSTAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their team spirit is too overwhelming!
DEFEAT_ARCADE_REPEATABLE_DESC: Gamers in a game? Too meta!
DEFEAT_BARREL_ROLLER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Barrels are for storing things, not for smushing plants!
DEFEAT_BASICS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Time to get back to basics, and thin out the zombie horde!
DEFEAT_BEACH_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their pompadours and bikinis may be stylish, but they're still brain-eaters!
DEFEAT_BEACH_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE: Defeat Basic Big Wave Beach Zombies!
DEFEAT_BEACH_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Teach these zombies that buckets are for making sand castles.
DEFEAT_BEACH_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Better beat these beach blanket bozos!
DEFEAT_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: They're zombies, but they look like weird crabs! Ick!
DEFEAT_BEACH_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: Half fish, half imp. Entirely gross.
DEFEAT_BLOCKHEAD_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their headgear is simply too geometric!
DEFEAT_BOOMBOX_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their emotions are too raw, too honest!
DEFEAT_BREAKDANCER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their fly moves are simply intolerable!
DEFEAT_BUCKETS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Time to make these zombies kick the bucket!
DEFEAT_BUG_REPEATABLE_DESC: Bug/zombie symbiosis is just too creepy!
DEFEAT_BULLRIDER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They look like bulls, but they're actually robots! GET 'EM!
DEFEAT_BULLY_REPEATABLE_DESC: Bones in beards are questionably fashionable!
DEFEAT_CAMEL_REPEATABLE_DESC: That camel-flauge isn't fooling anyone. Show those zombies they can't hide from you!
DEFEAT_CHICKEN_FARMER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They wrangled just one too many chickens!
DEFEAT_CONES_REPEATABLE_DESC: Practice a little garden safety by culling out Conehead Zombies!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: These cow-punching, boot-wearing ghouls need some good ol' fashioned frontier justice!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: In my day, buckets were for mucking the stables!
DEFEAT_COWBOY_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Send these cone rangers to the pokey!
DEFEAT_CRYSTALSKULL_REPEATABLE_DESC: Those weird skulls shouldn't be able to do what they do!
DEFEAT_DARK_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're not pleasant, they're peasant! And that's terrible!
DEFEAT_DARK_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: They'll never be knights with low-tier equipment like that!
DEFEAT_DARK_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their big stone hammers are clumsy and all too effective!
DEFEAT_DARK_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: These monks ain't funky! Except for their smell.
DEFEAT_DINO_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Zombie like cone. You not a zombie. Crush cone!
DEFEAT_DINO_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their mean little giggles are super unsettling!
DEFEAT_DISCO_MECH_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their 70s disco rhythms don't belong in their far-future era!
DEFEAT_DODO_REPEATABLE_DESC: Who knew dodos could be such jerks?
DEFEAT_EGYPT_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Bare-headed, cone-wearing or bucket-bearing, these basic bandaged brutes have got to go!
DEFEAT_EGYPT_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: These pail-packers need to go pound sand!
DEFEAT_EGYPT_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Don't they have a pyramid to build, or something?
DEFEAT_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Wrap things up by taking care of some Mummified Gargantuars!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're always growling about obscure bands!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BASICS_SCHEDULED_TITLE: Defeat Basic Neon Mixtape Tour Zombies!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DES: They don't know what it means to be a metalhead!
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their traffic cone and denim look is SO out of style.
DEFEAT_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DE: They need to learn at least two chords!
DEFEAT_EXCAVATOR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Shovels just shouldn't be that effective! Punish them!
DEFEAT_EXPANSION_RANDOM_LEVEL_REPEATABLE: Use your leveled-up plants to tackle extra-tough veteran zombies in expert levels! Warning: May Be Tense!
DEFEAT_EXPLORER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Somebody needs to teach these zombies that playing with fire is dangerous. That somebody is you!
DEFEAT_FISHERMAN_REPEATABLE_DESC: Because seriously. These guys. They need to go away.
DEFEAT_FOOTBALL_MECH_REPEATABLE_DESC: How dare they shove your plants like they do?
DEFEAT_FOSSILHEAD_REPEATABLE_DESC: A skull on a head is one skull too many!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: They have shiny jumpsuits and awful, carnivorous intentions!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: They need to upgrade to the zCone 7 anyway.
DEFEAT_FUTURE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: They have telephone poles for arms! TELEPHONE POLES!
DEFEAT_FUTURE_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: They scamper around in creepy little spider-bots! Brrrrrr!
DEFEAT_GARGANTUARS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Take on the big boys by taking out some random Gargantuars!
DEFEAT_GLITTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Roller skates are more of a 70s thing anyway!
DEFEAT_HUNTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Because snowballs are preposterous hunting gear!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: They lack technological sophistication! Punish them for it!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: I've heard of ice buckets, but this is ridiculous!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're all just evolutionary dead ends!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: These lunkheads don't even have the decency to be slothful!
DEFEAT_ICEAGE_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: Unfortunately these yetis are anything but scarce.
DEFEAT_IMPPORTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: How do they pack all those zombies in there? It strains credulity!
DEFEAT_IMPS_REPEATABLE_DESC: These things are just weird. Please get rid of them!
DEFEAT_JETPACK_REPEATABLE_DESC: Why do they get jetpacks? It's so unfair!
DEFEAT_JUGGLER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They're constantly ripping off other funnier zombies' material!
DEFEAT_KING_REPEATABLE_DESC: They refuse to govern with the consent of the governed!
DEFEAT_KNIGHT_REPEATABLE_DESC: They work too hard upholding a regressive feudal system!
DEFEAT_LOST_PILOT_REPEATABLE_DESC: Nobody should have ever issued them a license to fly!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their exploratory efforts are highly questionable!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DES: Buckets. Why did it have to be buckets?
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Impressive mustache or no, these guys have got to go!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DE: They just lug too much stuff around!
DEFEAT_LOSTCITY_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their helmets are just the piths!
DEFEAT_MCZOMBIE_REPEATABLE_DESC: How dare they spin their mics that way!
DEFEAT_MECH_CONE_REPEATABLE_DESC: Robo-cone zombies are too cylindrical to be allowed!
DEFEAT_MODERN_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their contemporary crimes may not be countenanced!
DEFEAT_MODERN_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Make them kick the... well, you know.
DEFEAT_MODERN_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: A traffic cone is a timeless look for a zombie. But you're not a zombie, so smash 'em!
DEFEAT_MODERN_GARGANTUAR_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're really just big softies. Make sure they know that.
DEFEAT_NEWSPAPER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They already threw out the comics section!
DEFEAT_OCTOPUS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Enslaving octopuses for zombie purposes is just not cool!
DEFEAT_PARASOL_REPEATABLE_DESC: Those parasols are just too fancy and expensive!
DEFEAT_PHARAOH_REPEATABLE_DESC: These Pharaohs think that they rule, but they'll never defeat you in a duel!
DEFEAT_PIANO_REPEATABLE_DESC: They can't even read sheet music!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Swab the decks with their leaky headgear!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_REPEATABLE_DESC: Do it before they mutate into Pirate Admiral Zombies!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Cross their crossbones off the list!
DEFEAT_PIRATE_IMP_SCHEDULED_DESC: Turn these cannoneers into cannon fodder!
DEFEAT_PONCHO_REPEATABLE_DESC: What are they hiding under their ponchos? You can never tell!
DEFEAT_PROSPECTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC: And defeat their scruffy prospector beards, too!
DEFEAT_PROTECTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC: E.M.Peaches make short work of these technological terrors!
DEFEAT_PUNK_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their jackets and boots have too many spikes!
DEFEAT_RA_REPEATABLE_DESC: Ra Zombies are out to soak up your sun - time to make them ancient history!
DEFEAT_RELICHUNTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Teach them it's better to leave relics where they are!
DEFEAT_SEAGULL_REPEATABLE_DESC: How can a seagull that small carry a zombie? It's ridiculous!
DEFEAT_SNORKEL_REPEATABLE_DESC: They wear snorkels when they don't even need to breathe!
DEFEAT_SURFER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They're throwing away a perfectly good post-secondary education!
DEFEAT_SWASHBUCKLER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Who do they think they are, buckling those swashes?
DEFEAT_TOMB_RAISER_REPEATABLE_DESC: It's time for these Tomb Raisers to learn that messing with you was a grave mistake!
DEFEAT_TREASURE_YETI_REPEATABLE_DESC: What secrets are contained within its lunchbox? Only one way to find out!
DEFEAT_TROGLOBITE_REPEATABLE_DESC: That iceblock-shoving trick of theirs is way over the line.
DEFEAT_WEASELHOARDER_REPEATABLE_DESC: Who hoards weasels inside a log? WHO???
DEFEAT_WEST_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Get them before they get you!
DEFEAT_WIZARD_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their dark transformative powers must not be abided!

ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Electric Blueberry prides herself on being eclectic as well as electric. "I like to keep 'em guessing," she says. "A zombie should always be like, 'Whoa, didn't see that coming,' when it's disintegrated."
ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Blueberries randomly electrocute zombies every so often.
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}area effect (electric fence)

{FLAVOR}"Electricity is all very well and fine as a phenomenon," says Electric Currant, "but electromagnetism as a whole is where it's really at."
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Currants create electrical fences between ones planted on the same row or column.
ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Dipping tea bags into a cup of water has always been the way to prepare your tea, but doing so with him might not be such a good idea. Actually, just don't consume Electrici-tea in general.
ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electrici-teas wait and emit zaps of electrical energy until they are eaten, at which point the eating zombies explode in a flurry of electrical discharges.
ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Electric Peashooter expects resistance, but he doesn't want to ohm anybody.
ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Peashooters fire pea-like orbs that pass through zombies and crackle with electrical power, doing damage all the while.
EMPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Has grown tired of people lazily calling him E.M. Pea. "There's a C and H there for a reason people! And I've got the stone to prove it!"
EMPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: E.M.Peaches explode and disable all machines in an area.
EMPEA_TOOLTIP: Disables all machines in an area

ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"When other plants talk about me, they say I’m too gruff. They say I’m difficult to approach, that I’m afraid to let others get too close to me. Also, I smell terrible," said Endurian. But deep down inside, he knows that he’s so much more than that. He’s also short-tempered.
ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Endurians are defensive plants that deal damage to zombies attacking them.
ENDURIAN_TOOLTIP: Defends while dealing damage to zombies attacking it.

ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap Escape Root and another plant to swap them
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't swap with endangered plants

{FLAVOR}The other plants put on a big surprise party for Escape Root last week, but he did his thing and suddenly it was a surprise party... FOR THEM!
ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Escape Roots explode upon being crushed, and can be swapped with other plants that are in danger.
ESCAPEROOT_TOOLTIP: Sturdy and can be swapped with other plants
EVENTS_HINT_1: Having trouble? Boosts from the Zen Garden can help you defeat hordes!
EVENTS_HINT_2: If a level is becoming too troubling, be sure to obtain more powerful plants!
EVENTS_HINT_3: Remember to bring plants that suit the threats you're facing!
EXIT_DANGER_ROOM_BODY: Are you sure that you want to leave? Doing so will reset the current level layout.
EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"My only regret," says Explode-O-Nut, "is that I have but one chewy center full of nitroglycerine to give in defense of this lawn."
EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Explode-O-Nuts provide protection, and when their shells are eaten, they explode to blow up zombies.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{FLAVOR}
Explode-O-Vine is sooooooooooooooo ready to explode. Just ridiculously ready. He's got the color picked out and everything.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Explode-O-Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide protection, detonate an explosion with knockback when planted, and then another explosion when eaten.
EXPLODEOVINE_TOOLTIP: Protects a plant inside, explodes and knocks back

FINISH_BEACH_1_DESC: It's no day at the beach without Lily Pads! They let you plant on water! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 1!
FINISH_BEACH_11_DESC: Bowling Bulb rolls bulbs down rows to bop, bounce and bash multiple zombies! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 11!
FINISH_BEACH_16_DESC: Abolish the atrocious Gargantuar of Big Wave Beach Day 16 to earn yourself a dandy Frostbite Caves Key!
FINISH_BEACH_19_DESC: Guacodile shoots, swims, and charges forward on defeat! REVENGE! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 19!
FINISH_BEACH_20_DESC: TIKI-TORCHER! Paste perennial partying zombies and earn rewards in this beachside bash! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 20!
FINISH_BEACH_27_DESC: Banana Launcher dispenses justice by launching missiles anywhere on the board! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 27!
FINISH_BEACH_32_DESC: Quash the querulous Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this surfing struggle on Big Wave Beach Day 32!
FINISH_BEACH_6_DESC: Run silent, run deep. Tangle Kelp drags marine zombies to a watery grave! Complete Big Wave Beach Day 6!
FINISH_COWBOY_1_DESC: Sneaky zombies creeping up from behind? Split Pea shoots forward AND back! Complete Wild West Day 1!
FINISH_COWBOY_11_DESC: Sun Shovel! Get an additional 25% of sun cost back when shoveling up plants! Complete Wild West Day 11!
FINISH_COWBOY_12_DESC: Melon-pult flings heavy damage melons down a lane, hitting groups of zombies! Complete Wild West Day 12!
FINISH_COWBOY_15_DESC: Wall-nut First Aid: Fully repair damaged defensive plants by planting on top of them! Complete Wild West Day 15!
FINISH_COWBOY_18_DESC: Tall-Nut totally frustrates flying and hopping zombies! Serves 'em right! Complete Wild West Day 18!
FINISH_COWBOY_20_DESC: Instant Recharge: Instantly refresh a seed packet by dragging and dropping Plant Food on it! Complete Wild West Day 20!
FINISH_COWBOY_24_DESC: Winter Melon hits groups of zombies, deals heavy damage AND chills them out! Complete Wild West Day 24!
FINISH_COWBOY_25_DESC: Attack the awful Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this desert duel on Wild West Day 25!
FINISH_COWBOY_3_DESC: BIG BAD BUTTE! Engage endless zombies and earn rewards in this frontier fracas! Complete Wild West Day 3!
FINISH_COWBOY_4_DESC: Chili Bean destroys a zombie and stuns the group behind it! Complete Wild West Day 4!
FINISH_COWBOY_6_DESC: Pile up Pea Pods for massive firepower! Complete Wild West Day 6!
FINISH_COWBOY_8_DESC: Crush the monstrous Gargantuar of Wild West Day 8 to earn a time-tearing Far Future Key!
FINISH_COWBOY_9_DESC: Lightning Reed shocks multiple foes at high speeds and adjacent lanes! Great for frying chickens! Complete Wild West Day 9!
FINISH_DARK_1_DESC: Cheap lil' Sun-shrooms emit ever-growing piles of sun! Radiant! Complete Dark Ages Day 1!
FINISH_DARK_10_DESC: Maul the medieval Gargantuar of Dark Ages Night 10 to earn yet another impossible Big Wave Beach Key!
FINISH_DARK_12_DESC: ARTHUR'S CHALLENGE! Punish primitive zombies to earn rewards in a forever feudal feud! Complete Dark Ages Day 12!
FINISH_DARK_15_DESC: Ug, metal! So annoying! Attract buckets and helmets away with Magnet Shroom! Complete Dark Ages Day 15!
FINISH_DARK_2_DESC: How about a quick little shooter that costs ZERO sun? Puff-shroom it is! Complete Dark Ages Day 2!
FINISH_DARK_20_DESC: Hamper the heinous Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this tenth-century titlecard on Dark Ages Day 20!
FINISH_DARK_4_DESC: Fume-shroom sprays all zombies in an area. Take that, clumps of zombies! Complete Dark Ages Day 4!
FINISH_DARK_6_DESC: What if zombies spat out sun as they took damage? Sun Bean makes it happen! Complete Dark Ages Day 6!
FINISH_DINO_1_DESC: Primal Peashooters sling serious smack with heavy, stunning peas! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 1!
FINISH_DINO_16_DESC: Annihilate the antediluvian Gargantuars of Jurassic Marsh Day 16 to earn a shiny Modern Day Key!
FINISH_DINO_17_DESC: Primal Sunflowers emit big, big suns! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 17!
FINISH_DINO_20_DESC: LA BRAINSA TARPITS! Face dinosaurs and prehistoric zombies in this bygone battle! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 20!
FINISH_DINO_23_DESC: Blast zombies with starchy goodness, courtesy of the Primal Potato Mine! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 23!
FINISH_DINO_32_DESC: Frustrate the feverish Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in the swampy strife of Jurassic Marsh, Day 32!
FINISH_DINO_4_DESC: Build up defenses quickly with the fast-planting Primal Wall-nut! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 4!
FINISH_DINO_8_DESC: Charm dinosaurs and sic 'em on the zombies with Perfume-shroom! Complete Jurassic Marsh Day 8!
FINISH_EGYPT_12_DESC: PYRAMID OF DOOM! Bash zombies for rewards in this endless Egyptian survival mode! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 12!
FINISH_EGYPT_13_DESC: Bonk Choy: this pugilisitic plant beats zombies up AND backwards! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 13!
FINISH_EGYPT_17_DESC: Plant Food Slot: hold onto one more Plant Food during a level! Always handy! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 17!
FINISH_EGYPT_19_DESC: Why shoot one pea when you can shoot two for twice the firepower with Repeater? Complete Ancient Egypt Day 19!
FINISH_EGYPT_2_DESC: Lob cabbages over gravestones for a long-distance surprise! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 2!
FINISH_EGYPT_21_DESC: Starting Sun Boost: start your day right with 25 extra sun in the bank every level! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 21!
FINISH_EGYPT_24_DESC: Sun-starved? Twin Sunflowers burp up twice the sun per square! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 24!
FINISH_EGYPT_25_DESC: Defeat the diabolical Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this bygone battle on Ancient Egypt Day 25!
FINISH_EGYPT_3_DESC: Whip boomerangs through several foes at once for double-dealing damage! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 3!
FINISH_EGYPT_5_DESC: Iceberg Lettuce freezes zombies in their tracks! So cool! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 5!
FINISH_EGYPT_7_DESC: Play more Ancient Egypt levels to unlock more plants!
FINISH_EGYPT_8_DESC: Defeat the hideous Gargantuar of Ancient Egypt Day 8 to earn a time-leaping Pirate Seas Key!
FINISH_EGYPT_9_DESC: Crumble gravestones instantly with Grave Buster! Complete Ancient Egypt Day 9!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_1_DESC: Phat Beet brings the rhythm and doles out damage all around! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 1!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_16_DESC: Mangle the musical Gargantuar of Neon Mixtape Tour Day 16 to earn a righteous Jurassic Marsh Key!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_17_DESC: Use Garlic for all your lane-diversion needs! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 17!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_20_DESC: GREATEST HITS: Rap rhythmic zombies and earn rewards in this melodic mashup! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 20!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_21_DESC: Spore-shrooms make more-shrooms! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 21!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_26_DESC: Revive eaten plants with the indomitable Intensive Carrot! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 26!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_32_DESC: Irritate the irascible Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in the operatic onslaught of Neon Mixtape Tour 32!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_5_DESC: Sneaky Celery Stalker hides underground, then pops up to smack zombies from behind! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day Day 5!
FINISH_EIGHTIES_9_DESC: Want to rewind zombies back to their starting position? Then let's do the Thyme Warp again! Complete Neon Mixtape Tour Day 9!
FINISH_FUTURE_1_DESC: Laser Bean's gaze pierces all zombies on a lane with each shot! ZAP! Complete Far Future Day 1!
FINISH_FUTURE_13_DESC: Infi-Nut regenerates over time and blocks all rows with Plant Food! Astounding! Complete Far Future Day 13!
FINISH_FUTURE_17_DESC: Fun with Sun! Spend sun on powerful blasts with Magnifying Grass. Complete Far Future Day 17!
FINISH_FUTURE_20_DESC: Mower Launcher: manually launch one mower by tapping and holding! Clear 'em out! Complete Far Future Day 20!
FINISH_FUTURE_24_DESC: Power Tiles boost your Plant Food effects. Create 'em with Tile Turnip! Complete Far Future Day 24!
FINISH_FUTURE_25_DESC: Deny the devious Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this someday struggle on Far Future Day 25!
FINISH_FUTURE_3_DESC: Use Blover to blow away all airborne enemies on the board in one big WHOOOSH! Complete Far Future Day 3!
FINISH_FUTURE_4_DESC: TERROR FROM TOMORROW! Tackle technological zombies in an infinite impending imbroglio! Complete Far Future Day 4!
FINISH_FUTURE_6_DESC: Citron deals overwhelming damage to one target at a time. Gargantuars beware! Complete Far Future Day 6!
FINISH_FUTURE_8_DESC: Face the furious Gargantuar of Far Future Day 8 to earn a realm-jumping Dark Ages Key!
FINISH_FUTURE_9_DESC: Use E.M.Peach to stun all robotic and mechanical zombies in an area! Complete Far Future Day 9!
FINISH_ICEAGE_1_DESC: Freezing wind got you down? Hot Potato breaks the ice! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 1!
FINISH_ICEAGE_11_DESC: Hold the line, or better yet, push 'em back! Chard Guard is on the case. Complete Frostbite Caves Day 11!
FINISH_ICEAGE_16_DESC: Attack the abominable Gargantuar of Frostbite Caves Day 16 to earn a sector-shifting Lost City Key!
FINISH_ICEAGE_19_DESC: Need to stun some zombies in place for a while? Stunion is ON IT! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 19!
FINISH_ICEAGE_20_DESC: ICEBOUND BATTLEGROUND! Fracture frigid zombies in this ongoing glacial gambit! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 20!
FINISH_ICEAGE_26_DESC: Rotobaga flies, floats and fires in four fabulous directions! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 26.
FINISH_ICEAGE_30_DESC: Confound the corrupt Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this cryogenic conflict on Frostbite Caves Day 30!
FINISH_ICEAGE_6_DESC: Fight ice with fire. Pepper-pult melts ice and lobs hot blobs over obstacles! Complete Frostbite Caves Day 6!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_1_DESC: Red Stingers shoot powerfully close to home and become more defensive further away! Complete Lost City Day 1!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_10_DESC: The best offense is a good defense? How about both! Endurian blocks AND damages foes! Complete Lost City Day 10!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_16_DESC: Dash the dastardly Gargantuar of Lost City Day 16 to earn an era-expanding Neon Mixtape Tour Key!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_19_DESC: Stallia slows down zombies with a burst of fragrant perfume! Complete Lost City Day 19!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_20_DESC: TEMPLE OF BLOOM! Eradicate exploring zombies in this perpetual party of botanical battle! Complete Lost City Day 20!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_26_DESC: Gold Leaf turns regular boring tiles into exciting sun-generating Gold Tiles! Complete Lost City Day 26!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_32_DESC: Pester the pernicious Dr. Zomboss in the adventurous arena of Lost City Day 32!
FINISH_LOSTCITY_6_DESC: A.K.E.E. lobs shots that bounce off of several foes down a lane. Heads up, zombies! Complete Lost City Day 6!
FINISH_MODERN_1_DESC: Boost shadow plants with the lunar lunacy of Moonflower! Complete Modern Day Day 1!
FINISH_MODERN_10_DESC: Poison zombies with the shadowy toxicity of Shadow-shroom! Complete Modern Day Day 10!
FINISH_MODERN_16_DESC: Upbraid the up-to-date Gargantuars of Modern Day Day 16, to earn a shiny Holiday Mashup Key!
FINISH_MODERN_17_DESC: Fling explosive nuggets at hungry zombies with Dusk-Lobber! Complete Modern Day Day 17!
FINISH_MODERN_20_DESC: HIGHWAY TO THE DANGER ROOM! Tangle with temporal titans in this neverending nexus! Complete Modern Day Day 20!
FINISH_MODERN_20_TITLE: Unlock Highway to the Danger Room!
FINISH_MODERN_23_DESC: Drag zombies to their deserved doom with the Grimrose! Complete Modern Day Day 23!
FINISH_MODERN_34_DESC: Defy the devilish Dr. Zomboss and earn your reward in the climactic clash of Modern Day Day 34!
FINISH_MODERN_4_DESC: Deal major slaps with the shadow Nightshade! Complete Modern Day Day 4!
FINISH_PIRATE_1_DESC: Can Kernel-pult deal damage AND stun zombies? You'd butter believe it! Complete Pirate Seas Day 1!
FINISH_PIRATE_11_DESC: BOOM! Clear entire groups of zombies with each explosive shot from Coconut Cannon! Complete Pirate Seas Day 11!
FINISH_PIRATE_14_DESC: Threepeater shoots down three lanes at once to triple your offensive firepower! Complete Pirate Seas Day 14!
FINISH_PIRATE_18_DESC: Spikerock: Strong enough to stand up to a Gargantuar, sharp enough to de-feet zombies! Complete Pirate Seas Day 18!
FINISH_PIRATE_21_DESC: Extra Seed Slot: Carry more plants into the fray! More seed slots mean more options! Complete Pirate Seas Day 21!
FINISH_PIRATE_24_DESC: Cherry Bomb's overwhelming blast fries whole groups of foes across lanes! Complete Pirate Seas Day 24!
FINISH_PIRATE_25_DESC: Hammer the hateful Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this saltwater scrap on Pirate Seas Day 25!
FINISH_PIRATE_3_DESC: Heat things up with Snapdragon's fiery attacks that hit multiple lanes at a time! Complete Pirate Seas Day 3!
FINISH_PIRATE_4_DESC: DEAD MAN'S BOOTY! Endless adventures on the high seas await your command! Complete Pirate Seas Day 4!
FINISH_PIRATE_6_DESC: Damage zombies and bust barrels with the indomitable Spikeweed! Complete Pirate Seas Day 6!
FINISH_PIRATE_8_DESC: Smash the appalling Gargantuar of Pirate Seas Day 8 to earn a zone-hopping Wild West Key!
FINISH_PIRATE_9_DESC: Swashbuckler got you on the ropes? Use Spring Bean to knock 'em back to Davy Jones' locker! Complete Pirate Seas Day 9!
FIREPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}has a chance to shoot a plasma pea
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost 
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Fire Peashooter knows that what she does looks exciting. But working with an open flame is serious and, more importantly, dangerous business.  That's why, in her spare time, she talks to children about the importance of fire safety. "I'm a trained professional," she explains. "Don't try this at home, kids."
FIREPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fire Peashooters shoot flaming peas down the lane.
FIREPEASHOOTER_PLANTFOOD: Throws a line of flame down the lane, damaging all zombies in it.
FIREPEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP: Shoots flaming peas and warms nearby plants
FORCE_RESTORE_PURCHASES_BODY: This item has been purchased before. Restore Purchases will allow you to claim all of your past purchases in any profile.
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"I think of myself as a pretty confident shroom and an all-around fungi," says Fume-shroom. "But sometimes, when I'm eating Plant Food, I hear them chuckling. I hear them calling me 'Balloon-shroom'. I don't think they know how much that hurts."
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that damage all zombies in an area.
FUMESHROOM_TOOLTIP: Shoots fumes that can damage all zombies in an area
GAMECENTER_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: You must connect to Game Center outside the PvZ2 app to access achievements and leaderboards.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't affect mechanical zombies

{FLAVOR}Good against zombies, as well as proof against any vampires who might accidentally wander by.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Garlic diverts zombies into other lanes.
GEMS_STORE_TEXT: Need more gems? Choose a package below.
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates when zombie is close
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}targets zombies that are 2 tiles ahead or behind it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}You might not know it looking at her, but Ghost Pepper didn't always wear that white sheet everywhere she went. She first put it on as a lark for a Halloween party one year. Everyone else had these elaborate costumes, and she thought it would be funny to dress like a plain ol' ghost. But she fell in love with that costume. It spoke to her. She'd found her calling.
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ghost Peppers haunt zombies that pass by and explode after a limited time.
GHOSTPEPPER_TOOLTIP: Haunts all zombies that pass by and explodes after a limited time
GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powers shadow plants inside them

{FLAVOR}Gloom Vine's gloomy exterior shouldn't be seen as implying a gloomy interior. His interior is gloomy, but for complicated personal reasons that go way back.
GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gloom Vines power individual shadow plants and shoot zombie-damaging gloom in eight directions.
GLOOMVINE_TOOLTIP: Shoots in 8 directions and shadow-boosts a plant inside of it
GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"Your botanists were so preoccupied with whether they could," says Gold Bloom, about nothing and to nobody in particular, "they didn't stop to think if they should."
GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gold Blooms produce a burst of sun all at once.
GOLDBLOOM_TOOLTIP: Gives an instant burst of sun
GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"For a small initial investment, you too can generate huge sun," says Gold Leaf. She’s a firm believer in solar markets.
GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gold Leaves create a Gold Tile on planting.
GOOGLE_PLAY_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: You must connect to Google Play to access achievements and leaderboards.
GOT_A_POWERUP: You got a new POWER UP!
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_COMPLETIONIST_BODY_TEXT: You already have all your keys!
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_MIDPLAYER_BODY_TEXT: You just got keys for all the worlds! Check them out!
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_NEWPLAYER_BODY_TEXT: You shouldn't be seeing this message, it is only for older players.
GRANT_WORLDKEYS_TITLE_TEXT: Hey, time traveler! Here’s all the world keys.
GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"Spa-BOOM!" enthuses Grapeshot. "You like that? I got a million of 'em! Wa-POW!  Buh-BLAM! Za-... um... Ker-... hmmm... Okay, I guess I've only got the three."
GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grapeshots explode and scatter bouncing projectiles in eight directions.
GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}removes graves and varying objects

{FLAVOR}He may appear spiky or ill-tempered, but Grave Buster just wants to give you a big hug. Unless you're a puppy. He's terrified of those.
GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grave Busters consume graves they're planted on.
GRAVEBUSTER_TOOLTIP: Plant it on a grave to remove the grave
GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE_DESCRIPTION: Disperse {COUNT} single-use Boost Tiles every {TIME} seconds!
GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE3_DESCRIPTION: Disperse {COUNT} three-use Boost Tile every {TIME} seconds!
GRID_IS_YOURS_PFTOMBSTONE_DESCRIPTION: Spawn {COUNT} Plant Food Gravestone every {TIME} seconds!
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Grimroses can drag 3 zombies before expiring

{FLAVOR}"When you think about it, the proper place for a zombie is in the ground," says Grimrose. "So, really, I'm just expediting the process."
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grimroses are shadow plants that behave like landbound Tangle Kelps, dragging zombies into the dirt.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}plant is lost after rushing attack
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on water

{FLAVOR}Ask Guacodile to tell you a little bit about himself and he'll give you a wry smile. "I'm a Guacodile. I've got a bite like a bear trap. I spit rock-hard pits with a force, speed and accuracy envied by every plant on the battlefield. Heck, I've been known to walk on water. I'm pretty much the whole enchilada." Yeah, the guy is a bit of a braggart but he’s good at what he does.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Guacodiles fire seeds from a distance. When attacked they will rush off the lawn biting any zombies they encounter.
GUACODILE_TOOLTIP: Shoots seeds, will rush all zombies ahead of him when attacked
GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stronger zombies form stronger barriers
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}best used against Gargantuars & Football Mechs

{FLAVOR}"I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."
GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can attack ahead or behind

{FLAVOR}Headbutter Lettuce was recently outed during a "truth or dare" game gone wrong. The entire plant world is still recovering from the shambles that Headbutter Lettuce's dark secret has left it in. "You won't believe it," he said, "This isn't butter. It's margarine."
HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Headbutter Lettuces bash zombies in front and behind while occasionally buttering zombies.
HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can target from anywhere on the lawn

{FLAVOR}Heath Seekers have always believed that the shortest distance between two points is an elaborately curved path that passes through several zombies and also looks pretty. Needless to say, they're struggling in geometry class.
HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Heath Seekers are instant-use plants that burst into a storm of homing, piercing darts.
HEATHSEEKER_TOOLTIP: Storms out a group of homing darts
hes_got_your_back: He’s got your back – and front!
HOCUS_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Observe," says Hocus Crocus. "Have I anything up my sleeve? Do I even have sleeves? No? Prepare, then, to have your quaint and old-fashioned notions of spatial location SHATTERED FOREVER!!!"
HOCUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hocus Crocuses use slick sleight-of-petal chicanery to magic zombies close to your home all the way back to the rightmost part of the lawn.
HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire, can fire up to 3 barriers
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}projectile knocks back, does damage, leaves barrier on empty tiles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks flying zombies

{FLAVOR}Holly Barrier would like to advise folks not to eat his berries. "It's rude to eat somebody's berries without asking," he says. "In addition, they are highly toxic."
HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Holly Barrier deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
HOLLYKNIGHT_TOOLTIP: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}regenerates health over time

{FLAVOR}As a young nut he spent way too much time standing between two mirrors and trying to look into infinity.
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Infi-nuts are weaker than Wall-nuts, but they can regain health over time.
HOLONUT_TOOLTIP: A weaker Wall-nut that regains health over time
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Don't even think about trying to pull one over on Homing Thistle. He's got a bead on you. He sees right through your facade. It's like he has a laser beam ... aimed at your soul.
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Homing Thistles fire seeking shots at targets that are the closest to home.
HOMINGTHISTLE_TOOLTIP: Attacks farthest left target in any lane
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}explosion damage pierces through zombie armor
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Hot Date's a charmer. He's polite, well-read, has lots of interesting opinions, and practices active listening. Zombies line up around the block to be incinerated by him.
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hot Dates attract zombies from lanes above and below them, and then unleash a lane of flame when they're eaten.
HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}melts an ice block or octopus

{FLAVOR}How does Hot Potato stay so positive and even-peeled all the time? Yoga, that’s how. She never misses a class. Also, regular meditation. It's the only way she can handle the hard work of fighting zombies, day in and day out, without melting down.
HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks or octopi they’re planted on.
HOTPOTATO_TOOLTIP: Plant it on ice blocks and octopi to melt them
HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}chills affected zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows away flying zombies in lane

{FLAVOR}You could say Hurrikale is a "blow hard" in the truest sense of the phrase. He is the first chair trombonist in the Biennial Philharmonic Orchestra. He is also proficient in the trumpet, saxophone and the tuba. But man o' man, you should really see him on the flugelhorn. Dude absolutely kills it.
HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hurrikales push back all zombies in their lane with a chilling wind.
HURRIKALE_TOOLTIP: Blows a chilling wind that pushes back zombies in lane
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten

{FLAVOR}Hypno-shroom has no trouble persuading zombies to fight on behalf of the plants. But he has yet to convince one to cluck like a chicken. "One day," he says. "One day."
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: When zombies eat Hypno-shrooms, they will turn around and fight for you.
HYPNOSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Makes a zombie fight for you
ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}weak zombies in 3x3 area are iceblocked when defeated

{FLAVOR}Even though Ice Bloom got the freezing zombies gig from her old college roommate, Ice-shroom, after he retired from the zombie-fighting life, she insisted that what she's doing with her role on the battlefield is totally different. She's not just some imposter or a sub-standard replacement, darn it! She's her own plant, and she wishes her peers would see her that way.
ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ice Blooms freeze, chill, and damage all zombies on the board, and more so in a 3x3 area around where they’re planted.
ICEBLOOM_TOOLTIP: Freezes all zombies on the lawn, turns weak ones into defensive ice blocks
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact

{FLAVOR}Don't get lost staring into Iceberg's adorably cute eyes. If you do, it will be your last step... but only if you're a zombie.
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iceberg Lettuces freeze a zombie when stepped on.
ICEBURG_PLANTFOOD: Flash freezes all zombies on the lawn.
ICEBURG_TOOLTIP: Freezes zombies that step on it, and extinguishes flames
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}crushed by rolling zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}main attack becomes more powerful after being fed Plant Food

{FLAVOR}Iceweed is excited to get the call-up to the big leagues and can't wait to start refrigerating zombies whilst inflicting damage on them. He insisted we say "whilst."
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iceweeds damage and chill zombies that walk over them.
ICEWEED_TOOLTIP: Damages and chills zombies that step on it
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_INTRO_TEXT: We have detected multiple different identities associated with you. On the following screen please review the data with each identity and select which one you would like to proceed with.
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_SAVE_FAILURE: Identity save has failed. Please check your internet connection and try again.
IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_WARNING_TEXT: Are you sure you would like to proceed with this identity? This will be the permanent identity associated with you. All Arena Winstreak, Arena League, and Adventure progress will be lost on other identities.
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can imitate any other plant 

{FLAVOR}Having studied French Theater at Julienne, the Imitater went to the streets with his art, and has perfected his technique he calls "Potato stuck in a box."
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Imitaters let you use two of the same plant during a level!
IMITATER_PLANTFOOD: Performs Plant Food effect of the plant it's imitating.
IMITATER_TOOLTIP: Lets you have two of the same plant
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten

{FLAVOR}Imp Pear impairs zombies. Of course, Imps don’t appreciate this characterization, but who cares?
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: When zombies eat Imp Pears, they become Imps. When Imps eat Imp Pears, they are destroyed, releasing stunning gas.
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Inferno doesn't feel like he gets enough credit. "Of course I burn zombies," he fumes. "That's a given. But what about how I sweep them down the lane through the sheer force of hot air? Where's my prize for that?"
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Infernos swirl up devastating fire tornados that sweep zombies back, burning and damaging them.
INFERNO_TOOLTIP: Shoots tornadoes that burn and push back zombies
INFLICT_CONDITION_ASH_DESC: Use Cherry Bombs, Lightning Reeds, Jalapenos and more to incinerate ghastly ghouls!
INFLICT_CONDITION_DELAY_COUNT_LABEL: Butter, Sap or Stall Zombies {ACTIONS_LEFT} Times!
INFLICT_CONDITION_ELECTROCUTE_DESC: Use Lightning Reeds, Electric Blueberries and more to zap zealous zombies!
INFLICT_CONDITION_KNOCKBACK_DESC: Use Primal Peashooter, Chard Guard, Hurrikale and more to bounce back pesky zombies!
INFLICT_CONDITION_REFRIGERATE_DESC: Use Winter Melons, Iceberg Lettuce, Snow Peas and more to chill, freeze and otherwise cool down the undead!
INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"How do I revive defeated plants?" asks Intensive Carrot. "In a word: vitamins. Vitamins and sorcery."
INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Intensive Carrots bring eaten plants back to life.
INTENSIVECARROT_TOOLTIP: Brings eaten plants back to life
jackolantern_back_for_limited_time: Jack o' Lantern is back for a limited time!
JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fire recharges over time
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}"Boo! Mwah-ha-ha-haaaaah," opines Jack O' Lantern. Oh, yes. Things and stuff are scheduled to be seriously spooky when he's around. Count on it.
JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Jack O’ Lanterns spray fire down a lane, doing extensive burning damage over a short distance.
JACKOLANTERN_TOOLTIP: Fires jets of flame over a short distance
JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}This jalapeno is one spicy character by day and The Macramé Vigilante by night. You might be wondering what his secret weapon is... it's knots.
JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Jalapenos destroy an entire lane of zombies.
JALAPENO_TOOLTIP: Destroys an entire lane of zombies
JOUST_DOWN_FOR_MAINTENANCE: Oops! Arena is down for maintenance! Come back in 5 to 10 minutes!
JOUST_DOWN_FOR_SERVER_STABILITY: Oops! Arena is down for maintenance! Come back in 5 to 10 minutes!
JOUST_EXIT_DESCRIPTION: If you stop now you will lose this match.
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_1_DESCRIPTION: Defeat zombies to score points. Score more than your opponent before time runs out to win!
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_2_DESCRIPTION: Zombies get more difficult and more valuable as you defeat them quickly. The further from your house they fall, the more you'll score!
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_3_DESCRIPTION: Winning Arena matches rewards Crowns. Earn as many Crowns as you can to climb to the top of your leaderboard!
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_4_DESCRIPTION: Place in the top ranks of your leaderboard for a promotion into a more competitive league with better rewards, and more challenging opponents.
JOUST_HOWTOPLAY_5_DESCRIPTION: Crowns from Arena matches also unlock Season prizes.
JOUST_NEED_CONNECTION: Connect to the Internet for Arena
JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TICKETS: A free Gauntlet for Arena is now available!
JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_BEGIN: A new Arena tournament has begun. Aim for the top!
JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_ENDED: The Arena tournament has ended. Log in to collect your rewards!
JOUST_NOTIFICATION_TOURNAMENT_ENDING: The Arena tournament is ending soon, secure your ranking!
JOUST_POINT_OF_LOSS_CALL_TO_ACTION: Would you like to add more time to beat this score?
JOUST_POINT_OF_LOSS_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: {TIME} seconds have been added to the clock.  Good luck!
JOUST_RESULTS_WINSTREAK_CALL_TO_ACTION: Win multiple games in a row, earn rewards!
JOUST_REWARD_STREAK_RETENTION_CALL_TO_AC: You lost, but you can still save your reward streak for the next match!
JOUST_TOURNAMENT_LEAGUE_REWARDS_DESCRIPT: Collect the most Crowns in your league and win the tournament!
Challengers who place in the top 3 each tournament move up a league, while the bottom 3 move down a league.
JOUST_TOURNAMENT_PLACEMENT_RESULT_FTUE: Here are 5 Gauntlets to help you get started!
JOUST_UPDATE_AVAILABLE: A new Arena update is available. Update now!
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}butter immobilizes zombies

{FLAVOR}While working as an usher at the local movieplex, he saw "Fried Green Tomatoes" and found his higher calling. He packed up his husks, his kernels, his butter, and enlisted.
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and butter at zombies.
KERNELPULT_PLANTFOOD: Triggers a butter storm that stuns every zombie on the lawn for a few seconds.
KERNELPULT_TOOLTIP: Flings corn kernels and butter at zombies
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}knocks back zombies 1 tile during growth, can only grow twice

{FLAVOR}"I like to keep an even keel," says Kiwibeast. "But zombies... oooh... zombies make me so mad! And when I get mad... RARRRRRGGG!"
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Kiwibeasts emit damaging thumps, and become bigger and more powerful the more they are hurt by zombies.
KIWIBEAST_TOOLTIP: Becomes more powerful as it takes damage
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}After a laser eye surgery had gone horribly right, Laser Bean gained a sense of purpose and a new-found affinity for competitive staring contests.
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Laser Beans fire down a lane, hitting all zombies ahead of it.
LASER_BEAN_TOOLTIP: Shoots a laser that pierces through zombies
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}erupts, damaging nearby zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates a burning lava pool in its tile
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants
 
{FLAVOR}Lava Guava frowns with barely-repressed rage. He’s trying to keep it in check. He’s trying so hard. But one day some zombie’s going to push him too far, and he can’t be held responsible for the consequences.
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lava Guavas erupt, creating a lava pool that burns zombies.
LAVAGUAVA_TOOLTIP: Erupts and leaves behind a burning lava pool
LEAVE_DANGER_ROOM_GAME: Do you want to return to the world map? Leaving will count as a loss and you will need to restart this level.

LEVEL_OF_THE_DAY_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: You must complete Ancient Egypt - Day 5 before you can start the event.
LEVELUPQUEST_BLOOMERANG_DESC: Take a high-level Bloomerang out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_BLOOMERANG_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Bloomerang for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_CABBAGEPULT_DESC: Take a high-level Cabbage-pult out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_CABBAGEPULT_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Cabbage-pult for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_GENERIC_DESC: Take a high-level power plant out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_GENERIC_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Plant for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_KERNELPULT_DESC: Take a high-level Kernel-pult out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_KERNELPULT_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Kernel-pult for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_PEASHOOTER_DESC: Take a high-level Peashooter out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_PEASHOOTER_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Peashooter for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_REPEATER_DESC: Take a high-level Repeater out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_REPEATER_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Repeater for Free!
LEVELUPQUEST_SUNFLOWER_DESC: Take a high-level Sunflower out for a spin!
LEVELUPQUEST_SUNFLOWER_TITLE: Try a Leveled-Up Sunflower for Free!
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}This may come as a shock, but Lightning Reed has a serious passion for ham radio. His call sign is El3ctric H1ccup. You can tune in every Tuesday to hear him read the classics to elderly plants. This week: Seeds and Sensibility.
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lightning Reeds shoot lightning at the nearest zombie up to one lane away. The bolt will then arc and hit other zombies.
LIGHTNINGREED_PLANTFOOD: Launches a cloud that travels around the lawn, zapping zombies with lightning as it hovers over them.
LIGHTNINGREED_TOOLTIP: Zaps several chickens or zombies per strike
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}can also be planted under non-aquatic plants

{FLAVOR}Not many people know this, but Lily Pad absolutely loves square dancing. There he is, a circular plant gliding across the dance floor making squares. He loves how it pushes his boundaries and really makes him think outside the sphere.
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lily Pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.

LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_1: Leave spaces in the back columns for bigger shooters.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_10: Thrown Imps tend to land in the same spots.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_11: Zombies of a world can be defeated by plants of that world.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_12: Stop or slow early zombies to give more time to generate sun.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_13: Build sun production as fast and early as you can.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_14: Replace sun producers with offensive plants later in the level.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_15: Back up barrier plants with short-range melee plants behind them.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_2: Plant sun producers early and often.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_3: Try for 2 columns of sun producers.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_4: Try to save sun for costlier but more powerful plants.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_5: Use Plant Food on anything to make room for floating Plant Foods.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_6: A plant becomes briefly invulnerable during its Plant Food effect.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_7: Don't be afraid to plant on the right half of the lawn.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_GENERAL_9: Try insta-kills like Chili Bean or Chomper against heavily armored zombies.

LTE_EVENTS_DESC_VALENBRAINZ: Love is in the air as Valenbrainz is here! Play new levels, crafted with love by our finest monkeys, to earn rewards that'll stun your sweetheart! The Thymed Event is only active for a limited time!
