NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Oh my... Did I eat a months expired burrito? Everything feels weird...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:winnie}The scanner readings give off nothing but white noise!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}One second, some useful data has appeared.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Remember how your neighbor had traces of a different reality over themselves?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}We had a whole talk about it and everything!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, there are entities here from a different reality.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:winnie}Somebody has opened the bridge between universes.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Currently, all that's crossing the bridge are zombies.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_15: {TIRED:winnie}I certainly could make a guess as to who's responsible for this.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_19: {SAY:crazydave}But zombies being the only ones getting through?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_1_INTRO_21: {EXCITED:crazydave}Let's get em' Penny! Let's fight some alternate universe zombies!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, the two universes seem to be merging as we speak.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}I was about to say, these zombies...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}It's like they come from similar memories, just different!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}The causality of events, their differences allowing a multitude of possibilities for development...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}However, one we cannot dedicate ourselves to at this moment.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_8: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}You think there's an alternate Dave and Penny out there?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Most likely. I wonder what their reactions are to current events.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:crazydave}If alternate me is similar, he's probably freaking out!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_2_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:crazydave}And not getting the half of it!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}We're in the Neon Mixtape Tour now?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_3_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, the merging of the universes is affecting all eras.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss has still not answered his usual contacts.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Calculations indicate that this entire predicament is "shady".
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_3_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}And not just because of the show lights!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I've done some metaphorical digging.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Data points to the situation we find ourselves in to be one of matter crossing over.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}The funneling of zombies from a neighboring universe into our own is not one-way.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:winnie}Our own universe has zombies being taken out of it!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:winnie}They're being transported to the alternate universe as we speak!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}Seems more like a cheap gimmick than anything!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:crazydave}What I really need crossing is waffles and Mexican cuisine!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}There is a noticeable affinity for crossovers in our current musical situation.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Readings indicate: many zombies will switch places with each other during jam switches.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_4_INTRO_15: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Can't forget about jam on the waffles too.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we have been delivered crucial information!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}It is from a source unlike anything I have scanned in a long time.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}It is I, the great Dr. Edgar G. Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}However, not the Zomboss that you would probably expect!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}I am the only Zomboss which matters.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}One from the parallel universe currently making its way into yours.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}My brilliance has likely come to your attention, as it is I who has orchestrated this endeavor.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}It is my deepest desire that you lot live up to your reputation.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}Myself from your home universe has complained (for what felt like hours) over your endeavors!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}Frankly, I fail to see how stopping a vacation makes you a threat in the slightest.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_14: {SAY:zombossicon}But despite my superior logic, my alternate self has insisted that I could not best you.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_15: {SAY:zombossicon}He has insisted that my variations of you are pushovers, too...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_16: {SAY:zombossicon}Which frankly did not set me in a delightful mood at all.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_17: {SAY:zombossicon}We had to make a deal. We trade our adversaries!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_18: {SAY:zombossicon}We have switched places with each other for a true battle of wits!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_19: {SAY:zombossicon}We have also come to terms to trade some of our forces with each other!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_20: {SAY:zombossicon}Merely to make the game more interesting.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_21: {SAY:zombossicon}All with the bottom line: May the better Zomboss win!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_23: {SAY:zombossicon}By taking you out... the ones my other self couldn't...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_5_INTRO_24: {SAY:zombossicon}...I shall forever prove that I am, in fact, the superior Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}It seems this alternate version of Zomboss is dragging us to different points in time.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps to further his "game" with our own Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}One of them probably invented a way to cross universes.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}At that point, their meeting must have been inevitable.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Yeah, I don't think they got along.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}Unlike me! I would get along with myself!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}I already talk to myself as is!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Either way, another alternate universe zombie is here.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Sea Spill Zombie can spill toxic waste in a 3x3 area.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}The poison spills can damage our plants.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_6_INTRO_13: {TIRED:crazydave}So much for other universes being clean.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we are met with a dimensional anomaly.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}One might say, a ripple effect of Holiday Mashup.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Despite the fact that Zomboss' plot has ended, its effects echo in the cracks of the timeline.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}We may encounter them on future adventures too sometime.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}For now, we must vigilantly observe the objects from the alternate universe.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}There are fireworks which damage plants and zombies, but cannot be destroyed by plants.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}However, they can be eaten by zombies.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}We also have Balloon Magician Zombie to worry about.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}His balloons will cover our plants, blocking attacks.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:crazydave}Sounds like Blover may come in useful!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:winnie}My readings say that zombies haven't been the only ones whom crossed universes!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}In the mass amounts of the undead, one plant found its way here.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}Void Orchid will help us defend ourselves.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:winnie}She can turn zombies into gravity spheres!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}Their gravitational pull will attract others to the lane it's on.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_7_INTRO_18: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Can she attract some hot dog stands while she's at it?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_11_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We are about to experience one of many negative effects from the alternate universe.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_11_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Piercing Cold is an event which has been transferred to our version of Frostbite Caves.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_11_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Piercing Cold will bring in projectiles that can freeze our plants and empower zombies.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I detect high levels of parrot-ness.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_12_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}These alternate universe parrots have minds of their own!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_12_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}They do not even need Pirate Captain Zombies to attack anymore.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_14_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}I'm detecting dimensional doors being opened left and right.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_14_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:winnie}More and more zombies are crossing the threshold.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_14_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}The two Zombosses are both ready to sacrifice their big players.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_14_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}We must prepare, their chess match is about to enter the endgame.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I have received yet another threatening note.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}If it's from that alternate Boss Man, I don't wanna hear it!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}We shall see what it says regardless to give us a tactical edge.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}You have proven to, in fact, be quite a thorn to deal with.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}I shall not let you win, however.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}A true Zomboss never backs out without playing dirty.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}Your variant has forgotten how to handle your kind.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}This world is a far cry from the intelligence him and I used to display.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_INTRO_1: {SAY:zombossicon}Sending tactical attacks on your house with upmost precision...
{SAY:zombossicon}...it's become a forgotten art around here.
{SAY:winnie}The alternate universe Zomboss has adapted, learned new tricks.
{SAY:winnie}Probably by being exposed to our, comparatively much less stable timeline.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I have just received an electronic note.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_OUTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Drats! Even my newfound power of temporal matter displacement has not worked!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_OUTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}This almost ensures my loss in "the game."
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_OUTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Make sure to note that I will take out my anger on your counterparts in my world!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_OUTRO_8: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}As much as our Boss Man is annoying...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_04_ALTVERZ_15_OUTRO_1: {EXCITED:winnie}And my calculations point to us never having to encounter him again!
{SAY:winnie}Well, it is a one in a-

NARRATIVE_SPONGEBOB_1_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}And that's why he must be stopped!

NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_208: {SAY:missinfo}Skateboarding, as it exists today, was probably born sometime in the late 1940s, or early 1950s,[3][4]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_209: {SAY:missinfo}when surfers in California wanted something to do when the waves were flat. The first skateboards were made from roller skates attached to a board.[5]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_210: {SAY:missinfo}Skateboarding gained in popularity because of surfing: in fact, skateboarding was initially referred to as "sidewalk surfing".[6]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_211: {SAY:missinfo}The first skateboards were handmade from wooden boxes and planks by individuals. Companies started manufacturing skateboards in 1959, as the sport became more popular.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_212: {SAY:missinfo}But how did these wonderful creations come to be?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_213: {SAY:missinfo}To answer that, we need to go waaaay back.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_214: {SAY:missinfo}The Big Bang is a physical theory that describes how the universe expanded from an initial state of high density and temperature.[1]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_215: {SAY:missinfo}Various cosmological models based on the Big Bang concept explain a broad range of phenomena,[2][3][4] including the abundance of light elements,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_216: {SAY:missinfo}the cosmic microwave background (CMB) radiation, and large-scale structure.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_217: {SAY:missinfo}The Big Bang Theory is an American television sitcom created by Chuck Lorre and Bill Prady for CBS. It aired from September 24, 2007, to May 16, 2019, running for 12 seasons and 279 episodes.[3]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_218: {SAY:missinfo}The show originally centered on five characters living in Pasadena, California: Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons),
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_219: {SAY:missinfo}both physicists at Caltech, who share an apartment;
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_222: {SAY:missinfo}waitress and aspiring actress who lives across the hall; and Leonard and Sheldon's similarly geeky and socially awkward friends and coworkers, aerospace engineer Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg)
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_223: {SAY:missinfo}and astrophysicist Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar).[4][5] Over time, supporting characters were promoted to starring roles,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_224: {SAY:missinfo}including neuroscientist Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), microbiologist Bernadette Rostenkowski (Melissa Rauch), and comic book store owner Stuart Bloom (Kevin Sussman).
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_225: {SAY:missinfo}Hopefully you found my neat information tidbits entertaining!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_227: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Since our last meeting, I’ve heard that the universe I originate from has been taken offline.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_228: {SAY:douglas}They wiped my existence from that reality. All my neighbors, David, Patrice, Edgar...

NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_231: {SAY:douglas}But they said they knew better. That the universe would be better without me.

NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_237: {SAY:douglas}And David? Well... he knows where to sit and grobble eat, that’s for sure.

NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_260: {SAY:douglas}Let me talk about random critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_261: {SAY:douglas}First off, they’re literally the worst thing to happen in any game.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_262: {SAY:douglas}Like, how come that I, the better player, lose to peasant RNG?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_263: {SAY:douglas}If you ask me, I’d get rid of them all together.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_264: {SAY:douglas}They’re a detriment to not only the game but humanity itself.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_265: {SAY:douglas}It started off in a goofy shooter game like TF2, but trust me, it’ll end all of us.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_269: {SAY:douglas}We’re all going to be ended by the skilled crit rocket coming our way from a F2P.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_270: {SAY:douglas}Like, seriously. Let’s think this through for a second from a critical gameplay perspective.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_271: {SAY:douglas}If I, the player, have a relatively big advantage on a player by counterplay,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_272: {SAY:douglas}Then I, said player, SHOULD win the encounter by having better offense, neutral,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_273: {SAY:douglas}And defensive play. It makes no sense then why the OBJECTIVELY worse PLAYER
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_274: {SAY:douglas}wins the encounter by simply clicking M1. Like, great. Now my day is ruined and
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_275: {SAY:douglas}I’m pooping my pants. TF2, for the most part, has a great sense of balance that has
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_276: {SAY:douglas}been able to keep itself stable over the years. Sure, you got items that break
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_277: {SAY:douglas}the game’s pace much like the Diamondback, Kunai or even sniper himself,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_278: {SAY:douglas}But for the most part, the game’s alright in its balance.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_279: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}The Diamondback is a community-created promotional secondary weapon for the Spy.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_280: {SAY:missinfo}It is based on the Diamond Back .357 from the video game Deus Ex: Human Revolution;
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_281: {SAY:missinfo}a futuristic metal Revolver with a black grip, front sight, and cylinder.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_282: {SAY:missinfo}The Diamondback has the ability to store up to 35 Critical hits for later use.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_283: {SAY:missinfo}One Critical hit is stored for each enemy backstabbed, or for each building
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_284: {SAY:missinfo}that is destroyed while being sapped (regardless of whether or not the Sapper is what actually destroys the building).
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_285: {SAY:missinfo}However, any stored Critical hits are lost upon death, and any buildings destroyed with the
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_286: {SAY:missinfo}Spy's Sapper attached while he is dead does not grant any Critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_287: {SAY:missinfo}In addition, the weapon's base damage is 15% lower than the Revolver,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_288: {SAY:missinfo}and it cannot roll for random Critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_289: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}The classes for the most part are designed to be able to counter each other
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_291: {SAY:douglas}promote gameplay diversity in classes and team work. You know. The game
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_292: {SAY:douglas}called TEAM FORTRESS 2 requires TEAMWORK. yeah. Crazy. Anyway,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_293: {SAY:douglas}it makes no sense why therefore a PUSHING AND COORDINATED
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_294: {SAY:douglas}TEAM SHOULD DIE to a SINGULAR random critical hit. You’re telling
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_295: {SAY:douglas}me that just because someone got a good roll on the RNG dice
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_296: {SAY:douglas}they get to win OVER ME??? AND MY BETTER AIM AND SKILLS???
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_297: {SAY:douglas}I want you to seriously understand what I’m saying because I'm fed up.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_298: {SAY:douglas}i dont care anymore. This game Is horrible and has been able to still be
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_299: {SAY:douglas}alive thanks to the incompetence of the game’s anti-cheat.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_300: {SAY:douglas}Thank god that they decided to publish the SDK code and now everyone
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_301: {SAY:douglas}can do whatever they want and publish it. You know what. Screw this.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_302: {SAY:douglas}I’m going to code the SDK code into having no random critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_303: {SAY:douglas}It’ll be like TF2. But Better. A better TF2 for all of us.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_304: {SAY:douglas}I’m tired of being bound to the shackles of random critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_309: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Are you aware of the concept of parallel universes?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_312: {SAY:douglas}But none of them feel like they truly exist.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_313: {SAY:douglas}Some have such radical changes to our status quo...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_314: {SAY:douglas}While for others, you could spend a lifetime not knowing you’re outside of your own.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_315: {SAY:douglas}Even the plants you defend your lawn with have many variants between realities.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_316: {SAY:douglas}So the peashooter has many forms: fire, ice, electric, shoot, even shadow.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_317: {SAY:douglas}But recently there's been new plants that really need to be added to your defence.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_318: {SAY:douglas}So there's three and the first one is Bendy, he shoots wrenches.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_319: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Oh that's sick, but why not ink?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_320: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Wait, that's actually a good idea, but look at this Pomni-pult.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_322: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Yeah, zombies would stand no chance, but look at this, it's Wolfy, Hunterria’s wolf.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_324: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}I'm just kidding, actually look at this one.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_326: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Yeah, it's an ender pea, it shoots minecraft blocks.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_328: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}But I personally prefer our own reality.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_329: {SAY:douglas}Even if it has horrendous creatures such as...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_330: {SAY:douglas}t h e s p o n g e
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_332: {SAY:douglas}I get chills up my spine whenever I think of it.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_333: {SAY:douglas}I remember him meddling with my soul.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_334: {SAY:douglas}But then again... all he wanted was a friend.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_342: {SAY:douglas}And... that’s kind of the only time I ever get to speak with you.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_344: {SAY:douglas}I’m only speaking to you because of a miracle.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_345: {SAY:douglas}I was wondering if he’d prepare another one this year.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_346: {SAY:douglas}Yknow, last year's wasn't all that great.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_348: {SAY:douglas}Spongebob spent all his time trying to craft his best day ever, that he kinda lost his magic along the way.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_349: {SAY:douglas}Me personally? I wouldn't have invited that gorblin fella.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_350: {SAY:douglas}Asking such proposterous riddles. Hate people who waste my time like that.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_351: {SAY:douglas}Like... I just wanna finish the puzzles and get my rewards!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_352: {SAY:douglas}I don’t want this guy speaking to me the entire time!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_355: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Have you heard of the Ancient Egypt theme?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_356: {SAY:douglas}It has these harps at the beginning.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_358: {SAY:douglas}And the wonderful piano melodic lines just spark an itch in my belly.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_359: {SAY:douglas}Did you know that Laura Shigihara, the composer for Plants vs Zombies 1, also composed the Ancient Egypt music theme?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_360: {SAY:douglas}I think it’s better than the Pirate Seas music.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_370: {SAY:douglas}Even the Chinese developers agree with me.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_371: {SAY:douglas}They included it in every world soundtrack for a reason!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_372: {SAY:douglas}Unfortunately they’ve been taken over by more generic instruments.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_373: {SAY:douglas}If I could play an instrument it would be a harp.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_375: {SAY:douglas}I always dreamt of plucking strings that are made out of human tissue.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_379: {SAY:douglas}Just like when you use imppear’s plant food and you hear all of the fart sound effects overlap.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_382: {SAY:douglas}I know I´ve been talking for a bit at this point.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_388: {SAY:douglas}I'm sure for some of you, it may bring you back to a more magical moment in life.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_389: {SAY:douglas}For others, you may be thinking of another game.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_390: {SAY:douglas}Like Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_392: {SAY:douglas}I asked to appear in that one but my calls were never picked up.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_400: {SAY:douglas}Could be better. Could be worse, though.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_401: {SAY:douglas}I asked the zombie with the big brain if he was willing to add us to Holiday Mashup.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_402: {SAY:douglas}A very cool world. I like its themes.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_404: {SAY:douglas}I get it. He has his reasons.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_405: {SAY:douglas}But he didn't even want to give our little absorbent friend a chance.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_406: {SAY:douglas}His work would fit in nicely in the chaotic realm of the holidays.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_407: {SAY:douglas}I mean, if zcorp can be there.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_412: {SAY:douglas}I´m sure they could make room for us in that schedule.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_413: {SAY:douglas}I wouldn't mind taking over for the levels during the holiday.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_414: {SAY:douglas}Like all the other little guys that have appeared recently.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_419: {SAY:douglas}And yet, we get none of the recognition.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_422: {SAY:douglas}I mean, you campaigned to get costumes into the game.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_424: {SAY:douglas}Maybe we can campaign for us to get a chance.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_427: {SAY:douglas}Perhaps it’s because, as some call us, we are "not canon".
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_430: {SAY:douglas}For the people who care about that sort of thing.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_431: {SAY:douglas}I felt the need to, y’know, clarify.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_432: {SAY:douglas}None of this is "canon", for those interested.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_434: {SAY:douglas}My existence is real to myself and myself only.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_435: {SAY:douglas}But I do hope I can exist within your heart.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_441: {SAY:douglas}I´ve been collecting these digital creature cards recently on a phone app.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_442: {SAY:douglas}Just something to pass the time, really.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_443: {SAY:douglas}Yet the company running the game lowered the cards you get per pack.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_445: {SAY:douglas}Why they do this is beyond me.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_446: {SAY:douglas}Perhaps that little mafia imp is behind this?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_447: {SAY:douglas}He seems like a jolly fellow if you look past his goons.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_448: {SAY:douglas}But he took away my creatures, man.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_449: {SAY:douglas}Now I can´t complete my collection as quickly.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_450: {SAY:douglas}This level of greed reminds me of the beings that destroyed my world.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_452: {SAY:douglas}At least the game is still fun.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_456: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}But I suppose you don’t care much for my gaming ventures.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_457: {SAY:douglas}I’ve already gone on long enough about my crippling addiction to team fortress 2.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_458: {SAY:douglas}You know, I have hobbies outside of that.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_459: {SAY:douglas}I’m actually a real estate manager on the side.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_460: {SAY:douglas}I recently had the distinct pleasure of acquiring a piece of land in Egypt.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_461: {SAY:douglas}And I must say, the process is rather uncomplicated by local standards!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_462: {SAY:douglas}What they do for you in a manner that is both thoroughly both efficient and almost ceremonious...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_464: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}...is simply hand over the property itsel-
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_466: {SAY:missinfo}Might I implore you to calm yourself for but a moment.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_467: {SAY:missinfo}Here you are sat idly toying with whatever trinket you found and it’s becoming most vexing.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_468: {SAY:missinfo}Prey could you not take a brief respite and cease with this restless fidgeting?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_473: {SAY:douglas}Perhaps this unique opportunity allows me to express myself.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_474: {SAY:douglas}I only get one chance to speak to you yearly...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_475: {SAY:douglas}And who knows if that’ll continue into the future.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_480: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Hammeruit is a plant in Plants vs. Zombies 2, introduced in the 12.0.1 update.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_481: {SAY:missinfo}It is a 3x1 AoE melee-attack plant, and is able to charge if there is no zombies in its attack area,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_482: {SAY:missinfo}dealing more damage next time it attacks. Hammeruit can instantly destroy grid items, barrels, and stones.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_483: {SAY:missinfo}Hammeruit appears to be based on the hammer orchid, any of the 10 species of orchid in the genus Drakaea.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_484: {SAY:missinfo}However, its name is a portmaneau of "hammer" and "fruit" - which is inaccurate, since it's based on a flower.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_486: {SAY:missinfo}When given Plant Food, Hammeruit slams its hammer 3 times in a row, dealing increasing damage with each hit.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_487: {SAY:missinfo}Releases shockwaves at the last hit that travels in 3 directions.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_489: {SAY:missinfo}When boosted by Enforce-mint, Hammeruit will deal an additional 50 damage (increases by 20 damage for each level)
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_490: {SAY:missinfo}with its normal attacks, an additional 200 damage
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_491: {SAY:missinfo}(increases by 200 damage for each level) with its Plant Food attacks, and its charge time is reduced by 1 second.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_493: {SAY:missinfo}Level Seed Packets Coins Upgrades Sun Cost Recharge Starting Recharge Toughness Damage* Plant Food Damage^
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_498: {SAY:missinfo}99 999 62 2228 0 seconds 0.02 seconds 3.14 damage googolplex * 2^(136,279,841) damage 597 damage
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_499: {SAY:missinfo}927 8e9 12v2 435i828 5l minutes until the fog. seconds 0.02 seconds August 4th 2037 09:37 AM damage daMAge damage I need more damage
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_501: {SAY:missinfo}It’s one of two plants in the entire franchise who is based on the Hammer Orchid,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_502: {SAY:missinfo}the other being Hammer Flower from the Chinese version.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_505: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Thank you for the useful insight Miss Information!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_506: {SAY:douglas}Now I don’t have to explain what I’m talking about!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_507: {SAY:douglas}Yeah so this plant is kind of stinky.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_510: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}You know, there’s one world I would really like to see in PvZ2.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_512: {SAY:douglas}Sky City, as it’s frequently called. Such an awesome world.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_513: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Sky City (天空之城; pinyin: tiānkōng zhī chéng) is the 9th world in the Chinese version of Plants vs. Zombies 2 and second Chinese-exclusive one.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_514: {SAY:missinfo}The main feature of this world is that zombies will no longer rush into the player's house,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_515: {SAY:missinfo}but instead, they will attack Crazy Dave's ship until it is completely destroyed.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_517: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Why thank you! It’s so cool. I really want to see it added.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_518: {SAY:douglas}The developers keep saying it’s not possible.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_519: {SAY:douglas}I don’t believe that. I believe they are telling tall tales.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_520: {SAY:douglas}Do you know what kind of tech they have?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_521: {SAY:douglas}They could do it. They’re just lazy.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_522: {SAY:douglas}If they’re worried about it not fitting as a world...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_523: {SAY:douglas}Perhaps they could do it, as an Epic Realm!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_525: {SAY:douglas}I wasn’t a fan of that one.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_526: {SAY:douglas}Regardless, it is a good feature to use for the Sky City.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_527: {SAY:douglas}If the name is considered off, perhaps they could rename it to Assault Airspace.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_529: {SAY:douglas}If they’re concerned about it taking up too much space in Travel Log’s Tourist Trap...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_530: {SAY:douglas}They could make it its own separate island.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_531: {SAY:douglas}I’d also like to see all my favorite plants.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_532: {SAY:douglas}Asparagus, Horsebean, Saucer, Pineapple, Loquat, and maybe even, Gatling Pea.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_533: {SAY:douglas}For the zombies, I would like to see all of them. Except for the missile launcher.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_535: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Missile Zombie ((飞弹僵尸; pinyin: fēidàn jiāngshī)) is the ninth zombie encountered in Sky City.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_536: {SAY:missinfo}In the stage, he will randomly appear in the lower right corner of the screen. He cannot be targeted by plants.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_537: {SAY:missinfo}In order to destroy him, the player must swipe him away with their finger rapidly in a similar fashion to Power Toss.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_538: {SAY:missinfo}If the player does not act fast enough, he will shoot a missile onto a ground tile and destroy the player's plants
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_539: {SAY:missinfo}on that tile and the surrounding tiles, as well as doing huge damage to their ship.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_541: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Thanks. Anyways, maybe they could add some new zombies.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_542: {SAY:douglas}Not sure what. I like the idea of a zombie that shoots missiles.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_543: {SAY:douglas}I think it’d also be cool, if they made a new ambush zombie.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_544: {SAY:douglas}They could also tie it to the general guy.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_545: {SAY:douglas}It’d make a lot of sense if you know what I mean.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_550: {SAY:douglas}They’re trying to hoard all the ones and zeros for themselves.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_551: {SAY:douglas}Well IM entirely made out of ones and zeros and I find that quite offensive.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_553: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Do you hear a storm oncoming, perhaps?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_571: {SAY:missinfo}Caliginous Carnival - Night 16 is the sixteenth level of Caliginous Carnival
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_573: {SAY:missinfo}The player must survive a Gargantuar attack without any lawn mowers
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_574: {SAY:missinfo}When this level is finished for the first time, the player recieves a key for unlocking
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_575: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Yknow, speaking of that darned carnival, I can’t even bring myself to play it.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_577: {SAY:douglas}I’ve seen countless realities where those are used!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_578: {SAY:douglas}And they’re interesting in none of them!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_579: {SAY:}Douglas I bet that "caliginous" carnival thing is just using another trampoline gimmick, too.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_580: {SAY:douglas}Oh, let me guess. They’re called "trampolimps" here instead.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_582: {SAY:douglas}I’ve seen tons of other realities do it.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_586: {SAY:douglas}The reason why I can peer into other realities...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_590: {SAY:douglas}Something... strange happened after we defeated that yellow square.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_592: {SAY:douglas}Not sure how, or when, but I felt like I could fight anywho.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_593: {SAY:douglas}I felt like I could escape into greater realms, with many possibilities.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_596: {SAY:douglas}Someone is watching... I’m not sure who it is...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_599: {SAY:douglas}I felt like I could fight big leaders and primordial hunters;
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_601: {SAY:douglas}Greediest mob bosses, luckiest men, nasty nannies...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_603: {SAY:douglas}But all this time I felt... alone.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_604: {SAY:douglas}With no friends after that defeat, I didn’t have anyone to talk about it.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_609: {SAY:douglas}Oh no. I see what’s happening here.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_613: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}All this time, I was just a guinea pig.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_614: {SAY:douglas}For some kind of... custom character creation system.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_625: {SAY:douglas}In the grand scheme of things, I really am unimportant.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_626: {SAY:douglas}My purpose all along... was to be a testing ground. A joke.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_627: {SAY:douglas}No wonder they deleted my original universe.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_629: {SAY:douglas}Even now, I faintly hear someone mocking me.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_630: {SAY:douglas}It wasn’t the sponge. It’s the world.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_632: {SAY:douglas}And now I’m a bother to you. Aren’t I?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_635: {SAY:douglas}You're probably just here for the pinata party rewards, aren’t you?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_636: {SAY:douglas}That’s what this was all really about.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_643: {SAY:douglas}I'll-- I'll give you another 10,000 coins from the pinata party rewards. Please.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_647: {SAY:douglas}I never expected you to take the offer anyways.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_649: {SAY:douglas}This party is one of the classics, I’ve heard.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_650: {SAY:douglas}It is very well made and designed.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_652: {SAY:douglas}I'm sure Spongebob would have loved to be here, but alas.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_655: {SAY:douglas}I don’t know if you’ll ever hear from me again.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_656: {SAY:douglas}Don’t know if I’ll have another chance to ever reach out again.

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {SAY:zombossicon}The zombies and I are normal people, simply trying to help you.

NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}User Dave, it's time to saddle up and leave.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Where do you think the future will take us?
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_NEW_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_5: {SAY:crazydave}We should take another look at my Time-Space Taco Map.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}My Uncle Milo used to have one of these, he called it a boom box.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2: {SAY:winnie}Actually, that's close enough. I'll allow it.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Maybe we can use that to unlock our minds.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I still have some cleaning to do.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_3: {SAY:winnie}Actually, User Dave, my sensors indicate you may not be so wrong.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_4: {SAY:winnie}This key will be most useful for traveling to the Far Future!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_5: {EXCITED:winnie}Surely, the Future has some information about your missing taco.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_GARGANTUAR_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}You're right, Penny! I wonder how much tac-nology has advanced.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}User Dave, it's time to saddle up and leave.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Where do you think the future will take us?
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_6: {SAY:crazydave}{SPECIAL15}Just remember. Tomorrow is always a taco...
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_LASTTLEVEL_7: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}That's right! These plants versus you and your zombies.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {SAY:crazydave}And we didn't even use any spoons...
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I admit you are correct in this regard.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5: {SAY:zombossicon}We have no existential conflict over the nature of spoons.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}That looks like it could be all futurey.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:crazydaveicon}That Mr. Boss guy seems like a really nice fellow!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_13: {TIRED:winnieicon}We should be wary of that one User Dave.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_15: {EXCITED:winnieicon}Earning Stars will prepare you for Star Gates we find later!
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnieicon}Also, Endless Zones will keep you sharp for future trials.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydaveicon}{SPECIAL15}Just remember. Tomorrow is always a taco...
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_18: {SPECIAL16:crazydave}And a taco is what we find inside of all of us.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}I bet Future Dave has solved our taco paradox.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}I'm detecting a rush of tachyon particles.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:winnieicon}Maybe Future Penny is trying to make contact.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}The Future will be requesting your presence.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}Upon entry, legal possession of your brains...
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Will be transferred to one Dr. Edgar Zomboss.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_WORLDMAP_INTRO_4: {PLAYFUL}Let's get these plants to the watering hole.
NARRATIVE_COWBOY_ZOMBIENOTE_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}It appears brains are outlawed around here.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Hi neighbor! Welcome to The Tiki Torch-er!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_2: {SAY:crazydave}But beware! Zombies are selling seashells by this seashore!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_BEACH_3: {SHOUT:crazydave}And they insist you pay in brains!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_COWBOY_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Big Bad Butte!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_COWBOY_2: {SAY}And by big I mean crawling with zombies...
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DARK_2: {PLAYFUL}Here you'll find that day is night and knights are zombies!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DINO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to La Brainsa Tarpits!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_DINO_2: {PLAYFUL}I hope you're ready for a reptilian rumble!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EGYPT_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Pyramid of Doom!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EGYPT_2: {SAY}It's just like a regular pyramid, but... you know... doomier.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EIGHTIES_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to the GREATEST HITS!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_EIGHTIES_2: {PLAYFUL}I hope you're ready for a righteously up-tempo experience!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_FUTURE_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Terror from Tomorrow!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_FUTURE_2: {PLAYFUL}Making tomorrow's terror something terrible for today!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_ICEAGE_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Icebound Battleground!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_ICEAGE_2: {SAY:crazydave}This place is cold as, uh, ICE ... not to mention chock full o' zombies.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_ICEAGE_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Best bring some hot zombie-fightin' moves. And maybe a nice warm coat too.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_LOSTCITY_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to the Temple of Bloom!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_LOSTCITY_2: {PLAYFUL}Here you'll find that gold is good but brings out more zombies!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_MODERN_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Howdy, neighbor! Welcome to Highway to the Danger Room!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_MODERN_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Here you'll find that all time is one time...
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_PIRATE_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY}Hi neighbor! Welcome to Dead Man's Booty!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTROWRAPUP_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}Nice pick, let's see how far you can get!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_LAWNMOWER_SUCCESS_: {SAY}Your Plant Food carries over to the next level!
{PLAYFUL}Now it's time to pick another plant!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_POWER_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}The Endless Zones are harder than usual!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_POWER_2: {SAY:winnie}Power Ups and Plant Food can only be purchased once per level.
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_SUCCESS_3: {SAY}In the Endless Zones, your lawn mowers carry over to the next level!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_SUCCESS_5: {SAY}Your Plant Food carries over to the next level as well!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_SUCCESS_7: {PLAYFUL}Now it's time to pick another plant!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_TUTORIAL_3: {SAY}Now you get to pick one more.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Warning! I've detected carafes containing chemical compounds of a malevolent makeup!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_2: {TIRED:crazydave}Can you translate that into Crazy Dave Talk for me?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_3: {TIRED:winnie}There are evil potions on the lawn!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}Evil medieval potions! They're the most dangerous kind...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}On account of having twice the evil!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2: {TIRED:winnie}No one, User Dave. We have simply arrived in the Dark Ages.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Indeed. According to my research, a plague has swept this era.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5: {SAY:winnie}Also, sun no longer falls from the sky.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What we need is someone to brighten this place up!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}These guys not only know how to turn a frown upside down...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}They make more sun as they grow! Great guys, very talented.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I'm afraid the Dark Ages are giving me a bad case of the vapours.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_2: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, the vapours are no longer considered a real ailment.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_3: {SAY:winnie}But I believe Fume-shroom will be of use here.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_4: {EXCITED:winnie}His vapors are quite real and provide a distinct advantage against the right zombie opponents.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Fume-tastic! Let's give the zombies a case of the vapours instead!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2: {SAY:zombossicon}It is my fervent medical opinion that your humours are out of balance!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Methinks the siphoning of thine brains is the only way to correct this ailment!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey! I prefer my humors and my brains unbalanced!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Data suggests the Dark Ages were a time of intellectual decline and moral  confusion.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_2: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Perhaps now is a good time to call upon the persuasive powers of the Hypno-shroom?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Good idea, Penny! We'll convert the wicked – Dark Ages style!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_4: {SAY:crazydave}Deploy this shroom and the zombies won't know what bit them...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Until they see that it was their fellow zombies! Then, mind BLOWN!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}According to my data, iron and other metals were routinely put to use during the Dark Ages.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_2: {EXCITED:winnie}Thus, Magnet-shroom should make an excellent ally here.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}He can pull buckets, helmets and other metal objects off of zombies!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Some people think it's magic. But really, it's just physics.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Boy, Pea-shooter and Wall-nut sure are good at what they do.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Talk about two great plants that fight great together!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_3: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave! Perhaps you are not as cerebrally unsound as you periodically insist!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_4: {PLAYFUL:winnie}What if there was one plant that behaved like both a Pea-shooter AND a Wall-nut?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Two plant powers in one legume's body?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}Keep talkin' like that and people are going to call you Crazy Penny!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_8: {SAY:crazydave}Which would be weird for both of us.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}A question for you, my Ignoble Foes!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Hast thou noted how violent thine plants become upon consuming Plant Food?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Perchance, hast thou wondered what Plant Food is truly made of?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {SAY:zombossicon}Verily, I shall tell thee. It's zombies! Plant food is made out of zombies!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Unpossible! We feed our plants only the highest quality organic uhm...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6: {TIRED:crazydave}Hey Penny, what is Plant Food made of?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_7: {SAY:winnie}I fear the true nature of Plant Food requires further analysis, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_8: {TIRED:winnie}Excuse me while I run some tests.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Why would anyone go and stick a nice sword into a dirty ol' rock?
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2: {TIRED:winnie}I understand it to be a test, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Only someone with great physical strength and strength of character may remove it.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4: {SAY:crazydave}I bet someone with a jackhammer could remove it.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_6: {TIRED:winnie}An inelegant but no doubt effective solution to the test, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have found no evidence that Plant Food contains zombies or zombie byproducts.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {TIRED:crazydave}Phew! Plants shouldn't eat zombies who eat plants.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Except Chomper. He has to. Dude needs the fiber.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Why dost thine time-traveling jalopy lie to thee?
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Perchance, a question best left for another day?
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Now, I pray, imagine maniacal laughter as I depart.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}User Dave, we have encountered a scroll.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}I love side-scrollers! They're my second favorite kind of game.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_3: {SAY:winnieicon}This is not a game. It's a piece of parchment bearing a message.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Will ya look at that! It's Dark Ages email. Neat-o!
NARRATIVE_DARTICHOKE_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dartichokes aim first at high-priority targets like Wizards and Octo Zombies.
NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Alert, User Dave. My sensors indicate we have moved 153,954,765 years into the past.
NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yabbers! That's before I was even born!
NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Correct. We seem to have landed in some form of Jurassic Marsh.
NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}A meteorite. Curious. My records indicate this should be... bigger.
NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}More like super Seattle-sized. I hope history has not gone awry...
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Surrender your brains forthwith, inane time stumblers!
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Else you shall share the fate of these terrible thunder lizards: EXTINCTION!
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}But I don't want to get extincted!
NARRATIVE_DINO_17_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}I just always wanted a primitive sunflower who gave big suns!
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This epoch is known for its unusual lifeforms, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}I was thinking more in terms of saurians, User Dave. Dinosaurs.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}They won't attack us directly and we can't affect them.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}However, they will definitely react to zombies. Be wary!
NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Beware the Jurassic Bully zombies, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Zuh? But how? Even Gargantuars get knocked back!
NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}True, User Dave. The Bully is simply too stupid to observe typical physics.
NARRATIVE_DINO_23_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I detect Primal Potato Mines nearby, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_23_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Their prepaleolithic potency will far exceed our more refined modern versions.
NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I can feel the ground a-trembling, Penny! More dinos?
NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Indeed, User Dave. A herd of stegosaurs approaches.
NARRATIVE_DINO_6_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate they will snare zombies with their tail, and then flick them off.
NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have analyzed a new plant, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}The Perfume-shroom charms dinosaurs and turns them against the zombies.
NARRATIVE_DINO_8_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Dino-sour power? On OUR side? This is taco-level great news!
NARRATIVE_DINO_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny! I just remembered how much I love silent letters!
NARRATIVE_DINO_9_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Coincidentally, User Dave, a flock of Pterodactyls is approaching.
NARRATIVE_DINO_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Is there nowhen I may go to avoid your imbecilic interference?
NARRATIVE_DINO_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Stay right where you are. I have an enormous rock scheduled to make your acquaintance.
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I see a toenail! Of unusual size!
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2: {SAY:winnie}This raptor claw bespeaks an ancient arena of dinosaurian dimensions, User Dave!
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I detect an incoming meteor, User Dave
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {SAY:winnie}I advise immediate egress from this timezone.
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Bye-bye, dinos! You'll be birdies in no time!
NARRATIVE_DINO_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}Bah! You leave me no choice but to enact... Project Paradox!
NARRATIVE_DRAFTODIL_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Draftodil to slow and eliminate flying zombies.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_BLOOMERANG_LEVELUP_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Indeed they do, User Dave. But they are not.
{SAY:winnie}The lower Bloomerang is at MAX LEVEL.
{SAY:winnie}Oh, and no need for sun. Plants are coming special delivery!
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_CONVEYOR_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}No need for sun.  Plants are coming via special delivery.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_CONVEYOR_OUTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}Awesome! I've always wanted to eat one of those.
{SAY:crazydave}Wait... that's not a starfish. It's an actual star.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_A_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL}This will be the first last stand. There will be more lasts to come.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_B_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}I love sitting, but now is not the time! Let's get crazy.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}{START_DIALOG_MUSIC}I hope that pharaohs had some heirs.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_LASTSTAND_C_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}I guess that was their last stand too.
NARRATIVE_EGYPT_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_A_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY}There's a brand new symbol to match. It's a bucket.
