STRAWBURST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire

{FLAVOR} "Big is good," says Strawburst. "Though small’s pretty choice as well. And you should never discount medium. I just like sizes, really."
STRAWBURST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Strawbursts grow a berry for small, medium or huge damage!
STRAWBURST_TOOLTIP: Grows a berry for small, medium or huge damage
STUNION_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact

{FLAVOR}Oh sure, everyone knows Stunion as the battle-hardened warrior with the potent breath. But he’s so much more than that. He’s an accomplished pianist. He speaks five languages fluently. Heck, he's the leader of a Cub Shallots group in his spare time. Dude’s got layers. Go on, peel 'em back. You’ll see.
STUNION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Stunions breathe a stunning cloud of gas on nearby zombies in the lane.
STUNION_PLANTFOOD: Immediately breathes a large cloud of stunning gas to the right, across three lanes.
STUNION_TOOLTIP: Stuns nearby zombies in the lane
SUGGEST_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION: Need help choosing plants? Power Picks will set you up with aggressive attackers, a brawny guardian, and the right sun producer you need to win.
SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}infected zombie drops 0.2 sun per hitpoint, up to 300 sun per Sun Bean

{FLAVOR}As the eldest of the bean brothers, Sun Bean often finds his siblings exasperating. Chili Bean is a little crude, Laser Bean is too far out, and Spring Bean is just plain lazy. Still, he loves them just the same. That's how it is with family.
SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sun Beans infect zombies with sun. As a zombie takes damage it generates sun.
SUNBEAN_TOOLTIP: Zombies that eat it drop sun when damaged
SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}After the release of her first major YouTuber video "Zombies On Your Lawn," Sunflower's YouTuber channel has been bursting with fun. She is currently putting the final touches on her reality show TV pitch "Sunflower Thinks She Can Dance."
SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sunflowers are essential for you to produce extra sun. Try planting as many as you can!
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Oh sure, Sun-shroom is known for his ever-present grin and sunny disposition. But truth be told, even he has his dark days. It ain't easy keeping things light when you live in the shadows.
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sun-shrooms give small suns at first, then normal suns, and finally large suns.
SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Sweet Potato really is as sweet as she looks. Her favorite animal is the unicorn. Her favorite color is (and this is a direct quote) "all the colors of the rainbow." When she writes the letter "i", she draws a little heart where the dot belongs. Frankly, if it were anyone else, this amount of syrup would be sickening. But on her, well, it just seems right.
SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sweet Potatoes attract zombies from other lanes when they are close by.
SWEETPOTATO_TOOLTIP: Attracts zombies from other lanes when they are close
SYNC_DATA_INFO:
"By registering your account, your player data will be merged across available player IDs to ensure all progress across devices and platforms is kept. You can also force sync your data for your current player ID to ensure you are up-to-date with what is stored on our servers.
To see your current player IDs, go to Settings -> Download Preferences."
SYNC_FAILED_TO_LOAD_BODY: We were unable to load your player data from our game servers for. Please find a more stable internet connection or try again later.
SYNC_FAILED_TO_SAVE_BODY: We were unable to save your player data to our game servers for. Please find a more stable internet connection or try again later.
SYNC_LOADING_DATA: Loading player data from game server...
SYNC_SAVING_DATA: Saving player data to game server...
SYNC_SUCCEEDED_BODY: Player data was saved with the game server and reloaded.
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks launched imps

{FLAVOR}Tall-nut is opening a chain of stores for Tall and Taller gentlemen. "I'll shell out the savings to you!"
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that block low flying zombies.
TALLNUT_PLANTFOOD: Becomes encased in metal armor, greatly increasing its health.
TALLNUT_TOOLTIP: Heavy-duty wall that blocks low flying zombies
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on contact

{FLAVOR}Tangle Kelp likes to go deep. He majored in philosophy. Grab a root beer with him, and he'll go on and on about Nietzsche's "Thus Spoke Zucchini" or hold forth on Kant's "Critique of Petunia Reason." It's cool and all, but sometimes you just want to keep the conversation light. Sometimes you just want to talk about the temperature of the water.
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
TANGLEKELP_TOOLTIP: Aquatic plant that pulls a zombie underwater
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use

{FLAVOR}Teleportato Mine is an avid film and movie fan, she'll ramble on and on about all the cool effects and physical props for them, to the point where she attempts to recreate them with a pretty decent success rate. Her recent obsession? Starch Trek. Cross your fingers and hope she doesn't watch the Termitater.
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Teleportato Mine instantly teleports zombies to her location, then explodes.
TELEPORTATOMINE_TOOLTIP: Teleports zombies to explode alongside them
TEST_FEASTIVUS_QUEST_DESC: Defeat Treasure Yetis before they totally overrun Feastivus!
TEST_WIN_RIFT_LATEST_LEVEL_QUEST_DESC: Chase down Dr. Zomboss and earn coins while doing it!
TEST_WIN_RIFT_LATEST_LEVEL_QUEST_TITLE: Play Most Recent Penny's Pursuit Level!
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Threepeater loves playing multiplayer in video games, but split-screen never works out because the left head always cheats.
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.
THREEPEATER_PLANTFOOD: Fires off a waving wall of peas across the lawn.
THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}rewound zombies have restored health

{FLAVOR} "Possibilities other to open be to need we." Warp Thyme says, "Limited too far was time to approach unidirectional the that felt always I've."
THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Thyme Warps rewind time, sending zombies back where they started.
THYMEWARP_TOOLTIP: Sends zombies back where they started
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}grass tiger grows over time

{FLAVOR}"How many Grass Tigers could a Tiger Grass amass before they'd tire of making Grass Tigers?" We've presented this riddle to both the Sphinx and The Grate Mystery, and even they still couldn't solve it, and they studied the Suburban Almanac cover to cover.
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tiger Grass spawns a grass tiger who leaps out to attack nearby zombies.
time_twist_pinata_parties: Time Twist Piñata Parties are here!
TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes 25 seconds to swallow a zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be gulped

{FLAVOR}Toadstool just can’t stand being idle. "I keep everything that I want to do on lists, and keep the lists where I can see them so that I’m always motivated!" she said. Whenever there’s work to be done, she’s always the first to hop to it.
TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Toadstools gulp down zombies whole, then produce sun.
TOADSTOOL_TOOLTIP: Gulps down zombies whole, then produces sun.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}multiple torchwoods increase strength of fire peas
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}does minor lane-wide fire damage when destroyed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Torchwood and Snapdragon have become fast friends. They like to hang out at either the Tiki Lounge or the Renaissance Faire.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage. They also deal lanewide fire damage on defeat.
TORCHWOOD_PLANTFOOD: Permanently turns into a blue-fire version, with blue-fire peas doing twice the damage of fire peas.
TORCHWOOD_TOOLTIP: Turns peas into fireballs and does lanewide damage on defeat

TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}set aflame by Torchwood
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of other plants

{FLAVOR}This zesty little guy can't wait to get at it! Places to do! Things to go! It works because he planned thoroughly ahead of time.
TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tumbleweeds roar off down the lane, bouncing off zombies and knocking them back with a chance to stun them.
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}turkeys naturally rot over time and disappear

{FLAVOR}Turkey-pult’s turkeys are so delicious, you’d never know they were actually made of tofu! Almost never. You might know. Okay, fine, cards on the table: there is absolutely no way you could ever mistake these turkeys for the real thing.
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Turkey-pults lob tofu turkeys that damage zombies and then charge down the lane to damage even more zombies.
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_HAVE_FUN: Now have fun with Power Ups!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_KILL_ALL_ZOMBIES: Kill all the zombies before the timer runs out!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_USE_POWERUP: Great! Now use the Power Up!
TUTORIAL_POWERUPS_ZOMBIE_WAVE: Great, now don't let these zombies eat your brains!
TWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Twin Sunflower's super-chic line of ultra-expensive sunglasses has been a huge hit wherever she goes. Due to this she has been unable to travel without being swarmed by the Poppyrazzi.
TWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Twin Sunflowers give twice as much sun as a normal sunflower.
TWINSUNFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Gives twice as much sun as a sunflower
ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of itself, mutating from green to yellow to red
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}costs more sun the more Ultomatoes are on the board

{FLAVOR}Ultomato yawns as unimaginable energies build up inside his being. It’s cool. He can afford to wait. He’s got allllll day.
ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ultomatoes charge up slowly, then fire a devastating beam down the lane that damages zombies as long as the charge lasts. Ultomatoes can be made more powerful by planting multiple Ultomatoes on the same tile.

WALLNUT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Having retired from his days as a champion bowler in the Pro Leagues, Wall-nut is looking forward to a real challenge on the front lines of home defense. DEFENSE! DEFENSE!
WALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Wall-nuts have hard shells which you can use to protect your other plants.
WALLNUT_PLANTFOOD: Becomes encased in metal armor, greatly increasing its health.
WALLNUT_TOOLTIP: Blocks off zombies and protects your other plants
WASABIWHIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}prioritizes zombies behind it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}"The trick to proper whipping is all in the wrist," says Wasabi Whip. "Well, not the wrist, exactly, since I don't have any. You have to, like... BE the wrist."
WASABIWHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Wasabi Whips lash out with their flaming whips, delivering whuppings to zombies both in front and behind.
WATCH_1_AD_DESC: More like RAD quest! Watch an ad, get some stuff!
WATCH_MULTIPLE_ADS_DESC: Watch some ads, get some stuff, come back and get even more! It's questy!
WIN_SINGLE_JOUST_MATCH_DESC: Seriously, go win an Arena match! It's fun!
WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}You may recognize Winter Melon's voice from such incredible documentaries as "It's Cold Up Here," "Ice Bingo," and "Surfin' Swedes."
WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Winter Melons do heavy damage and slow groups of zombies.
WINTERMELON_PLANTFOOD: Chilling, heavy melons are launched up that target every zombie on the lawn.
WINTERMELON_TOOLTIP: Does heavy damage and slows groups of zombies
WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Winter-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Boingsetta
{STAT}Cold Snapdragon
{STAT}Hurrikale
{STAT}Ice Bloom
{STAT}Iceberg Lettuce
{STAT}Missile Toe
{STAT}Snow Pea
{STAT}Winter Melon

{FLAVOR}Winter-mint has advanced degrees in cryonics and cryogenics, is a master builder of snowmen, and subscribes to season passes at three different ski resorts. He does think it's a little chilly in here, though.
WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Winter-mints chill all zombies present on the board when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Winter-mint Family plants on the lawn.
WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be transformed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}targets Wizard and Frog Sorceress Zombies first

{FLAVOR}Witch Hazel paused, unsure how to proceed. Then, all at once, she knew: Use magic, like, ALL THE TIME!
WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Witch Hazels use magical sorcery to transform zombies into Puff-shrooms.

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_BEACH: Take a trip back to the '60s and hang ten on the ocean waves! Tides are changing and those gnarly zombies make it not-so-safe to go back in the water!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_COWBOY: Head down the dusty trail for a showdown with the outlaw zombies of yesteryear! Gather up your plants for the big Brain Rush of 1850!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_DARK: Bring out your undead to the year 948! Harvest mushrooms in the dark of knight and get medieval on zombies from the days of yore!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_DINO: The ground thunders under the awful feet of terrible lizards! Dinosaurs prowl the past, provoking prehistoric zombies into a frenzy of ancient antipathy!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EGYPT: Zombies infest one of Earth's earliest civilizations! Tackle mummified monsters and more under the scorching sun of Egypt, circa 2500 BC!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_EIGHTIES: Stock up on hairspray and rewind to the 1980s! With synthesized music and voraciously radical zombies, this heinous dance party will, like, totally tax you to the MAX!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_FUTURE: In the year 2323, the zombies will have brain extraction down to a science! Can the plants of the future save you from the undead of tomorrow?
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_ICEAGE: Explore the frozen wastes of prehistory and chill out with the coolest zombies ever. Beware the winds or your plants will be frozen veggies.
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_LOSTCITY: Discover the vanished city of gold, where sun is plentiful and misplaced zombies abound! Use special tiles for extra sun, for these treasure-seekers are no idol threat!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_MODERN: The end is the beginning! Return to moments before you left in a contemporary contest stocked with zombies of every egregious era!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_PIRATE: The year is 1679, the golden age of zombie piracy! Keep your booty close and your plants closer as zombies take to the seas to plunder your brains!
WORLD_PREVIEW_DINO_UNLOCK_DESCRIPTION: Complete Neon Mixtape Tour - Day 16 to unlock
WORLD_PREVIEW_DISCLAIMER: Purchased content can be claimed by any of the user profiles!

{FLAVOR}Sometimes Rotobaga hears the other plants gossiping about each other. "Did you notice that so-and-so has been putting on weight?" they might say. Or, "I hear that so-and-so is dating so-and-so. Can you believe it?"  But Rotobaga isn’t the kind of plant to engage in idle gossip. She’s not interested in talking about anyone behind their leaves. She does her best to just rise above it.
XSHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.
XSHOT_PLANTFOOD: Fires a rapid stream of shots in all four diagonal directions.
XSHOT_TOOLTIP: Shoots along the diagonals, up to four directions at a time

ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}imps thrown from barrel when destroyed

{FLAVOR}Barrel Roller Zombie is part of a super underground secret awesome club. You probably haven't heard of it. Also, his left arm is slightly longer than his right arm.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His rolling barrel crushes plants and provides excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_EXPLOSIVE_ALMANAC_DE:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}barrel explodes when destroyed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}fire attacks do 20% more damage to the barrel

{FLAVOR}Powder Keg Roller was just your ordinary Barrel Roller Zombie, until his barrel rolled off into the great sea. In a desperate search to find a new one, he found a ragtag group of pirates offering homemade barrels. Unfortunately for him, they weren't homemade barrels, they were made in a factory... a BOMB factory... they're BOMBS.
His rolling barrel explodes when destroyed, and provides excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Go to the beach, they said. Put a cone on your head, they said. So, yeah, that's what Pompadour Conehead did. He's at his best when following simple instructions.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His starfish cone gives him twice the toughness of a normal pompadour zombie.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Pompadour Buckethead tried to learn to play the ukulele. He figured it would be easier to learn than the guitar on account of how small it is. But his stiff fingers ... they just weren't made for it. Now he just bangs on his bucket. And he's not half-bad either.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His scallop shelled bucket gives him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Pompadour Zombie recently noticed that he was wearing only one flip-flop. He THINKS he lost the other one while doing the limbo at a bonfire party the other night. But to be honest, that entire night is a little hazy ... and that flip-flop could be anywhere.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}See that starfish on Bikini Conehead's cone? She put that there herself. She gets a lot of compliments on it too. And sure enough, now it seems like everyone is accessorizing with starfish. She's a trendsetter, that one.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her starfish cone makes her twice as tough as a basic bikini zombie.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Bikini Buckethead had big ambitions. She wanted to do more than just lurch around on a beach all day. Her life's dream: to perform internationally with a synchronized swimming team. Sadly, the nose plug was her undoing. If she only had a nose ...
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her scallop shelled bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Is it weird that we haven't seen any female zombies before? Some say yes. Some say no. Either way, Bikini Zombie is used to breaking new ground. She's not afraid to go where no woman zombie has gone before. You could call her a pioneer. You could call her a hero.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pulls plants to the right
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plants next to him are tossed off the lawn

{FLAVOR}Everyone is tired of Fisherman Zombie's fishing stories. He's always bragging about the size of his catch. Time and time again, he claims to have caught "the big one." But the fact of the matter is, no one has seen him actually catch a fish. Not once. It's more than a little suspicious.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Casts his line to pull far plants to him.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Talk about a disgruntled zombie. Beach Flag Zombie is fed up. None of the other zombies seem to appreciate just how difficult it is for him to swim while holding a flag. Not once have they thanked him for doing the hard work that needs to be done. So it shouldn't come as a surprise: He's been interviewing for jobs elsewhere.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge wet "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with driftwood
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Mermaid when damaged

{FLAVOR}This big guy loves the water. When he's deep down in it, he feels light as a feather. He feels like he's flying. Most importantly, during those precious moments, he feels as if the weight of Imp Mermaid Zombie has been lifted from his shoulders.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Titanic zombie who isn't shellfish with his might.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Imp Mermaid Zombie couldn't decide whether to wear the top made out of coconut shells or the top made out of seashells. She went with the slinky coconut-shell number because, really, the seashells are soooo last wave.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Washes in past your defenses, then flounders forward.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_OCTOPUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}910
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bound plants are passive until their octopus (400 HP) is destroyed

{FLAVOR}It started innocently enough. One day, Octo Zombie decided to get a pet octopus. But he loved that octopus so much, he got another and another ... and another. Next thing you know, he was volunteering at an octopus rescue shelter. And now, well, no one wants to tell him, but he's pretty much the undersea equivalent of a cat lady. You should see how many are living at his house. It's quite startling.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_OCTOPUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Throws octopi at your plants to bind them up.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SNORKEL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}submerges to avoid attacks

{FLAVOR}Snorkel Zombie has a hard time getting the Bikini Zombies. He's tried offering them flowers, jewelry, and even chocolate-covered brains. But nothing seems to work. They just can't seem to see past the snorkel on his face.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SURFER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700 (surfboard) + 350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.55 (surfing), 0.185 (on land)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}can crush a plant with his board

{FLAVOR}Surfer Zombie took up surfing just last year. At first, he only did it because he thought it would make him look cool. But he was a natural. Now he can hang 10 with the best of them. Now he's headed to the pro circuit. Now he IS cool.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SURFER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Surfs past plants on the water, then carries board on land.
ZOMBIE_CAKETANK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Seasonal Spirit: {STAT}immune to most status effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}75% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}#caketank is the hot new trend. It is trending all over the place. Look under your bed. It's trending there, too.
ZOMBIE_CAKETANK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: #caketank advances to your house, releasing shocking birthday surprises as its layers take damage.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250 (camel sign) + 170
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}arrives in a group of three zombies or more

{FLAVOR}Each Camel Zombie is an excellent ballroom dancer, practicing every day by holding up mysterious signs with strange symbols. They call it "The Camel Dance."
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Arrives in step with other Camel Zombies.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_MANYHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Leader of the many hump camel group.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_ONEHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Leader of the one hump camel group.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_SEGMENT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Just another camel in the group.
ZOMBIE_CAMEL_TWOHUMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Leader of the two hump camel group.
ZOMBIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}600
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fires imps to mid-lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}explodes into shower of imps if not destroyed quickly

{FLAVOR}The Imps joined the Order of the Cannon Fraternity, Kappa Pea, and quickly rose through the ranks due to the constant firing of their leadership.
ZOMBIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shoots Pirate Imps past your defenses. Eventually it can explode and rain down imps.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}It is a fact that everyone loves clowns, and zombies, and therefore clown zombies.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The pointy cone provides extra protection for this jolly fellow.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}It turns out miniature elephants are a much greater challenge to train than the regular-sized ones. This is especially true if the trainer is a zombie and has no mind.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The bucket-like miniature elephant stand allows this zombie performer to withstand extra damage.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (grinderbox) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases a Carnie Monkey when grinderbox is broken

{FLAVOR}Initially hired to take care of a case involving a runaway monkey, he found himself frustrating a great magician in his chase, and as punishment, Grinderhead Zombie found himself spellbound into a card, sealed away for who knows how long. It's cramped in there, itchy, and the monkey still hasn't learned his lesson. All-in-all it's a net negative.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grinderbox helmet provides spectacular defense against attacks, also houses a monkey for extra pizzazz!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches a Cannonball Imp towards the middle of the lawn

{FLAVOR}Despite recent budget cuts, this cannon show is still possible! Unfortunately at the cost of lacking the needed staying power.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Launches a daredevil carnie imp high above the crowds.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_COTTONCANDY_BLUE_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws blue cotton candies that boost zombies' speed by 50%

{FLAVOR}"I hate the guy next to me." - Blue Vendor Zombie
Throws blue, speed-boosting cotton candies for zombies to enjoy while they perform.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_COTTONCANDY_PINK_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws pink cotton candies that boost zombies' toughness by 18%

{FLAVOR}Pink is in fashion! A vibrant and playful color! Perfect for carnie visitors and especially for all the awe-inspired imps! Though despite seeing lots of success, he still finds the time to try sabotaging his (very limited) competition, usually by sliding in disgusting veggies in his candy. Only buy stuff from him if you find his effort respectable, capiche?
Throws pink, toughness-boosting cotton candies for zombies to enjoy while they perform.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Carnie Zombie loves the freedom of the open road and would never ever cheat you. He expected that nobody would cheat him either, but those darn carnival games just always seem to get the better of him. One might say spending copius amounts of Zombucks on carnival games in the first place is a poor investment in this economy, but you'd be surprised just how fluffy those rewarded carnival toys are.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A hard and honest worker at a "hard and earnest" carnie.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DOVE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}150
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}1.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}flies over and targets the most recently placed plant

{FLAVOR}Expertly trained to hide in tight spaces and grab objects with utmost precision. However, training their manners is a daunting task, so be patient with their litter.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DOVE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Quickly flies from the Magician to carry away a plant.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}450
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}breathes fire towards nearby plants every 7 seconds
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguishes flame

{FLAVOR}Always safety-conscious, Firebreather Zombie only breathes fire when there are things nearby that burn easily. That's not all he's confused about, either.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_DESCRIPTION_H: Firebreather Zombie... wait for it... breathes fire. And plenty of it!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}In a world filled with supposed wonder, Carnie Flag Zombie has been upset that his iconic phrase "Come one, come all!" always seems to fall on deaf ears. He was tasked to put up various posters in hopes of enticing people to come to the carnival but he suspects they may be achieving the opposite result.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge extravagant "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barbell
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Carnie Imp Twins when damaged

{FLAVOR}Don't let appearances decieve you, Strongman Gargantuar's got a master's degree in 18th-century French poetry, which is his preferred hobby. He only got convinced to enter the entertainment industry under the promise that he'd get to carry elephants. You can imagine his disappointment upon meeting Carnie Buckethead.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Muscular zombie that's ready to steal the spotlight and put on a show!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700 (helmet) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Cannonball Imp can't keep any of his jobs for long. He always ends up getting fired.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is fired past your defenses, then moves on to Act 2 of his performance.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_SPLIT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Carnie Imp Split is pursuing solo opportunities, as is Carnie Imp Split.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_SPLIT_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Separating Carnie Imp Twins creates two Carnie Imp Splits.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}splits into two imps upon defeat
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage before splitting

{FLAVOR}They're not actually twins, though they are identical.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Two imps are generously provided for the price of one.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}teleports other zombies and himself 1.5 tiles forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summoned doves steal plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to magic effects

{FLAVOR}"Now you see my entry, now you       !"
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Teleports zombies and himself forward using his magic tricks! Also has sneaky doves that'll fly away with your plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MIRROR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}460
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}reflected card projectiles affect plants

{FLAVOR}She remembers this moment as if it was yesterday: her, walking in the hall of mirrors, struck by the gaze, the beauty of which she had never seen before. It truly takes one kind of a face to look this good inside a warped reflection. This story of self-love is as twisted as the funhouse mirror itself.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MIRROR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Carries a mirror that reflects tarot spells back onto plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MONKEY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}1
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes plants with its mug instead of eating

{FLAVOR}Oo-Oo-Aah-AAH!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MONKEY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Once released, monkeys will run at full speed to show off their latest act: "The Baneful Battery!"
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MUSICBOX_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stuns plants in a 3x3 radius around her
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases 3 Mechanical Monkeys on her lane once defeated
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off her windup key
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}music box has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets

{FLAVOR}The story tells of an inventor who had created a mechanical doll so lifelike, that it had smitten one of the youth of a traveling carnival band. The boy decided to pursue her heart and abandon his lover, unaware of the dolls' true nature. He made his way to the place where he sees the doll everyday, only to find she's nothing but a shell. Before he could leave, however, the inventor had trapped him in the building. Several days later, a girl went around town, looking for her lover, to no avail. Back in his lab, Dr. Zomboss cheered and laughed as he witnessed his creation slowly moving to life on its own, the boy nowhere in sight.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MUSICBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Stuns nearby plants with her soothing music box tunes and has a surprise saved for her final act!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_PRANKSTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}910
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}attacks plants with electric buzzer before throwing dynamites, dealing more damage the longer it's used
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}throws dynamites that deal 900 damage at plants after stopping at the sixth column, priority depends on higher cost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a Carnie Nibbler when defeated

{FLAVOR}Prankster had already been the Zombie that he is nowadays way before the Carnival. His origin is shrouded in rumors. Some say he hides something, believing others can't handle the truth. Another rumor was that he came from a terrible discovery regarding his father. Some even say that he is actually a bloodthirsty vampire. We asked Prankster, but he simply stated that he prefers his origin to be multiple choice.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_PRANKSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Throws deadly dynamites towards plants just for some giggles! Prioritizes higher cost plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (stilts) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ignores plants while on stilts instead of eating them
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to most knockback while on stilts

{FLAVOR}At such a towering height, Stiltwalker Zombie has an elevated view of things. He refuses, for example, to buy second-hand milk.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION_HE: Stiltwalker Zombie's stilts allow him to walk right over most plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_BALL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}1
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ignores plants
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes and deals 300 damage to a random plant in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd column

{FLAVOR}Fun for the whole family, these revolutionary toys were patented back in the 16th century and were lovingly stockpiled here for a long while. All they needed was a paint-job and an award winning smile and you're set! Just don't kick them too hard, the Caliginous Carnival team and the Zomboss estate are not liable for any damages. No refunds.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_BALL_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Bounces deep into defenses and explodes and destroys a plant for its final act!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with new Mallet-Smashing action, dealing 7.5 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}The series 14 Action Gargantuar has been a point of contention due to the specific way in which they were manufactured; in that regardless of how you package them, they will always find a way outside of their box. As you can imagine, this has brought great frustration to both gardeners and collectors alike.
The biggest toy on the market.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_SNIFFER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}750
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}sniffing does no damage, but helps it block shots for other zombies

{FLAVOR}"If I was a nose, why would I have a nose? Checkmate."
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_SNIFFER_DESCRIPTION_HE: This toy sniffs plants, blocking shots and gives the zombie performers space to put on a show!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_TEDDY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage to other obstacles
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off its head

{FLAVOR}These were once made to heighten zombie morale and sold as an actual product among zombiekind just so Dr. Zomboss could gain some quick bucks. As one could already guess, his PR had to work overtime after that disaster.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_TEDDY_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Pushes plants across the lawn with its totally fluffy arms.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_TEETH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}330
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.45
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}A lot of zombies could have really used these in their daily unlives but Zomboss had to be a showoff.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_TEETH_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Shuffles towards plants with quite the presentation with its appetite!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_BLUE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.135
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops onto the lawn in groups of 2 to 4

{FLAVOR}Working on improving themselves, these talented gymnasts put in years of work to be able to perform these undeath-defying stunts perfectly. All that effort just to be invited to a flimsy place like this with no opportunity to find a better gig. It's quite sad, really.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_BLUE_DESCRIPTION_H: A group of zombies that perform wonderful tricks by landing one by one on a single tile, with style and elegance to boot!
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Once released onto the lawn chickens run full speed to peck at your brains.
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_FARMER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons zombie chickens when damaged

{FLAVOR}After publishing the fourth study on Ornithology, and four years of research at the Hadron Collider, Chicken Wrangler Zombie has finally solved the riddle of what came first.
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_FARMER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Releases a flock of chickens once his baling wire is broken.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}The sheriff of these here parts. Please pull over the horse and pull out your driver's license, registration, and proof of brains.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His cowhide cone gives him twice the toughness of a regular cowboy.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A five-time winner of the temporal chili cook-off. Those Egyptian zombies don't know their chili, but Cowboys love their beans. The more you eat, the more you brains.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His chili pot hat makes him greatly resistant to damage.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (cart) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cart-Head Zombie could probably move a lot faster if he did a handstand and rolled, but he's not thinking that far ahead.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cart-Head Zombie's cart-shaped chapeau provides extra-wheeled head protection.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cowboy Zombie thinks he's the roughest, toughest, meanest zombie varmint in the west, south and east. He's anxious to test his skills in the central coast region.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge dusty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Arrows point to the brain on Cowboy Rally's Flag, as if to say, "Hey, everyone, I would like to emphasize this image." It's canny design.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Cowboy Rally Zombie marks the appearance of a sizable stampede of zombies.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with brand
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Bull Rider when damaged

{FLAVOR}Likes candy.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Conehead Peasant is just happy to have a cone over his head. Times are tough, man. He knows a lot of zombies don't even have that.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His stony turret cone makes him twice as tough as normal peasants.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}None of the other zombies seem to understand just how versatile Buckethead Peasant's choice of headwear is. Sure, his bucket makes for a great battle helmet. But just last night, he cooked a truly divine brain stew in it. And next time you see his band, check out what he’s using for a kick drum.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His forged bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1600 (helmet) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Knight Zombie was just as surprised as anyone when Zombie King promoted him. He'd never say this out loud, but he's not sure he deserves the position. He's not sure he has what it takes to wear the armor. But like they say, "Fake it 'til you make it."
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His king appointed helm provides amazing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_DARK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Someone shouted, "Bring out your undead!" And then Peasant Zombie found himself here. He simply doesn't remember anything that happened before that.
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}They keep telling Peasant Zombie that there is no greater reward than being granted the banner to carry into battle. But when he sees other Peasant Zombies being granted cones, buckets, and even helms, he thinks maybe they're making that up so they don't hurt his feelings.
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge dark "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_DARK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with hammer
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Monk when damaged

{FLAVOR}When Dark Ages Gargantuar wants to find pantaloons that fit him, he has to shop at the "Enormous & Towering" store. He hates it though. It's embarrassing. He just wants to shop for clothes where all the other zombies shop.
ZOMBIE_DARK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Immense zombie who brings the hammer down.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Frankly, Imp Monk Zombie decided to don the robes because of the sweet haircut that went with them.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Summoned past most of your defenses, then shambles onward.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to fire damage

{FLAVOR}Imp Zombie knows he's too old to wear a dragon costume like a kid on Halloween. But he doesn't care. Let the others judge. His spirit animal is a dragon, and he feels closer to his true self when he's dressed like this.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Spit past most of your defenses, then claws forward.
ZOMBIE_DARK_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}420
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2 (normal), 0.16 (juggling)

{FLAVOR}Oh sure, everyone loves to laugh at Jester Zombie's clownish routines. But what no one knows is that he has a Master of Fine Arts from the Chewliard Performing Arts School. Heck, he's been on stage with some of the finest classical theatre companies this side of the lawn. But sometimes you just gotta go where the paycheck is.
ZOMBIE_DARK_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Returns projectiles that are shot at him.
ZOMBIE_DARK_KING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000

{FLAVOR}As Shakespeare once wrote, "Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown." And Zombie King couldn't agree more. It is incredibly difficult to get a good night's sleep with a crown on your head. That thing is all kinds of uncomfortable.
ZOMBIE_DARK_KING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grants knight helms to nearby peasant zombies.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}plants turn back to normal when Wizard Zombie dies

{FLAVOR}All the zombies agree, Wizard Zombie's powers of transmutation are impressive. But what they don't get is ... why sheep? Everyone knows it would be more helpful if the Wizard used his powers to turn plants into, say, more zombies. But yeah, no one is going to say that to his face.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Jurassic Conehead Zombie is trying to get the jump on the whole "traffic cone" idea. He figures it'll be a HUGE market in about 150 million years.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cones, or old leftover horns bundled together with string so that they look sort of like a cone, provide some middling protection.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.175

{FLAVOR}The real question, the burning mystery, is: where did he find blue fur for his outfit?
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Crude drawings of buckets provide as much protection as the real thing.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1600 (skull) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16

{FLAVOR}Contrary to his name, Jurassic Fossilhead's fossil head isn't actually a fossil. That skull's maybe a week and a half old, tops.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fossil skulls not only provide a huge amount of damage absorption, but are also extremely classy.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (amber) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}If you were to extract DNA from the Amberhead Zombie and combine it with the DNA of a frog, you'd probably be breaking the law at some point.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Amberhead Zombie's head-engulfing ball of amber provides hardened protection.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16

{FLAVOR}Jurassic Bully is slow, stupid, and smells bad. But hey, at least he's punctual.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A trudging, damage-resistant zombie who is immune to all knockback.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants and leaves scorched tiles behind which disappear after 25 seconds
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to knockback

{FLAVOR}Somebody tied rocks to Jurassic Rockpuncher's hands. Being unable to remove them (because he had rocks tied to his hands), he was left with no choice but to roll with it.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE: Jurassic Rockpuncher pummels plants with rocks tied to his hands.
ZOMBIE_DINO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Jurassic Zombie is NOT primitive. See, he's wearing a tie and everything!
ZOMBIE_DINO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Regular beard-having zombie from the unimaginable past.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He's not only got a flag, but he's also got a can-do attitude and a fierce hunger for success. Success and brains.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge epochal "wave" of highly anachronistic zombies.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Where did Jurassic Rally Zombie get his fancy new flag? Nobody knows. It's a mystery. The police should look into it. Or maybe we could get a fund together and hire a detective. It's a real puzzle.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Jurassic Rally Zombie marks the arrival of large group of zombies.
ZOMBIE_DINO_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}5400
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with bone
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Jurassic Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Jurassic Gargantuar wonders how there can be zombies millions of years before the advent of humanity. He doesn't let it get in the way of his plant-bashing, though.
ZOMBIE_DINO_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}This nasty little nipper can make a serious dent in your defenses if left to his own devious devices.
ZOMBIE_DINO_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A weaker, smaller, much more vicious version of the typical Jurassic zombie.
ZOMBIE_DISCO_MECH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons Disco Jetpack Zombies

{FLAVOR}After some initial problems with the sideburn suspension system, the Disco-tron 3000 went on to become the shufflin' dance-bot of doom it is today.
ZOMBIE_DISCO_MECH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Drops in disco zombies when dropping the beat.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with sarcophagus
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Mummy when damaged

{FLAVOR}True fact #1: The pyramids were built in an attempt to make Mummified Gargantuar seem small. It didn't work. True fact #2: The Sphinx isn't missing its nose... that is the face of... Gargantuar.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Massive zombie from a royal line of mummies.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Imp Mummy prefers to laze around the tomb, hop up on the urns, and scratch at the sarcophagi. The sound of him coughing up a hairball is one you will never forget.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Thrown over most of your defenses, then slinks onward.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_8BIT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190 (can come with cone (+ 370) or bucket (+ 1100))
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Being made out of light and positional co-ordinates has no effect on this erzatz zombie’s ravenous hunger for tangy brains.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_8BIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pixelated zombie generated by super cool arcade machine. Comes in regular, cone and bucket flavors.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490 + 600 (arcade cabinet)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19

{FLAVOR}When it’s a choice between quarters for games and quarters for laundry, Arcade Zombie is prepared to make the ultimate stinky sacrifice.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Pushes an arcade cabinet that spits out 8-Bit Zombies.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Neon Conehead Zombie used to be a big believer in de-evolution, but then he forgot what it meant.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Cones provide protection and focus the sound of righteous tunes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Neon Buckethead Zombie had to go all the way to the dump to find a headband he really liked.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Buckets absorb damage because that’s just what they do.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}turns on his boom box for 8 seconds after reaching the sixth column
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}boom box has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets

{FLAVOR}Boombox Zombie doesn’t want to buy, sell or process anything; he just really wants to consume your brains.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Holds aloft a boom box that tranquilizes all plants with its heartfelt tunes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24 (normal), 0.35 (jamming)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}kicks zombies 1.5 tiles forward when jamming

{FLAVOR}Delivers only the freshest moves at bargain basement prices.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_DESCRIPTION_: Kicks zombies forward when transported by the power of rap.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He's cutting down on his head-banging so as not to bang his head clean off.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Fluorescent colors and little yellow plastic strips are the marks of a truly hip, groundbreaking new style of zombie wave flag.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge mixtape-making "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with guitar
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes sonic blast when metal music plays, dealing 1000 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Impunk when damaged

{FLAVOR}Hair Metal Gargantuar only knows one chord, but you'd better believe he'll play it all night and then some.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Nepotism got Lost City Imp where he is. He’s Bug Zombie’s second cousin thrice removed, but he parlayed that connection into a sweet gig getting carried around in a little box.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gets tossed past most defenses, then explores on foot.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMPPORTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350 + 500 (backpack)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tent has 700 HP

{FLAVOR}Imp Porter is stronger than he looks. He’s also more charming, smarter and has a better education.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_IMPPORTER_DESCRIPTION_HE: Drops pack on Gold Tile, pack becomes tent from which zombies emerge.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_JANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25

{FLAVOR}Wealthy beyond reason, the Parasol Zombie lived a life of luxury – when what she craved was a life of adventure. She funded the expedition to the Lost City and set out to see its wonders for herself, never forgetting to bring her trusty parasol. "In case it rains," she explained – but it only came out sounding like "Brains."
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Parasol provides protection from lobbed projectiles.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_LOSTPILOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}He faked his pilot's license and figured nobody would notice. But they did.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_RELICHUNTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}760
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.155
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}swings past defenses randomly in the 4th, 5th or 6th column

{FLAVOR}Relic Hunter has hunted some pretty impressive relics in his day. Idols, antiques, curios... he’s hunted 'em all.
ZOMBIE_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16

{FLAVOR}Zombie engineers considered the orange cone the height of zombie protective technology. It wasn't until they perfected the design for the Robo-Cone that someone remembered the bucket.
ZOMBIE_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The armor-plated cone offers phenomenal protection for its pilot.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16 (normal), 0.5 (tackling)
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}All-Star Zombie is a third-round draft pick and shows a lot of promise, but come on, his salary demands are beyond ridiculous. Ten million brains per year? For FIFTY YEARS?
ZOMBIE_MODERN_ALLSTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A heavy-duty zombie who charges your defensive line.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (balloon) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Balloon Zombie has no idea where the balloon came from, but he's going with it and he's open to seeing where it takes him.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Balloon carries zombies over barriers and ground defenses.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800 (newspaper) + 460
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (normal), 0.88 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage normally, 8 times the normal damage when angry

{FLAVOR}You can't really blame him for getting so upset; he was THIS close to finishing the crossword (23 down was "Brains.")
ZOMBIE_MODERN_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Newspaper protects zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes and deals 300 damage to a random plant in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd column

{FLAVOR}Super-Fan Imp has season tickets, subscribes to the team newsletter, and is super pumped about exploding on contact with fans of the opposing team.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTION_HE: An all-too-enthusiastic imp who explodes with rah-rah-rah fervor.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Conehead Mummy Zombie prefers the circular cone shape over the typical pyramid shape. It's a fashion thing, and Conehead Mummy Zombie always stays ahead of fashion.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His cobra cone headdress makes him twice as tough as normal mummies.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Buckethead Mummy Zombie graduated Magna Zom Louder from Zombie Academy where he learned to utilize his diaphragm during groaning lessons.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sandy bucket greatly protects him from damage.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (pyramid) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Pyramid-Head Zombie isn't aware that his pyramid is pyramid-shaped. He's a little slow in that respect.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His pyramid-shaped headgear provides triangular noggin protection.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Is he a mummy? Is he a zombie? It turns out he's a zombie who's rolled himself in toilet paper to protect his fair skin. True fact!
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Egyptian Flag Zombie is so far behind he thinks he's in first place. He's clearly living in de-Nile.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge sandy "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Sometimes, a regular Flag Mummy Zombie simply isn't enough to inspire the desired amount of terror and disgust. In these instances, upgrading to the Egypt Rally Zombie isn't the sensible choice, it's the only choice.
ZOMBIE_MUMMY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE: He celebrates with increased vigor and truculence the arrival of a new wave of bandaged baddies.
ZOMBIE_NEWSPAPER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1800 (newspaper) + 490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (normal), 0.88 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage normally, 15 times the normal damage when angry

{FLAVOR}Sunday Edition Zombie REALLY loves the comics section, which is why his rage is so all-consuming when it is torn to tatters before he's finished reading it.
ZOMBIE_NEWSPAPER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The newspaper protects zombie, who becomes enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.6
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants

{FLAVOR}The Pelican Zombie upgraded from the Seagull Zombie and has no regrets. No egrets, either. Just a pelican.
ZOMBIE_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pelican Zombie crosses water without a plank and flies over low plants.
ZOMBIE_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 (sarcophagus) + 290
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (when entombed), 0.5 (freed)

{FLAVOR}The second cousin once removed of King Rot, he rose to power with his disappearing sarcophagus act, but met his untimely end in an unfortunate goat accident. His tale is told in great detail on the back of his sarcophagus, which no one will ever see.
ZOMBIE_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sarcophagus greatly protects him but slows down a rather fast zombie.
ZOMBIE_PIANO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}840
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with piano
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}causes cowboy zombies to switch lanes

{FLAVOR}Pianist Zombie only knows two songs, and they're both groaners.
ZOMBIE_PIANO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His rolling piano crushes plants while his music causes dancing zombies to switch lanes.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Conehead Pirate is a simple zombie. When asked what his favorite dish is, he'd think for a moment, straighten his ascot, and say, "Rrurrarrbrains." Perhaps he could borrow a cup, neighbor?
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His Jolly Roger cone makes him twice as tough as normal pirates.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Buckethead Pirate Zombie is looking for his bucket. Have you seen it? It's where? Up where? Speak up, he can't hear you.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sturdy wooden bucket provides excellent protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Dredged from the deepest of seas, Barrelhead Zombie's barrel is a high-quality cask that fits just a bit too snugly.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Barrelhead Zombie's keg-like hat provides augmented protection.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}What could it be? Could it be gold? Or some sort of other kind of treasure?  Who knows!
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_BARREL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Contains Imp Zombies that launch out when destroyed.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}420
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}parrot pet steals plants

{FLAVOR}Pirate Captain Zombie isn't actually a captain.  His dry cleaning got mixed up with someone else's, but he thought he looked cool with an eye patch.  Plus, the parrot already knew his name, so he just went with it.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His parrot can fly away with your plant and then return to him.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_CAPTAIN_PARROT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}300
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}1.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can fly to plants in other lanes to carry them away

{FLAVOR}He's a third generation aviation revolutionary. He wants to serve his pirate brethren like his father and his grandmother, Salty Anne, before him.
Quickly flies from the Captain to carry away a plant.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Keeping up with the latest pirate trends is always tricky, but remember, he was planking before it was cool.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge salty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Jolly Roger Zombie and his flag are fused together into a single brain-munching unit. Their teamwork is an inspiration to ghouls everywhere.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Jolly Roger Zombie marks the arrival of lots and lots of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with shark
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires off Pirate Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Gargantuar Pirate likes short walks off the plank, moonlit raiding parties, and the smell of cannon fire. A true romantic.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Enormous zombie who redefines the shark attack.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}He was a bootblack, with a side trade as a pickpocket on the streets of London, but all he stole were oversized footwear. "Time to steal some booty!" was his catchphrase.
ZOMBIE_PIRATE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Prefers the compact space of barrels, both cannon and rolling.
ZOMBIE_UNUSED_64_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}60 (poncho) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}randomly wears a protective metal grate (1100 HP)

{FLAVOR}The grate is his most prized possession. The poncho is there just to protect it from getting rusty. Also, he's looking for his mechanical horse.
ZOMBIE_UNUSED_64_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sometimes has a hidden armored plate.
ZOMBIE_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}appears on the left side of the lawn after dynamite explodes
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks put out dynamite

{FLAVOR}"There once was a zombie who got old, spending all his days looking for gold.  'Til one day in the rain, he finally ate brains... and, wait, where's his other shoe?"
ZOMBIE_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Launches over your defenses when his fuse burns down.
ZOMBIE_RA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tries to steal sun

{FLAVOR}Ra Zombie isn't actually named after the Sun God Ra, though that's a common mistake. He just likes to say "Ra" a lot.
ZOMBIE_RA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tries to steal sun, just for safe keeping.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION: Was there enough traffic in Ancient Rome to justify cones? Historians differ. It's a real debate.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A traffic cone made of marble provides some protection.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION: They had buckets just like this back in Ancient Rome. Believe it.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A fancy bucket with a bit of flair distinguishes this zombie.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION: Did you know that in Ancient Rome, a centurion commanded a century? Isn't that wild?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A higher grade of Roman Zombie.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION: Bust Head Zombie belongs in museum with a big sign that says something like, "WARNING: THIS IS A ZOMBIE!"
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A bust head means this Roman zombie can take a serious beating.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION: Surprise! That exploding vase has a zombie in it! Isn’t that surprising?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_BALLISTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A ballista from Ancient Rome, the Zcorpion Zombie launches an exploding vase at the nearest plant in its lane.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION: In Ancient Rome, flags were often used on the battlefield to direct troop movements. Though come on: how much direction do you really need to shuffle leftward?
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The flag indicates more zombies are on their way!
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION: He's got a column and he's not afraid to use it.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Wears a helmet. Throws an imp AND a net. Just a real piece of work.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION: Hot tip: take this one out as fast as you can if you don't want your life turned into a pit of abject misery and despair.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_HEALER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Uses weird Roman magic to heal zombies.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION: Like all Zombie Imps, Roman Imp keeps turning up where you least want him.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Small. Impy. Wears a former lion.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION: Hailing originally from Greece but thriving in Rome, Zombie Medusa takes advice from her snakes based on their charisma and shared personal hisssstory.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_MEDUSA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zombie Medusa pushes petrified zombies in stone blocks as well as stoneifying zombies and zomboids that face her.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION: The shield protects him from bad reviews and hurtful remarks.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_: A dull-witted, unusually shy Roman zombie who's also carrying a shield.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION: When three Roman shield zombies are too many, how about two? Two's a good number, right? It's even, it's prime... it's got everything!
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_PAIR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: A pair of Roman shield zombies.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION: This number of shield zombies is three higher than zombies can count.
ZOMBIE_ROMAN_SHIELD_TRIAD_DESCRIPTION_HE: Three Roman shield zombies in a row.
ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.355
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}floats over low plants

{FLAVOR}Seagull Zombie has racked up the frequent flier miles and dreams of going to the top colleges in the world on a cerebral gastronomy vacation.
ZOMBIE_SEAGULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Crosses watery gaps without a plank and flies over low plants.
ZOMBIE_SWASHBUCKLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lands four tiles into your lawn

{FLAVOR}He swashes. He buckles. But, he also writes home every third Sunday and sends brains and treasure via post. He's a good zombie at heart.
ZOMBIE_SWASHBUCKLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Swings in on a rope to land midway onto your lawn.
ZOMBIE_TOMB_RAISER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}380
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates tombstones (700 HP) on the lawn

{FLAVOR}He dreams about playing fetch, running for the brains. He loves burying himself in the yard, and is not yet indoor trained. He's still looking for his tail.
ZOMBIE_TOMB_RAISER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Throws out bones to create tombstones.
ZOMBIE_TREASUREYETI_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Speed Details: {STAT}runs away after a short while
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}carries treasure

{FLAVOR}The rare and wondrous Yeti carries his lunch box up and down Mount Brainer to his isolated mountain lodge.
ZOMBIE_TREASUREYETI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A rare and curious creature, he always packs a lunch.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}After a wild night, Conehead Zombie woke up holding a mysterious receipt for a cone and industrial strength adhesive.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His traffic cone headpiece makes him twice as tough as normal zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}There was a time when Buckethead Zombie was hailed as a zombie genius for his innovative bucket-on-head strategy. It's been a few years, though, and zombies wonder if he's got any surprises left. His secret? He doesn't.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His bucket hat makes him extremely resistant to damage.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (bricks) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}After consultation with various storybook wolves, it was determined that straw helmets and wood helmets were not up to snuff, and that brick helmets had to be seriously considered.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Brickhead Zombie's brick head provides thorough brickheaded brickheadness.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Basic Zombie hates the term "Basic." He doesn't consider himself some generic foe or common corpse. He's an individual, darn it, and he's going to make a difference even if it kills you.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A spelling impaired zombie named "Brian," Flag Zombie keeps thinking the rest of the zombies are talking to him. At least he feels important.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His flag marks the arrival of a huge pile or "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Rally Zombie splurged on the all-leather flag because, heck, he's worth it.
Rally Zombie and his flag marks the arrival of a large clot or "pile" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Gargantuar is the embodiment of power, made real. He is a juggernaut of hunger, from which there is no escape. He is fear unleashed. Well, he's fear slightly leashed.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H: Gargantuar really is kind of a big deal.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}What he lacks in reach he more than makes up for with his bad attitude, or zombadittude as he likes to call it. Don't encourage him.
ZOMBIE_TUTORIAL_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is hurled onto the lawn past your defenses, then shuffles ahead.
ZOMBIE_VASE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}The ceramic confines of the Vase Gargantuar's home has done nothing to his endless hunger, his immense power, or his vast destructive potential. However, his footspeed could be better.
ZOMBIE_VASE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Phenomenally sized zombie stuffed into a tiny unliving space.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1300
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16 (normal), 1 (stampeding)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches a low flying imp rider over plants 2 tiles forward
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}tall blocking plants blocks flying imp
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}He's not an angry bull. He loves flowers, playing in the fields, sitting under trees, and long walks across the pasture. He wants to settle down when he meets the right cow. Too bad he's a robot.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Can launch his zombie rider past most of your defenses.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1400
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19 (normal), 2 (stampeding)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}charges multiple times, dealing 2000 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches a low flying imp rider over plants 2 tiles forward
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}tall blocking plants blocks flying imp
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}"Legend" perhaps overstates Rodeo Legend Zombie's status in the rodeo world. Don't tell him that, though, unless you're desperate to hear an hour-long tirade about calf-roping.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Rodeo Legend Zombie smashes a plant and launches his zombie rider past most of your defenses.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULLRIDER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Had dreams of becoming a rodeo clown but found the clown make-up to just be too creepy.
ZOMBIE_WEST_BULLRIDER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gets launched past all but the tallest plants, then proceeds on foot.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}"Workplace safety is no joke," is what they kept telling him at orientation. But easy for them to say. They're not the one stuck putting this oversized pinned book on top of their head every time they have to go to work.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A typical ZCorp employee, except with more on his mind.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}ZCorp fully complies with all local, state and federal waste disposal ordinances.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: An environmentally friendly recycle bin protects the employee's noggin from damage.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_CONSULTANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tosses zombies into other lanes
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}switches lanes or goes backward from time to time

{FLAVOR}Has started to regret consulting for the Holiday Mashup initiative. Building giant Zombots that get destroyed easily by literal Peashooters seems to be more of a financial liability now that she thinks about it.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_CONSULTANT_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: ZCorp Consultant speeds into the lawn, tossing zombies into other lanes.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Was tasked along with others to overlook the ongoing Holiday Mashup initiative. Considering using office employees as foot soldiers on a battlefield is usually considered a worker's rights violation, he would assume that this isn't going so well.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}ZCorp branded office supplies are in limited supply - get one for your work cubicle now! All proceeds go straight into Dr. Zomboss' pockets. What? You think all those giant Zombots pay for themselves?
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: It's the combination of notebook and comically large pushpin that really gives this contractor the edge.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190

{FLAVOR}Having been stuck at a dead end 9-to-5 job for almost 5 years now, you'd think applying for another similar job at ZCorp would be the last thing someone like her would want to do. But hey, they gave free coffee mugs at orientation!
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2100
