{FLAVOR}Head Office Impgantuar's door is always open. It is, however, highly inadvisable to take him up on that offer.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His giant noggin is a blunt instrument of smashing.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500 (laptop) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (normal), 0.37 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage when angry
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes if defeated before he can throw his laptop, dealing 800 damage to nearby zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}becomes enraged after throwing his laptop (laptop deals 1000 damage)

{FLAVOR}His real passion is in plaid coat manufacturing. But alas, sometimes dreams don't come true in the corporate world we died in.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_HELPDESK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: ZCorp HelpDesk drops in and throws an exploding laptop.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Gargimp Legal delivers cease-and-desists the old-fashioned way: with a baseball bat.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tiny but fierce, the Gargimp Legal department is the best and the beast in the business.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_RACER_CHAIR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1150 (when on chair), 500 (zombie)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (zombie), 1 (when on chair)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}chair deals 5000 damage when it collided
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches over plants 2.5 tiles forward when chair collided
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}ZCorp Chair Racer brings fun and spontaneity to the zcorporate experience.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_RACER_CHAIR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: ZCorp Chair Racer zooms in at high speed, collides with great impact, and catapults leftward with extraordinary grace.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}mouth turbine can pull plants to it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summoned zombie sharks can consume plants

{FLAVOR}The Zombot Sharktronic Sub is a true labor of love. Dr. Zomboss obsessed over every detail of the aquatic mechanism of doom as he worked on it day in and day out from the wee hours of the morning until well after dark. He carefully handcrafted the shark's nearly impenetrable exterior skin. He shaved each razor-sharp tooth to a point by hand. And he painstakingly installed the lethal plant-consuming fan inside the machine's horrific maw all by himself. Zomboss shed more than one tear of joy when his masterpiece was complete. Say what you will about the evil genius, but he is passionate about his projects.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The ravenous engine of carnage from the murky depths.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes little damage from regular attacks
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can launch Cannonball Imps
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}magic attacks deal huge damage

{FLAVOR}"Perhaps my tricks and traps didn't work to sway those plants, but I refuse to give up on a form of entertainment with so much history and plant-destroying potential," cackles Dr. Zomboss, all while tapping out a jaunty little tune on his keyboard. Not long after the tune finished, his expression soured. "It's rigged! Those plants are cheaters, the lot of them! Why, if I didn't take over the carnival, so many wonders would have been left unearthed. I deserve to have that toybox!"
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_CIRCUS_DESCRIPTION_HE: The mystery-filled circus-wagon of terrors and delights.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can target mine carts

{FLAVOR}Ranchers and farmhands abandon your fields. Rumbling down the dusty trail, this wagon was engineered to strike fear into the heart of any horticulturist who should encounter it. Dr. Zomboss normally doesn't take any bull, but this time he made an exception.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION_HE: The stagecoach of destruction from the western wilds.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fire breathing attacks destroy plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbed fireballs can hatch Imp Dragon Zombies

{FLAVOR}With a rumble of destruction, Dr. Zomboss forged his Dark Dragon in the heart of a volcano. Then he tempered the beast in the chilled waters of Doom Lake. Finally  he fed its furnace with coal from the Mines of Morbidity. And the paint job - that was done by Carl.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: The desolator of all, from dark times.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons dinosaurs

{FLAVOR}With flagrant disregard for temporal tidiness and simple good taste, Dr. Zomboss figured it would be a good idea to build a big metal dinosaur.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: A mechanical means of dinosaurian destruction.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attack can create tombstones

{FLAVOR}To add that extra bit of wickedness to the Sphinx-inator Dr. Zomboss chiseled his creation from the stonework of cursed tombs. You should not take this instance of reuse and recycle to mean he's going green. The only thing green about him is his tongue.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The destroyer of plants from the ancient sands.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speakers do passive damage (except to ground plants and Phat Beet) and send out shockwave attacks

{FLAVOR}In another world, in another time, Dr. Zomboss would receive the bounty of enthusiastic applause that is his due. Not here and now, though. Nope.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION_: An intimate evening with some of Dr. Zomboss’ most recent and painful explorations.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can destroy Power Tiles

{FLAVOR}When Dr. Zomboss is nestled into the comfy folds of his futuristic cerebral control pod he almost finds it hard to be evil. Of course once he sees a lawn full of happy plants that puts him right back where he needs to be, hungry and evil.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The Power Tile crushing creation from the Far Future.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss was real impressed with himself when he came up with the idea to build a weaponized woolly mammoth with the power to blast snow and ice out of its mechanical trunk. But what Dr. Zomboss didn’t realize until it was too late: He’s allergic to mammoth fur. Now he has to load up on allergy medication every time he wants to take the darn thing out for a spin.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The mammoth mech with an ice blast from the past.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops zombies and bags o’ sand

{FLAVOR}After repeated failures with variously robotic engines of destruction, Dr. Zomboss decided to go with a kinder, more eco-friendly lighter-than-air option to sow disaster and discord.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY_DESCRIPTION_: The floating fortress from the skies above.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannon can rain down imps past your defenses

{FLAVOR}"Hoist the mizzenmast, batten down the hatches! 15 zombies on a dead man's boat, yo ho ho and a bucket of brains!" Dr. Zomboss had to admit he was really getting into this whole pirate thing. Though he never thought he'd be on a boat on a boat.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The plant plundering privateer of the high seas.

DEFEAT_SPRINGENING_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DES: Because their dumb boiled eggs smell horrible!
DEFEAT_BIRTHDAYZ_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: They don't want to celebrate, they just want your brains!
DEFEAT_SUMMERNIGHTS_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DE: Didn't anyone tell them not to hold fireworks? Proper safety is important!
DEFEAT_BIGBRAINZ_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: Who celebrates going back to school? WHO?!
DEFEAT_PVZHEVENT_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: They're imposters! They aren't the REAL heroes!
DEFEAT_FOODFIGHT_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: They contribute to the food waste epidemic! Stop them!
DEFEAT_FEASTIVUS_ZOMBIES_SCHEDULED_DESC: Looks like their only present is going to be an old-fashioned beating!
DEFEAT_STEAM_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their industrial revolts will NOT be tolerated!
DEFEAT_STEAM_BUCKETHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Having a fire hazard around coal? That cannot go unpunished!
DEFEAT_STEAM_CONEHEAD_SCHEDULED_DESC: Their cones must not industrially advance!
DEFEAT_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Throw a wrench in THEIR plans!
DEFEAT_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_REPEATABLE_DESC: According to all known laws of aviation, they shouldn't be able to fly!
DEFEAT_STEAM_BARREL_REPEATABLE_DESC: You might want to give them a mint, but don't allow them to come near any of yours!
DEFEAT_STEAM_MINER_REPEATABLE_DESC: They don't even mine the coal! They just transport it!
DEFEAT_STEAM_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: They shouldn't even be allowed to work!
DEFEAT_STEAM_BACK_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: You're going the wrong way, stupid!
DEFEAT_STEAM_FURNACE_REPEATABLE_DESC: Having a furnace strapped to your back has got to be a safety violation!
DEFEAT_STEAM_INVENTOR_REPEATABLE_DESC: She shouldn't have even passed the job interview!
DEFEAT_STEAM_MECHANIC_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their endless mass production is offsetting the job market!
DEFEAT_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_REPEATABLE_DESC: Don't worry about it, they're already heartless!
DEFEAT_STEAM_REPAIRIMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: They don't even work here, get them outta here!
FINISH_STEAM_1_DESC: Fight off Labor Zombies from all sides and unlock the dazzling Cattail! Complete Steam Ages, Day 1!
FINISH_STEAM_4_DESC: Harsh winds that can stun zombies all throughout the lane may prove useful after you complete Steam Ages, Day 4!
FINISH_STEAM_11_DESC: Lily of Alchemy is sure to give those zombies what for using her lobbed poisonous projectiles! Complete Steam Ages, Day 11!
FINISH_STEAM_13_DESC: A better pay is always the better way. Complete Steam Ages, Day 13 and get paid more for your hard work of keeping those lawnmowers in place!
FINISH_STEAM_14_DESC: Berry Blaster can shoot out bouncing berries that can do some damage before exploding! Complete Steam Ages, Day 14!
FINISH_STEAM_16_DESC: Put a stop to the nefarious plot of Foreman Gargantuar at Day 16 of Steam Ages and earn yourself a dashing World Key!
FINISH_STEAM_18_DESC: Pea-nut fights from afar, and survives in close quarters encounters! Complete Steam Ages, Day 18!
FINISH_STEAM_20_DESC: BRAIN DRAIN FACTORY: Forge your way through the mass-produced madness! Complete Steam Ages, Day 20!
FINISH_STEAM_22_DESC: Maypop Mechanic's the best at multitasking, she'll help you stay protected in all directions! Complete Steam Ages, Day 22!
FINISH_STEAM_25_DESC: Lotus Root fires lotus of bubbles to cover a wide area, or annihilate a zombie point blank: he roots for you! Complete Steam Ages, Day 25!
FINISH_STEAM_32_DESC: Unwind the unyieliding Dr. Zomboss and earn your trophy in this gear-grinding grapple on Steam Ages, Day 32!
FINISH_SKYCITY_1_DESC: Attack Zombies in 3 lanes with the air-adapted Acesparagus! Complete Assault Airspace Day 1!
FINISH_SKYCITY_4_DESC: Receiving projectiles like mail? Return to sender with Puffapple's reflective prowess! Complete Assault Airspace Day 4!
FINISH_SKYCITY_6_DESC: Acquire aerial apprentice Saucer Squash and abduct weaker Zombies while stunning others in range! Complete Assault Airspace Day 6!
FINISH_SKYCITY_12_DESC: Crash the Colonel Gargantuar back to earth and get one step closer to who's behind this aggravated, aerial activity! Complete Assault Airspace Day 12!
FINISH_SKYCITY_13_DESC: Carefully coordinated to target the right Zombies, the pilots in the P-15 Peagle Pod are like peas in a pod- figuratively AND literally! Complete Assault Airspace Day 13!
FINISH_SKYCITY_15_DESC: Need damage in a pinch, but don't have clouds nearby? Dazzle and damage the dead with Nispaereo's dance! Complete Assault Airspace Day 15!
FINISH_SKYCITY_18_DESC: Able to rapid-fire normal peas or send a mega pea for fortified foes, Gatling Pea is back just in time for war! Complete Assault Airspace Day 18!
FINISH_SKYCITY_25_DESC: Crush the Camotron Vulture Fighter and any chance of a "Plan C," too! Complete Assault Airspace Day 25!
FINISH_HOLLOWS_3_DESC: Flameweed warms up plants and burns zombies under them rapidly, including flying foes. You'll want it in your coal-lection! Complete Hypothermic Hollows Day 3!
FINISH_HOLLOWS_12_DESC: Get rid of your cold shoulders for an encounter with the tribal chief! Complete Hypothermic Hollows Day 12!
FINISH_HOLLOWS_17_DESC: ABSOLUTE ZERO PLATEAU:  Take your frigid fights to the polar extreme! Complete Hypothermic Hollows Day 17!
FINISH_HOLLOWS_20_DESC: Save the day with an unprecedented alliance to send the Tuskmaster back into extinction! Complete Hypothermic Hollows Day 20!
FINISH_MARKET_3_DESC: Begonia fires spears of ice and fire that can combo together for some serious petal power! Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 3!
FINISH_MARKET_6_DESC: Cheese Strawberry lobs delectable cheese that reduces zombie eating speed. It doesn't get cheddar than that! Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 6!
FINISH_MARKET_10_DESC: Chef Gargantuars are serving up trouble! Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 10!
FINISH_MARKET_12_DESC: Iris can create mystical birds to keep flocks of zombies away while stalling them too. You'd feather believe it! Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 12!
FINISH_MARKET_17_DESC: DISCONNECTED TRADE CENTER: Explore the seemingly never-ending stretches of the market while putting your heart in the cards. Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 17!
FINISH_MARKET_20_DESC: One final obstacle remains to save the market. It likes to chug oil and kick grass, and it's all out of oil. Complete Lunar Rainbow Market Night 20!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_1_DESC: Hatter-shroom fires hats that ricochet off zombies! Time to throw your hat into the ring! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 1
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_4_DESC: Spring Princess lobs springs that throw zombies back. Let's hop to it! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 4!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_7_DESC: Ent may be prickly, but he's durable to zombie bites and heals himself when unoccupied! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 7!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_12_DESC: Is it an imp? Or is it a reflection of something much more sinister? Complete Fairytale Forest Day 12!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_14_DESC: Coffee Bean wakes plants from slumber and gives them a speed boost! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 14!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_18_DESC: Haze-shroom helps you dispel magic from both plants and zombies, all while growing stronger! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 18!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_22_DESC: THE NEVERENDING STORY: Don't lose yourself amidst its never-ending pages, and bookmark how long you can endure this hero's journey! Complete Fairytale Forest Day 22!
FINISH_FAIRYTALE_25_DESC: It's time to see this story to its end, and slay the terrible dragon! Can our heroes triumph over the evil wizard? Complete Fairytale Forest Night 25!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_BASICS_SCHEDULED_DESC: Wipe that nasty smile off their faces!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Outmatch these braggarts and show them how a real strongman does it!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_REPEATABLE_DES: Someone needs to humble them down!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_COTTONCANDY_REPEATABLE_DES: It's up to you to end this never-ending sibling rivalry!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their stunts are dangerous, and frankly irresponsible!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_REPEATABLE_DE: Put out those ill-placed fiery dispositions!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_REPEATABLE_DESC: Two heads are better off dead!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_MIRROR_REPEATABLE_DESC: Their anomalous illusions need to be shattered!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_IMP_REPEATABLE_DESC: Show them that their practical stunts are no more than an outdated trend!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_REPEATABLE_DESC: We're no strangers to magic abilities. Show them why they're no longer special!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_PRANKSTER_REPEATABLE_DESC: These pranks are getting way too far! Put a dent in their malevolent smiles!
DEFEAT_CARNIE_MUSICBOX_REPEATABLE_DESC: Put these hollow freaks to sleep before they play frightening lullabies!

EPICQUEST_AARON_FUTURE_CRASH_DESC_2: Crash landing ahead with the orbiting Space Dancer!
EPICQUEST_AARON_FUTURE_CRASH_DESC_4: Protect Plants while crazy mechs try and crush them!

EPIC_QUEST_GIRA_WEATHER_STEP_10_TITLE: The Dinosaurs are about to become birdies!

EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_1_TITLE: Battle against extrauniversal foes in this crossover with Alternate UniverZ for a stash of gems!
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_2_TITLE: The invaders are throwing a chili festival. Feed them what they asked for!
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_3_TITLE: Alternate metal has started rocking the 80's. Show them how its done in our universe!
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_4_TITLE: Put a stop to the ever-changing beats before they fully assimilate into our timeline!
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_5_TITLE: This Irish freak is ready to steal the stage. Make him know he doesn't belong here!
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_6_TITLE: Put a stop to these toxic menaces before they irreversibly pollute the big waves!
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_7_TITLE: With the help of the Void Orchid, show these invaders how to further light up the night!
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_8_TITLE: Luck has proven terrible for these beasts. Can your luck persist in this conundrum?
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_9_TITLE: Take down these haunted ghouls before they dig your grave!
EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_10_TITLE: Invaders that can charm the sun are breaking through, keep your sun production out of harm's way!

EPIC_QUEST_ALTVERZ_STEP_14_TITLE: The universal collision is reaching its endgame! Stay strong in this penultimate brawl!

LTE_REPLAY_HALLOWEEN_24_TITLE: The foulest stench is in the air this Lawn of Doom. Investigate spooky sightings and face against a familiar foe in a brand new light!

LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_1: Boosted plants work differently, check them out!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_2: Vine plants share space with other plants, making them a great use for extra sun!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_3: Try out different plants, you just might find a new favorite!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_4: Take advantage of minecarts to move expensive plants.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_5: Keep exploring! Progressing through Adventure will unlock Epic Quests!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_7: Plant defensive plants like Wall-nut on sewers!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_8: You never know what Portals can contain, so prepare for the worst!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_9: Place cheap plants in front of charging All-Stars to stop them!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_10: Use Infi-nut's Plant Food ability to block those pesky Fishermen and their hooks!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_11: Magnet-shroom instantly takes out All-Stars and Chair Racers.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_12: Use Hypno-shroom on zombies with high bite damage, health, or both!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_13: Use fire plants to deal with troublesome Egg Stealers and Rock Carriers!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_14: Use cheap, spammable plants to distract MC Zom-B's microphone spin!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_15: Penny's Challenges focus on your endurance. Work out any leaks in your defense!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_16: Plant forms of fodder to block Tomb Raiser's bones.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_17: Manipulate your defense to benefit from Jurassic Marsh's tar.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_18: Certain jams can speed up or slow down zombies!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_19: Want to replay Epic Quest levels? Visit Travel Log's Tourist Trap!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RFL_20: Thymed Events usually appear during special holiday occassions!
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_2: A general calls for military service.
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_4: A leader stays with her pack.
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_5: Three heads average roughly to one intelligent head.
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_6: Remains of the Graveyard Onslaught training program may be out there...
LOADINGTEXT_NPCS_RFL_10: Fortune favors the bold, and the good-looking.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_1: Tarot Cards shuffle their position at the start of the level, but the deck is the same.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_2: Boom Balloon Flower's balloons deal bonus damage when stacked!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_3: Use Potato Chip to deal free bonus damage later on in levels!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_4: Carnie Imp Twins won't split if eaten!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_8: Destroy the Jack-in-the-Box to avoid nasty toys!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_9: Keep an open mind for Monkeys.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_10: The Vendor Bros. will ignore buffed zombies (and each other)!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_11: A seemingly bad Card can be a blessing in disguise!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_12: Plant a Hypno-shroom or Sun Bean in front of a Grinderhead.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_13: Group a bunch of Zombies together before triggering a beneficial Tarot Card.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_14: Some Jack-in-the-Boxes are duds that explode quickly, but only summon one toy. Oops!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_15: Use Potato Chips to quickly peek at the Tarot Cards at the start of the night before things get crazy.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_18: Telling Bluebert that Pinky stole his high school crush...
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL_RFL_19: Whispering to Pinky that Bluebert copied his cotton candy recipe...
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_1: Bought an Epic Realm? Check it out in the Travel Log's Tourist Trap!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_2: Check out the Sandbox in Travel Log's Tourist Trap to test plants freely!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_3: Commando Zombie alternates between straight and lobbed shots.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_4: Draftodil has decreased effectivity on Assault Airspace Zombies!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_5: Beware- grounded projectiles fall into the sky in Assault Airspace!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_6: You can't make new Clouds, so make the most of what the sky gives.
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_7: Saucer Squash can abduct Bulls and smaller zombies regardless of health!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_8: The Rift houses various zombies of odd appearance AND ability!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_9: The Rift can contain just about ANY zombie!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_12: Use the cannon powerup as much as you feel like it — it's free, after all!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_13: Filling out the Almanac? Try out Inzanity!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_14: Check our Discord for update announcements!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_16: Puffapple can deflect more projectiles when given Plant Food!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_RIFTROAD_RFL_17: Meteor Flower and Tar make for a deadly combo!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_3: Witness the tiny but accurate might of Action Gargantuar!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_4: Plants love the soothing lullaby of Music Doll... Be wary!
LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_5: Use The Great Zucchini to turn dangerous zombies into their weakest link!

LOADINGTEXT_TIPS_CARNIVAL2_RFL_8: Take advantage of Funhouse Mirror Zombies with negative Tarot Cards!

WORLD_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_SKYCITY: In this vast, endless cloudscape, a new zombie militia has risen. They've laid seige to your flying fortress, and under the command of their leader, warped this era with knowledge of the future! Protect your airship, and put an end to this paradox before something goes terribly wrong!

NARRATIVE_PIRATE_CHALLENGE_MINIGAME_C_GE: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Congratulations on beating my score. I'm not bitter.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Hey! Enough bickering! We've got gems to save!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GIRA_WEATHER_1_INTR: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, help! There's sand in my eyes! Where are we?!
{SAY:zombossicon}With the power of my new storm machines, I have full control over the environment!
{SAY:zombossicon}Here in Egypt, your silly plants will be no match for the sandstorm! Muah-hah-hah-ha!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I suspect we will have to travel through previous worlds to shut down the storm machines.
{SAY:winnie}My calculations show that they can affect either plants or zombies. We must remain vigilant.
{SAY:crazydave}Can you turn on your washer fluid? My eyes need cleaned out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GIRA_WEATHER_4_INTR: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What's with the weird big thingamajig on the lawn?
{SAY:winnie}That is a Gargantuar podium, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}My research tells me the trap tile may spawn a Gargantuar out of the podium.
{SAY:winnie}Unlike previous trap tiles we've encountered, plants can't trigger these.
{SAY:crazydave}Wait, Penny, how much do plants even weigh?
{TIRED:winnie}Well, User Dave, if you insist... a Peashooter weighs around 6.45382 ounces.
{TIRED:winnie}A Sunflower is 3.34677 ounces, Wall-nuts are 10.22186 ounces, Chompers are 9.44376....
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I don't have the time for this! We're on a tight budget - get moving!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_GIRA_WEATHER_8_INTR: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}It's so misty and moisty and munchalicious here!
{SAY:winnie}My readings indicate that zombies here won't be visible due to the misty terrain.
{SAY:crazydave}This place gives me the ghouls with these invisible fellows!
{TIRED:winnie}Invisi-ghoul is not a word, User Dave.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Whaaaaaattt?! Next you're gonna tell me munchalicious isn't a word either!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I smell magic! And something rather unpleasant as well!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_2: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, that would be the plant we must rescue: Imp Pear.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_4: {SAY:winnie}Imps who consume Imp Pears will release gas due to indigestion.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_5: {TIRED:crazydave}And I thought stale milk was bad.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_6: {SAY:winnie}Regardless, we must rescue the Imp Pear for our collection.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_01_7: {TIRED:crazydave}I'm not letting him near my fridge.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_03_2: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, the Imp Pears are in danger. We must protect them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_03_3: {SAY:winnie}My processors detect that these Imp Pears are all on the same type of Power Tile.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_03_4: {SAY:winnie}Feeding Imp Pears Plant Food will turn groups of zombies into Imps.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_03_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}That'll just make the lawn all funky smelling!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_04_2: {SAY:crazydave}At least they can't make this place smell any worse!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_04_3: {EXCITED:winnie}We now have a way to combat the Evil Potions.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_04_4: {EXCITED:winnie}Boosted zombies that consume Imp Pears lose their boost effects.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_04_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}Huh. Maybe these little stinkers ain't so bad after all!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}I've discovered a brand new species! Imp Pears!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, have you even paid attention once throughout this adventure?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}These little buggers can take out hordes of critters!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_5: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I don't believe there were any squirbos in the Dark Ages...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_05_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}Speaking of those darned squirbos, here come the zombies!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Well, well, well, look who's meddling with my plants again!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Do you really think that Imp Pear is on your side?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Just look at his face! Can you really trust the face of an Imp?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_4: {SAY:zombossicon}An agent who will turn against you at the snap of my fingers!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_6: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, Mr. Boss Guy, what's your opinion of Imp Pears?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_7: {SAY:zombossicon}I'm not being paid enough for this...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_9: {SAY:winnie}Your word cannot be trusted, Zomboss! You have lied too many times in the past!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_07_1: {SAY:zombossicon}Oh, is that so? Tell me, have you seen your precious zombifying pears?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Hey, wait a darn second. Where are they? They're all gone!
{SAY:zombossicon}Precisely! You can have fun with these "Imp Pears" in the meantime! Muah-hah-hah!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{TIRED:winnie}Calculations point to none of this making sense.
{TIRED:crazydave}And I'd just started to like the little fella...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_08_I: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I think I know what happened to our Imp Pears!
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Ah, great! The mind of the operation has figured it out!
{SAY:zombossicon}I've experimented with your gross pears, and have made great breakthroughs with their properties!
{SAY:zombossicon}In the process, however, I have created... some really awful things.
{SAY:zombossicon}...and I don't want them in my lab, so I'm sending them to thwart you!
{SAY:zombossicon}If I had a nickel for Imp-related amalgamations I've created... I'd have two nickels currently.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_HERPLE_IMPPEAR_08_O: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, how come you've grown to like Imp Pears so much?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Anything's good compared to those freakish imp things!
{SAY:winnie}I would indeed like to avoid facing such amalgamations again, User Dave.
{SAY:crazydave}Now that Imp Pear's rescued, we can go squirbo hunting!
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, just you wait! I've saved my most important breakthrough for later...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_CLASSROOM_STEP_01_I: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Welcome back, neighbor!
{EXCITED:crazydave}You took QUITE the nap!
{EXCITED:crazydave}We haven't seen ya' in ages!!
{EXCITED:winnie}Hello universal traveler, make yourself at home.
{SAY:winnie}You've got particles of other parallel universes all over you.
{EXCITED:winnie}Welcome to universe 215, where zombies are vicious, and plants flourish!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Yeah, in this universe I got my taco!!!
{EXCITED:crazydave}It was quite good with the waffle syrup.
{SAY:winnie}I've scanned your universal particles.
{SAY:winnie}Data tells me that, where you come from, certain plants contain different properties.
{SAY:winnie}At least compared to this universe.
{EXCITED:winnie}For convenience's sake, I'll assign a name to your home universe for comparisons.
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, what's your favorite ice cream flavor?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Me? Uuuuh... Vanilla!
{EXCITED:winnie}Universe "Vanilla" contains quite a few similarities yet also differences in plants.
{SAY:winnie}I'll brief you with several short challenges showcasing these differences.
{SAY:winnie}Welcome to the classroom.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Classroom? I'm outta here!
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Firstly, the iconic duo of Sunflower and Peashooter remain the same in both universes.
{SAY:winnie}That ends the list of plants which I am obligated to mention being the same.
{SAY:winnie}Here are the differences between "Vanilla" universe which will be showcased in this step of my class:
{SAY:winnie}Bloomerang: +5 projectile damage. (20->25)
{SAY:winnie}Tall-nut: -25 sun cost. (125->100)
{SAY:winnie}Iceberg Lettuce: Additional chill effect.
{SAY:winnie}Cherry Bomb: +15s recharge. (35->50)
{EXCITED:winnie}Here's your opportunity to try them out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_CLASSROOM_STEP_02_I: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}For my following showcase, we are paying a visit to the Pirate Seas.
{SAY:winnie}It is calculated to be the best location for you to comprehend the following lesson.
{SAY:winnie}Here are the plant differences which will be showcased in this step of my class:
{EXCITED:winnie}Here's your opportunity to try them out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_CLASSROOM_STEP_03_I: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This showcase will revolve around crowd-controlling plants.
{SAY:winnie}Here are the plant differences which will be showcased in this step of my class:
{EXCITED:winnie}Here's your opportunity to try them out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_CLASSROOM_STEP_04_I: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}For the following showcase, we have traveled to the Far Future.
{SAY:winnie}My algorithms deem it to be the ideal place for this lesson.
{SAY:winnie}Here are the plant differences which will be showcased in this step of my class:
{SAY:winnie}Red Stinger: Increased durability in defensive states.
{SAY:winnie}Citron: Capable of projectile splash damage. (100 damage, 1 tile)
{EXCITED:winnie}Here's your opportunity to try them out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_CLASSROOM_STEP_05_I: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This showcase is set in Jurassic Marsh.
{SAY:winnie}We're going to be covering the primal plant selection this lesson.
{SAY:winnie}...as well as a plant which will help with them being more costly.
{SAY:winnie}Here are the plant differences which will be showcased in this step of my class:
{SAY:winnie}Intensive Carrot: Now revives plants to full health.
{EXCITED:winnie}Here's your opportunity to try them out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_CLASSROOM_STEP_06_I: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}In this lesson, we'll cover some less categorical plants.
{SAY:winnie}Many of them reside in the 1980's, so the location only seemed appropriate.
{SAY:winnie}Here are the plant differences which will be showcased in this step of the class:
{SAY:winnie}Thyme Warp: Available to use in all worlds.
{EXCITED:winnie}Here's your opportunity to try them out!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_CLASSROOM_STEP_07_I: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Welcome to the final step of this course.
{SAY:winnie}In this step we'll be going over the plants in the shadow family.
{SAY:winnie}However, we'll also be taking a look at two other plants.
{SAY:winnie}Grapeshot was selected to showcase how other exploding plants typically fair compared to Cherry Bomb.
{SAY:winnie}And Gold Bloom was chosen too, for his unique origin and ability.
{SAY:winnie}Here are the plant differences which will be showcased in this step of the class:
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_CLASSROOM_STEP_07_O: {SAY:winnie}You're all caught up, and ready to exit out of the classroom into the real world!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Whoow! I managed to skip class and get away with it!
{EXCITED:crazydave}But at least our friend over here's got the know-hows!
{EXCITED:winnie}We hope you enjoy your stay in this universe!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Bye for now! Check with ya' later!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woah! Look at all these zombies with their flashy costumes!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The yearly heroic convention has begun, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Zombies and plants alike are getting ready to dress up as their favorite heroes.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Oh! Reminds me of my escapades in Dandeland.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}I can detect a terrifying aura brewing from the other side of the lawn.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Be prepared: these cosplayers are resistant to chilling effects.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}They are far too hyped to see their heroes to remain "chill", so be alert.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, you may want to keep the volume of your voice low.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_1_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Some of these heroes may be making guest appearances at the con.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Huh? What are you two doing at this appalling event?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Oh, Boss Man! Are you here to get autographs from heroes too?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Ugh... Think about your words for a minute, David.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}I am the reason for their mere existence!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}All that praise should be going to ME!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Why does everyone care SO much about these shoddy heroes anyway!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}I am not seeing any Zomboss costumes!!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_9: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:winnie}I don't think that would be a particularly exciting costume.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}J-Just get a lab coat or something!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}Bah! I ought to spoil this event!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}As for you two, have fun dealing with these monotonous wannabes while I cook up a solution!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_2_INTRO_14: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}Surely there are no deep-seated issues there.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I would like to inform you that the zombies are plotting something unique today.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_5_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}The wannabes are preparing to imitate their favorite heroes by copying their attack style.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_5_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Although, they are following the rules a bit too closely for their own good.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}They are letting us know their next moves ahead of time.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_5_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:winnie}So we get to see a premonition right before they take their turn.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_5_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:winnie}Best use our turn to plan things out!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}This convention is going to give me an aneurysm!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}My sophisticated plan has been put in an unjust time-out!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_6_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Are the zombie heroes disrespecting you, Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}I am being endlessly pestered for autographs!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}And in my annoyed predicament, I made a crucial tactical misstep.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_6_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}I... accidentally signed a sponsorship for the convention's Lawns of Legends tournament.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_6_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}Now I will have to get enrolled in the gutter with the rest of the wackjobs...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_6_INTRO_9: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Fame does come at a cost, it appears.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I am DONE with associating with game competitors with poor body odor!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Now, it is time to destroy this event!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}I used to like the idea, but it is far too repelling to remain existant!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}Think of all the plant heroes here!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}But I wanted to meet up with them again and get some autographs!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Well too bad, David. I am afraid your meet-and-greet begins AND ends today.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}A familiar face is here, and he's been looking for revenge.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}This time, he's got a new trick up his sleeve.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}Prepare to have your most horrible comic-book-related nightmares come to life!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}Now if you will excuse me, I will go check on the special weapon!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_14: {SAY:zombossicon}I am very eager to see how your opponent is going to utilize it!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_15: {SAY:zombossicon}Especially after he failed against a parallel version of yourselves!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_16: {SAY:zombossicon}...long story. Read the last issue to get caught up!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_17: {SAY:zombossicon}Anyways, if he were not the real deal, you would think he was a cosplayer...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_18: {SAY:zombossicon}But his heroics are about to send you and this horrid event into cancelation!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_20: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I would like to alert you that Z-Mech has returned.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, the guy with the robot? We'll be fine!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}This time, he is equipped with a never-before-seen ability.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_23: {SAY:winnie}And it seems to be linked to that terrible aura I detected earlier.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_HEROES_10_INTRO_24: {SAY:winnie}I cannot fully scan what it is for the time being, but beware of zombies suddenly changing.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_FOODFIGHT_1_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Jeepers, Penny. The zombies look all messy!
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My scans show they are having a "food fight", User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}It's around that time of the year again where zombies and plants alike celebrate a bountiful feast.
{TIRED:winnie}...By participating in messy activities involving flinging food at each other.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Can't wait to join in on the fun and throw all sorts of thingamabobs at 'em!
{SAY:winnie}Do not let the excitement get to your head too much, User Dave.
{TIRED:winnie}We know how you act when that happens.
{SAY:crazydave}Oh c'mon, Penny! What if they even throw me a taco?!
{SAY:winnie}The only taco-shaped object to be found here are the nefarious Taco Imps.
{SAY:winnie}Alongside them, all the zombies here have gotten so adjusted to having food flung at them...
{SAY:winnie}...that they have developed immunity to Kernel-pult's butter.
{EXCITED:crazydave}What! I will not tolerate indifference towards butter!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_FOODFIGHT_2_INTRO_: {SAY:zombossicon}You three are the LAST people I wanted to see in my current predicament!
{SAY:crazydave}You look as upset as you were last time, but with sore eyes now.
{SAY:zombossicon}I am just having a rough patch, alright!?
{PLAYFUL:winnie}I detect high levels of anguish and jealousness, User Dave.
{SAY:zombossicon}Can you detect a way out of this conversation!?
{SAY:zombossicon}Whatever. I shall take my leave. Do NOT follow me!
{SAY:crazydave}He must be having a bad day, huh?
{SAY:winnie}I suggest we all leave him alone for now. We would not want to provoke him like last time.
{SAY:winnie}In the meantime, more zealous, food-fighting zombies are incoming.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_FOODFIGHT_4_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, do you think Boss Man is doing alright?
{SAY:winnie}Zomboss? I am sure he is doing alright. There are still zombies approaching after all.
{TIRED:winnie}But if you meant mentally, then I am not so sure.
{SAY:winnie}From what I observed, his punishment of being exiled from the family gathering mentally dented him.
{TIRED:crazydave}Poor guy, first he got his vacation ruined and now his Thanksgiving as well.
{SAY:winnie}I would prefer if you were not so concerned about Zomboss, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}Let us not forget that he is our enemy.
{SAY:crazydave}Eh. You just don't understand emotions, Penny.
{SAY:winnie}You have a point. Although, never forget that he has been endangering your life for years now.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Despite the rough exterior, Boss Man might just be a sour cookie.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_FOODFIGHT_6_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Today's food scuffle involves the stunning of zombies.
{SAY:winnie}And fortunately, we have Imp Pears at our disposal.
{TIRED:winnie}Unfortunately though, only Imps that release gastronomical gases can stun them here. So use them wisely.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_11_FOODFIGHT_9_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I am receiving a transmitted message from an unknown source.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Let's hear it then! Could be the turkey delivery service I ordered from earlier!
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I can't believe that you hag wanted to have this discussion during dinner!
{SAY:zombossicon}I go through all the trouble to get our family holographic meatballs and this is my thanks!?
{SAY:zombossicon}"Evil genius isn't a real job Georgey!"
{SAY:zombossicon}"Why aren't you more like Zombillion?"
{SAY:zombossicon}I've had it!
{SAY:zombossicon}Don't expect me at any more dinner parties, you hear me!?
{SAY:zombossicon}And quit comparing me to Zombillion! He's nothing compared to me!
{SAY:zombossicon}You hear!?
{SAY:zombossicon}I'm like a god in human clothing!
{SAY:zombossicon}Lightning bolts shoot from my fingertips!
{SAY:zombossicon}*sigh*
{SAY:zombossicon}I can't believe them!
{SAY:zombossicon}Just gotta do everything myself, as always!

NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_1_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, it's time! It's the most wonderful time of the year!

NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_03_SPRINGENING_2_INTR: {EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man! How's Springening going? Are you painting eggs? Maybe even egg hunting?

NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_05_BIRTHDAYZ_13_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, you can't seriously be considering what Zomboss has to offer.

{SAY:crazydave}I think it's time for us to put an end to this chapter of our story, Boss Man.

{SAY:hunterria}He is not like us. Surely you understand.
{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria cares for wolfy. Fat man cares for his mammoth.
{SAY:crazydave}Uhh, Penny? Is that true?
{SAY:winnie}No records show cases of animal mistreatments, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}Hunterria, Zomboss is lying to you to take advantage of your hunting capabilities.
{SAY:hunterria}Mammoth use mind magic on Hunterria. Boss warned this.
{SAY:crazydave}Mind magic?
{TIRED:winnie}I assume this is what Zomboss described "persuasion" as.
{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria do not dislike fat man or mammoth.
{SAY:hunterria}But no one will get in way of hunt.
{NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{SAY:crazydave}That sounds ominous. Penny, what does that mean?
{TIRED:winnie}It means that she's off for another hunt, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}This time, we're the target.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_12_FEASTIVUS_12_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I've successfully retrieved Elder Hailstorm.
{EXCITED:crazydave}He's frozen solid! We need to thaw him out!
{SAY:hunterria}Fat man and his mammoth is a true prize game.
{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria must unleash all her resource to hunt them down.
{SAY:hunterria}Once Hunterria is done, two turtle doves, three french hens-
{SAY:hunterria}Four calling birds, six geese and seven swimming swans will be free.
{SAY:hunterria}They will no longer be mistreated by Elder Hailstorm.
{SAY:winnie}Hunterria, you need to listen to us. Zomboss is lying to you.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Yes! Using a carol, it sounds like.
{SAY:hunterria}Mind magic will not work on Hunterria.
{SAY:hunterria}Wolfy. Tell your brothers to prepare. We must hunt.
{NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{SAY:winnie}Her mind is set, User Dave. If we can't convince her-
{EXCITED:winnie}We need to prepare for her hunt. We must defend Elder Hailstorm.
{SAY:crazydave}Then we'll return him safely to his tribe!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Bring it on! It'll take more than that to ruin Feastivus!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Keep an eye out though, Penny. She might send twelve drummers to beat us up!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, did you cancel our news subscription?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}That's weird! I should've gotten an issue of gardening quarterly this morning!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I really needed to know how I can improve my crops with one easy step!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_5: {TIRED:winnie}You shouldn't believe everything you read, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Data suggests that 50% of gardeners fell for 3,000 crop-related scams every month.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Did you read that data off somewhere, Penny?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:winnie}My database is rigorously fact-checked and updated constantly.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_12: {SAY:crazydave}Can you also predict the weather, Penny?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}Then this should be manageable for small-time gardeners like me!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Turns out there were more zombies than you predicted, Penny!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Impossible. My weather forecast has a 98.7% accuracy.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}We all make mistakes every now and then.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}I must thoroughly check the previous sources that have backed up these findings.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Say, while you do that, can you predict today's tide as well?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Affirmative. This would also serve as a check to my forecasting capabilities.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}..high tides for the entirety of the week.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What the hey? There were no tides at all these past two days!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}Improbable! These forecasts are backed up by data provided by verifiable organizations!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Our definitions of "feeling well" differ variously, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_5: {TIRED:winnie}But I do believe I'm in need of a health checkup.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I didn't really want to go surfing that badly, anyway.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Sure, this sucks for some of our aquatic plant friends-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Words of assurance received. Thank you, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_12: {SAY:crazydave}Uh, oh. I think I see some zombies on the horizon.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_4_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}You're in no state to fight them, Penny! Let's make like a pea and leave!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}What is it, Penny? Did my issue of gardening quarterly finally arrive?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}I've received reports that many of our plants have abandoned our ranks.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_5: {SHOUT:crazydave}WHAT? THAT'S CRAZY! Why would they do that?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}It appears that deserters are ones among our aquatic troops.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Peashooters? But we go so far back!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}I've questioned some of the remaining plants, and it appears they left due to this recording.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}This sucks... our aquatic plants....we'll survive without them...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}Whu-huh? That's my voice! I never said any of that!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}Someone recorded and tampered with our dialogue from a couple days ago.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}Unclear. And with my database system sabotaged as well, a search would prove difficult.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_6_INTRO_18: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, this sucks. They left before the pool party too!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, despite the difficulty, I think I've managed a discovery!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_2: {TIRED:crazydave}Have you found out who's been spreading hoaxes around, Penny?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}I've detected strange signal readings from zombie adjacent origins.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}One we should be familiar with, in fact.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}It seems ZCorp has had a hand in disrupting our flow of information.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}ZCorp? That's the company Boss Man owns, isn't it?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_8: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}ZCorp is actually an independent entity from our leader, Dr. Edgar George Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:missinfo}While it's true that we've collaborated in the past, he has very little direct influence over us!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}Wow! Thank you for the explanation, Miss.....
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_11: {SAY:missinfo}.. Information! Miss Information's the name, and telling the news is the game!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}How did you broadcast yourself into our communication systems!?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_15: {SAY:missinfo}As the head of ZCorp's media branch- I have access to all of ZCorp's expansive resources!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}Were you the one who's been spreading misinformation around?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_17: {SAY:missinfo}Am I? Well, don't touch that dial!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_18: {SAY:missinfo}We'll soon find out, after the break!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_2: {SAY:missinfo}It's a scorching, hot, hot, day of weather out here in the Old Western Wilds!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Finally. I've been flipping through so many channels..
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Were you the one who had been tampering with my database?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}As well as sullying User Dave's good name to the press?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_7: {SAY:missinfo}Such slanderous claims! Do you have any evidence to back it up?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:winnie}I have plenty of evidence in my-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}How did you do that? Erasing all my gathered evidence-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_11: {SAY:missinfo}I don't believe I have any idea of what you're talking about, dear viewer!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_12: {SAY:missinfo}Now- onto the weather! Forecast calls for clear skies...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_13: {SAY:missinfo}....and a whopping 0% chance of a stampede ambush!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}While my database is still compromised, I can at least confidently say this-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_9_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}Miss Information is telling the truth about the absence of stampede ambushes.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Did you know that 90% of zombies have a metal chip implanted into them?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_2: {SAY:missinfo}It's true! Dr. Zomboss mandated this to literally pull zombies to work with a giant magnet!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Don't believe anything she says, User Dave. She is a proven liar!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Her methods are an insult to the integrity of journalism!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_6: {SAY:missinfo}Why, my dear audience- news is written to sell, after all.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_7: {SAY:missinfo}We simply let our audience come to their own conclusions.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_9: {SAY:missinfo}Next up: Cooking With no opposable thumbs. Starring: Miss Information.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_10: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:crazydave}Don't worry, Penny. I've got a plan!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}That newswoman exposed a secret weakness of the zombies!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_11_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}I suppose I'll let this play out as a lesson for you to not be as trusting.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Penny, I can't take it! I don't know what's real or not anymore!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_2: {TIRED:crazydave}Yesterday Miss Information told me that birds aren't real.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_4: {TIRED:winnie}We live in uncertain times, User Dave- where corrupt figures mislead and lie to you.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Penny, you'll never lie to me, right?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}I would never, User Dave. Nor am I capable to.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I've deduced a means to combat her misinformation and misdirection.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_10: {PLAYFUL:winnie}We simply give her employees a taste of her own medicine.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Breaking news! Chaos ensues at ZCorp headquarters as rampant misinformation spreads!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_2: {SAY:missinfo}ZCorp is actively looking into the issue, and have singled out three prime suspects-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}That's right! It was us all along!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}We've spread rumors to your workers that you're cutting their pensions in half!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}And I told them spoons aren't real! What do you think of that?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_6: {SAY:missinfo}Will no one put a stop to this madness? The Big Lie?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Why are you doing this, Miss Information? What's your endgoal?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Are you doing this under Boss Man's order?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_9: {SAY:missinfo}ZCorp is a leading brand in zombie innovation and leadership!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_10: {SAY:missinfo}The time of Zomboss is over! We at ZCorp will be the leaders of the future!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_11: {SAY:missinfo}And as the ones in control of the flow of information - we'll rule above all!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}So.. this is not a Boss Man scheme?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_14: {SAY:missinfo}I've told you before dear viewer, we are an independent entity!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_15: {SAY:missinfo}Please hold as we sort out these technical difficulties.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_14_INTRO_16: {SAY:missinfo}In other news, have you felt that sunlight is suddenly scarce to come by?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}I've received word that you three had encountered rogue employees sometime last year.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_2: {SAY:missinfo}I would like express that their actions do not reflect ZCorp values and goals.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Enough corporate talk! We got you cornered, Miss Information!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yeah, I've installed an antivirus! You can't hack us now!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_5: {SAY:missinfo}Oh, dear. And here I was about to offer you a discount on our brand new line of products as an apology!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_6: {SAY:missinfo}Have you ever wanted an unstoppable killing machine to suit all your evil needs?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_8: {SAY:missinfo}Perhaps I can interest you with a live demonstration!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, massive threat inbound. Z-Mech approaches.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_10: {SAY:missinfo}And this time, it's the real deal!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}I've detected many more disturbances as well.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Get ready, User Dave. Things are about to get confusing.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_02_LUNARZOOYEAR_1_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Whoa, Penny! Would you look at that, it's the Chinese New Year!
{SAY:crazydave}They have their own calendar system from the western world! Right?
{SAY:winnie}I apologize. Sometimes it's surprising to see you remember things that I've taught you.
{SAY:crazydave}Still don't understand why the zombies would celebrate it, though.
{SAY:winnie}Cultural exchanges like these are all around a net positive.
{SAY:crazydave}Speaking of net positive- is that guy literally covered in money?
{SAY:winnie}Money Tree Zombie periodically throws yuanbao in a 3x3 area, up to three per throw.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}And they say money doesn't grow on trees!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Clearly they've never been to the Zen Garden!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_02_LUNARZOOYEAR_2_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny, I just realized! Now that it's the new years, I have something to say to you.
{SAY:crazydave}I just wanna say that this had been an amazing year!
{SAY:crazydave}And I'm very fortunate to have you throughout it!
{SAY:winnie}This seems a bit sudden, but I appreciate the sentiment nonetheless.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}We make a good team, Penny! Good things come in pairs, after all!
{SAY:winnie}Indeed. Although that expression seems somewhat fitting for the occasion.
{SAY:winnie}I'm detecting interesting matchups among the zombie threats today, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}The zombies seems to have created beneficial pairings to overtake our defenses.
{SAY:winnie}Given they're usually too stupid to utilize such an advantage, I suspect something's afoot.
{SAY:crazydave}Hey, who knows? Perhaps the stars aligned this New Year's Eve, Penny-
{SAY:crazydave}-and the zombies managed the formation just out of sheer... dumb luck.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_02_LUNARZOOYEAR_4_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Ugh.. somehow I feel dreary today, Penny.
{SAY:crazydave}Almost if something bad's about to happen.
{EXCITED:winnie}On the contrary, User Dave. It seems today would be a fortunate one for us.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Oh, really? Have they started handing out red envelopes?
{SAY:winnie}Negatory. But the layout of today's lawn seems beneficial to us.
{EXCITED:winnie}With this setup, zombies will be walking towards their own death!
{SAY:winnie}Most likely. These traps tiles would prove an impenetrable defense.
{TIRED:crazydave}Something still seems off... I'd watch out if I were you, neighbor.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_02_LUNARZOOYEAR_6_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}New threat detected, User Dave. Lion Dancer Zombies approach.
{SAY:winnie}They breathe inextinguishable fire, killing plants over a short range.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Wow, these zombies are way more into the celebrations this year!
{SAY:crazydave}But these guys weren't even around last year! Something's awry...
{SAY:winnie}Your concerns might have some merit, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}I'm sensing some suspicious patterns that seem very beneficial for the zombies.
{SAY:winnie}Advantageous layouts, new threats...
{SAY:crazydave}You could almost say that they've been very-
{NPC_ENTER:lucky}{SAY:lucky}...very Lucky, A gander now?
{SAY:crazydave}What the-? Penny, who is this?
{SAY:lucky}Top o' the mornin' lads. Another fan in the makin', A see!
{SAY:lucky}Ye would like know more about me, aye?
{SAY:crazydave}Well, I was just-
{SAY:lucky}Then fear not, my good lad! A, Lucky, shall arrange for you receive a copy of me autobiography!
{SAY:crazydave}Ouch!
{SAY:crazydave}Penny, this book just fell from the sky!
{SAY:lucky}Ah, that so? How... awfully lucky for you have that happen, now.
{TIRED:winnie}We've been through this repeatedly by now. What is your motive, Mr. Lucky?
{SAY:lucky}Motive? Why, a simply want a mighty craic on me, tha's all!
{SAY:lucky}Ah' been promised a grand dinner by me admirers- but, A believe that you might be holding on it.
{SAY:lucky}A'd expect a meal on me by the time the firework starts. G'wan, chop te it, me good fella!
{NPC_EXIT:lucky}{SAY:crazydave}What? I don't remember telling that guy we're making him dinner!
{TIRED:winnie}He meant your brains, User Dave. He wants your brains on a platter.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_02_LUNARZOOYEAR_7_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Wow, Penny- this Lucky guy seems to have done everything!
{EXCITED:crazydave}His autobiography said that he had traveled all over the world, from Egypt to the Wild West!
{EXCITED:crazydave}And he singlehandedly stopped Zomboss' evil plans to trap people in an eternal holiday!
{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, that is clearly a self-aggrandizing description that Lucky had written himself.
{SAY:winnie}Most of these claims are provably false.
{SAY:crazydave}How would you know, Penny?
{TIRED:winnie}Need I remind you, we were the ones who stopped Zomboss' evil holiday themed plans.
{SAY:crazydave}Maybe he did it again without us knowing?
{SAY:winnie}Despite all the exposition he had given in that obnoxiously self praising book-
{SAY:winnie}I still fail to see any quality that would make him such a good strategist.
{SAY:winnie}What could he have done to give zombies such great tactical advantages over us?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Done? He doesn't need to do anything, Penny! He's just that lucky!
{SAY:winnie}Hypothesis rejected. There must be something here that we are not seeing.
{SAY:crazydave}You're right about that one, Penny.
{SAY:crazydave}Something's off today. I feel like someone's watching me! Could it be-
{SAY:winnie}Yes, User Dave. We appear to be in the presence of ghosts.
{SAY:crazydave}Horrors! I've heard about this!
{SAY:crazydave}Chinese culture sees the seventh month as the "ghost month!"
{SAY:crazydave}And today's the seventh day of the celebrations!
{SAY:winnie}....
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, would you mind directing me towards where you've heard that?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_02_LUNARZOOYEAR_9_INT: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave... do not be overtaken by his shallow words and easy flattery.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny, look! The little guys I planted last week are starting to bloom!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}That is good news User Dave, they arrived just in time for the bountiful month of harvest.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}You're right, Penny! Plants are way more productive this time of year!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Probably to get all their business done before winter comes!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Old gardener's tales and farm folklores suggest as much, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Nevertheless, I regret to inform you that zombie activity is back on steady rise.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_8: {TIRED:winnie}It seems no matter what month it is, they're always prepared to cause our plants trouble.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}We can't have those no-good zombies ruin joyful harvest time!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}I must implore you to keep your voice down.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_4: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I call into motion the start of our monthly meeting. Generals, status report.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}Very well. As you both may know, we've entered what our dastardly foes would call their most productive time of the year.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}In contrast, this month has always been the slowest time for zombiekind, before it picks back up in October, the month of ghouls!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Needless to say, this obviously affects our financial earnings as well.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria can dig more buried treasure to help for money. Hunterria recently found unexplored underwater ruin-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}No, you silly girl! A couple buried treasures won't be able to revitalize our financial situation! We're in deep trouble here!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}We don't even have money to afford that type of expedition!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}I'm already in the tank for all the money I borrowed from ZCorp! My brother Zombillion and his interest rates...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_14: {SAY:zombossicon}This leaves me no choice! I'm going to start cutting off fruitless divisions who only hog resources with zero benefits!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_16: {SAY:zombossicon}Yes, and both of your divisions are on the chopping block.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_17: {SAY:zombossicon}It is up to you both to prove to me that your department, as well as your position- is worth keeping!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_18: {SAY:zombossicon}Otherwise, I will have to deem you a waste. And you both know what happens to waste.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_21: {SAY:zombossicon}Exactly. Only one of you can stay, so prove to me you're worth more than your peer.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_22: {SAY:zombossicon}That is all, you may return to your post.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_24: {SAY:nanny}To think I could finally have a calm month for once.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_26: {NPC_EXIT:nanny}{SAY:hunterria}Wolfy. Our home is at stake. We must win boss favor by proving our worth.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_27: {SAY:hunterria}Call on your brothers. The hunt is on.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_29: {TIRED:winnie} Zomboss seems to have mistakenly connected us to his General meetings, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_31: {SAY:crazydave}Oh drat, Penny! Let's go before she notices us!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria finally track scent down. Fat man and his iron mammoth has been eavesdropping.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Well, to be fair, Boss-man was the one who added us to the call by mistake!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:hunterria}This simply won't do. Such methods are dishonorable for us hunters.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria must punish Fat man for such treachery.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Are you going to report us to Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria will not get boss involved. We settle this according to way of hunter.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:hunterria}We duel. Hunterria give you time to prepare. Hunterria wants honest and fair battle.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:hunterria}If you win duel, Hunterria will let Fat man go.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}A moment, Hunterria. If you insist on a fair battle...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}...then why have you placed User Dave's mold colonies on the board?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}This is a clear disadvantage for us.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_12: {SAY:crazydave}Hey, so that's why those guys aren't in my mold tank!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_13: {SAY:hunterria}This is fair. The strong must protect the weak. Hunterria will also be protecting animal friends during duel.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_14: {SAY:hunterria}Prove your honor as hunter. Protect your mold friends as we duel.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_15: {NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{SAY:winnie}Well, user Dave. I suppose we have to make do with these restrictions.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}I say game on, Penny! Neighbor, Let's prove our honor!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:hunterria}Fat man and neighbor won battle fair and square. Hunterria recognize their resolve.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}You're no pushover, either, Hunterria! You put up a good fight!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria must. It is her duty as a hunter. And general to boss.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Very noble. If that's all, Hunterria, then we shall take our leave-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_6: {NPC_ENTER:nanny}{SAY:nanny}Cough. What- what's all this? What are you four up to?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:hunterria}Old woman. Hunterria was dueling Fat man and his neighbor.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:nanny}Don't call me old. What did you just say?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_9: {SAY:nanny}Oh, I see what's going on here! Tryna win the boss' favor by offing these three first, huh? you gettin' the jump on me?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_10: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria do no such thing. Hunterria was-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_11: {SAY:nanny}Shut your trap, you primeval heathen. I am not losing my job to some... to some pet!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_12: {SAY:nanny}I can't go back to the streets. As much as I loathe it, Zomboss' protection is the only thing keeping me on my feet!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_13: {SAY:nanny}If he ever got rid of me and that fatso mafia got a wind of it...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_14: {SAY:nanny}And that's if Zomboss doesn't dispose of me first! I ain't lookin' for a one way trip 70 years to the past!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_15: {SAY:crazydave}Whoa, will Boss-man really do that again?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_16: {SAY:nanny}Well, I ain't tryin' to find out! Outta the way, you neanderthal!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_17: {SAY:nanny}if anyone's gonna take credit for offin' these three, it's gonna be me!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_18: {NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{NPC_EXIT:nanny}{TIRED:winnie}We should've left when we had the chance.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria apologize for yesterday. Old woman was going through issue.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Why are you back, Hunterria? I was under the impression that our matters were settled.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:hunterria}Our duel is not over. Hunterria must still prove her worth to boss.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:hunterria}Like you prove worth to the Fat man.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_6: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria has been watching you two. Your kinship with Fat man, that is what boss is to Hunterria.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_8: {SAY:hunterria}Yes: like how Fat man provide home and take care of mammoth, this is what boss does for Hunterria.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_9: {SAY:hunterria}Boss cared for Hunterria. Took her from Savannah. Hunterria is only paying boss back for generosity by hunting you down.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_10: {TIRED:crazydave}Oh, geez- when you put it like that...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}I find this to be a false equivalence. User Dave has never asked me to prove my worth to him.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Hunterria, if Zomboss truly cares about you...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}...he will not threaten to abandon you when you stop being useful to him.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_14: {TIRED:crazydave}Penny! You can't just say that to her!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_15: {SAY:hunterria}That is just how boss is. Hunterria know boss very well.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_16: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria hunt you down now. To prove worth.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_17: {NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{SHOUT:crazydave}Oh no, Penny! What do we do?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_18: {SHOUT:crazydave}Just when these little flowers are in the process of blooming too!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}It's likely a part of Hunterria's plan to take them hostage, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}She said it herself, she's been watching us.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}For the meantime, these spikeweeds would be able to protect the little flowers from being trampled.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria apologize for not showing up yesterday. Hunterria was tending to Wolfy's offsprings.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria only doing her duty. Perhaps Old Woman should just get better.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_3: {SPECIAL1:nanny}Why, you @%$!, when I'm done with you- COUGH.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Hypothesis: Zomboss is nearing his decision on who to "dispose of."
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_11: {SAY:nanny}It ain't gonna be me, you hear? I've worked for him longer than you, there's no way he'll ever fire me!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}If that was the case, then why are you so nervous?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_14: {SAY:nanny}And you know how much that egomaniac likes having his ego stroked!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_15: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria has just been doing job. Hunterria is not @#$%! up.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_17: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria not understand. Hunterria is not a girl dog. Or donkey. Or cat.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_21: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria can't go back. Savannah, savannah is gone.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_23: {SAY:hunterria}That's why Boss takes Hunterria and her animal friends in. Boss saved Hunterria.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_25: {SAY:nanny}Oh this, this is rich! You think he did that out of the kindness of his heart?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_26: {SAY:nanny}He's using you, you dolt! You're no more than a dog to him!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_27: {SAY:hunterria}Old Woman... Why couldn't Old Woman be thankful for what boss done for us both?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_28: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria might be the one from stone age. But Old Woman is the one with heart made of stone.
