NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_42: {TIRED:winnie}Let's just fend off Hunterria's troops, for all our sake.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:nanny}{NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:nanny}It ain't gonna be me, you hear! Ain't me! So you might as well call it quits now!

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_1: {SAY:zombossicon}It turns out, I've forgotten to cut funding to this defunct division headed by a Zom- Zomtarani..?
{SAY:zombossicon}Anyway, they've been defrauding money from us for the past five years, so I cut them out!

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}That accursed journalist must've been tampering with our line again! I'm gonna have a word with Zombillion!
{SAY:zombossicon}One of you, take care of them! He must not be privy to our inner-workings!

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_3: {SAY:hunterria}What Old Woman did is dishonorable. Punishing someone for something someone else do. It is injustice. It is betrayal.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_10_HALLOWEEN_1_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Alert, User Dave. Intruders inbound.
{EXCITED:winnie}I'm detecting a massive horde of ghouls and monsters roaming around the neighborhood.
{SAY:winnie}Shall I deploy our arsenal?
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Whoa, calm your horses, Penny!
{SAY:crazydave}These are just trick or treaters!
{SAY:winnie}Looking up term: "Trick or treaters."
{SAY:winnie}A person, typically children, dressed in costumes, going house to house to ask for candy.
{SAY:crazydave}Yes, that's it!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I suppose you never had a proper Halloween celebration before, huh?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}This time of year we usually go around the timeline kicking zombie butts!
{SAY:crazydave}We never just stayed home giving out candy. That must be why you're confused!
{SAY:winnie}I see. You are correct, User Dave. I will update my database accordingly.
{SAY:winnie}So it is the norm to dress up as zombies during this time of month.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Totally normal!
{SAY:winnie}This will prove troublesome.
{SAY:winnie}How are we supposed to differentiate between zombies and children pretending to be one?
{SAY:crazydave}Well, it's probably obvious.
{SAY:crazydave}But you're a smart machine, Penny! Put those scanners to good use!
{SAY:winnie}Noted. Scan successful.
{SAY:crazydave}Whoa, you were scanning while we talked?
{SAY:winnie}Zombies, genuine undead lifeforms, detected upon our doorsteps.
{SAY:crazydave}Oh, I see them now! Yikes, now that's no trick or treater!
{SAY:crazydave}Let's get planting, neighbor! Don't let these zombies get our candies!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}And brains, of course.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_10_HALLOWEEN_2_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What're we doing in the Dark Ages, Penny?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Don't you want to indulge in the tradition of trick or treating more?
{EXCITED:crazydave}I prepared the candy bowl! You can try giving them out to kids!
{SAY:winnie}Apologies, User Dave. But duty calls.
{SAY:winnie}As enticing as broadening my knowledge may be, zombie invasions have not receded.
{TIRED:crazydave}Darn. I guess this is more important.
{SAY:crazydave}Lay it on me, Penny, what do we have here this time?
{SAY:winnie}Critters. An abnormally large amount.
{SAY:crazydave}Strange. What could've caused this-
{NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}But of course! Who else could it be?
{SAY:winnie}As expected, General Hunterria will be our adversary this time, User Dave.
{SAY:hunterria}...
{SAY:crazydave}Err... Hunterria, are you just gonna stand there?
{SAY:hunterria}Me Hunterria.
{TIRED:crazydave}Uhh... Yeah. We've met.

{SAY:hunterria}Me Hunterria, and me is going to send animals after you.

{SAY:hunterria}Good. Hunterria has more evil things to do! Watch out, Hunterria will get you!
{NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{TIRED:crazydave}That was odd.
{SAY:winnie}We can deal with that later, User Dave. For now, these critters demand action.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_10_HALLOWEEN_4_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Say, Penny, it never occurred to me until just now.

{SAY:crazydave}I recall Boss Man saying something about that once.
{SAY:crazydave}Could there be any connection?
{SAY:winnie}Researching...
{SAY:winnie}This celebration seems to originate as a time for people to commemorate parted souls.
{SAY:crazydave}Parted souls, huh? Zombies and ghosts are technically that, right?
{SAY:winnie}Yes, though any link between this celebration and zombie activity remains unclear.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Maybe we should ask one of them to find out!
{NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{EXCITED:crazydave}Speak of the devil, it's Hunterria!
{SAY:crazydave}Hunterria, is there any connection between Halloween and zombie activity?
{SAY:hunterria}...
{SAY:hunterria}No.

{SAY:hunterria}Lot of Zombie office hour is at night. Same with ghosts and cryptids. That why more monsters around at Halloween night.
{SAY:crazydave}...
{SAY:winnie}You seem unusually knowledgeable about this, Hunterria.
{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria is cavewoman. Don't mean she stupid.
{SAY:hunterria}She has office job. With Boss.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I guess that does count as an office job in zombie society.
{SAY:hunterria}What Halloween is about is celebrating evil. Evil like Hunterria.
{SAY:hunterria}Which why Hunterria gather more animals! She is planning evil! Look how evil Hunterria is!
{TIRED:crazydave}Okay...?
{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria will get you.
{NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{TIRED:winnie}Well, I couldn't dismiss that this time. That is perplexing.
{TIRED:crazydave}Right...?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_10_HALLOWEEN_5_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, do you feel it too? I think someone's watching us!
{SAY:crazydave}But when I turned around to look, nobody was there!
{SAY:winnie}Most curious. For some inexplicable reason, the zombies have turned themselves invisible.
{SAY:crazydave}Not again! Is this Halloween magic at work?
{SAY:crazydave}Some zombies are scary enough on their own! Why do they need to be invisible too?
{NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{EXCITED:crazydave}It's you again! Hunterria, are you behind this?
{SAY:crazydave}Are you using Halloween magic to turn your critters invisible?
{SAY:hunterria}No. Invisibility already household technology for zombies. No magic necessary.
{SAY:hunterria}Zombie scientist very advanced. They tamper with personal time travel too.
{TIRED:crazydave}...Is it wrong to assume that you didn't know all this?
{SAY:winnie}Perhaps we are underestimating her know-how. She is a general of Zomboss.
{SAY:hunterria}Vehicle right. Hunterria is doing more evil tonight. Gathering more animals.
{SAY:winnie}I say we should just wait and see how this situation develops, User Dave.

{SAY:hunterria}To take down Boss.

{SAY:winnie}I have a theory. But it's going to take some time to piece everything together.
{SAY:crazydave}My mind is blown! What is happening!?

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting signs of yet another nefarious scheme by Dr. Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Scheme!? I'm merely providing myself with a creative outlet!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Why does this creative outlet set off my alarms, then?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}I need your lawn as set dressing!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_8: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}If that vision is to have a huge head, you've done it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}My head is my temple and nobody gets to insult it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}Anyways, I want to be a movie director!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}But, coming up with original stories is hard!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}So, I'll just take cues from Hollywood:
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_01_INTRO_14: {SAY:zombossicon}Remake existing movies and claim them as my own work!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}For this shoot, I'm going to need you all to stand perfectly still!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Allow my employees to completely overtake the field!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Their makeup and VFX will do the rest!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}Oh, it's going to be a great one!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}My zombies play the terrifying aliens, and you all play...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}They're about to invade! Look shocked, terrified!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_05_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}Don't screw this one up like you've been doing the rest!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_06_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}Make the Gargantuar look mighty and fearsome!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_06_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}We can't let our main antagonist get defeated in his introduction scene!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_09_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}This time, I'm sending fearsome robot assassins from the future to your doorstep!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_09_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}For dramatic effect, you need to sacrifice your brains!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Because of your lack of cooperation, all my movies have been bombing with test audiences!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}So, I'm going to be recreating an old classic.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}I'm putting myself in the starring role!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Regardless of your cooperation, I'll have a thrilling conclusion to my movie-making career!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}No more remakes from you, Boss Man!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_OUTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}Your rip-off movies are finally going to the bargain bin, Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_PARODY_10_OUTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Next time, you're gonna need a bigger Lily Pad!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_01_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I have located the first batch of captured plants around here somewhere.
{SAY:crazydave}Would it happen to be those Peashooters over there?
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}GRAH! When did you two neanderthals get here?
{SAY:zombossicon}You're not supposed to be here yet! My experiments are far from correctly set up!
{SAY:zombossicon}No matter! Let's see how you like your peashooters now!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{EXCITED:crazydave}We did it Penny! Let's have a victory party!
{SAY:winnie}Celebrations can wait. These Peashooters are about to break a whole lot of zombies out of ice.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_02_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}So, do you still like your precious plants?

{SAY:winnie}We are not playing your twisted game!
{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, it's no game I assure you.
{SAY:zombossicon}I just want to test out your hypothesis!
{SAY:zombossicon}Do you like these creatures merely because they are able to assist you, or out of the kindness of your hearts?
{SAY:zombossicon}The choice is yours! Time is ticking!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, much like last time, these Homing Thistles are put in another disadvantageous circumstance.
{TIRED:winnie}Especially now that a group of local jesters are present here tonight.
{SAY:winnie}Keep them safe and we will get through this soon!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Those jesters won't juggle anything on my watch!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_05_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}More bells, you know what that means...
{SAY:winnie}Jesters, User Dave. They are back to harm our captured plants.
{SAY:winnie}It seems as if Zomboss is trying to make us all dislike the prospect of using plants as allies.
{SAY:winnie}He put them into these unfortunate scenarios to prove a sadistic point.
{TIRED:winnie}But we must not let these fabricated situations alter our resolve or prove him right.
{SAY:winnie}Precisely. AND he's endangering innocent plants to do it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_06_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I know deep down you're all hypocrites!
{SAY:zombossicon}Let's see if your very own allies sabotaging one another does the trick! Mwahahaha!
{SAY:winnie}I detect high levels of anger, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_06_OUTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Fantastic work, now we just have two batches of plants left to save.
{TIRED:crazydave}Boss Man's gonna see! We aren't lying!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_08_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have located the last group of captured plants.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Let's get them saved and show him what's what!
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Not so fast you time traveling twerps!
{SAY:zombossicon}I see my brilliantly devised traps have failed in hampering your resolve, but this shall not!
{SAY:zombossicon}You two are not ready for this, shall I say... GRIM situation...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_ENDANGERED_08_OUTRO: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Curses! You really DO care for these horrid things!
{SAY:zombossicon}I guess I should've expected as much! I'll return, you cretins!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have saved the Pepper-pults and Grimrose. Let the party commence.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_01_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Jeepers, Penny! Somebody cut out the lights!
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we have been through this before.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_02_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, it appears some alternate zombie threats are coming out of the shadows.

{SAY:winnie}These new zombies are alternative versions of other zombies we have encountered before.
{SAY:winnie}The Dark Explorer appears to be an Explorer Zombie from medieval times.
{SAY:winnie}You are correct, User Dave. I will need to find more data on them.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_04_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}What's with those spooky new tiles on the lawn?
{SAY:winnie}Data shows that these are Boosting Tiles, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}Zombies that step on them can receive toughness, speed, or invincibility boosts.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_07_IN: {EXCITED:crazydave}It must be a sign we're getting close to Gloom Vine!
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, this is an old gardener's myth.

{SAY:winnie}Local weather seems to forecast sudden wind chills.
{SAY:winnie}We should bring heating to be safe. It's going to be a cold night.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_08_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This is it, User Dave. We have almost rescued the Gloom Vine.
{SAY:winnie}We have one last challenge to overcome.
{SAY:winnie}Power Tiles are on our side, however, the zombies have Boosting Tiles on theirs.
{SAY:winnie}A massive attack is approaching. We must be prepared.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_SHADOWLURKERS_08_OU: {EXCITED:winnie}We have successfully acquired the Gloom Vine!

{SAY:winnie}I will see what I can do.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_POOLPARTY_01_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woah, Penny! What're we doin' back here?

{SAY:winnie}Hold off the leisure for now, there might also be a plant in need of rescuing here shortly.
{SAY:winnie}If my memory drives are correct, the pool will limit planting capabilities.
{SAY:winnie}So placing down Lily Pads will be of importance to fend off intruders traversing it.
{SAY:winnie}Be on the lookout for an alternate, compact version of the Shield Zombie too.
{SAY:crazydave}Huh? I thought that was the cleanup crew!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_POOLPARTY_02_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my systems have yielded worth-while results.
{SAY:winnie}First and foremost: we do indeed have a new plant to retrieve.
{SAY:winnie}Lotus Pod is an interesting specimen capable of switching abilities depending on where it is placed.
{SAY:winnie}On land, it lobs heavy-hitting torpedoes at a zombie.
{SAY:winnie}While on water, it launches swift torpedoes that speed through the pool.
{SAY:winnie}Dealing damage to multiple targets in an area once it hits.
{SAY:winnie}On another topic, the zombies have some newfound strategies.
{SAY:crazydave}Yeah, uh, I think they found their ducky tube supply again from the last time they were here.
{SAY:winnie}Beware of their inflatables, as it makes them navigate the pool faster than on land.
{SAY:winnie}It appears my scans have also noticed that some have submerged themselves underwater.
{SAY:crazydave}Bummer. Guess my pool cleaning work is gonna be cut out for me once we're done.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_POOLPARTY_05_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Hey neighbor! Came by real quick to tell you about something crazy!
{SAY:crazydave}And we can't have that! Only I can be crazy!
{SAY:crazydave}She said she'd be busy analyzing stuff somewhere else.
{SAY:crazydave}No clue why, but she did tell me something exciting before leaving.
{SAY:crazydave}The zombies used some sort of wackymajig to make themselves smaller!
{SAY:crazydave}How can they do that?! I sure wish I could!
{SAY:crazydave}When I'm small, I bet I can eat tacos twice as fast!
{SAY:crazydave}Just that I'd probably be knocked unconscious by a squirbo in one hit.
{SAY:crazydave}Unless I manage to avoid getting hit entirely!
{SAY:crazydave}Wait, uh oh... I'd watch out though.
{SAY:crazydave}The zombies here could probably do that with peas.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_POOLPARTY_08_OUTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have successfully secured the Lotus Pod.
{SAY:winnie}This'll prove quite an important ally moving forward.
{SAY:crazydave}And now we can get back to cleaning the pool!
{SAY:winnie}We have important matters to handle elsewhere.
{SAY:winnie}I'm afraid Zomboss has a new plot brewing.
{SAY:winnie}Data is currently inefficient but it is likely nothing pleasant.
{SAY:crazydave}Fine, I'll go deal with this some other time.
{SAY:crazydave}Hopefully not at nighttime though, I'd hate to clean the pool at night!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}What about that zombie rocket we saw earlier?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, prepare yourself for the following information.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}All of the zombies from the rocket appear to be from the "Hero-Con" event.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_15: {EXCITED:crazydave}I've already got our costumed plants ready!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_1_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}Good thing we brought 'em for the journey!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woah, there's a LOT more of those heroes fellas than I remember.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}This is very likely the doing of General Camo.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Last time we fought a hero-themed army, it was his doing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}It would be logical to conclude that this is yet another scheme.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Therefore, I will provide the same means we used to defeat him last time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Plant Food Tiles will trigger the Plant Food effect of a plant once it's planted on them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:captaincamo}I'm a little busy right now, but I'll see if I can fit you in.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_5: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}General Guy! What are you doing here?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}I knew this was another one of your schemes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Are you trying to give your new "army" superpowers?

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Camo doesn't seem up for conversation right now.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a large influx of Repairimps.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_3_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}Ugh, what are those ugly things they're carrying?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a presence of strange zombie tricks.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Zombie tricks... now that's something I haven't heard about in a while.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{PLAYFUL:captaincamo}Oh, I've been saving this just for you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}I've done thorough research on how to utilize these heroic tricks to my advantage.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamo}Who knew nerds could actually be useful for something.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_8: {SAY:captaincamo}Oh, if I could get my hands-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_10: {TIRED:captaincamo}Gotta keep myself composed, it's not good for the heart.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:captaincamo}Since you BANISHED me from my own time period-!!!!

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}If you intend to power them up with this meteor's radiation, you're too late.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_19: {SAY:captaincamo}You just need to know where to dig, hahaha!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_21: {SAY:captaincamo}I could be lying, want to find out?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_22: {SAY:captaincamo}Besides, I'm here for more personal reasons as well.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_5_INTRO_23: {SAY:captaincamo}Now get ready! Some bad natural satellites are about to rise!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{SAY:captaincamo}You might be interested to know that I actually dug up the history of this place.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_2: {SAY:captaincamo}Zomboss had quite a few heroes before he assembled our initiative squad, huh?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_3: {SAY:captaincamo}It's obvious the moron lost contact with most of them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}So typical for him to let go of useful assets...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_5: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}According to recent records, most of the zombie heroes created by Zombot Hero-Tron 5000 are retired.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}Yeah, they used to be a pain but uh...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}I heard a lot of 'em left Boss Man behind and just sign autographs for long lines these days.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:captaincamo}I think a proper accident is exactly what it takes to create a real new "hero."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:captaincamo}And this just so happens to be the location where one of them originated.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_11: {SAY:captaincamo}So today, I'm sending in the Huge-Gigantacus lookalikes...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_13: {SAY:captaincamo}By recreating these circumstances, I'll have a superpowered soldier for myself!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamo}One that's going to be in the same league as the others!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_7_INTRO_15: {SAY:captaincamo}So do your thing, gardeners. Emulate evolution and wipe out the "Gigantacuses" that have no potential!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_2: {SAY:captaincamo}None of them were strong enough? Psh.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:captaincamo}If I can't have super soldiers... I'll have my revenge!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_6: {SAY:captaincamo}Do you ever look up at the clear night sky?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a powerful laser.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:winnie}It's been cloaked all this time... it's on Camo's rocket!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}General Camo is trying to blow up the moon!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_18: {SAY:crazydave}It's got a cute rabbit on it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}General Camo, blowing up the moon isn't beneficial in any way for someone like you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}Why would you want to do that?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_21: {EXCITED:captaincamo}Oh trust me scrap heap, I know EXACTLY what I'm doing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_22: {SAY:captaincamo}This will assert my power over all the zombies, but most importantly-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_23: {SHOUT:captaincamo}Get rid of that MORON'S STUPID UGLY MUG!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_24: {SHOUT:captaincamo}HOW CAN ANY OF YOU SLEEP WITH THAT IGNORAMOUS'S FACE STARING DOWN AT YOU EACH NIGHT!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_29: {SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss carving his face into the moon?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_30: {SAY:captaincamo}I'm not going to let that monument to stupidity stay up in the night sky!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_32: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamo}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting the laser cannon charging.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_33: {SAY:winnie}It's going to be fully functional in three days!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_8_INTRO_34: {TIRED:crazydave}Oh brother. Now this is truly despicable.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{PLAYFUL:captaincamo}Hah! You idiots focused on the laser and forgot all about the radiation!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}Thanks to the utter stupidity of both of you, I'm getting everything I came here for.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamo}Some of my troops have already soaked in that radiation goodness!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_6: {SAY:captaincamo}And my laser cannon is on its way to wipe that grin off the face of the king!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_8: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamo}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting zombies with heightened attributes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_9_INTRO_10: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Uh, what? Sorry, I was eating all the funky cheese off the ground.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Camo, we're leading a full-frontal assault on your rocket today!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yeah! We can't let you get rid of the moon!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}My troops are already juiced up on every bit of radiation left on this rock.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamo}And your plants are now the ones playing dress up.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_6: {SAY:captaincamo}So how are you exactly planning on taking me down?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}You've clearly never read a comic book.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Plus, we've got every heroic plant you can ask for in our arsenal.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}You're not the only one with tricks up your sleeve.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's right! And this is what heroes do to villains!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamo}I don't know if you nincompoops realize...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_INTRO_18: {TIRED:captaincamo}Ugh. Gotta ease up on the shouting.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_4: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Tired from ordering other zombies around all day?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Your laser cannon has been successfully destroyed, Camo.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_15: {SAY:captaincamo}After all that, I've still completed one of my plans.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_16: {SAY:captaincamo}I got most of my troops powered up from the radiation.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_18: {SAY:captaincamo}Even though you prevented my revenge, I won.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_21: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamo}{EXCITED:crazydave}Big words for someone who just ate dust!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_23: {SAY:winnie}We failed to stop his plot to power up his troops.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_24: {SAY:winnie}This could prove troublesome in the future.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_25: {SAY:crazydave}Come on Penny! Look at it on the bright side!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ_10_OUTRO_26: {SAY:crazydave}We stuck it to the bad guy! And nobody got hurt!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, why have we returned to Big Wave Beach?
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Haven't you heard, Penny? They've opened up a new gift shop!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}I even bought myself this sweet, one of a kind souvenir from there!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}It's meant to make me mighty lucky!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, it appears that the zombies have sold you a regular rock.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}I guess I'll go toss it away...
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_9: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}My scan has indicated that User Dave is not this shop's only customer.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}In addition to selling cheap souveniers, the shop is selling inflatables to the zombies of this period.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_1_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Zombies wearing these ducky tubes will have increased mobility in the water. Be alert.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}This Acid Lemon guy can do some real damage to strong armors these zombies have!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Not only that, but he can also toss that slice of his to push them back! Pretty cool, huh?
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_4: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Excellent analysis User Dave, I'm quite impressed!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}How did you research this information so quickly?
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}Well you see Penny, when I threw that rock yesterday, I heard something yelp in pain!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Turns out I accidentally hit this guy here!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Poor thing, that's probably why it looks like its screaming in pain.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:crazydave}It did make him release some of his acid though, which is how I noticed what he does.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}But there! You see, Penny? This rock IS lucky! It led us to a new ally!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}We'll use it to find some treasure and give it to him as an apology!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}I appreciate the concern for your new friend, User Dave, but your treasure hunt will have to wait.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}The zombies have become aware of our presence.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_2_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}We could utilize him and his friends in our defense.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_3_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}All we've found so far is a bunch of garbage left by these party animals!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}At this rate, Acid Lemon won't forgive me!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_3_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}This zombie waste will be moved by the tide past our plants until it reaches the shoreline.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}It is harmless, but our plants will be distracted by them as they float by.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Say, maybe our little buddy will help us out with the clean-up!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:crazydave}Hey neighbor, don't you think this one looks kinda familiar?
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Jackpot! Look at what me and my lucky rock found Penny!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_5_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}With the pearls we get from them, we'll be able to buy the perfect apology gift!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}I'll even buy you those spoilers you wanted!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}While I appreciate the sentiment User Dave, it appears that these "clams" are zombies in disguise.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_5_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}They are fully committed to their act, and will assume a defensive position upon meeting a plant.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_5_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}However, once their hard shell is destroyed they will continue on foot as per usual.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_5_INTRO_8: {TIRED:crazydave}And I was just about to grab my mallet too!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My analysis indicates the presence of another type of Shell Zombie.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_7_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Unlike their heavyweight counterpart, they will aggresively snap at nearby plants instead of protecting themselves.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_7_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Watch your fingers! There's a zombie in there and he'll bite!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, during your treasure hunting escapades, I have made a discovery.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}It appears that we're not the only ones returning to Big Wave Beach.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You'd be correct on that assumption, machine!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Guess what!? I'm not gonna tell you!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}An evil genius could do with some secrets kept to themselves!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}Know that it's in the service of a great, totally diabolical, evil plan! Totally!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Are you the reason for the increasing amount of garbage at the beach, Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}Do you seriously think I'm the source of everything bad that happens in the world?
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}As much as I'd like that to be the case, the appearance of this waste has nothing to do with me!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}A huge magnanimous party recently took place here, bringing about great pollution!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}And now I'm stuck having to deal with this colossal mess, grumble, grumble.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_15: {SAY:zombossicon}Nothing! My scheme this time has NOTHING to do with either of you!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_16: {SAY:zombossicon}Stay put as I peruse this ocean of waste for no particular reason!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_17: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss seems to have his own agenda, as always.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}And it most likely has something to do with the piles of garbage littering the beach.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_19: {SAY:crazydave}Are you saying he's off on his own treasure hunt amongst these garbage?
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_9_INTRO_20: {SAY:crazydave}Gasp! We can't let him get to the treasure first! Lucky rock, guide us!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Blasted! I'm left with no other options!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}My mother has my hands tied here, so I'm just gonna have to come clean to you time-leapers.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}You wouldn't happen to have seen a- *murmur*?
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}Speak up Boss Man, we can't hear you!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}A ROCK! I'M LOOKING FOR MY NEPHEW'S BLASTED "PET" ROCK!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Curse him and his stupid party! Not only had he stolen my time tech to travel here-
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}He practically got off scot-free because my nag of a matriarch forbid me from laying a finger on him!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}And not only that- now I have to deal with even more of his stupid mess-
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}How am I responsible for him losing his pet rock? "Oh, it's your time machine, Georgie-"
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_1: {SAY:zombossicon}Shut up, hag! You're the one at fault!
{SAY:zombossicon}I already told you I'm replacing the fridge with an experimental time machine model!
{SAY:zombossicon}How is this MY fault!? She should be the one preventing him from stupidly marooning himself!
{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, how I long to get even with this entitled problem child- one day...
{SAY:zombossicon}I am forever cursed to my familial bonds!
{SAY:zombossicon}Bah! I'm only doing this to keep the next Food Fight dinner from becoming another slog!
{SAY:zombossicon}Else, I'd never hear the end of it...
{EXCITED:winnie}A rock, you say? User Dave, could it be?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}You meant this? It's my lucky rock!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Well, nevermind! Stay where you are as I retrieve it!
{SAY:zombossicon}How would someone keep a rock as a pet, anyway? My nephew's idiocy knows no bounds!
{SAY:zombossicon}At least I have a sensible reason to keep around a pet goldfish bowl!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You might've defeated me, but I got what I came here for!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Curse you, machine, curse you, David, curse you, you stupid companion rock!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}And curse you, you sorry excuse of a kin, attaint to the Zomboss' legacy, deadbeat brother's spawn of sloth- the-
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_4: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}It's okay if he took it away Penny...
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}We don't need some fancy shmancy rock to find treasure...
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}Because what we really found was the best treasure of all!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}The new friend we've made along the way!
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_8: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I don't think that's the lesson you should be learning from all this.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Nor do I perceive there being any lesson to learn here to begin with.
NARRATIVE_PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_12_OUTRO_1: {TIRED:winnie}Let's just return home and never speak of this again.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, what happened? Why did we stop?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_2: {TIRED:winnie}Apologies, User Dave, but I have abruptly run out of energy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}So it appears we are currently stranded.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}And I cannot determine our current location.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Dang, I thought this was the fastest route to get home.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}I knew we should've made a left turn at Wild West...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Last time I'm asking Travel Log for directions.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}It appears this highway is still under construction.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Quite a new phenomenon, it seems inter-temporal transportation has become more widespread.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:crazydave}Oh, I've seen some of those ZCorp doohickeys being sold!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}Apparently they're trying to "commercialize time travel" or something like that.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps that is why the zombies are working on this highway as we speak.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}Should I ask if they have an extra jerry can we can use?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_1_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}We should remain cautious while I recharge.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, I regret to inform you, but we're seemingly not the only people stranded on this dimensional highway.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}I can see that! I've seen portals come and go whenever we were driving before...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}...but this is the first time it has gotten so close and personal!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}It seemingly doesn't end there, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Our presence seems to have attracted the other denizens of this "no man's land."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Things would be much simpler if that were the case. I'm referring to hitchhikers, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Zombies that have been stranded in this rift between timelines.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, that's right! I usually just drive past em, like the portals!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Circumstances provide us no such luxury this time, User Dave.

NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_9: {TIRED:crazydave}I've got a bad feeling about this. My seventh sense is kicking in.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_05_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}We need to make sure they don't pierce our defenses with their arsenal of weapons.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Great, I can't wait to get out of here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_3: {TIRED:crazydave}Almost feels like I'm getting hallucinations at this point...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_4: {TIRED:crazydave}All I see is snow and ice and snow and more ice...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}I've even seen some zombies burned alive and survive!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Their body temperature is barely above zero, making them immune to chill.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Furthermore, their skin is completely fire proof due to their burns.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:crazydave}Burning yourself makes you immune to fire AND ice!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_07_INTRO_13: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What do they call it... alternative medicine?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}If Zomboss abandoned these zombies, they're all scattered and without purpose!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Logic dictates that there had to have been a zombie powerful enough to become their leader.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}If we continue defending ourselves we will eventually catch their attention.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}My engines are 50% repaired, so there's a chance we will be able to flee from this place before then.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Speaking of, my scanners are detecting new incoming threats...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}These zombies might have evolved into a brand new hierarchy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}All tribes have their members: Leaders, chiefs...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}It seems we've already gained the attention of the chiefs.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}During this time period, chiefs were particularly deadly.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Their mastery of cold breathing leads to entire lanes of frozen fighters.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}We must provide more heating than ever.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_15: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, a little bit of stink breath's never killed anyone.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}Besides, I think it's kind of neat that these zombies have separated from Boss Man.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe a new leader for them really can work.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:winnie}It's an interesting notion, and given the evidence, highly likely.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}There's no existing data to match such a scenario.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_09_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps we haven't crash landed to remain and observe these occurrences without reason.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}I'm noticing a lot more zombies on the horizon than usual.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}We appear to have gotten on the leader's radar.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_3: {TIRED:winnie}This is bad. My engines are nowhere near ready.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}A hero to his people, the acquirer of brains.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}An avalanche fighter and the king of the tribe.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_9: {SAY:crazydave}This is the first time we're fighting off a zombie horde not lead by Boss Man, right?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Just because they're not lead by Zomboss doesn't mean they're any less dangerous.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_11: {TIRED:winnie}If anything, they're more unpredictable. I've documented all of Zomboss's patterns.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_12_INTRO_13: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}So it's leader a leader here, huh?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I've got lots of good news!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}First of all, my engines are 75% repaired!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Secondly, Elder Hailstorm and his cronies have retreated!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Status of Elder Hailstorm is still unknown.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}That's odd, I swear I've seen some zombies still approaching?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}You appear to be correct, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}This is most unusual. Their leader has been defeated.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}They should have all retreated and left us alone.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}Do you think they're just that hungry?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Even if they were, they'd still follow the orders of their leader.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Stranger more... there's a brand new type of evolved zombie.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}The Weasel Queen will summon Permafrost Weasels who are even more durable.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}Once her log is broken, she will yodel for even further weasel support.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:crazydave}Now this just plainly doesn't make any sense!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:crazydave}If I know zombies, which I do, they'd have stopped at this point!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_19: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe do a dance party too, but sending in new troops?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. It defies all previously encountered patterns.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}I'll run analysis, in the meantime, these zombies should be fended off.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_13_INTRO_23: {EXCITED:crazydave}We should use Flameweed, he's got quite an itching for torching zombie weasels!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, something quite unprecedented has happened!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}We appear to have gotten a stone tablet letter from the zombie tribe.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Oh. Well, that's quite normal, we've gotten loads of those.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}It's written in a very poorly constructed primitive language, but I believe I can translate it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}"Me Elder Hailstorm! I order writing and delivering of this letter!"
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}"The attack from yesterday not from us. Me find you not as prey anymore."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}"Me respect you when find who you are."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}"Our old bad leader return. Divide happen."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}"Me stand by my people. We not allow big brain zombie to retake leader."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}"Cowards from tribe joined his side, rest of us hiding."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}"Help the tribe Me ask. We not want serve bad leader again."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_20: {EXCITED:winnie}This is unprecedented. We have been asked for aid by a zombie group.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}From the guys that Boss Man abandoned?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_24: {SAY:winnie}The zombies still attacking us are from the tribe, but they switched sides once Zomboss returned.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_25: {EXCITED:crazydave}This is too crazy even for me!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_26: {SAY:winnie}It seems Zomboss hasn't noticed we're here yet.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_14_INTRO_27: {SAY:winnie}I'll calculate our next plan of action.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my engines have fully repaired. We should go now.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Actually Penny, I think I wanna stay for a bit longer.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}What is your reasoning for this illogical action, User Dave?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}You heard the Elder Guy, Penny! These zombies need our help!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man wants to be their leader again, but they already got a new leader!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}And that leader actually wants to be pals with us!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I don't think that entirely reflects the situation.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}My sensors indicate a 66% chance of these zombies betraying us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}We gotta believe them Penny! Elder Guy even said he "respect us."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_15_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}If you wish us to stay and help, we shall.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}I come back to the ice age to find my zombies under new leadership!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}And half of them refuse to respect me anymore because of some wannabe!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Inspired by the presence of "a weird man and his red metal mammoth"!????
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_6: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man, these zombies have moved on! I mean, you abandoned them!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}A busy evildoer such as myself has too much to worry about to remember small things like that.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}You have to admit Zomboss, you should've seen this coming.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}Enough about me! What are YOU doing here!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}And why are you conspiring with these troglodytes!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_14: {EXCITED:crazydave}Because they have their own tribe now!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_15: {SAY:zombossicon}Their resistance is futile. You should get out of here and let me do proper clean up!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss... have you been training these zombies to emulate the Elder Hailstorm?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_20: {SAY:zombossicon}Well, I MAY have given orders to appoint some of my own zombies as new sub-leaders working for me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}And you're copying the original, down to the clothes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_22: {SAY:zombossicon}If it's war you're asking for, you have it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_16_INTRO_23: {SAY:crazydave}Aren't we already at war for years?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we've received yet another stone letter from Elder Hailstorm.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}"We fight back at big brain zombie."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}"We beat big brain zombie! We free tribe!"
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss must be prepared. He is determined to reclaim his title as the tribe leader.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:crazydave}He's got a whole truckload of zombies on his side already!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss is a prideful zombie, and he's not going to let defiance like this go.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I retract my previous doubt.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}This alliance could prove very useful for us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}If we succeed in defeating Zomboss, we may break the ice with these zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}We're truly experiencing a revolutionary moment in history.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_19_INTRO_20: {EXCITED:crazydave}I never thought I'd see the day.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}HAH! Did you really expect Elder Hailstorm to be able to defeat me!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}He couldn't even keep himself from getting frozen!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_5: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man, this has to stop! You have to leave this tribe alone!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Since when do you care about zombies!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}These zombies don't even wanna eat our brains anymore!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Preposterous! That's an insult to all zombie-kind!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}I shall retake my rightful place as the ruler of zombies in this era.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Why have you helped them seperate from me!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:winnie}Having zombie allies is a breath of fresh air, wouldn't you agree?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}At the very least I took out Elder Hailstorm with my explosion.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Status Report: Despite being turned to ash, Elder Hailstorm is alive and well.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Reports say he is simply too mighty to die from it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_ICEAGE_20_OUTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Fine! They can have their little tribe all to themselves!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Is this some kind of... sky city?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}No, User Dave. We are currently in an unidentified airspace.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}And it looks as if we're being assaulted.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}I don't remember flying fortresses in the history books.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I cannot identify our current location nor time period.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Please allow me time to adjust to the new environment.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}I was not aware that this is where we would end up by following the distress signal.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}Good thing we landed on this house, it's got a big blasty cannon and a shield!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}We can also put our flying buddies like Rotobaga to good use!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Unfortunately, the zombies are equipped with weapons of their own.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}While they can't eat our brains, they can take this ship down.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}I have given our neighbor remote access to the airship's cannon.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}They can find it in their "POWER-UPS" for free if things go haywire.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}The cannon will need time to recharge after use.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_1_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps fending off this attack will give us insight into our current situation.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}A good thing about clouds is plants love to sit on them.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}However, these clouds show to have high enough density that it is possible.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Hey Penny, who are those guys coming towards us?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Zombie Fighters have caliber on their air crafts.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}They will continuously gun our plants and ship down.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}What!? Guns? What kind of zombies are these!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}It's a good thing we retrieved Aceparagus!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Aceparagus shoots zombies in its own lane, or adjacent ones.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}After a couple of shots, it has to cool down and reload.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Zombies in the sky, big guns and flying houses...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Where did we travel to Penny? What is this place?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}But, I have finished my analysis of this location.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}We are in an era that used to be colloquially referred to as "Historical March."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}I don't see any marching happening! What a scam!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Despite the dates coinciding, the location itself is drastically different from my records.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Originally, "Historical March" was a wartime period in the 20th century.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Conflicts in it were fought with advanced weaponry, but not like this.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Not in the sky, and certainly not with this kind of technology.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_15: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Is this another one of Boss Man's plans?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_3_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}Chances of this being a scheme from Dr. Zomboss are high. We must stay alert.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}These plane Imps are beating us down Penny...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_4_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Our new compatriot Puffapple is just the solution to our issue.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_4_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}His elastic properties allows him to inflate himself to deflect their bullets.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}He is also highly defensive, so he can be used like other walls.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_4_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}That can give us some room to breathe on the clouds!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}That's a big ship, what's in there?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}I can not gather anything on the ship, the model is not in my database.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Anything involving imps is no good, let's be on a lookout.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED:crazydave}Penny, I'm gonna need your help again.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_6_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}It appears a new plane model is in action.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}F-82 Twin Fighters take up 2 rows of space, and will not go down unless both sides are destroyed.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Destroying one side without destroying the other will cause it to absorb projectiles.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_6_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Wow, you've really upgraded your analysis algorithms Penny.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_6_INTRO_8: {PLAYFUL:winnie}In times like this, they do need a good dust up.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_7_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}The zombies just don't go down no matter how much we beat on 'em!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_7_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The newly retrieved Saucer Squash can alleviate this issue.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Saucer Squash has the ability to stun zombies and capture weakened ones.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_7_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}We'll need all the help we can get.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_8_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Zombies with, what appear to be laser guns, are approaching.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_8_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}My scans were able to determine the logic behind their energy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_8_INTRO_5: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}These zombies fire plasma balls with both positive and negative energy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_8_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Positive comes in blue, negative comes in red.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_8_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Two negative connections will paralyze our plants.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_8_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}A positive and negative connection will chill our plants.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_8_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Two positive connections will slowly destroy non-defensive plants.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I have gathered some crucial information.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}I can confirm that Zomboss is not responsible for altering this world.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}I knew I recognized the gun model that Scientist Zombies use.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}I was running an analysis on them the past few days and the results are conclusive.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Those models are 1:1 replicas of a prototype gun that Dr. Zomboss attempted to build years ago.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Except he swore off ever using it due to it blowing up his lab.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}His research on this type of weapon was long abandoned, and copies destroyed.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}There is only one way to find out.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}The zombies have been coming in coordinated attacks from the East primarily.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}We will have to take the ship and follow the source.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_13: {TIRED:crazydave}Can't we rest a little? They have been attacking us so much.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_14: {TIRED:winnie}I'm afraid they won't stop if we stay here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_11_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}We will surely be taken down if we don't keep moving.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny, I don't know how much longer I can keep it together!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}This war world is unlike anything I've seen before!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}To add insult to injury, I'm detecting an imminent assault of zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}I am unable to retrieve that data at this time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}We were meant to get in here, rescue whoever sent the distress signal-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_10: {TIRED:winnie}User Dave, we must focus on the imminent battle.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_12: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{PLAYFUL:captaincamo}Oh, how I knew this would happen.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_16: {SAY:captaincamo}I sent that distress signal to trap you gits in a time period where I was in my prime!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:captaincamo}You common gardeners haven't faced real war!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_18: {SAY:captaincamo}Feast your eyes on everything here! My doing!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_19: {EXCITED:captaincamo}I gave this place a makeover of the century!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}General Camo, your threats are well and good-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}But what do you mean by "when I was in my prime?"
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}Have you caused changes to this era?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_24: {SAY:captaincamo}See, this time period holds some of my fondest memories.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_25: {SAY:captaincamo}I used to command all of this when I was in my youth.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_26: {SAY:captaincamo}Before I needed to wear this mask...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_27: {SAY:captaincamo}There was a brief period in history where I was on top of the world.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_28: {SAY:captaincamo}And had the resources to deal with nitwits like you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_30: {SAY:captaincamo}My younger self has already decided on a full frontal assault.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_31: {SAY:captaincamo}I suppose "if you want something done, do it yourself" really does apply.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_32: {SAY:captaincamo}I'll let him do the job and watch from the sidelines.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_36: {SAY:winnie}Actually, it puts things into context quite accurately.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_37: {SAY:winnie}The General Camo we know baited us into this time period.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_38: {SAY:winnie}So that his past self could "take care of us" back when he had immense resources.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_39: {EXCITED:crazydave}You mean this guy is working with himself!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_40: {SAY:winnie}I doubt that, it would cause too much temporal instability.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_41: {SAY:winnie}His younger self may not even know that he's here, spectating the battle.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_42: {SAY:winnie}This does bring one thing into question.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_43: {SAY:winnie}How was this war changed from what's documented to this aerial battle?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_44: {SAY:winnie}And if this was the high point of General Camo's career, what put an end to it?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_12_INTRO_45: {SAY:crazydave}I think I need to practice my battle cry.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}That General Guy is out of his mind!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}He pulled quite a dirty trick on us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}It seems I am unable to warp us out of this time period.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}He must have implemented counter-measures to time travelling out of here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}For the time being, focus on survival.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Young Camo's still got a large arsenal of weapons.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Makes it all the more puzzling what brought down his reign of terror.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_9: {TIRED:winnie}And... how a typical war got turned into... this.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_10: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{SAY:captaincamo}I suppose I'll tell you, seeing how you're still alive.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_11: {SAY:captaincamo}You're right, this used to be nothing but your typical tanks and landmines.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}You mean when you came back to trap us?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_15: {SAY:captaincamo}Zomboss and I share quite an extensive history.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_16: {SAY:captaincamo}He recognized my talents and brought me to his time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_17: {SAY:captaincamo}After failing to comprehend my mental superiority, he sent me back here...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_20: {SAY:captaincamo}I memorized the schematics to all his fancy future tech!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_24: {TIRED:captaincamo}Due to unforeseen circumstances, I was overthrown...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_25: {SAY:captaincamo}But not before I got to experience the glory of the battle.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_26: {SAY:crazydave}And ever since then, you've hated Boss Man?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_27: {EXCITED:captaincamo}Don't bring him into this! This is my time!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_28: {SAY:captaincamo}Oh, lookie that, I'm about to throw my signature ambush at you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_29: {SAY:captaincamo}Soon you'll see that what I used to wear was more than a fashion choice.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_13_INTRO_31: {SAY:winnie}A thinly veiled threat. We'll have to brace ourselves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_3: {SAY:captaincamo}Seems like I'm sending one of my strongest soldiers your way.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}Let's see how truly prepared you really are.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamo}You can fight off gas, but can you handle missiles!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Try to not let his intimidation get to you, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}He's gonna send his soldiers to blow our house to smithereens!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}We have a new soldier of our own.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_10: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Or, a "model" of plant, so it were.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}The P-15 Peagle Pod attacks zombies in its own lane, as well as ones in adjacent ones.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}The pea pilots target 3 separate zombies and proceed to dish out damage.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_14_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}They'll surely ease our burden for the time being.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_15_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, this might ease your worries.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_15_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Woah, we're really on a roll with the plant buddies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_15_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Nispaereo can capture surrounding zombies in a tornado.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_15_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}We're fighting off young Camo's forces pretty effectively so far.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:captaincamo}You should've been fried meat and circuits by now!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}We're slowly chipping away at your forces, Camo!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:captaincamo}Can't even rely on yourself these days!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_9: {SAY:captaincamo}I suppose the lack of tactical experience is really what's hampering this plan!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_10: {SAY:captaincamo}Time to get some experienced hands on deck!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_11: {SAY:captaincamo}I've got to steer this battle myself!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:captaincamo}You will not bring down the might of my army!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}It seems as if he's going to try to get his past self out of command and replace him.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_16_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}This can only mean bad things for us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_2: {SAY:captaincamo}Never thought that trying to usurp my own self would be this draining.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_3: {TIRED:captaincamo}Ugh... my body's not what it used to be.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:captaincamo}But this is what spells doom for you cretins! Because I did it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:captaincamo}I'm in control now! And you've got nowhere to hide anymore!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_7: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamo}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}It's just as I feared. Our General Camo himself is now running the army.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}I never thought he'd go that far. Meddling with one's own past is dangerous.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}He's already taking drastic measures to try and eliminate us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}I'm detecting multiple squadrons of Arbiter Planes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Arbiter planes cloak all zombies behind themselves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Making the other zombies essentially invincible to damage.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}If he's invincible, why can I see him?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_17_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}The range of its cloaking ability is 5 lanes in total.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_18_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Due to your recent distress, I've installed preliminary measures, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_18_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}I've already set up our defenses for today.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_18_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}And there's a new recruiter to our cause that you may have intel on.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_18_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Gatling Pea dishes out peas at an exceeding pace.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_18_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}When ready, you can tap Gatling Pea and it will fire a large pea that does more damage.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_18_INTRO_8: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}And thanks Penny, this defense does put my mind at ease.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_18_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:captaincamo}It would be a shame if I threw napalm bombs all over it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{SAY:captaincamo}Oh, I should really thank you for this!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_2: {SAY:captaincamo}I'm having the time of my unlife here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamo}Being back and controlling armies is simply electric!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamo}To think all of this was ruthlessly taken from me ages ago...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_6: {SAY:captaincamo}And I had to go into hiding for 70 years...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_7: {SAY:captaincamo}All because of some random old guy that came out of nowhere and overthrew me!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_10: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I knew you'd be willing to stoop to some low lows...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}But messing with your own self's past is even lower than I expected.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_12: {SAY:captaincamo}Eh, I'm sure there's still some depths to plumb.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:captaincamo}At least now I've got what I always deserved!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamo}To think... if I manage to bring all of this back to the present...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_15: {SAY:captaincamo}I could show up to that idiot Zomboss' doorstep...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:captaincamo}And point a cannon at his ugly mug!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_19_INTRO_18: {SAY:captaincamo}But first... I'll finish what I started here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I think I now have a pretty good understanding of how Camo got us trapped here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}I'm detecting satellites set up at an even higher altitude than ours.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}He must have set them up to prevent us from being able to time warp out of here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}And they're out of reach... and seemingly projectile-proof.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}What!? You mean we'll never get out of this war!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}I don't know how much more of this I can take, Penny!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm used to garden warfare, but not with real guns like this!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I understand the stress this has put on you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}You have been so used to fighting Zomboss for years.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}But as I must inform you, even if we did manage to leave now...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Currently, General Camo poses an immense threat to the world.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps a greater threat than even Zomboss if he's able to enact his plan of bringing this army to the present.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}We must find a way to both stop him, and free ourselves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_15: {EXCITED:crazydave}I can't perish in a war! I'm too young!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}There must be a way out of this.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_20_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}I'll continue trying to formulate a plan.
