NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I might have found a potential weakness in Camo's strategy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}But their current protection is too great.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}If I try, General Camo could notice and easily stop me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I'd only have one shot at this.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}And... you'd probably have to act as the distraction alongside your neighbor.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm not made of such sturdy oak!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_12: {TIRED:crazydave}I wish the Tree of Wisdom were here...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I am detecting high levels of emotional unrest.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}Look Penny, I think I lost my groove!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}Fighting zombies all these years, I thought I had it down!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_18: {SAY:crazydave}And suddenly, the script is all backwards!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, you need to "get your groove back!"
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_24: {SAY:winnie}It must be at a moment where he is greatly occupied.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_25: {SAY:winnie}I shall alert you when I scan an appropriate time for the plan to be enacted.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_22_INTRO_27: {SAY:crazydave}I think I'm gonna get a sip of black oil.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_23_INTRO_5: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:winnie}Perhaps if you were a better general, we'd be dead already.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_23_INTRO_12: {SAY:captaincamo}Now I can see why you lot have an unbreakable reputation!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_23_INTRO_13: {SAY:captaincamo}But I believe anything can be broken.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_23_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}He's still relying primarily on his army.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_23_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}... Well, you know what I mean.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_23_INTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}We'll need to get him to show himself in person.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:captaincamo}{TIRED:captaincamo}I can't believe the three of you even got me to this point!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Your armies aren't able to take us down!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Face us now or send more and we'll just take them down again!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_13: {SAY:captaincamo}Sure, direct attacks weren't as impactful as I was hoping.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamo}But you've clearly never heard of a "Plan B" before.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_15: {SAY:captaincamo}I've tricked your scanners, there's something big I've got in store.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_16: {SAY:captaincamo}Something you have no chance of taking down.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_17: {SAY:captaincamo}And no, I won't be showing up.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_18: {SAY:captaincamo}Unlike some tumor brain, I'm not stupid enough to put myself in a giant metal coffin!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_19: {SAY:captaincamo}But I am smart enough to learn from his mistakes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_20: {PLAYFUL:captaincamo}I got a surprise coming your way.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_23: {SAY:winnie}It's coming to us from the North at high speeds.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_24: {SAY:captaincamo}You can surrender, or keep at it and see what comes tomorrow.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_25: {PLAYFUL:captaincamo}Please choose the latter. I'll let you have fun dying...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_26: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamo}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, get yourself ready for tomorrow.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_24_INTRO_27: {SAY:winnie}If it's what I'm computing it is, it will be the perfect time to distract him.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_2: {SAY:captaincamoboss}Taking down ship after ship I send.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamoboss}Interesting attitude for birds in a cage.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_6: {PLAYFUL:captaincamoboss}And like a responsible owner... I'll let you out into the wilderness.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_7: {SAY:captaincamoboss}Where a bigger bird will grab you by its claws...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_10: {SAY:captaincamoboss}The strong rise above the meek in this world.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_14: {SAY:captaincamoboss}Haha! Realized the gravity of the situation?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}Yeah! I'm standing out here! On the open!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_19: {EXCITED:captaincamoboss}And I'll make sure to focus on your expression in your last moments!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_INTRO_20: {NPC_EXIT:captaincamoboss}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}This is perfect, User Dave! Keep it up!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_3: {SAY:captaincamoboss}That's it!? You think that's all I have!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_4: {SAY:captaincamoboss}I've got guns on guns! I've got plans C, D, and E!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_5: {SAY:captaincamoboss}You pathetic gardeners aren't gonna have enough chlorophyll to last a week!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_8: {EXCITED:captaincamoboss}No! You clever little trash can on wheels!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Yes, I managed to hack into his time-travel-disabling satellites.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Not only are we able to leave...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}I also made sure to reprogram them to specifically throw HIM out of this time period...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}I couldn't have done it without you two.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, if you hadn't conquered your fear, I don't know if we would have pulled this off.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_20: {SAY:crazydave}Yeah! It was scary at first, but... I did it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}It seems like you successfully "got your groove" back, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_24: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm ready to face down any zombie once again!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_25: {SAY:crazydave}That General Guy can't keep ol' panhead down!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_28: {SAY:winnie}Without Camo around, they have no real leadership.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_29: {SAY:winnie}And without that, the conflict will gradually fizzle out.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_30: {SAY:winnie}They probably aren't going to know how to maintain the tech he brought, either.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_SKYCITY_25_OUTRO_31: {SAY:winnie}Things will continue to play out naturally, and history will remain unaffected.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Is that a moon? With a rainbow?!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}I just remember some kind of flash...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_1_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Looks like we don't have time to ask questions, there's zombies here too!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Good thing there's some extra sun laying around!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Alright, I reached into the depths of my mind to pull out the memory of us ending up here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Last I remember I was just taking a snooze, some weird portal opened...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_4: {NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}There's another one of you? Just how many are there?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Woah! Who are you? Why do you look like that?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I come from a different universe than what you're used to.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A lot of things may seem bizarre until you two adjust.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}My name is Chimata Tenkyuu, and I run this market.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}This isn't the first time I have met one of you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}What? Is this another one of those timey-wimey dimensional situations...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}This is the Lunar Rainbow Market, a market that only opens under a Moonbow.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}However, something has gone terribly wrong this time around.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_14: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Strange creatures that don't appear to be youkai nor human.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_15: {SAY:crazydave}Strange creatures? Oh, those are just zombies, I fight them almost every day!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_16: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Your other selves have told me as much. They have been causing chaos!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}Well, if that's the reason why you got hold of me, you got the right man for the job!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_19: {SAY:crazydave}Wait, why do those zombies have wings?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_20: {AWKWARD:tenkyuchimata}I am not sure. Judging from your reaction though, they don't have wings normally?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}They ride on weird bugs but... not really.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_22: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Well, strange things occur here all the time. It's quite good for me, actually.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_23: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Regardless, these zombies have gained wings similar to fairies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_24: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They flutter about this world and are numerous.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_2_INTRO_25: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, I always wanted to see a fairy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}Chimata! I found a new plant at this market!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}Begonia? Those symbolise friendship and bond, but can also mean misfortune.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}So... what does it do? This is usually when Penny would fill me in.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}From what I have gathered, it manipulates both ice and fire...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Straight in the heart? That's gotta hurt.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Ice will cause heartbreak, hampering their ability to move.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Fire will cause lovesickness, crippling their strength.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}With both heartbreak and lovesickness, they become completely heartbroken.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_3_INTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Which makes them more vulnerable to your plants'... danmaku?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:crazydave}So from what you have told me...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}I have ended up in another world, along with other Crazy Daves?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_3: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Yes. And now that you're here, I am going to need your help to save the market.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Along with your neighbor and the other Daves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_5: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}One of your "zombies" was able to get here and he's been making a mess.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Faith in the market and myself is weakening as a result.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I can't let all the faith I have gathered vanish again...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}So I am going to need you, your neighbor and the other Daves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Not to worry, I will help you all get back home after this incident is resolved.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_10: {AWKWARD:tenkyuchimata}I think one of the sages may have dragged you here...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_11: {TIRED:crazydave}Well, that was kind of rude. I was just relaxing in my hammock.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_12: {SAY:crazydave}But zombies are dangerous if you're unprepared, that's for sure.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}I don't know. You brought me here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}This is kind of your mess, isn't it?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_18: {SAY:crazydave}And usually I require some kind of... motivation to clean up a mess.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_20: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I can give you any of the various delicacies in this world, is there anything you would like?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_22: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Well? I am a little desperate here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_25: {SAY:crazydave}Sandwich. But a cool-looking one. Like in the commercials.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_26: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I hate the modern day market and their commercials...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_27: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Alright, after this is all done, I will give you the most special sandwich.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_30: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Just keep fighting off these zombies like you know best.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_31: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Thanks to this incident, my level of faith has been going down and so I can't do much on my own.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_32: {EXCITED:crazydave}No time to lose hope! Crazy Dave is on the job!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_33: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}No, I mean the faith in myself. As a goddess, I require faith for power as well as my life.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_34: {SAY:crazydave}Oooooh, that must be why you look like that!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_35: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I've got to look the part for my role as a goddess, of course.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_36: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Anyway, there are many gods in this world, requiring faith as much as I do.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_37: {SAY:crazydave}Now hold on a minute, I see zombies with dusters!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_38: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Those are besoms. They surely intend to sweep your plants away.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_4_INTRO_39: {SAY:crazydave}No time for chit-chat! Time for zombie fightin'!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}I noticed, most of our plants are gone!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_3: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Luckily the ones at my market are still around, but...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}All the ones that belonged to you have lost their ownership completely.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Only I have the power to relinquish ownership, which means someone else has used my card...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_7: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}Well, well, well. If it isn't my very own fatso gardener.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}I had a feelin' that weird lass woulda brought you here too sooner or later.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}But you're too late, see? I've already gotsa the goods.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_11: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}You! You must be the one behind this incident.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Let's just say... One o' my side-gigs really paid off.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}All this "interdimensional" stuffs is outta my mind and sight usually, but oh, this market!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_14: {SAY:greedy}Why, when I found out about it, I was gigglin' like a candy-stuffed baby!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}My sources been tellin' me that it's got the power of ownership itself at its heart.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}And really, it was easy to exploit. I stumbled on the right dimension, I tell ya'.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_17: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}To use my power like that, crossing a god is dangerous you know...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_18: {SAY:greedy}Oh, please. You ain't all that. If you were, you wouldn't have needed all those "Daves" fightin' your battles.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_19: {SAY:greedy}And it seems you ain't destined to be any kind of "god of ownership" or whatever. No, someone else here seems to be a much better fit for that title...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_21: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}That someone else is me, that's what I meant.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_24: {EXCITED:crazydave}I know that guy, he's spoiled rotten!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_26: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I want to punish him for these acts, but I am too weak to do so.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_27: {SAY:crazydave}Let's just use what we have to fight off these zombies for now.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_5_INTRO_28: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I will help restore the ownership of your plants as well.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}It seems like a plant from last night wishes to be in your neighbor's ownership.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}This Cheese Strawberry can lob cheese to lower the attack power of Zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}What are these boxes with rainbows on them?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A remnant of an old incident of mine...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_5: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They mimic the powers of others, but only a small fraction.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They may help us out, or make things more difficult.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_7: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}Oh, they're gonna make things more difficult, alright.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}I'm beginning to get more and more power over ownership thanks to ya'.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}And that includes those cards o' yours!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Quite a sight, I gotta say. Nice craftsmanship.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_11: {SAY:greedy}They'll be good for shuttin' you up!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}You and those other "Daves" you brought here to annoy me!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}I've already activated some of 'em, toots. They're doin' good work.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_14: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}The ability cards were not meant to be used like this! Once I get my hands on you...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}You won't. Those hands won't be yours anymore either.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}This market's giving you all your power, the faith in "ownership" and the like.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_17: {SAY:greedy}Least that's what my professional's tellin' me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_7_INTRO_18: {SAY:greedy}But if all that faith goes to me instead, I'll own it all!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}So just who is this Greedy? Is he just another robber looking to ruin my market?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}He's a mobster zombie obsessed with wanting to have everything for himself.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}I've faced a lot of kooky characters like him recently.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And he wants to own everything in the market...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_5: {AWKWARD:tenkyuchimata}Has he not learned ownership isn't so easily passed?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}He is trying to break the natural order of ownership...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}...and I don't have the power to stop it yet.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}If he wins this, it sounds like he's getting the position of zombie leader too!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's gonna cause some serious trouble back at home!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_10: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And in other dimensions as well... He'll have universal access from here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}He won't stop until he has everything.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:crazydave}One time he even stole Feastivus spirit from everyone!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_13: {SAY:crazydave}And just because he wanted to be the most cheerful! Can you imagine that?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_14: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}If he has such a desire to own everything...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_15: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}He would undoubtedly launch zombie assaults on other dimensions to own as much as possible.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}And I got some personal stuff to deal with him! He stole my car once!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:crazydave}And my car is my best friend!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_18: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}That "car" must be a precious possession of yours.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_19: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Well that aside, we have a new threat. They appear to be princesses.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_20: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}They can cloak other zombies using their fans.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_21: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Similar to how Kappa use Optical Camouflage.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_22: {SAY:crazydave}What does royalty have to do with being invisible?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_8_INTRO_23: {SAY:crazydave}Now that I think about it, I don't think I have ever seen a princess in my life.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}It seems we received an offering from the Moriya Miko
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_4: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}This "place" is very significant I will have you know!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Anyway... These will produce some wonderful donations!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_6: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}What's that awful word I hear? Donations!? Bah!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}Such blasphemy will not be spoken in my new world!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}Any and all donations should be made to yours truly!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_10: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Hmph! You would even go as low as to steal a god's offerings.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_11: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Do you have any idea on what kind of karma this could bring you?!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Karma? You mean the stuff on those stupid websites?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}I need that donation, thank you. This is something we call "an open invitation" in the business.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_14: {SAY:greedy}I won't let it fall because of a couple of... Daves!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}I'm livin' it up now! I have servants, maids, minions...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_17: {SAY:greedy}The maids, the servants, they're all MINE!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_18: {SAY:greedy}There's even aristocrats who are willing to chit-chat and exchange pleasantries with me now. Shows I truly own more than anyone.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_19: {SAY:greedy}Ain't a chance I'm giving this life up now, and it's only gonna be gettin' better.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_20: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Alright Greedy, I am going to give you one chance to listen.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_21: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}You want to own everything... But what will there be to own once you have it all?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_22: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}You will own all possessions. But then you will seek more. You will want it all.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_23: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}You will chase the highs of ownership, seeking to fill that hole in you just ONE more time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_24: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Until there is nothing left. To own all is to own nothing.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_25: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Greed seeks eternity. Seeks deep, deep, eternity.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_26: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}It will never be satisfied. You will never be satisfied.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_28: {SAY:greedy}Once your precious market will be mine.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_32: {SAY:greedy}It'll be mine, mine, mine, mine, MINE!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_9_INTRO_33: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{AWKWARD:tenkyuchimata}Why did I even bother? They are all the same...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:greedy}I feel like you all aren't gettin' the point!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_2: {SAY:greedy}Do I really gotta spell it out?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_3: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Don't waste my time, get on with it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:greedy}Y'see, ever since my operations have been disapproved of by the big man himself, life's been tough for ol' Greedy.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}And you brought three of 'em to me right when I've got all this!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}How do you see that goin' down?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I have picked heroes intended to defeat you, this one even having done so previously.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Right. Tell ya' what. I ain't an unreasonable man. Let's make a deal.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_11: {SAY:greedy}I give ya back... Let's say... 10% of your power. And you will be spared of the oncoming attack to boot.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}In return, you tell me all the secrets of this place I've yet to uncover.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_14: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}I'd NEVER make deals with the likes of you!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}Fine. I tried bein' civilized with you. Time fo' my boys to really show ya' what they can do with all these resources.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_10_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:crazydave}It's another one of his huge attacks. Nothing the two of us can't handle!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:greedy}Why, you lot are as annoyin' as the tax-man.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_2: {SAY:greedy}I suppose it can't be helped. I'll have to send in more of my boys after ya'.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_4: {SAY:greedy}I don't know what he does, but have fun!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}He may be talking about those zombies resembling Shikaisens.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}These zombies use their vase to resurrect themselves.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_11_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Looks like we'll have to do some vase breaking, neighbor!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}Once again, another plant seeks to join you!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_12_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Iris can summon birds to attack and block zombies coming down their lane.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}Now, tell me honestly. Have you ever wanted to... ascend to higher ranks?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_5: {SAY:greedy}Bein' above just an errand boy. Squabblin' with that leader of ours all tha time!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_6: {SAY:greedy}What a waste o' a life. You could be makin' it big like me in the higher ranks o' society.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}That's... not exactly what I had in mind.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}But, y'know what I'll work with it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Maybe what you need is to meet an emperor. Someone who ascends others to higher ranks as you've described.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_11: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}I am growing really tired of this robber.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I am growing weaker as this incident continues.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_13_INTRO_13: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}If I fade away, what will become of humanity...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:greedy}Ooooh, guess what ol' Greedy just found out.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_5: {SAY:greedy}Your faith ain't in this little adventure, is it David?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}You ain't doin' this out o' the kindness o' your heart, are you?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}No need to pretend. I heard it all. You took advantage of this lass so that you could get yourself a sandwich out o' the whole ordeal.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}What? It's just a sandwich. Makes all the troubles worth it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Ah, that's what I like about ya'. Ya' know how to play your cards.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}You saw an opportunity to take what you wanted and you grabbed it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_14: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Hey! I agreed to give it to him as a reward! Really, it's the least I could do.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}Hehehe... Always a pleasure to see someone bein' played.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}You've got potential, David. You've got potential...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_14_INTRO_17: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:crazydave}I don't know what that was about, honest.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}I don't know what that talk yesterday was about, but don't even try to pull anything!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_3: {SAY:greedy}Me!? Poor little ol' me? Pullin' somethin'? Fuggetaboutit.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_4: {SAY:greedy}I was just pointin' out that Dave's got a bit of a businessman in 'im. Tha's all.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Look, fatso! I was pulled in here out of nowhere! I don't know where I am!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}I don't wanna be stuck here... and I wanted something to eat!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}Uh-huh. There's no need to play coy with me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}Look at 'er. She's desperate. Willin' to give anythin' up for your help. Same goes for the other Davids.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}Difference is: You saw how to monetize that. And that's alright.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}There's no shame in bein' a little greedy. That's how you get far in life... and unlife.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}...That's the problem with the outside world these days.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Like you said, why should this be your responsibility?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}I didn't do nuthin' to you this time.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_14: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}We know what will happen if you succeed...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}Is that what's holdin' all of 'em here? Vague threats? Your persuasion oughta do some work.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}Imma go enjoy some luxury right now. I own it, after all.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_17: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}Dave... My power is growing even weaker.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_18: {SAY:crazydave}Look, I think it's just the weather or something.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_15_INTRO_19: {TIRED:crazydave}I'll... take a bit of a look around.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I can't find him. Luckily, I have some stored up sun. There's quite a lot, actually.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_6: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Oh, once I get my hands on you...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}What? I thought you like responsible ownership.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}Here, lemme enforce it. Usin' a card! You won't be able to spend a dime!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_9: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}He is using Offerings to a Sacred Mountain.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_10: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Looks like he plans to use it to claim some sun for himself
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}...which will limit how much you can use.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_16_INTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Be careful with your sun, Dave's Neighbor.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Chimata, I decided to go ahead and get this lawn set up early!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_3: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}That's splendid! But why weren't you doing this before?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_7: {SAY:greedy}He doesn't wanna be helpin' ya, toots! You kidnapped 'im!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}Don't you get the idea by now!?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_9: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I... needed help... for the sake of humanity.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Right... right. Come on, don't start cryin' on me now. Girls these days...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_11: {SAY:greedy}Y'know David, without yo' car around, there's nobody who can tell you what to do.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}You're free to do anythin' you want ova' here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_13: {SAY:greedy}Listenin' to this lass? Please! She ain't even from around where we are!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_14: {SAY:greedy}You don't have to defend this market, it ain't yours anyways.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_15: {SAY:greedy}In fact, I can make it be yours. You can get a lot more than just a sandwich outta this...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_16: {SAY:greedy}I can make lotsa things be yours.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}But... no! You already tried to make a deal with me once!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_18: {SAY:greedy}Yeah, and that stupid car got in the way! You don't have to listen to 'er here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_19: {SAY:greedy}Seein' your little stunt earlier... You're your own man once you're off the chain. I've looked up your history...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_20: {SAY:greedy}Makin' deals. Sellin' things out of your car. Heh. A marketplace is the ideal location for you, ain't it?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}If I make any deal with you, you're just going to come back and steal everything!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_22: {SAY:greedy}Oh no. I've got more than what I need ova' here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_24: {SAY:greedy}I guarantee you, I'll make you an offer you can't refuse.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_26: {SAY:greedy}Tell me, you traveled all those worlds to get yourself a taco... One you never even ended up eatin'.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_27: {SAY:greedy}Just some sub-par replacement Zomboss cooked up to keep ya' occupied.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_29: {SAY:greedy}...I can get you that taco you've so been desiring.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_33: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}Dave, don't be persuaded by his blackhearted offerings!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_34: {SAY:greedy}It's a fair deal at the market place.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_17_INTRO_35: {SAY:greedy}As for you... I'm using a card to harness the ability of an underground sun!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The faith in me is deteriorating... Dave is nowhere to be found...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_3: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Was he really so greedy to the point he pursued a taco for worlds on end...?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Well, I guess everyone has their desires... It couldn't have been that bad, right?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_5: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I am hoping that by using the power of these colorful plants...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I can remind everyone of who I am and gain some of my faith back.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Including Dave's own faith in himself. I know how that feels...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_10: {ANGRY:tenkyuchimata}You just don't know when to stop, do you? You're despicable.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And you're a manchild on top of that.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_12: {SAY:greedy}Now, I thought you were above name calling, oh-goddess of ownership!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_14: {SAY:greedy}And guess what! David is actually considering my offer! Haha!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_18_INTRO_16: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}There's still faith. I can sense it.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_5: {SAY:greedy}Oh, he reached me personally! He REALLY wanted that taco.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}I'm sorry... I've been chasing it for so long.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}And with Greed Guy's card powers, he can make it real again.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Ha... I knew he couldn't be that bad.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}You mean the cards I stole from you?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}I'm not like you! That taco might've been an unfulfilled desire, but I've moved on!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_17: {SAY:crazydave}I travel with Penny now! I don't need some kind of "reward" anymore!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:crazydave}That journey is what it's really about!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_19: {TIRED:crazydave}I lost sight of that. I'm sorry, Chimata.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_20: {SAY:crazydave}I shouldn't have asked you for anything. That's not why I fight zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_21: {EXCITED:crazydave}You need protection from zombies, and Crazy Dave's the man to call!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_25: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I knew you could do it, Dave. I could tell you still held faith.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_26: {SAY:greedy}Hahaha! Fine, then! I'll just level you with the pavement!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_27: {SAY:greedy}You might have taken my core stash, but I've still got backups!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_28: {SAY:greedy}And there's one card you didn't know I had on me! My ace in the hole!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_30: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}That card? I didn't even know it was still around!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_32: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}It was made with the help of Kappa, it was related to a different incident.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_33: {SAY:greedy}If I can't have any riches, nobody can!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_35: {NPC_EXIT:greedy}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}The good news is, the display of plants from last night has garnered me some faith back.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_36: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}If we can live through tonight and tomorrow, I should be able to do something about all this!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_19_INTRO_37: {SAY:crazydave}Our plant costs seem to be all wonky, but I am sure we can handle it!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_2: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}You're gonna have to do more than use my own cards against us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}We're onto you, Greed Guy! Me and the other Daves!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_4: {SAY:greedy}Seems like I oughta take some drastic measures.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_6: {SAY:greedy}Why, when I had lotsa money I made some wise investments.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_8: {SAY:greedy}What's a rich fella like me without some body guards??
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_INTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Equipped to protect and destroy! My Klepto-matons!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:greedy}{SAY:greedy}Oh boy... That uuuh. That sure didn't go how I expected.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:tenkyuchimata}{SAY:tenkyuchimata}You're done. But for me, it's only the beginning.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, look at that, a sandwich! But I said I didn't want one!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_4: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A deal's a deal. You've more than proven yourself, Crazy Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_6: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}I've even personally decorated it to reflect the dimension you came from!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_7: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}A reminder of this special occasion! As stressful as it was.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_9: {SAY:greedy}Now then... Gulp... I know you know that stuff about me takin' ova' the market was just a big joke.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_10: {SAY:greedy}Heh-heh. A simple jest of mine. All in good fun.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_11: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Greedy... Oh Greedy. You're going to stay here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_12: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}And by the time I am done with your punishment...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_13: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The residents of this world will believe you to be a god of generosity!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_16: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}What did I tell you about crossing a god?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_17: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}Ahem... Daves, neighbors, you're free to go!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_MARKET_20_OUTRO_18: {SAY:tenkyuchimata}The gaps back to your dimensions are opening now. Thank you for your help!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_HOLLOWS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Hi neighbor! Welcome to Absolute Zero Plateau!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_HOLLOWS_2: {SAY:crazydave}Where the zeros aren't normal and boring... they're absolute!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_SKYCITY_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Hi neighbor! Welcome to Dead Zone Sector!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_SKYCITY_2: {SAY:crazydave}It's like a regular sector, but you can't get any reception!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_TRAVELLOG_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Hi neighbor! Welcome to Nature Trail of Peril!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_TRAVELLOG_2: {SAY:crazydave}It's just like trail mix, there's a little bit of everything!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_TRAVELLOG_3: {SAY:crazydave}Except this time, the trail mix wants to eat you instead!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_TRAVELLOG_MA: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Hi neighbor! Welcome to Disconnected Trade Center!
{SAY:crazydave}Spend responsibly and don't get trampled by those hungry customers!
NARRATIVE_DANGER_ROOM_INTRO_FAIRYTALE_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Hi neighbor! Welcome to The Neverending Story!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Error. This location matches none logged in my database.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}The last thing I remember was you opening a book... and then we're suddenly here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_1_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:winnie}It seems that upon opening that book, all of us were transported to this location.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_1_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:winnie}I suggest we hold onto this book for now, so I'm able to scan its properties.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_1_INTRO_1: {SAY:winnie}I also regret to inform you that we aren't alone in this place.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Wait, I can smell it! There are zombies in here!
{SAY:crazydave}And what are those things on the lawn? Poker cards?
{EXCITED:winnie}I'm detecting strange magical properties in these cards.
{SAY:winnie}Whether they'd be beneficial to us or not, we can only speculate.
{SAY:winnie}Let's focus on building our defenses for now.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Good thing I still stocked up some plant seeds!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SHOUT:crazydave}Nope! Nuh-uh! Big no on those cards being beneficial to us!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Perhaps that isn't all there is to it, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}As you might have noticed, another magical object has appeared on the lawn today.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}They have little vines growing around them...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}So it would seem. The local foliage has overtaken these mirrors.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:winnie}That means, they will be strictly beneficial to us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}They contain magical energy that can reflect magic card projectiles.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}We can use this to our advantage to reflect card projectiles back at zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_2_INTRO_1: {EXCITED:crazydave}A magical shield! Right back at you, zombies!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I gotta say, even if this is supposed to be precarious, I'm having fun!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}This place reminds me so much of the story Mama Dave used to tell before bed!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}A knight on a quest in a magical forest, triumphing over the evil zombie army!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}It seems that this forest contains not only zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:winnie}It attacks zombies by launching its hat, which will then ricochet off to other obstacles.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Where did he come from? Same way as us?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}That I can't be sure of. I'm still conducting scans on the nature of this "magic book."
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Is there anything about it that you can recall?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_3_INTRO_1: {SAY:crazydave}Hmmm... no. Not really. All I remember is that a zombie dropped it.
{SAY:crazydave}Bah! Let's just table this boring talk for later!
{EXCITED:crazydave}This little guy must be eager to throw its hat into the ring!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}You can be a squire to the Great Knight! Let's march ahead!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}I'm forecasting a certain type of mist will be enshrouding this area in a moment.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}It seems to affect plants and zombies in different ways.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}When shrouded by fog, zombies will receive boosts.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Our plants, meanwhile, will be cast into a deep slumber.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, you can't sleep on the job! Mushrooms don't even do that anymore!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I'm also sensing another additional presence amidst this mist.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}It seems to be a significantly powerful zombie.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_4_INTRO_1: {EXCITED:crazydave}Worry not, Penny! The Great Knight Dave is here to save the day!
{EXCITED:crazydave}When they appear, it'll be our time to heroically strike them down!
{TIRED:winnie}Let's avoid fights if we can help it. Our top priority is to escape.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, come on! Indulge in a little fun, won't you, Penny?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}I'm seeing a new challenger on the horizon! The cavalry's here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_2: {TIRED:winnie}Yes, an enemy knight... riding on a unicorn.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_3: {TIRED:winnie}This is slowly becoming more and more ridiculous.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Silly knight! You know only those with pure hearts can ride a unicorn!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Just watch, that unicorn is gonna throw him off the first chance it gets!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps it is a good time to utilize our new ally.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Spring Princess lobs springs onto tiles in front of her, even in adjacent lanes.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}These springs will then stay on the tile, knocking zombies back before expiring.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}Another addition to the Great Knight's troupe!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_5_INTRO_1: {TIRED:winnie}Could this cavalry have been sent by their leader as reinforcement?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a new set of cards bearing the diamond suit.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_2: {TIRED:crazydave}That cavalry from last time had a diamond mark...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Correct. Cards can only be activated by zombies bearing the same suit.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Special zombies belong to different, unique suits.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Different cards have different effects as well.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}This also applies to their reflected effects. So keep all that in mind.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Sheesh, there's so much to keep track of! Cards, mirrors, fogs...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}Hmmm... I don't know why, but the fog here looks more like smoke!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_9: {TIRED:crazydave}That... and the mirrors... it's giving me a certain image...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_1: {SAY:winnie}I see you managed to make the connection eventually, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}I was about to proclaim that these zombies' mysterious leader is none other than-
{NPC_ENTER:nanny}{SAY:crazydave}The Granny! I should've realized sooner! She's the one who trapped us here!
{SAY:crazydave}Huh? Didn't you send one of your imps to hand us that evil magic book?
{SPECIAL1:nanny}Of @#$%! course. Of course it's a MAGICAL book!
{SAY:nanny}I should've known Zomboss wouldn't tell me to just safeguard some random books.
{TIRED:nanny}An imp must've stolen one of them from my study after Zomboss gave them to me.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_2: {TIRED:nanny}All I remember was opening that stupid book, then waking up here!
{SAY:winnie}So you share our predicament. Then, I propose a truce.
{SAY:winnie}Let's put aside our differences and work together to find an exit out of this forest.
{PLAYFUL:nanny}Thinking about it, I actually don't mind it here...
{SAY:nanny}It's quiet. Quieter than the imp orphanages I have to look after, anyway.
{PLAYFUL:nanny}And heaven knows, I'm overdue for a break from Zomboss and his imps, aren't I?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_6_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}We don't know the nature of this forest. The sooner we leave, the better it'd be.
{TIRED:nanny}How would you know? It's just the usual plants and zombies! Who gives a hoot?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Let's just have some fun for now! Look, all our plants are having fun too!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}My sensors are picking up a faint trace of mischief in the air.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:nanny}{SPECIAL1:nanny}Imps! @#$%^! Imps! That's what's causing this... hootenany!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:nanny}I was finally beginning to relax, imagining myself away from little runts...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:nanny}This... thing! It manifested! What is it? Is it a cat? An imp?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:nanny}When I tried to get a closer look, it vanished!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:nanny}Oh, it's still there alright, I can hear it cackling! It somehow turned invisible!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_9: {SPECIAL1:nanny}Suddenly, the little @#$%^ reappeared and shoved my head into a tree!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_7_INTRO_1: {SAY:nanny}Even in this here la-la-land... I can't get these brats under control!
{TIRED:nanny}I wish they would just listen to me for once!
{NPC_EXIT:nanny}{TIRED:winnie}So we are facing an imp that can appear and disappear at will...
{SAY:crazydave}Oh no! Will our plants be able to see it?
{EXCITED:winnie}Perhaps our new companion, Ent, can be of help.
{SAY:winnie}He's a wall that attacks zombies in a range in front of it.
{SAY:winnie}He will also heal himself periodically anytime he's not being attacked by zombies.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}Try as hard as I may, I still haven't been able to crack this magic book.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Maybe you should focus more on what's in front of you, Penny!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, deciphering this mystery is our key to return home-
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_4: {TIRED:crazydave}No, I mean that literally! Look in front of you! What are those things?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_6: {TIRED:winnie}Apologies. I was so fixated on the book that I hadn't noticed these...
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}It looks like there's some type of potion in here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}Hey, neighbor! Why don't you try putting plant food in these potions?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_8_INTRO_1: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Who knows? Maybe something good will happen!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}So, to recap, The Nanny had gotten her hands on a collection of magical books.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}We've gotten our own hands on one of these books, courtesy of a slight-handed imp.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}After that, you opened the book, and we ended up here.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Negative. Scans suggest that The Nanny arrived here before us.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}Wait, so she fell into the book first?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Falling into a book... is that what happened?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:crazydave}Are we inside a magic book? Are we living a fairytale?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_9: {TIRED:winnie}Somehow, I feel like there's more to it than that.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_9_INTRO_1: {PLAYFUL:nanny}Tell you what, this place does remind me of the bedtime stories ma used to tell me.
{SAY:nanny}Stupid little tales where everyone's happy all the time. Gross.
{PLAYFUL:nanny}As if life could ever be that simple.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}But wouldn't it be fun if life was always simple like this?
{PLAYFUL:nanny}Heh. I suppose for idiots like you, having fun is all there is to life, huh?
{TIRED:winnie}I still don't get it. What does this all mean?
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_10_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SHOUT:crazydave}Is that a Gargantuar in a suit of armor!?
{EXCITED:winnie}This gargantuar also seems to be carrying an imp of nobility.
{SAY:winnie}When defeated, he will drop his queen imp, which will proceed to flee from the lawn.
{SAY:winnie}She needs to be defeated quickly, or else she will summon a cavalry into battle.
{EXCITED:crazydave}This is crazy! I've never faced a gargantuar in armor!
{NPC_ENTER:nanny}{EXCITED:nanny}Haaah... Haha. Crazy, you say? I completely agree.
{EXCITED:winnie}Are you behind this? How did you manage it?
{SAY:winnie}You couldn't even control an imp a couple days ago.
{SAY:winnie}And now you're controlling an army of gargantuars?
{PLAYFUL:nanny}Heh, who knows? I just thought it'd be nice for these idiots to listen to me for once.
{PLAYFUL:nanny}And just like that, they suddenly do.
{EXCITED:nanny}It's like everything I wanted to happen in this place, happens.
{EXCITED:nanny}Some of them have even begun calling me their queen!
{PLAYFUL:nanny}Now, why don't you give your queen some entertainment?
{EXCITED:nanny}Squash these three and their puny plants!
{NPC_EXIT:nanny}{EXCITED:crazydave}Oh no, you don't! No one shall beat the Great Knight Dave and his troupe!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Come on, neighbor! Let's gather our own army!
{NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}"Everything I wanted to happen in this place... happens...?"
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_11_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}I think I have a theory, User Dave. Would you be willing to listen?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Can't it wait, Penny? Me and the plants were about to go on another quest!
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, please. This is a matter of utmost urgency.
{TIRED:crazydave}Alright, fine.
{SAY:winnie}Everything in this place seems to link back to The Nanny.
{SAY:winnie}When she first imagined an imp, one magically materialized.
{SAY:winnie}She wished imps would listen to her, and they abruptly called her a queen.
{SAY:winnie}And remember what she said about this place when we talked about fairytales?
{TIRED:crazydave}That it's stupid?
{SAY:winnie}That it reminds her of her mother's fairytales.
{SAY:winnie}I believe this place was created based on the machinations of her mind.
{SAY:winnie}Since she fell first, the book was responding to her thoughts and created this realm.
{TIRED:crazydave}She dreamed of a fairytale world, and the book granted it?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Why would a cruel person like her want to live in a fairytale?
{NPC_ENTER:nanny}{PLAYFUL:nanny}So, is that how it is?
{EXCITED:nanny}This world was shaped from the machination of my mind... haha!
{PLAYFUL:nanny}How absurd!
{SAY:crazydave}See, she agrees with me!
{SHOUT:nanny}I'm agreeing with your car, you nitwit.
{TIRED:crazydave}Huh!? So you really did wish for a world like this?
{TIRED:nanny}Huh, maybe I have been. This whole time...
{EXCITED:nanny}To live in a world without nuisances, that is a dream come true!
{SAY:nanny}A world where people listen to me...
{SAY:nanny}A world with no pesky crying imps... no loathsome... despicable bosses!
{EXCITED:nanny}This must be what living on Easy Street feels like... ha. Cough. Haha!
{NPC_EXIT:nanny}{EXCITED:crazydave}She's crazy! And that's coming from me!
{SAY:winnie}Her mania doesn't stop there. She has sent in another assault.
{SAY:crazydave}Welp, looks like we have to pause that quest, friends!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Not to worry! The Great Knight Dave is here to stop the queen's madness!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_12_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Another massive wave of zombies is coming, User Dave.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}She really meant it when she said these guys listen to her like a queen, huh?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Not that I'd mind, though! More bad guys for The Great Knight to slay!
{SAY:winnie}I'm also detecting a strong opponent approaching our location.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Is the granny herself coming to challenge us?
{SAY:winnie}This strong aura I'm detecting isn't emanating from her.
{SAY:crazydave}An imp? How strong could an imp be?
{SHOUT:nanny}Whatever you do, DO NOT harm that imp!
{TIRED:crazydave}Since when have you cared for imps?
{SHOUT:nanny}No... NO! I won't let you harm her!
{SAY:winnie}Let's disregard this perplexing behaviour for now.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_12_OUTRO_: {TIRED:nannyboss}I'm not going to let you end like this.
{SAY:nannyboss}I'm not going to let this dream end like this.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_13_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Brrr! That was one creepy imp!
{SAY:winnie}Actually, it might not have been an imp at all.
{EXCITED:winnie}My scanner doesn't recognize it as such. It's a being of magic.
{EXCITED:winnie}The same magic that prevails in the air of this mysterious realm.
{SAY:crazydave}But then... why does it look like an imp?
{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{EXCITED:queennanny}You... look what you did! After I told you NOT to harm her!
{TIRED:crazydave}...Huh?
{SPECIAL1:queennanny}Are you as dumb as a @#$%! imp, unable to comprehend basic instructions!?
{TIRED:winnie}I feel like we have to address the elephant in the room.
{SAY:crazydave}What's with the get-up?
{SAY:queennanny}That "imp"... she's the embodiment of the book's power. That's what she told me.
{SAY:queennanny}The power to manifest someone's true desire. The power to manifest...
{SAY:queennanny}"...the shadow... the true self."
{EXCITED:queennanny}To be powerful, to be respected! This is a dream most wonderful!
{EXCITED:queennanny}But then you went ahead and almost destroyed her!
{SAY:queennanny}I'm not gonna have this dream end! I tethered her existence to my body...
{EXCITED:queennanny}Now, I have ensured that this is a dream none of us will ever wake up from!
{TIRED:crazydave}You mean, we're trapped here?! Forever!?
{EXCITED:queennanny}And for your penance, I sentence you and your plants to eternal slumber!
{SAY:queennanny}My court of Mirror Queens will see to it!
{NPC_EXIT:queennanny}{TIRED:crazydave}Mirror queens...? What're they gonna do to us?
{SAY:winnie}We've faced them before. They were present during our battle with the imp.
{EXCITED:winnie}They're able to control and disable our mirrors with ease.
{SAY:winnie}They also carry poisonous treats able to put plants into slumber.
{SAY:crazydave}T-This is really bad!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_14_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}So, what are we gonna do, Penny? How are we gonna-
{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, please, calm yourself.
{SAY:crazydave}But she said we're trapped in here forever! How are we going to-
{SAY:winnie}We will find a way to leave this place, User Dave. Rest assured.
{TIRED:crazydave}I should've listened to you when you told us to escape.
{TIRED:crazydave}But I just went out to goof off... and now she trapped us in here!
{TIRED:winnie}Well, this is quite a... distracting place, I can't exactly fault you.
{SAY:winnie}Nevertheless, now that you've calmed down, I must inform you of a new arrival.
{EXCITED:winnie}The zombies are in the presence of a big, bad wolf.
{EXCITED:winnie}He carries with him three buildings, each carrying a trapped little imp... pig.
{SAY:crazydave}Say, Penny, that's what I don't get. The Nanny hates imps, doesn't she?
{TIRED:crazydave}Why would her dream of an ideal world be littered with them?
{SAY:winnie}Think of this book's power like a mirror, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}This place reflects The Nanny's distorted perception of the world.
{TIRED:crazydave}How does this explain the imps?
{SAY:winnie}Well, imps are carefree spirits. They go about their days without worries.
{SAY:winnie}I suppose deep down, that's what The Nanny yearns most for.
{SAY:winnie}That's why this place is littered with imps.
{SAY:winnie}That's why the manifestation of her desire takes the form of an imp.
{TIRED:crazydave}Oh... so that must also be why she hates imps so much, huh?
{PLAYFUL:winnie}She's envious. And bitter.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_15_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, we have secured another plant. It's-
{EXCITED:crazydave}It's Coffee Bean! I know this guy!
{SAY:winnie}Then I suppose you're already aware of his properties to wake plants up.
{SAY:winnie}I'll have to add, however, he can now also speed up plants in a surrounding area.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I thought he retired! How did he get in here of all places?
{TIRED:winnie}He certainly didn't come in with us...
{SAY:winnie}Yet, since he's an old plant friend of yours, there's no way he originated in this place.
{TIRED:winnie}Come to think of it, did the plants we found so far even originate from here...?
{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{EXCITED:queennanny}What is this!? A plant that can wake someone from a dream!?
{EXCITED:queennanny}I will not have such blasphemy in my kingdom!
{SAY:crazydave}Just let us out already if you don't want us in your dream!
{EXCITED:queennanny}And have you call for reinforcements to destroy my dreams from the outside!?
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}Keep dreaming! HA-HA-HA-HA! Oh, you see what I did there?
{EXCITED:winnie}Your paranoia and mania has blinded you to reason.
{EXCITED:winnie}This realm of dreams is nothing but an illusion. Nothing here is reality.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Yeah, and we're going to keep resisting you until we're out of here!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_16_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{SHOUT:queennanny}Your continued resistance to my dreams has tainted it so!
{TIRED:queennanny}So much that I've begun recollecting the absolute misery that awaits me in the "real" world...
{TIRED:queennanny}Zomboss, and all the suffering he puts me through...
{SPECIAL1:queennanny}Those @#$%^, nasty little demonic imps of his...
{EXCITED:queennanny}...and her. That no-good, backstabbing wicked witch!
{SAY:winnie}We are, indeed, in the presence of a witch today.
{EXCITED:winnie}She is able to transform our plants into frogs, which will then progressively hop forward.
{TIRED:queennanny}Hmph... these sickening thoughts... It must've given birth to these witches.
{SAY:queennanny}No matter! Under my command, they will for once be someone else's nuisance!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_17_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{PLAYFUL:queennanny}To think the lullabies of my sainted mother would manifest itself into reality...
{EXCITED:queennanny}Oh, mother dear. I've followed your sweet advice!
{EXCITED:queennanny}Now, I'm living it up on Easy Street!
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}Can you hear me, mother? I know you're...
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}...down there. Listening.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Down?
{SAY:winnie}Again, this place is nothing but an illusion conjured by that magic book.
{SAY:queennanny}Tsk. Why are you so insistent on resisting this!?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Because we're trapped here! Against our will!
{EXCITED:queennanny}Trapped? This is salvation! You oughta thank me!
{SAY:crazydave}How is this salvation!?
{EXCITED:queennanny}This is a world without problems, where every issue can have a simple resolution!
{SAY:queennanny}Such is the nature of fairytales. Any outcome would result in a happy ending.
{SAY:queennanny}Besides, deep down, I know that you'd enjoy something like this.
{SAY:crazydave}Me? No way...!
{EXCITED:queennanny}Don't even think to lie! You think I haven't noticed?
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}You were running around the meadows with your stupid plants!
{EXCITED:queennanny}Frolicking without a care in the world, playing the imaginary "Great Knight!"
{EXCITED:crazydave}That was before I realized I could never go back to reality!
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}Ah. But if this is your reality, then you wouldn't have such worries, would you?
{SAY:queennanny}You just get to exist in this simple, happy place for the rest of your days!
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}Admit it. Doesn't that sound enticing?
{TIRED:crazydave}W-Well, I-
{SAY:queennanny}Still resisting? Perhaps you're finally living up to the name...
{EXCITED:queennanny}Crazy! Mad! Deluded! To the point of denying salvation!
{NPC_EXIT:queennanny}{SAY:winnie}Do not listen to her, User Dave, neighbor. It is merely nothing but drivel.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_18_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have found ourselves another new ally, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}Haze-shroom attacks zombies with her spore clouds.
{SAY:winnie}These clouds steal magic such as zombie buffs.
{SAY:winnie}She also cures plant debuffs within limited range, including animal transformations.
{SAY:winnie}The more she steals magic, the stronger her attack gets.
{TIRED:crazydave}Huh. Where did you find her, Penny?
{TIRED:winnie}You know, User Dave. We initially thought these plants all originate here.
{SAY:winnie}But with the appearance of Coffee Bean, we know that can't be the case.
{TIRED:crazydave}Does that mean they came from the outside?
{SAY:winnie}This is speculation, but... The Nanny fusing herself with the core of this book's magic...
{TIRED:winnie}...perhaps it has strengthened the pull of this realm.
{SAY:winnie}Things from our reality began to get pulled into this dream, even without a book.
{TIRED:winnie}The line between reality and dream is getting blurred. If this continues...
{TIRED:winnie}There wouldn't be any distinction. The two worlds will merge.
{TIRED:crazydave}I... don't know how to feel about that.
{SAY:winnie}It will be catastrophic. Imagine the chaos it would unravel. We can't let it happen.
{SAY:winnie}Tomorrow, I will conduct more searches for any possible escape routes.
{SAY:winnie}You and the neighbor will have to hold down the fort in the meantime.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_19_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey neighbor. It's just gonna be the two of us today. And the plants.
{SAY:crazydave}I wonder if we could ever get out of here.
{TIRED:crazydave}...but maybe... even if we didn't, it wouldn't be so bad?
{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{PLAYFUL:queennanny}So. You've actually put some thought to what I have to say...
{EXCITED:crazydave}I'm only considering it as a worst case scenario!
{SPECIAL1:queennanny}Well then, I'm glad that @#$% car is out today. Makes things easier for me.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Don't talk about Penny like that!
{TIRED:queennanny}Oh, please. "Penny" is a machine. "It" is not like you and me.
{SAY:queennanny}It does not want. It does not need. It does not dream.
{EXCITED:queennanny}It doesn't understand the plight of people like us!
{SAY:crazydave}People like us?
{SAY:queennanny}Don't we desire the same thing?
{EXCITED:queennanny}To be as free-spirited as a child, unburdened by the cruelty of the world!
{TIRED:queennanny}The world is cruel. It takes, takes, takes. You know this.
{SAY:queennanny}In the past, you resorted to selling junk from the back of your car just to get by!
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}Aren't things better when you're just a kid, reading fairytales before bed?
{SAY:crazydave}...
{SAY:queennanny}But the world took that innocence from you, slowly, but surely.
{SAY:queennanny}Don't you hear it, the beckon of this forest? Do not resist it!
{EXCITED:crazydave}You're... you're mad! You're trying to get into my head! Penny warned me!
{SAY:queennanny}Oh... you're already there without my help, "Crazy" Dave.
{EXCITED:queennanny}Most everyone's mad here! You, especially...
{SAY:crazydave}I'm not mad! I'm-
{SAY:queennanny}I'm not talking to you! I'm talking to your little neighbor.
{SAY:crazydave}Huh? Them?
{SAY:queennanny}Why do you continue tagging along David in these asinine journeys?
{SAY:queennanny}To protect the world? What has the world done for you?
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}Heh.
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}We both know that's not true though, do we?
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}All this plants vs. zombies nonsense. It's just a game to you, isn't it?
{SAY:queennanny}A game where you can pretend to be a "hero," a "Great Knight."
{SAY:queennanny}An escape from the cruelties of the world!
{EXCITED:queennanny}Admit it, you're just as mad as the rest of us!
{SAY:queennanny}If you weren't, and the world's treating you well, wouldn't you be anywhere but here?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Stop talking to us like you know us!
{SAY:queennanny}You said it yourself, "wouldn't it be fun if life was always simple like this?"
{SAY:queennanny}It's the truth. Continue rejecting it, and you'll find only misery awaits you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_20_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{EXCITED:queennanny}Everyone dreams of a blissful life!
{SAY:queennanny}If you join me, I can make any of your dreams come true!
{TIRED:crazydave}Any dream?
{SAY:queennanny}Stop resisting. Be a kid again! As long as you steer off the cliff-
{SAY:queennanny}-you can spend the rest of your days blissfully running along the field of rye.
{TIRED:crazydave}I...
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}...what is going on?
{EXCITED:queennanny}Pay this machine no attention! Embrace your desire and join me!
{EXCITED:winnie}What!? User Dave, you can't seriously be considering this!
{SAY:winnie}We have to return to reality!
{EXCITED:queennanny}Living in a happy fairytale will absolve you from your misery!
{SAY:queennanny}We don't need reality anymore! Better have it be swallowed by dreams of fairytales...
{EXCITED:queennanny}Join me and let this dream expand! Absolve many others from suffering!
{EXCITED:queennanny}The choice of everyone's happiness is in your hand!
{SAY:winnie}Nobody should have authority over other's happiness-
{SPECIAL1:queennanny}Shut up, SHUT THE @#$% UP, YOU INCESSANT MACHINE!
{SHOUT:queennanny}You have no say in this matter!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Don't talk to her like that!
{SAY:queennanny}"Her?" I already told you! This machine...
{TIRED:crazydave}...is right. Is it really happiness if it's just an illusion and lies?
{SAY:queennanny}Why must you care for the frivolous details!?
{SAY:queennanny}Don't you want to be happy?
{SAY:crazydave}...
{TIRED:crazydave}I might've been happier in the past, but...
{TIRED:crazydave}Fighting zombies... with my plants, with my neighbor...
{TIRED:crazydave}...with Penny.
{SAY:crazydave}That is how I choose to be happy now. And that choice...
{TIRED:crazydave}...it's what I'm taking away from everyone if I let this dream continue!
{EXCITED:crazydave}I'm not joining you! ALL of us will escape this dream!
{SPECIAL2:queennanny}You... you moronic baboon! You @#$%^!, !@#$%^!
{SHOUT:queennanny}Why can't you understand!? It's a hard knock life out there!
{EXCITED:queennanny}There is no happiness waiting for you in reality!
{SAY:queennanny}So be it! If you won't be lulled to the embrace of a pleasant dream...
{SHOUT:queennanny}...then you shall cower beneath an UNRELENTING NIGHTMARE!
{SHOUT:queennanny}OFF WITH YOUR HEADS!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_21_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{SHOUT:queennanny}Why, why, WHY!?
{SHOUT:queennanny}Everyone else gets to live their happily ever after! So WHY?
{SHOUT:queennanny}Why can't you... why won't you just let me be happy?
{SAY:crazydave}We never said we want you to be unhappy!
{TIRED:crazydave}But we just can't be a kid reading fairytales forever.
{TIRED:crazydave}We have to grow up eventually.
{SAY:winnie}You have to look into the now, and the future.
{TIRED:queennanny}...look into the future...?
{SHOUT:queennanny}...I HAVE NO FUTURE! ZOMBOSS TOOK IT AWAY FROM ME!
{TIRED:queennanny}That's all he... that's all the world ever does. It takes, and it takes, and it takes-
{SHOUT:queennanny}Curse him! Curse his deplorable imps, endlessly tormenting me...
{SHOUT:queennanny}Curse you! Curse your camping van! Curse your complicit neighbor!
{SAY:queennanny}Curse these disgusting plants! And... and...
{TIRED:queennanny}Curse her, that wicked witch! She left me behind! She...
{TIRED:crazydave}Nanny...
{SAY:queennanny}Look into the future... hah. Haha. HA-HA-HA-HA!
{EXCITED:queennanny}So be it. This dream shall be THE FUTURE!
{EXCITED:queennanny}I will override our rotten world, our painful reality, with these fairytales...
{EXCITED:queennanny}...and I will eliminate everyone who has ever wronged me! Starting with you!
{SAY:queennanny}Yes... this is how things should be.
{TIRED:crazydave}Please don't do this...
{SHOUT:queennanny}The world is about to change! Your existence... WON'T BELONG THERE!
{SAY:queennanny}I thought I could just leave you be... but you're like a plague.
{SHOUT:queennanny}I'll have to get rid of ALL OF YOU!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_22_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I must warn you both. This dream is growing more unstable by the day.
{SAY:winnie}No doubt due to The Nanny's deteriorating mental state.
{SAY:winnie}Soon this dream will leak into reality.
{SAY:winnie}Once that happens, I don't know if it will be reversible.
{SAY:crazydave}Did you not find any exits yesterday? Are we just stuck here?
{SAY:winnie}Not necessarily. I believe there's still one way for us to leave this place.
{SAY:winnie}Remember, anything that The Nanny wants to happen in this place, happens.
{SAY:winnie}So, the only way for this dream to end, is for The Nanny herself to wish for it.
{TIRED:crazydave}But how? You saw her the other day! She was...
{SAY:crazydave}...
{TIRED:crazydave}...look, Penny. I know she's the enemy...
{TIRED:crazydave}But I just can't help feeling bad for her.
{TIRED:winnie}...
{TIRED:winnie}The Nanny... she's right. I am a machine. Only ever programmed to terminate zombies.
{TIRED:winnie}I do not know what it is to dream, or hope.
{SAY:crazydave}What? Penny, what are you talking about?
{TIRED:winnie}I never got anyone's fascination with this realm. I only ever see it as a cage.
{PLAYFUL:winnie}But... I think I'd like to. I want to know how it "feels" to be happy. To make you happy.
{SAY:winnie}So that you never end up like her.
{SAY:crazydave}Penny...
{PLAYFUL:winnie}But that's what I'm getting at. If a machine like me can have her "heart" changed...
{PLAYFUL:winnie}...who's to say we can't change The Nanny's too?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Penny... you were always more than a machine to me! You're my companion!
{EXCITED:crazydave}And you too, neighbor, and all our plants. We're a team!
{EXCITED:crazydave}We can do it! We can save the world!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}...and let's hope that we can change her heart too.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_22_OUTRO_: {SAY:queennannyboss}I have arranged for you to be able to see it personally.
{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}I even have a surprise lined up for you.
{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}Will it be good? Oh, don't worry sir.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_23_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Is this real...? Or is it just a figment of an ailing old mind?
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man...!? How are YOU here?
{SAY:zombossicon}Ah, you two are here as well, so she was right.
{SAY:winnie}Did The Nanny bring you in here?
{SAY:zombossicon}She did. She told me she had something she wanted to show me.
{SAY:zombossicon}I thought it was just gonna be another one of her mundane drivels...
