{SAY:zombossicon}But she told me she created a realm, using those books I gave her, too!
{TIRED:crazydave}How did you get your hands on those books?
{SAY:zombossicon}You think I've just been twiddling my thumbs when I'm not fighting you?
{SAY:zombossicon}No, I've been looking for more of them. The L.O.A.M parts!
{SAY:zombossicon}When I retrieved those books, I sensed that they contained magical power!
{SAY:zombossicon}But they weren't L.O.A.M parts. I've no use for it. That's why I discarded them.
{SAY:zombossicon}To think it was still capable of such a magnificent feat!
{SAY:zombossicon}Perhaps I shouldn't judge a book by its cover...
{SAY:zombossicon}Anyway, enough pleasantries! The Nanny still has something she wanted to show me...
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{TIRED:crazydave}Why would The Nanny bring him here!? Unless...
{NPC_ENTER:queennanny}{EXCITED:queennanny}When I said I'm going to eliminate those who've wronged me... I meant it!
{SAY:winnie}You mean to exterminate him by bringing him here?
{EXCITED:queennanny}That idiot is way too prideful and ignorant to ever consider I would betray him!
{SAY:queennanny}I only needed to lure him under lies and empty promises...
{EXCITED:queennanny}Just like he did to me once before!
{TIRED:crazydave}What are you planning with him?
{PLAYFUL:queennanny}Oh, do not worry. You three got front row seats for that.
{EXCITED:queennanny}HA-HA-HA-HA-HA!
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_23_OUTRO_: {SAY:queennannyboss}Yes sir, I can create anything I want here.
{SAY:zombossicon}For what purpose did you do this?
{SAY:queennannyboss}You've given me so much, I thought I'd repay you.
{SAY:zombossicon}Heh. I suppose that's true. Without me, you would've been nothing, wouldn't you?
{SAY:zombossicon}I shall take this beast for a test ride!
{SAY:zombossicon}My judgement never failed. I knew I saw who you truly are the day I hired you.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_24_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}Penny, I think this world is finally getting to me!
{TIRED:crazydave}I just saw something huge flying over us...
{SHOUT:crazydave}...and it had THREE HEADS!?
{SAY:winnie}That must be the bait The Nanny used to lure Zomboss in here.
{NPC_ENTER:queennannyboss}{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}Oh... him and his stupid little imps are so easy!
{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}Jingle some keys... give them a new toy, and they'll do anything you want!
{SAY:winnie}There's still time to stop your plans. I don't think you understand the ramifications.
{EXCITED:queennannyboss}Ramifications? I'm doing the world a favor, even when it never did me any!
{SAY:queennannyboss}I'm creating the perfect world. A fairytale without pain nor suffering.
{SAY:winnie}...shaped based on your selfish views of what the world should look like.
{SHOUT:queennannyboss}Shut up, SHUT UP!
{SHOUT:queennannyboss}Zomboss robbed me of my future, with his false charms and promises!
{EXCITED:queennannyboss}He's the evil wizard that needs to be usurped at this tale's end!
{SAY:queennannyboss}Ha... HA-HA-HA!
{SHOUT:queennannyboss}That's why... I shall rob him of his LIFE!
{TIRED:crazydave}Penny's right. This isn't even about creating a perfect world anymore, is it?
{SAY:queennannyboss}Pawns do not get to speak to the Queen.
{SAY:queennannyboss}This is a matter between The Wizard... and I.
{EXCITED:queennannyboss}Play your part, and KILL each other. Pave the way for me to Easy Street!
{SAY:queennannyboss}This is how it should be, yes. I can feel it in my grasp.
{SAY:queennannyboss}My new world... It will be...
{PLAYFUL:queennannyboss}Heaven...
{NPC_EXIT:queennannyboss}{SAY:winnie}I'm sensing tonight will be a relentless assault of the likes we've never seen.
{EXCITED:crazydave}We'll win this, Penny! We have to!
{PLAYFUL:winnie}Thank you, User Dave. Still...
{EXCITED:winnie}The Nanny is pulling out all the stops. So let's not hold back either.
NARRATIVE_EPIC_REALM_FAIRYTALE_25_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Greetings, David, puny plants, and assorted allies.
{SAY:zombossicon}I am the Wizard of this fairytale land, here to claim my throne!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man, you need to listen to us. This is a trap!
{SAY:winnie}A trap set by The Nanny to kill all of us.
{SAY:zombossicon}Kill me? She would never! She's my most loyal general!
{SAY:zombossicon}Do you know how taxing it is to be the general of the imp division?
{SAY:zombossicon}Her dedication shows her loyalty to me! She will never betray me!
{TIRED:crazydave}...Boss Man, you really know nothing about her, huh?
{SAY:zombossicon}Enough! The Nanny is loyal to me! And this Zombot she created for me is proof!

NARRATIVE_FAIRYTALE_TREASURE_2: {SAY:narrator}Alongside it is an old, worn out ID card for an employee of Z-Tech.
NARRATIVE_FAIRYTALE_TREASURE_3: {SAY:narrator}You can barely make out the smile of a woman in the fading photo.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woah, is this where air was invented?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}No, User Dave. What you are seeing is merely steam coming out of the machines powered by said vapor.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}Bleh, what scent did they put around here?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}It smells like burning coal. ...and you know me and coal go way back.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I used to hate him in high school!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}We appear to be in the midst of the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}It seems like zombies are hard at work here.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}What are those holes in the ground for?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}During the Industrial Revolution, manholes like these were used for easy access to different parts of the working environment.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}The zombies could utilize them to their advantage.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_1_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}We can put protective plants on top of these manholes such as Wall-nut.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woah, those backwards zombies are worse than I thought.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_2_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}They ate my burrito behind my back!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Luckily, it seems Cattail is making her grand return here.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Cattail can shoot spikey projectiles at zombies near her, back or front!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Due to being a feline, her sight range is quite larger than those of plants like Phat Beet.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_3_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Gentlemen Zombies use their umbrellas to hover over most plants and obstacles such as Spikeweed or Lava Tiles.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}They also have a considerable appetite for plants of the sun producing variety...
NARRATIVE_STEAM_3_INTRO_7: {TIRED:crazydave}Who even invented tea? How bored did they have to be?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_5_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Its strong bursts of wind can stun zombies.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}The further away from it the zombie is, the longer it'll be stunned for.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_5_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I used to stun people by blowing at them too.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_5_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Fanilla will undoubtedly thwart any aerial attempts of Gentlemen Zombies.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_5_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}It is difficult to utilize umbrellas during windy weather.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Seems like a new zombie is on the horizon.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_6_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Barrel Zombies use their barrels as armor, and once destroyed, they will try to rush for our brains.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_6_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Their incredibly bad breath also allows them to eat through defenses more efficiently.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_6_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I think I might have a mint.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Someone appears to have left blueprints on our lawn.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_10_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Blueprints? They invented the color blue too...
NARRATIVE_STEAM_10_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}These seem to contain important information that Zomboss could use to plot his revenge...
NARRATIVE_STEAM_10_INTRO_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Zombie info!? Unfortunately, I do not know how to read.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Good news. The papers have been left in such a way that their text is backwards.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_10_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}The zombies are too unintelligent to decipher such writings.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_10_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}But we must remain cautious of the zombies who can read it from the other side.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have good news and bad news.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Which do you prefer to hear first, User Dave?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}There is yet another zombie that has arrived from the factory.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Coal Miner Zombies can crush any plant using their carts.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}When defeated, they will spill all of the coal in adjacent lanes.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}It is advised to eliminate the burning coal fast, as it will deal damage to our plants.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}The coal also seems to have some impish inhabitants.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_11: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Say, what if we strike the zombie moving the cart instead of the cart itself?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}I fear the zombies pushing the cart may wear protective armor.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}I have detected a new plant, the Lily of Alchemy.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}It fires lobbed projectiles that have a chance to bypass armor!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_11_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yes! We will be able to clear those coal fiends in no time!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny! I've got an admission to make.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}This air era has gotten the better of me!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}While carrying our shovel and bags of plant food...
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_5: {TIRED:crazydave}...I accidentally tripped on a doggone pothole. It's all in the sewers now.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}I'm not going down there, it's dark and scary!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}I saw hundreds of imps last time I took a peek!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}I can confirm the sewers are infested with approximately 5000 imps daily.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_9: {TIRED:winnie}Very well, I will retrieve them after this zombie attack.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_14_INTRO_10: {TIRED:winnie}We will have to adapt to this inconvenience.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}After everything you've done to me, I'll make sure you pay your debt!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}The industrial revolution is a key turning point. My time to rebuild! Recoup!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}And once I do, your annoying brains shall be mechanized!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}But my revenge can be served even sooner...
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}And the man for the job? Foreman Gargantuar.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}He will fix you right up! And I'll watch while sipping delicious tea.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Now, all this evil monologuing is making me knackered!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm not ready to be a robot!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_OUTRO_LAUNCH_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}We have successfully defeated the Foreman Gargantuars!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_OUTRO_LAUNCH_2: {SAY:crazydave}That's what they get for enjoying tea so much!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_OUTRO_LAUNCH_3: {SAY:crazydave}And we got another one of those shiny travel doohickies!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_OUTRO_LAUNCH_4: {SAY:winnie}This key looks to be a skip forward in time.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_OUTRO_LAUNCH_5: {SAY:winnie}Analysis indicates that this key leads to a... circus?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_OUTRO_LAUNCH_6: {SAY:winnie}I'll need to run more analysis upon our arrival. This is most confusing.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_16_OUTRO_LAUNCH_7: {SAY:crazydave}Eugh, at least I don't have to deal with tea enthusiasts anymore!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Is it just me, or is it getting hot in here?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Correct. The surrounding air temperature is indeed rapidly increasing.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Incorrect. The smell's origin is that of coal.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Furnace Zombie is the most likely culprit.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Oh. Well, burning coal is something I can get behind.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}You might not get behind the other aspects, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Upon defeat, the furnace explodes in a 3x3 area.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}Having a furnace strapped to your back must be a hassle, though.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:winnie}Fire effects, for example, will do more damage.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_17_INTRO_14: {TIRED:winnie}On the other hand, ice effects will not be as effective.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_18_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Electrici-tea emits zaps of electrical energy to zombies nearby.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_18_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}When eaten, it releases a flurry of electrical discharge.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_18_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}It also possesses the unique property of being irresistible to Gentleman Zombies.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_19_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Cause that's exactly what these zombies are doing!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_19_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Pea-nut combines the attributes of Peashooter and Wall-nut.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_19_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:winnie}It is very effective when placed on the manholes.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_19_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}Speaking of peanuts, I heard there's new zombies that don't even need to be paid anything!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_19_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Strange Clockwork Zombie imitations are found upon scanning the workplace.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_19_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Odd automatronic replicas with no need for pay or food.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_21_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}We can list through some of the employees here...
NARRATIVE_STEAM_21_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}...and bring up something shady to fire them!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_21_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}This strategy will not work, as I'm detecting a new underpaid foe...
NARRATIVE_STEAM_21_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Inventor Zombie will use her aerodynamic machine to bypass defenses.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_21_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Her machine is extremely sturdy, meaning it will take a lot of punches.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_21_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:winnie}However, there is one considerable design flaw.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_21_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}It uses metallic parts to hold itself together.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_21_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:crazydave}No need to spell it out Penny!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_23_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Why do only zombies get to use gears and cogs!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_23_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Why can't plants get to use such scrumptious objects!?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_23_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:winnie}Our very own crafty Maypop Mechanic uses them to attack zombies.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_23_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}She can fire two gears at once, one big and one small.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_23_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}The small gear bounces off zombies up to five times.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_23_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}The big gear is launched backwards but eventually reverses direction, ending up going forwards.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_24_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my calculations have come back with results.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_24_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss's continuous presence in this location is illogical.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_24_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss has a pattern of selfish behavior and goal-based action taking.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_24_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}If his goal is to flee from us, hiring new factory workers is irrational.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_24_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Eh, boss man is just a weird fella.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_24_INTRO_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Maybe he enjoys the smell of burned coal.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_25_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Lotus Root fires water bubbles at close-by zombies.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_25_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}For maximum damage, zombies need to be very close.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_25_INTRO_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Reminds me of the paint shotgun I used to terrorize children with.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_26_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Be on a lookout for Repairimps, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_26_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}They are hired to repair any mechanical tool or automatronic.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_26_INTRO_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Oh, so they get their little tools out and they do their little jobs?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_26_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}To cut costs, they just carry repairing stations.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_26_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}It then continually repairs in a 3x3 area.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_29_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my scanners have picked up something noteworthy.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_29_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}The tunnels located below the yard are connected to a lot more than manholes.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_29_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Because Zomboss has been sending more and more zombies in them.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_29_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}They are not just coming out of manholes, they are exploring.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_29_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}What would they even find down there? It's the sewers!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_29_INTRO_8: {TIRED:crazydave}Unless they're looking for that quarter that I dropped in there unintentionally...
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Do you or do you not enjoy the presence of Penny, the camping van?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}For if you do, you support the mechanical inventions brought on by the sweat of labor.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}In turn, you should stop to consider:
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Which of those were developed before I arrived here?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}You must stop and admit, my endeavors often produce more good than harm!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_INTRO_10: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Is it true Penny, had Zomboss really caused the industrial revolution?
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}The data is too contradictory to consider, as is Zomboss's tendency to lie.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:winnie}Let's do something proven to work: banish Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I say, this was a stitch up!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_OUTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}You should have all boarded the pain train!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_OUTRO_3: {PLAYFUL:winnie}The train has arrived to beatdown station!
NARRATIVE_STEAM_32_OUTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Insufficient data to base a reply on.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_ZOMBIENOTE_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}Cross-analysis suggests that the memo is indeed of zombie origin.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_ZOMBIENOTE_3: {SAY:winnieicon}Tomorrow seems to be a big day for the factory.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, this indicates there's work to be done.
NARRATIVE_STEAM_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4: {TIRED:winnie}...and disproportionately short lunch breaks to accompany it.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}It appears we have stumbled on an early 20th century funfair.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}We have traveled to an era of financial instability. Perhaps that is the reason.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}In any case, Dr. Zomboss' signal stops here.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}Boss Man? In a place like this?
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}I can only trace his last recorded position.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}He spent some time here, but we may currently be here on our own.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Which could prove beneficial for the time being, as he may return.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:winnie}I recommend we stay here and try to uncover the reasoning behind Zomboss' visit.

NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_14: {SAY:crazydave}Couldn't he have picked a time when this carnival was active?
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_15: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}It looks more undead than the zombies!
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}Perhaps it still is active, in its own strange way.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}In fact, I'm detecting various magical objects on our lawn.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}It seems there are cards that can only be activated by planting on top of them.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_19: {SAY:crazydave}But what can we use to plant on them...
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_20: {EXCITED:crazydave}Found something! A poster with Potato Chips!
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}Nice find, User Dave. Potato Chips may help our cause.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_23: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, please refrain from eating our ammunition.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_24: {SAY:winnie}The low cost of these chips will prove useful here at night time.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_1_INTRO_25: {SAY:winnie}And they possess crunchy attributes that can help deal damage to zombies.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}This place gives me a bad feeling...
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}It seems we've already got guest appearances.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Carnie Twin Imps will split into two individual imps upon defeat.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_2_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's horrible! I've seen bacteria do that!
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}This might prove disadvantageous, especially with dangerous cards present.
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_2_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}I still don't understand the shtick with those cards!
NARRATIVE_CARNIVAL_2_INTRO_7: {TIRED:crazydave}They look like the type of stuff that I got my future read from!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}Combining the different parts was a joy!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}I even came across weapons I haven't used in a long time.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}And now, all I've got to do is make sure you cretins remain occupied!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}Enough time twisting energy is at my disposal to bury your puny attempt!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}I tried to warn you time and time again not to interfere.
NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}Look both ways before you cross me!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_OUTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}I have stalled you long enough for everything to come to fruition!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_OUTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}I am well aware of precisely what I am doing!
NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_OUTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}And you'll never take this away from me!

NARRATIVE_MODERN_50_OUTRO_25: {EXCITED:crazydave}Boss man, you won't get away with this!

NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}What!? It's Luck O' the Zombie time now!?
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I was running some calculations and the most probable cause for the time shifts is-
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, you've figured it out, haven't you?

NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}This is your final plan, boss man?
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}Yes! It's what I've always wanted! The best vacation possible!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}I'm using my fully developed time manipulation technology in order to always make it be a holiday!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}...and believe me I was reaching for some of these.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}You've managed to make a device that twists all time in relation to itself!?
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}Yes! Look, it's been a long-time passion project.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}Would've been easier had you not been intervening CONSTANTLY!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_14: {SAY:zombossicon}It all began when I had to pull the plug on Project Paradox...
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_15: {SAY:zombossicon}Dave over here required a taco to get off my back and allow me to clean things up!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_16: {SAY:zombossicon}But during that cleaning up, interesting results were made aware to me.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_18: {SAY:zombossicon}I don't care! I realized time could truly be manipulated on a grander scale than I ever attempted before!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_19: {SAY:zombossicon}LOTS of experiments later... and I got myself a time manipulating vehicle of my own!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_20: {SAY:zombossicon}Now I'm never going to let another day fall to monotony or dullness again!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_21: {SAY:zombossicon}And if you try and stop me, my zombies will march through your defenses vigorously using their holiday spirit!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_22: {SAY:zombossicon}Holiday spirit like the one Luck O' the Zombie enjoyers have!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_23: {SAY:zombossicon}You think they care about something like stun while being cheerful!? Hah!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_2_INTRO_24: {SAY:zombossicon}So I recommend you never... EVER bother me again!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, I have to admit that this is all a little bit freaky.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_3_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I've crunched the numbers and all of this points to disaster.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_3_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}We must alert Zomboss... but with zombies being more resistant to effects like stunning, we need a new approach!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe a new festive plant will join us?
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_3_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Good call, User Dave. We must contact Sap-fling.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Sap-fling can slow down crowds of zombies by creating sticky sap tiles!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}This should work against most cheerful zombies.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}If the previous fellas didn't care about stunning, I wonder what these don't care about...
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_4_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}I've had 20 messages in an hour from you, inconsiderate vehicle!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss, this technology of yours is highly unstable!!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_4_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}I predict that after about a month, the timeline will collapse!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_4_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}After that, the damage to the fabric of reality may be unrepairable!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}Oh reality this, reality that! All you know to do is complain!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}I have the perfect comeback to all your worries!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_4_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}Maybe you should get more in the holiday spirit yourselves and leave me alone on my vacation!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, it's the spooky month of the year!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_5_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}More and more zombies we've encountered in previous eras are getting invited to the seasonal party.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_5_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}It is imperative that we strike back with some seasonal allies of our own.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Ghost Pepper can aid us in trying to scare the zombies off.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Similarly to a real ghost, she floats in the air and spooks whoever comes near.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_5_INTRO_8: {SAY:crazydave}But zombies? Yeah, everyone ran screaming about those!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I suppose you've already made your minds up.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}A shame that you're too blind to see the raw potential my invention brings!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}You could have left me to tend to my vacation in peace! But pestering me seems to be the priority!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}Unbeknownst to you, I have planned for this outcome as well!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}I developed formulas that can make my troops go bezerk!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}And since it is the season to be jolly, I'm giving a zombie infused with them to you as a gift!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}...I did say I was reaching for some of these.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}Bah! You'll be crushed by the great hero Impfinity before you get to question my choices further!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I am detecting a large, boost formula powered imp.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Zomboss must have somehow created chemical compounds capable of increasing the strength of zombies.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}These were probably developed during Zomboss' research in previous eras.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, we must carefully consider our next move.

NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_6_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}This is getting wackier by the day.

NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_4: {TIRED:winnie}Zomboss, please, can we just talk about this?
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}I've worked too long and hard on this to have it spoiled by filthy plant users like yourselves!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}Do you think evil scheming doesn't tire a person? I've earned this holiday break!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_8: {TIRED:winnie}Earned or not, reality is at stake!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:zombossicon}To ensure you keep out of my way, I'm moving onto Phase 2 of my contingency plan!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}During the holidays, everyone wants to have a drink!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}And my plentiful and varied boost formulas are the perfect little ingredients to drop into them!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}To ensure the health of my troops, and to ensure your demise, I have reached out to ZCorp!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_14: {SAY:zombossicon}Truly the most competent zombie-run corporation! Which... admittedly is not saying much.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_15: {SAY:zombossicon}But with their help, I was able to mass produce my devious drinks to fit for any occasion!
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}With ZCorp's delivery system, I predict these drinks will be rapidly delivered onto our lawns.

NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}Scanning... Side effects of drinking include: slight health increase, and bad breath.
NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_7_INTRO_21: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe we should hit up the good ol' Almanac to see what ZCorp's other drinks are up to!

NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_12_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}Fighting all of my enhanced Zombots is in their future then...

NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_12_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Given that time is relative, I shall give you a reminder of what is now!

NARRATIVE_HOLIDAY_19_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}But your inconsiderate aggravation calls for a more "hands-on" approach.
