Any method to keep his opponents hot on their feet or on their toes, he knows it. He would've made it to the top of his class, had it been not for Has-hands-weed. There's still a bit of a grudge.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Flameweeds burn zombies that walk over them and unlike other weeds, can attack flying zombies.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_PLANTFOOD: Scorches two tiles to the left and right of himself, dealing massive damage.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_TOOLTIP: Damages and ashes zombies that step on it
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms the plant he's planted on
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can still be frozen

{FLAVOR}Has considered other fire related works before; cooking, romantic lighting, babysitting, you name it. None of those jobs lasted more than a day, and they just don't suit him. Also they don't provide good health insurance.
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pyre Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide minor protection from cold plus an additional close range explosive attack.
PYREVINE_PLANTFOOD: Throws a line of flame down five tiles, damaging all zombies in it.
PYREVINE_TOOLTIP: Warms a plant inside and shoots at nearby zombies
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, explodes on contact

{FLAVOR}Potato Chip insists that it's important to go along with where life takes you. A bag, a tube, some kind of other thing? It's all life. "March on and keep a happy face," it says. Potato Chip, however, is not familiar with the terrifying concept of "crunch."
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Potato Chip crumbles upon contact, creating a small explosion that deals little damage.
POTATOCHIP_TOOLTIP: Explodes on contact, doing chip damage to a small area
CARAMELPOPCORN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}kernels deal splash damage on a single tile and slow zombies on impact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bags of popcorn deal splash damage and slow zombies in an area around them

{FLAVOR}"Me and Kernel-pult? We're on good terms," she answers. "I fling caramel and he flings butter, but we both look for the same results, work towards the same goal. I'm tired of people trying to create fake drama, who said that you can't mix sweet with salty?"
CARAMELPOPCORN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Caramel Popcorn lobs zombie-slowing caramelized corn kernels and bags of popcorn.
CARAMELPOPCORN_TOOLTIP: Flings caramelized corn kernels and popcorn bags at zombies
LOTUSPOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}changes its attack depending if it's planted on land or water

{FLAVOR}Lotus Pod came from an exotic, far-away land to showcase his expert amphibious techniques to the rest of the world. As it turns out, the only jobs he could get were all water related. 5 years of perfecting uprooting techniques down the drain...
LOTUSPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lotus Pod shoots out seeds when on land, and fires explosive torpedos across its lane when in water.
LOTUSPOD_TOOLTIP: Lobs seeds when on land, launches explosive torpedos when in water
ACIDLEMON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}has a chance to throw his lemon slice, knocking the target back a short distance{STAT}

{FLAVOR}After the rock incident, Dave keeps owing him more and more. Acid Lemon is fine with anything at this point: share an ice-cream cone, pay for a bus ticket or heck, just a regular verbal apology. So far he's received a frozen Conehead Zombie, a ride to a zombie-infested dead end and wouldn't you know it, another hit on the head with a rock! He closes his interview with "Genies are real, and they're amongst us."
ACIDLEMON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Acid Lemon shoots corrosive juice that deals extra sour damage to metals and armor. Has a chance to throw a lemon slice for even more damage and a brief knockback.
ACIDLEMON_TOOLTIP: Deals extra damage to metallic or bulky armor and zombies
ASPARAGUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Often confused for his old army captain, Aceparagus has a hard time carving out his own identity. It's hard living in someone else's shadow, almost like this entire aerial assault is a shadow of something urban from a different reality. No, that can't be.
ASPARAGUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Aceparagus deals burst damage in his surrounding rows, needing to reload after using up his ammo.
ASPARAGUS_TOOLTIP: Attacks zombies in front and adjacent lanes
PINEAPPLE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}when attacked will get fat
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Coming from a proud lineage of defensive pineapples, Puffapple worries about the pressure of not being able to live up to his Father's expectations when it comes to taking his place this high in the sky. He's a nervous eater, and with not much to eat here he's found himself chewing on the bullets of which are available in excess. But none of that stuff can be good for his health, and outside of hurting when crunching on their rough shells, he also worries about becoming fat as an aftermath. He's a bit of an eccentric plant, but very dependable when it comes to getting the job done.
PINEAPPLE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Puffapple can stop zombies from advancing and can deflect projectiles by puffing up.
PINEAPPLE_TOOLTIP: A flying wall that deflects ranged zombie attacks
SAUCER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}instantly abducts imps and shrunken zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}After the recent appearance of Saucer Squash, the ZIA continues to maintain its stance that there is no such thing as alien plant life, and that the Saucer Squash must be some kind of drone plot by rogue ants. While many zombies are still convinced by this coverup, the sights many Cowboy and Harvest Zombies see at night paint a truly horrifying story. Too bad that's never getting into Miss Information's news cast.
SAUCER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Saucer Squash stuns zombies in her beam, able to abduct low-health and shrunken zombies.
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}rows adjacent to Peagle Pod
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The P-15 Peagle Pod model is equipped with the highest quality Phloem cell engineering featuring the Chlorophyll model 24 Fuselage, Bioactive Propulsion Wings, Empennage made of a Wooden Vertical Stabilizer and 2 Wooden Horizontal Stabilizers for Pitch firing stability. Internal mechanisms include the Hazelnut Ailerons and Elevators, the newest Epidermis Oxygen Based Rudder, Stem Flaps, 2 Pressurized Oak Slats, Starch Speed Brakes that double as Air Brakes, Protein Canards and Proteolysis Based Nose and Main Gear. Other features include Pisum sativum Shock Absorbers, Retraction Mechanism, Photosynthesis Jet Engines and Afterburners, an Oak Exhaust Nozzle, and an Ejection Seat. 3 Pea Pilots included.
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: P-15 Peagle Pod sends out commandos to attack zombies in a nearby area.
HORSEBEAN_TOOLTIP: Deals heavy damage to zombies in surrounding lanes
LOQUAT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Nispaereo has been auditioning for AGES now to a prestigious aerial dance show, but has been hit with rejection every time. "I just don't understand," she weeps, swallowing a large mouthful of mint chocolate chip ice cream. "They let in those talentless trapeze hacks from that circus, but they draw the line at ME?!"
LOQUAT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Nispaereo creates a vortex that pulls zombies together, dealing damage.
GATLING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged

{FLAVOR}A plant with a legendary reputation that preceeds him, there have been murmurs on if he found his way into the compost in some great battle or if he's some fictional character made to inspire young sprouts. There have even been some to don the mantle and attempt to continue the legacy. The truth of what has become of him is about as simple as Gatling Pea himself: he found himself in a REALLY high position.
GATLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gatling Pea shoots in bursts of four. When charged, Gatling Pea can be tapped on to fire a single giant pea.
GATLING_TOOLTIP: Tap on Gatling Pea when charged to fire a giant pea
SOLARPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to switch mode
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbing mode fires up to 3 solar peas on any row in front of Solar Pea
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies defeated by Solar Pea drop sun
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Compared to her fellow sun plants in the greenhouse, Solar Pea prefers a much more "direct" approach in persuading zombies into participating with the secondary sun production process. "It's a harsh method, but those zombies wouldn't be so hurt if they let in a little bit of sun into those dingy crypts of theirs every once in a while," Solar Pea explains. "Thankfully, many gardeners out there enjoy the feeling of the sun on their skin, it's part of the gardening process after all and it's wonderful, wouldn't you agree?"
SOLARPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Solar Pea can be tapped to switch between a straight-firing and lobbing mode.
SOLARPEA_TOOLTIP: Tap on Solar Pea to switch between straight-shot or lobbed mode
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}anywhere on lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, leaves behind a molten lava pool that burns zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}A recent graduate in the field of meteoritics, Meteor Flower's exhaustive work on the field finds notoriety in many a newspaper. Mostly in tabloids stating that the end of the world is nigh. Despite it all, Meteor Flower keeps their petals high and their readings accurate. They've been looking to conduct their next study near ZCorp's Printer shop, for no particular reason.
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Meteor Flowers can fire meteor strikes at any tile on the lawn, leaving behind molten lava to burn zombies.
METEORFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Tap on Meteor Flower, then a tile, to launch molten meteor strikes
SWEETPEA_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}No one knows what flavor their candy is, and those who try to find out get trapped in a rabbit hole of chocolate factory conspiracies, government cover-ups, and missing Zombie reports. However, Sweet Pea doesn't get why their cherry flavor has such a direct reaction. "Trust me, I'm as lost as you."
SWEETPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sweet Pea shoots candy peas that split into shards upon contact, spreading out and dealing damage to other zombies.
MAGICSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged

{FLAVOR}With a pretty notorious history of being a successful card shark, his roll was put to a halt once some folks in Vegas caught wind of his lucky streak. Feel free to call him a Scaredy-shroom all you want for skipping town, but he's got a good cap on his stipe, and he finds it in his best interest to keep it on there as long as possible.
MAGICSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Magic-shroom can be tapped on when charged to fire either freezing, sun, or plant food tarot card powers.
MAGICSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Tap when charged to release tarot card powers
GREATZUCCHINI_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies with less than 200 health die instead
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage, lowers speed of zombies that can't be transformed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The Great Zucchini has been facing a bit of a culture shock ever since making the move from his old job. "The exchange rate for Sun is utterly confusing, Zombies try to pull their tricks whenever they can, and dear me- Nobody waits their turn here!" For being a smarty plant, he's got a lot of learning to do.
GREATZUCCHINI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The Great Zucchini can be tapped on to release the magic of the Basic Zombie tarot card, transforming zombies into basics.
GREATZUCCHINI_TOOLTIP: Tap when charged to transform zombies into basics
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies hit with the cheese deal less damage to plants

{FLAVOR}Cheese Strawberry wasn't supposed to be here. He slipped into a parcel and stowed away when the Jinjin Tea Shop sent it out to a mysterious customer, and thus sent him on an interdimensional trip to a world unlike anything he saw before. But that didn't matter much to him, because all that did was give him a free trip to try the new foreign cheese! How could you say no to that?
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cheese Strawberry lobs smelly cheese that makes zombies nauseated, lowering their eating damage.
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_TOOLTIP: Lobs smelly cheese that lowers zombie eating damage
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}attack slows down when at half health

{FLAVOR}Frozen Pear is a tourist by heart, and will take any opportunity she can to visit new worlds. As such, she will frequently update the viewers of her vlog constantly whenever she can. "This place is so much more relaxing compared to the last place I went to," she says in her most recent upload. "There were so many scary zombies there! Especially that one on the wheelchair, I still have nightmares of that one." She shivers fearfully. "I'm just glad here has all these crazy holidays they love to celebrate. And I want you guys to guess my favorite in the replies!"
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Frozen Pears can release impact waves that damage, freeze, and chill all nearby zombies when they get close.
FROZENPEAR_TOOLTIP: Blocks zombies while freezing them in a 3x3 area
LRIS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}magical birds naturally rot over time and disappear

{FLAVOR}Being a master of summoning, Iris fit in perfectly with the other magical plants. She’s in a close knit trio with Witch Hazel and Hocus Crocus, where the three of them love to gossip, go out to coffee shops, and endlessly shop together. Even if they have to deal with the occasional Wizard Zombie, they all just love the time they spend together. But despite it all, Iris misses her dear friends back home, and endlessly writes to them about her adventures.
LRIS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iris can release a magical bird from its cloak, which can continuously attack zombies and slow them down.
LRIS_TOOLTIP: Releases magical birds from its cloak that attack zombies while stalling them
SUCCULENTGRAPE_DESCRIPTION: In the grape family, Succulent Grape has always been the third child, but every time people mention that he is not like Grapeshot and Microwave Grapes, he always says that he is the youngest (a little secret: Succulent Grape is actually short-sighted).
SUCCULENTGRAPE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Succulent Grape lobs explosive grapes above his head, dealing stun damage.
MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}rolling fireballs are extinguished immediately upon contact with water
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plant food will permanently upgrade fireball damage

{FLAVOR}Missile Toast and Missile Toe never truly see eye-to-eye. Hot and cold, fire and ice, heat and snow, they will always butt heads. Their arguments get so loud (and usually end up in fire and snowballs flying), other plants have made a song about them:

She’s Missus Green Feastivus, she’s Missus Snow. She’s Missus Heat Blister, she’s Missus Ten Below...
MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Missile Toasts conjure fireballs to launch at zombies. After hitting a target, the fireballs continue to roll forward across the ground, doing damage across their path.
MISSILETOAST_TOOLTIP: Conjures fireballs that roll forward across the ground after hitting a target
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^8600CC^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fire spike leaf pierces through 2 zombies, makes them Lovesick and lowers their damage; ice spike leaf pierces through 4 zombies, makes them Heartbreak and chills them
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}chill effect can't be removed by fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies hit with both the fire and ice spike leaf get Heartbroken and take more damage from attacks
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spike leaf deals extra 40 damage if zombies have other spike leaf effect
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}When three universes crashed together, not only was untold Zombie chaos unleashed within the Lunar Rainbow Market, but a very powerful plant was born to combat the crisis. Begonia is a plant only said in legend, and came into being to stop the Zombie scourge once and for all. Strange that the last collision didn't wake her up, though.
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Begonias randomly throw two types of spike leaves that can stack to increase damage taken by zombies.
BEGONIA_TOOLTIP: Throws icy and fiery spike leaves that increase damage taken by zombies
PICKLEDPEPPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Pickled Pepper used to be a mildly successful comic at a social club called the Comedy Cannon, until one fateful night where a heckler pushed his buttons one too many times. Safe to say, the bottled up words thrown around were sour, heated, and even a little bit salty.
PICKLEDPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pickled Peppers destroy an entire column of zombies.
PICKLEDPEPPER_TOOLTIP: Destroys an entire column of zombies
ICYCURRANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}area effect (icy fence)

{FLAVOR}The cold isn't why Icy Currant is constantly shivering with a worried look on it's face. No, rather, it has suffered countless acts of trauma over the years. Electric Currant's been giving him the cold shoulder, he's broken multiple codes of conduct at the workplace, and right before he was planned to enter the fray, he got blown up in a freak accident. It's a slow recovery...
ICYCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Icy Currants create icy fences between ones planted on the same row or column.
SPRINGPRINCESS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs land randomly in a 3x3 area around zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs deal extra damage to zombies that can't be knockbacked
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs disappear over time

{FLAVOR}She prefers autumn.
SPRINGPRINCESS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spring Princess launches springs that bounce zombies back.
SPRINGPRINCESS_TOOLTIP: Launches springs that bounce zombies back
MADHATTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each consecutive bounce deals more damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}after the last bounce, hats have a chance to rebound, hitting the first original target
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plantfood will permanently upgrade hat, making it split into spikes upon contact

{FLAVOR}Despite his maniacal nature, offputting smile and his association with nonsense, he spends some of his time hosting tea parties with the other fairytale plants. Oftentimes, they’ll do it with hats of various sizes. He may seem like a mushroom who’s lost their marbles, but even he has some table etiquette.
MADHATTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hatter-shroom spins and launches hats that bounce into multiple zombies.
MADHATTER_TOOLTIP: Spins and launches hats that bounce into multiple zombies
COFFEEBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plants affected by buff attack faster until effect runs out
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of other plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The current spokesman for an energy drink owned by Rodeo Legend Zombies, Coffee Bean has considered stepping down after the unintended side-effects of a viral marketing campaign have taken a toll on him.
COFFEEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Coffee Bean wakes up plants in a 3x3 area.
COFFEEBEAN_TOOLTIP: Wakes up plants in a 3x3 area
ENTS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}slowly heals after not taking damage for 5 seconds
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}withstands instant kills, only takes 1500 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}roots destroy barrels and pianos in one hit but Ent takes 1500 damage

{FLAVOR}Ent has roots tied deep into their family, and keeps in touch with all of them. Especially their uncle, whose advice and wisdom gives Ent the energy to push on, and their fun loving sister who's currently traveling the stars. Then there's the weird cousin that spits wind and drops apples. Ent doesn't like him.
ENTS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ent attacks with sharp roots and heals itself when not taking damage.
ENTS_TOOLTIP: Attacks with sharp roots and heals itself when not taking damage
INKBLOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fog makes zombies allergic to buffs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}remove debuffs from nearby plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}uses buffs and debuffs to upgrade into 2 different ranks, temporarily increases damage and size of fog

{FLAVOR}Story goes of a deeply ingrained mushroom that stood peacefully in a forest. Each and every day, the mushroom watched as a group of frolicking plants were having fun dancing and singing with each other. Wanting to join them in harmony, the mushroom wished for a way to unroot itself... until one day, her wish was met in an unexpected and hazy way.
INKBLOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Haze-shroom sneezes fog that becomes stronger the more buffs it steals.
INKBLOT_TOOLTIP: Sneezes fog that becomes stronger the more buffs it steals
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms zombies into stronger zomboids depending on their health
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms specific zombies into special zomboids

{FLAVOR}As the zombies amassed their army within the timeline, Znake Lily merely gave a sly, slithery smile. Zomboid seeds in hand (err... tail?), he recalled his ancestor's saying hissed down through generations:

"When in Rome, do as the Romans do."
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Znake Lily transforms zombies into helpful zomboids.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (monitor) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Knows next to nothing about computers, other than the fact that they make very good headwear.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A typical ZCorp employee, except with better computer skills.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (monitor) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Once a member of ZCorp's IT department, Computerhead Contractor was demoted back to contractor after one-too-many lawsuits relating to her slamming computers onto Dr. Zomboss' head under the guise of "tech support."
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her computer skills, more specifically her ability to have an entire computer on her head, really gives this contractor the biggest edge.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Zombie just doesn't feel like he's getting anywhere with this whole "love" thing. They say you gotta open up your heart to succeed. He just wants to open the mind. Don't get the wrong impression: he's not much of an intellectual. He's just hungry.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Conehead uses his cone for protection against flying peas, lasers, and watermelons, but also as protection against heartbreak. The cone is always there for him.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His cone hat makes him twice as irresistible - and also twice as tough.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Buckethead was in need of a prom date. He saw a bucket in the street and it was love at first sight. It’s kind of sad. Don’t pick prom dates off the street, kids.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His stylish bucket attracts dates and resists projectile damage.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Flag Zombie carries the balloons for a reason. He just likes to let his thoughts float away in hope that one day he will find love. You’d expect him to let the balloons float away after he does this, but he holds onto them, like the wallet he put in his ripped pocket.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Marks the arrival of a huge lovesick "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with heart pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Cupid Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}This Gargantuar believes that he's been blessed with a cupid's arrow. In reality, he's just way into Valenbrainz.
Enormous lovebug who crushes in more ways than one.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}First place winner of every cupid contest since 2015.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Floats over most of your defenses, then flutters onward.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_JANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}She finds it strikingly weird that she happened to be the only female zombie willing to associate herself with Valenbrainz, but she doesn't complain about it too much. All the constant attention she's been getting all but makes up for it.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Parasol provides great rejection for lobbed projectiles and too-forward confessions.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (balloon) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Love is in the air? Wrong. That is a zombie and you've fallen for his trap.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HE: Valenbrainz zombie with a balloon. Zombie will float above plants until balloon is popped.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes and deals 300 damage to a random plant in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd column

{FLAVOR}Being a fan of both Cupid and Stupid takes a toll on this zombie. Luckily, his explosive attitude more than makes up for it.
Blows up plants with his loving attitude.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}St. Paddy's Zombie thought he was the luckiest zombie alive, then he got drafted to Holiday Mashup.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}Constantly complains how he was fed lies about there being tons of gold at the end of a rainbow. All he found were cones. Maybe one day he'll notice that he went to the wrong end.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His lucky cone gives him double the health of a normal St. Paddy’s zombie.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}Clearly remembers seeing a four-leafed clover somewhere.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His bucket is so lucky that it even resists projectile damage.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}He traded in a four-leafed clover for this lucky, one of a kind flag, said to give you all the luck in the world. So far all it did was make his arm tired.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge Irish-dancing "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with magical guitar
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Leprechaun Imp when damaged
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bashes out sonic blasts at range, dealing 1000 damage

{FLAVOR}Many zombies wonder where he got the guitar from. His answer? The same place they got a parasol, a shovel, a torch and all the other wacky things zombies bring into battle: Walmart.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_: Oversized Irishman who yields his mighty guitar.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}There is no convincing him that bathing in gold is unhealthy. One comic book of Zcrooge McDuck was all it took for him to convert his lifestyle.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Scuddles onto the battlefield with a pot of gold that totally belongs to him.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_RA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}Being colorblind doesn't dampen his excitement to dress in all blue for his favorite holiday, Springening!
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_RA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tries to steal sun, so that he can get rich.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_DODO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}The Leprechaun Imp and the dodo go way back. This unlikely friendship is, in fact, a very clever symbiosis. Leprechaun Imp provides the gold, and the dodo eats the gold. It's a simple process, really.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_DODO_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Dodo bird with a Leprechaun Imp rider. The dodo can flap and jump over barricades as well as troublesome plants.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}instant-kill any plant on contact when jamming

{FLAVOR}Nobody knows that it takes 273 Lepreglitters to generate a rainbow. A fact which leaves many Lepreglitters desperate for work when it's not raining.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Trails glamorous rainbows that protect zombies behind her when she's feeling lucky.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_PUNK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}How fast Leprepunk kicks depends on his mood. If he's happy, he'll kick fast. If he's sad, he'll kick slow. If he's hungry, he'll kick a plant.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_PUNK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Moshes plants back a space when he feels like it.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}Springening Zombie never shuts up about Springening and it's driving all other zombies up the wall. If he could just stop asking for wrapped chocolate eggs he could probably do something with his unlife, like find a cone. Or a bucket.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}Unlike Springening Zombie, this zombie doesn't even like Springening. The only reason he's dressed like this is because he owes Hippity-Hop Gargantuar. Don't ask what happened.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His polka-dot cone makes him twice as sturdy as normal springening zombies.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}He tried to hop into battle once and broke his legs. Don’t worry, he’s fine. He is a zombie if you couldn’t tell. He’s also part elephant. No joke.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His Easter basket hat provides excellent resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR4_RED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (eggshell) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}He likes eggs. He likes eggs very much. He was voted "most likely to like eggs" in high school, and has a huge collection of them. When he isn't fighting the plants on the lawn, he's making videos for his massively popular tutorial channel on YouTube.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_ARMOR4_RED_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His head-encasing egg thoroughly protects him from attacks - and it comes in three different colors!
ZOMBIE_SPRING_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}Totally demolishes 6 year olds in Egg Hunting competitions.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His flag marks the arrival of a huge pale-colored "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}smashes plants with carrot
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Chick Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Springening Conehead once asked Hippity-Hop Gargantuar to crush a Kernel-pult that kept him from moving. He would later regret that decision immensely.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Sometimes things cannot be unseen. This is one of those times.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects

{FLAVOR}What came first? The egg, or the chicken? Answer: An imp in a chick costume.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hatches from tossed eggs, then scrambles forward.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250 (egg sign) + 170
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}arrives in a group of three zombies or more

{FLAVOR}Proud members of the Egg Fan Club. Current members: 3
ZOMBIE_SPRING_CAMEL_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_: Walks in with a group of easter treats.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_PONCHO_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}60 (poncho) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}randomly wears a protective metal grate (1100 HP)

{FLAVOR}Springening Poncho doesn't know why everyone refers to him as Springening Poncho. He's just a regular old Poncho Zombie trying something new. "Nobody questioned Ra Zombie or Balloon Zombie when they changed outfits, why does it have to be me?" is what he would say if the only thing coming out of his mouth wasn't "brraiinz."
Sometimes has a hidden armored plate.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}plants turn back to normal when Springening Wizard dies

{FLAVOR}There is a certain magic to spring. This zombie does not understand second meanings.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}appears on the left side of the lawn after chocolate bomb explodes
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks put out chocolate bomb

{FLAVOR}Is currently under investigations relating to missing imps incidents in local pizzeria chains.
ZOMBIE_SPRING_PROSPECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Hops over your defenses when his chocolate-covered bomb explodes.
ZOMBIE_EASTER_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}470
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each present has 600 HP

{FLAVOR}Was severely disappointed when he found out that Chick Imps don't share the same colors and patterns as the Easter eggs they came out of.
ZOMBIE_EASTER_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Strong zombie that can push presents across the lawn, with extra Springening cheer!
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}Despite the name, this zombie's birthday is actually a mystery. He doesn't want anyone to know when it is, so he can celebrate all the time. It could be tommorrow, it could even be right now.



Happy Birthday, Birthdayz Zombie!
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His birthday hat doesn't protect him, but it helps him celebrate on the lawn.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}He's a veteran ice cream stealer.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His ice-cream hat gives him double the protection of normal party-goers.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}Is it technically a bucket? Can a bucket-shaped cake truly be called a bucket? Have zombies' standards for what qualifies as armor truly hit rock bottom? Scientists are still researching this pressing matter.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His tasty birthday cake bucket provides excellent protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}You ever wonder how weird balloons are? Happy birthday - here's a rubber sack of my breath!
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge celebratory "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Present Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}There's only one thing worse than getting socks for your birthday.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H: A gargantuan zombie wrapped up and ready to go.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700 (present) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}Present Imp is famous for sneaking his way basically everywhere. Wanna go on vacation? Hide as luggage. Wanna be at a party? Hide in the presents. Wanna sneak off the Holiday Mashup programme? He's still figuring that one out.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gets unwrapped past most of your defenses, then parties onwards.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_JETPACK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}320
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}His jetpack is actually just packaged fireworks that went off prematurely, but don't spoil his fun.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_JETPACK_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Boosts to float over all but the tallest plant barriers to get to the party.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 (cake) + 290
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (when in cake), 0.5 (freed)
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}He’s always dreamed of being the cake at a wedding, but could only go to kids birthday parties. He’s fine with it.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_PHARAOH_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His birthday cake greatly protects him but slows down a rather fast zombie.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_BARRELROLLER_ALMANAC_DES:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with present
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Imp Pear Imps are thrown from barrel when destroyed

{FLAVOR}Not the most interesting occupation, but "Present Roller" is indeed one, believe it or not.
His perfectly wrapped-up barrel crushes plants and is great for parties.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}470
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each present has 600 HP

{FLAVOR}He prefers Feastivus, he's gotten used to the snow. However, we can't always get what we want.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION_H: Strong zombie that can push presents across the lawn.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}A robotic present sent from the 50th Birthdayz event from now. His robotic present is equipped with all the latest gift-cleansing hardware, like the clothes-eradicator, knockoff detector, and destroyer of anything vegetables related. Also branded by Imps United.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_MECH_CONE_DESCRIPTION_HE: The armor-plated gift box offers phenomenal protection for its pilot.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}420
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2 (normal), 0.16 (juggling)
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to Sun Bean effects

{FLAVOR}"Yeah, it's all fun and games having to entertain those dang imps the entire day, all until one of them decides to glue a cake to your hand." says Birthdayz Jester in an annoyed clown tone.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Returns projectiles that are shot at him like a birthday party gone horribly wrong.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_CAKETANK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}#caketank is the hot new trend. It is trending all over the place. Look under your bed. It's trending there, too.
ZOMBIE_BIRTHDAY_CAKETANK_DESCRIPTION_HEA: #caketank advances to your house, releasing shocking birthday surprises as its layers take damage.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects

{FLAVOR}At first you may think there isn't much to this zombie, but if you got to really know him you'd still be correct.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is flown into your defenses, then plays onwards.
ZOMBIE_CHILDRENSDAY_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}Teddy Imp dreams of being a real bear, fetching his favorite snack: honey! His extreme bee allergy gets in the way of such dreams, but who would tell an innocent imp that?
ZOMBIE_CHILDRENSDAY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Is flown into your defenses, then prowls onwards.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}5400
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with stick
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tosses Teddy Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}The alternative to this was wearing an outfit made from pure candy, and that'd be like hanging a big 'EAT ME' sign around these little monsters. Call him whatever you want, but the risk isn't worth it.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H: The biggest baby of them all.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_FOOTBALL_MECH_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 4 times the normal damage to other obstacles

{FLAVOR}Toy Car Imp hates to eat his fruits and vegetables and would rather push them away. He wants to stay young forever and believes there should be a day that celebrates the greatness of being a child. They would call it: Children’s Day.
Pushes plants across the lawn to the left instead of eating.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_BASIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}He may look like a kid, but try calling him that in a raw online match and you'll get the most ear-piercing sound imaginable.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_ARMOR1_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}He might look childish, but- oh who are we kidding. That is clearly a grown zombie stuffed into children's clothing. You ain't fooling us!
His plastic cone gives him twice the amount of protection and entertainment than that of a regular kid zombie.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_ARMOR2_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}He's grown tired of playing in the sand. When he grows up, he wants to explore the world. Zombies might not age, but they can dream.
His bucket makes for great protection, and a noise muffler for all his parent's pointless lectures.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_ARMOR4_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (legos) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}This lego headwear set is suitable for children aged 5-10. Legohead Zombie just found out that he's actually 11 years old. He's having a hard time coping with this.
Legohead Zombie's carefully assembled headgear playfully provides great head protection.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}Puberty hit really hard for this zombie. Now he shoulders all the responsibility to guide his friends towards the harsh cruel world of being an adult. Happy 13th Birthday, Jeremy!
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge hyperactive "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows low-damage bubbles (bubbles deal 20 damage)

{FLAVOR}He’s called Fishy Imp for many reasons. He carries a fish, he’s done some fishy things and he smells like fish. He also brought a fish to a birthday party and it did not end well.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Fishy Imps blow a barrage of low-damage bubbles from their toy guns.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350 + Imp Child Cargo
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects

{FLAVOR}His dad got trapped on a balloon just like him, and his granddad before that back in the industrial age. It seems to be running in the family.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Imp Child flying with a bunch of balloons. When the balloons are popped, the Imp is set loose into your defense.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BASIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Summer Zombie loves sparklers. He carries them everywhere. He also burned down his house when he brought them inside. Now he wonders if he should keep the sparklers or not. Tough decision.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Summer Conehead keeps his cone close and his shades closer. But not too close, he’s claustrophobic.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His cone - and more importantly, his sunglasses - give him double the toughness of ordinary summer zombies.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Summer Buckethead's got everything he needs to keep the place bright wherever he goes. Don't tell anybody, but he's afraid of the dark.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His glow-in-the-dark bucket provides hearty damage protection.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}You’d expect the flag to just burn and turn into ashes from the sparklers, but there are other zombies that you should be questioning for things that don’t make any sense at all rather than something minor like this.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge sparkly "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with spatula
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tosses Hot Dog Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}4 years of chef training and 2 years of cooking classes were a mere waste of time. He does not, in fact, know how to cook. But tenderize? That's his speciality.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Oversized chef who is the king of the grill.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Hot Dog Imp uses all natural ingredients: corn syrup, sugar and VERY real meat. Definitely does NOT contain sewage and/or back hair.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is launched into your defenses, then tries to ketchup.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BUG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350 + Summer Zombie cargo
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects

{FLAVOR}Summer Zombie's always going to summer night parties to light the place up. He saw a lightning bug there and was going to catch it, but then realized the lightning bug caught him. They've been best bugs ever since.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BUG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lightning Bug carries Summer Zombie in over ground defenses.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}turns on his boom box for 8 seconds after reaching the sixth column
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}boombox has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz is the one day of the year where you get to express your love towards someone. Also buy lots of chocolate. Lots of it. That's what the ads on TV, the bumper stickers, and all the Valenbrainz cards at the supermarket said. So that's exactly what he did.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Holds aloft a chocolate "boombox" that tranquilizes all plants with its sappy tunes.
ZOMBIE_SUMMER_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}burning s'more destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish s'more
