{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}breathes fire towards nearby plants
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants

{FLAVOR}They're still confused on what the year is, Wooly Imp was too busy organizing with the other zombies. He told them to not dress up as camels this year, so they listened. They had to cut out Malcom though, who played the titular role of the camel's hump. Last they heard of him, he had some real choice words on Wooly Imp's planning skills and why he just won't tell them what animal they should dress up as. Nowadays, team isn't like what it used to be, but it's best not to step out of line, lest they end up as a lion with two legs.
ZOMBIE_LION_DANCE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A duo of zombies that enter your lawn to provide a fiery and crushing performance.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800 (newspaper) + 460
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (normal), 0.88 (when angry)
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage normally, 8 times the normal damage when angry

{FLAVOR}With a new year, come new crossword pages. He is still trying to solve last year's page.
ZOMBIE_LUNAR_NEWSPAPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Newspaper protects celebratory zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
ZOMBIE_WEALTH_GOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}7000
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons lunar zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops yuanbao from the sky
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}switches lanes from time to time

{FLAVOR}While your standard cadaver is undead, this one's great fortune has lead him to be practically immortal! It would be utterly naive to even attempt to defeat this zombie! Unfortunately for him, that means he'll never have true respite from you and those pesky plants attempting to rob him blind whenever he appears. Maybe his fortune is failing him in that regard, but admitting such would be declaring defeat, and his pride won't allow that.
ZOMBIE_WEALTH_GOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A zombie of immeasurable wealth, ready to share his goodwill and fortune to fellow zombies to kick off a new, prosperous year.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}He's a fan of football alright, but he's still having trouble comprehending the rules of this particular match. So if a Peashooter beheaded a Buckethead before the third Gargantuar managed to squish the 5th Kernel-pult on the field, does that mean it gave the Soccer Imps the sign to run towards the house, scoring a point? You have to admit, Zombie football is one heck of a game.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}These special cones came from his side job as a high school sports coach. Twenty-five bucks each, in THIS Zomconomy?!  Totally not worth all the complaints he has to put up with from the little league's parents!
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His carefully stacked pile of sportz disc cones provides him with decent protection.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}The long standing tradition of dumping sport drink on athletes after a big win is well known to Lawnbowl Buckethead. He’s been busy practicing his technique, and is eager to show it off to his friends and enemies alike.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His freshening, fuel-filled fangear fulfills frontal fortification, fantastically.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}Lawnbowl Flag Zombie has been a part of every huge football-related riot since the 1960s. Between the 1961 Banana Republic vs. Zombified Zeppelins, the 1978 Wandering Weeds vs the Undead Usurpers, and the infamous 2003 Pioneering Plants vs the Dread the Dead match that ended with one of the losing Dread the Dead supporters attempting to stuff a football up the referee's nose, he has seen all of them. And always has been the one to bear the flag.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Marks the arrival of a huge exuberant "wave" of football supporters.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}plants turn back to normal when Lawnbowl Wizard dies

{FLAVOR}This internship under Tim has gone in a direction Lawnbowl Wizard could not have anticipated. Being forced to judge downs day in and day out is a great mental workout, but the verbal abuse from the bystanders? It can drive a good zombie to drink. He wants to tell Tim about his concerns, but unfortunately he’s too busy watching the big Lawnbowl Commercialz Zpecial, sponsored by PopSmartz.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Lawnbowl Wizard’s distance judging technique lets him turn plants into passive benchwarmers – AKA sheep.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (zeppelin) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}You would not believe the amount of brand deals Lawnbowl Balloon Zombie got to put branding on his special balloon. However, his pride was far greater than any sum of brainz or money that they could provide, and thus he branded it himself, with the thing most important to him.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HE: His big, game day zeppelin lets him float gently above the crowd.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with goalpost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Lawnbowl Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Not once have the plants been listening to his calling out of offsides, unsportsmanlike conduct, or incomplete passes. He’s been trying to move the goalposts so the plants will start paying attention, but all it’s done so far is provide a decent blunt weapon.
The ultimate defensive end on the home (invading) team.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis

{FLAVOR}Lawnbowl Imp has been a huge fan of Ballpark Frank for years on end. The best lesson he learned from him was to "be the ball", so that’s what Lawnbowl Imp did. He misunderstood the lesson a bit as to WHAT ball he should be, but Lawnbowl Imp's got the can-do spirit (and flexibility) to make it work.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gets passed deep into your defenses, then rolls out.
ZOMBIE_SPORTZBALL_TREADMILL_ALMANAC_DESC:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to hypnosis
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}brain gives 50% speed boost, 18% toughness boost

{FLAVOR}Cardio Zombie is all about health, healthiness and healthy lifestyles. He refuses to consume carbs, downing nothing but high-protein brains for every meal. In his opinion, other zombies really need to up their game. NO EXCUSES!
Advances to a set spot on the board, then tosses buffing brains at other zombies until he's defeated.
ZOMBIE_SPACE_DANCER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}280
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (normal), 0.28 (jamming)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}kicks zombies 2 tiles forward when jamming

{FLAVOR}Space Dancer has been credited with assisting in Dr. Zomboss's moon colonization plan a few years back, helping to put the first zombie on the moon. What, you thought they used rockets?
ZOMBIE_SPACE_DANCER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Kicks zombies into orbit with the power of his ZASA internship.
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Peasant Rally Zombie often tells the other peasants that they’ve got to move quick to slay an ogre on the loose. The truth is, he doesn’t know where the ogre is. Could he be the ogre?
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Marks the arrival of a huge dark pile of zombies.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2.5 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}For one to become a high ranking wizard, one must take an oath never to eat vegetation. Which is why being a summoner of the dark arts has its perks. For however troublesome that thing on his head might be, at least it makes for a good loophole. Just don't stare at it for too long. It gets grouchy.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Dark Summoner Zombies summon four dragon imps around themselves at a time, twice.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (tower) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}There is a tale of a beautiful princess locked in a secret tower. This brave, once knighted zombie, managed to find her. His quest, however, was stopped once he fell in love with the tower instead. Now, his hobby of making tower-like headware has completely consumed his unlife. And he lived happily? ever after...
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His medieval tower shaped armor provides astonishing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ROBBER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.41
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a large sun on defeat

{FLAVOR}It's true that sun theft is a considered a crime in 9 different states, especially in such a bleak period like the Dark Ages. But he knows that if he ever gets locked up, he won't finish the sent
ZOMBIE_DARK_ROBBER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bandit Zombies carry sun they have stolen within their bags. They also run away after some time.
ZOMBIE_DARK_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}torch destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish torch

{FLAVOR}If Lost Explorer was transported to Ancient Egypt to become Explorer Zombie, then where does this guy come in? The truth is that there's an entire convoluted multiverse revolved around the Explorers that we'd rather not delve into right now.
ZOMBIE_DARK_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants and can make a mean howl.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_VETERAN_VANILLA_DESCR:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}630
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}plants turn back to normal when Arcane Shepherd Zombie dies

{FLAVOR}Sure, the Arcane Shepherd's newfound magical upgrades are undeniably cool. Some zombies are still doubters about the whole sheep thing, though. He's got more powerful spells that can quickly mutate plants into another living creature, and he's still using it just to create sheep?! They can't deny he's effective though. In the time it takes for any potential doubters to process their thoughts, the Arcane Shepherd can have a whole lawn of plants transformed into sheep. Maybe it'd be best that they stay quiet about their opinion.
Turns plants into passive sheep at a much faster pace than his standard counterpart.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}The only thing other than brainz motivating him to move faster is the Imp Mermaid who has been obsessively chasing him around in the water trying to eat his toenails.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE: Marks the arrival of a tidal wave of zombies.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SNORKEL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannot be targeted by most plants while submerged
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Snorkel Zombie and Scuba Zombie have fierce competition. Snorkel Zombie may be able to dodge horizontal shots, but has his skeleton withered from constant exposure to high water pressures? Scuba Zombie doesn’t think so! He also is unable to think at all!
Scuba Zombies are submerged so deep that they cannot be targeted by as many plants compared to their counterpart.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SHELL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000 (shell) + 270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12 (when in shell), 0.22 (freed)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 10 times the normal damage when in shell

{FLAVOR}Clearly this zombie hasn't broken out of their shell, but that's okay. Some shells are emotional, but others allow you to viciously snap through plants in total safety, and this zombie is okay with that.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SHELL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Wears a sturdy shell and uses it to clamp at plants it meets, heavily damaging them.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SHELL_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3000 (shell) + 270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12 (when in shell), 0.22 (freed)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to movement impairing effects until the shell is broken

{FLAVOR}Don't even think about telling this guy that shell tongue twister. He's heard it a million times over, and is probably why he still hermits into his shell to stop hearing it.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_SHELL_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION_HE: Wears a protective shell and stops at most plants it encounters.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GREASER_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500 (plastic wrap) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Everything was going great for Greaser Imp. Awesome beach party with all his buddies, interesting brains to meet and consume, but then Dr. Zomboss came outta nowhere with his weird shark thing. Next thing he knows, he's stuck at the bottom of the sea, and he's pretty sure he had some scuffle with a sea sponge? Swimming his way back up to surface was rough, being trapped in this plastic and all, but he wasn't going down without a fight. His next escapade? Dealing with that punk shark. He's sure he could take it down.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GREASER_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Washes out on land, stuck in discarded plastic. When broken free, he'll continue forward - in style.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}It caught on.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: With the use of his totally tubular duck floatation apparatus, the Pompadour Ducky Tube Zombie can quickly waddle his way through water.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Go back to the beach, they said. Bring a ducky tube, they said. So, yeah, that's what Pompadour Conehead Ducky Tube did. He's still at his best when following simple instructions.
His starfish cone still gives him twice the toughness of regular pompadour ducky tubers.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Previously considered a critically endangered species by thanatologists across the globe, recent conservation efforts to preserve the humble Pompadour Buckethead Ducky Tuber have proven to be more than fruitful. Only downside being is that they've almost entirely outcompeted and devastated the local ecosystem of Big Wave Beach, casualties include the rare Eastern Dragon Seahorse population and multiple coral formations. A bucket makes all the difference.
His scallop-shelled bucket and ducky tube combo give him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}The highly stylish shell on his head is subtly undermined by the implication that his swimming capabilities are reduced to a children's toy.
His fashion statement of a shell greatly protects him from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Ever the pioneer, Bikini Ducky Tube Zombie was quick to become the first woman zombie to jump aboard the recent ducky tube hype train. It's not really all it's cracked up to be, but don't tell that reporter lady that she said that. The fallout would ruin her reputation.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_H: With the use of her gnarly duck floatation apparatus, the Bikini Ducky Tube Zombie can quickly waddle her way through water.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}The rubber ducky makes for a nice companion during long nights floating the sea aimlessly.
Her starfish cone and ducky tube combo gives her twice the toughness and style of regular bikini ducky tubers.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}She stubbed her toe on a rock once.
Her scallop-shelled bucket and ducky tube combo give her great resistance to damage and provides extra style.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Her shell actually houses one of the great divine sages of a time long past. Mr. Grand Fizzleworth, the snail overlord of universal travel, lives in her shell and frequently tells her stories of intergalactic travel. She keeps trying to alert zombie kind of the threats of intergalactic traveller warriors and their eventual plan to destroy the earth in order to build a planetary parking lot in its place. Mr. Grand Fizzleworth chose her as the messanger, and she must respect that decision. Zombie experts however, have claimed that the shell contains nothing but her head. But she knows better.
Her seashell and ducky tube combo, while being the latest fashion trend, also protects her greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_WEAK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4 (on water)

{FLAVOR}Before the zombies decided on ducks, they originally had these seahorse floatation devices. They were eventually thrown to waste, but now they're back with vengence... with mildly aggrivated volleyballs.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_WEAK_DESCRIPTION_HE: Stationary obstacle that flows along tide until it reaches land again.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22 (on water)

{FLAVOR}If you see these appearing on the shoreline, call an official zombie emergency number and report the sighting so that you can be immediately told that nobody cares and that you shouldn't either. An enviromentalist Dr. Zomboss is not.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION_: Heaps of trash that follows the tide up to shore.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_STRONG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16 (on water)

{FLAVOR}These ancient monuments have arrived overseas from an island long lost to the ages, and are theorized to be depicting a mythical figure. Whatever could this mean?
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GARBAGE_STRONG_DESCRIPTION_: Highly durable statues that erode downstream until it hits land.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Being constantly called "egghead" in high school drove him to have a more "radical" and "hang 10" personality, but he recently decided to take the name back. Yeah, he’s an egg, and he has a shell. It may not be the right shell, but he’s owning it, isn’t he?
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His seashell head protection mechanism protects him greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Some dudes and dudettes think that her shell belonged to something before. Others think that her shell is a rare sea slug, residing on her head. There are few who think that SHE might be the sea slug, but hey, we’ll never really know.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her seashell, although definitely not the hottest fashion, protects her greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}It turns out all he needed to do to free himself from an iceberg was just become a mouth breather. But hey, now he moves faster than everyone else. Slippery feet, teehee.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Marks the arrival of a blizzard of zombies.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can be disabled by E.M.Peach

{FLAVOR}Robo Dodo actually has a neat ability: an external temperature calculator, designed by Dr. Zomboss himself to keep track of environmental hazards, including excessive cold or heat. It can even calculate the temperature right now: pretty darn cold.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Tankier than the normal non-robotic dodos, Robo Dodos can only fly over one tile, and only fly over certain plants and slider tiles.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (tusks) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Rumor has it that Tuskhead Zombie acquired his tusk from the very first version of the Zombot Tuskmaster 10,000 B.C. Dr. Zomboss only lets him keep it because it’s made of ivory, and would rather not be the one having it in his possession.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His mammoth skull protects him greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}His previous job as a librarian earned him the skill of walking insanely fast. He doesn’t really know how they correlate, but he isn’t complaining.
Marks the arrival of a massive lost crew of zombies.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_CRYSTALSKULL_VETERAN_DES:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 5 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}boosts every zombies' speed by 100% and toughness by 43% for 8 seconds after reaching the eighth column

{FLAVOR}Upon being dropped, the Magenta Skull would implode, releasing the thousand tortured sounds from their eternal prison to bring their wrath upon the world once more. But don’t worry: Magenta Skull Zombie passed his ZSATS. We’re in good hands.
Magenta Skull Zombies use their weird magenta skulls to boost all other zombies.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (temple) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Templehead Zombie often has to attend therapeutic sessions with Dr. Zomboss. The constant barrage of clueless adventurer zombies trying to find hidden artifacts inside of him makes him feel violated. You can see his story now on the next episode of "Dr. Zomboss Cares About His Employees."
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: An entire temple on his head allows for great damage protection.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}torch destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish torch

{FLAVOR}During one of the most important expeditions, Lost Explorer Zombie found an artifact so peculiar that upon grabbing it, it instantly teleported him to Ancient Egypt. From there on, he took a new identity: "Explorer Zombie." He was lost no more, he knew what he had to do: burn plants for a living.
ZOMBIE_LOSTCITY_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants and brighten the night.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}He found the flag at the attic of his old man's house. A little dry and worn out, but it does the job when it comes to making everyone at the party go insane, follow you to raid the nearest neighbor's house, and consume his cerebrum.
Marks the arrival of a massive headbangin' army of zombies.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}900
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.44
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}The other zombies just don't get him. They always say "What's up with Goth Punk Zombie? He looks so emotionally distant all the time." It's not that he's constantly down or anything. It's just that, as a zombie, he's physically incapable of portraying emotions.
Goth Punk Zombies rock out to only the saddest of tunes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (speaker) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He can't remember what exactly happened. A wild night at Impunk's place and a couple of brain drinks make you do some berserk things you usually regret in the morning.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His head-encasing speaker protects him greatly from damage, and has also busted his eardrums.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BASS_BASIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}850 (speaker) + 270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speaker blasts out shockwaves every few seconds, dealing 10 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speaker blasts out sonic blasts at range, dealing 1000 damage

{FLAVOR}With a legendary discography under his belt, Bassist Zombie had no trouble mashing with the monsters of the musical world. From the Jiangshi of China to the Space Ogres of Mars, he's rocked and rolled with the best of them. However, he's been advised to tour locally by his agents following a recent pyrotechnic disaster during Brain-in-a-Jar's keyboard solo. Let it be known that despite what the media claims about deliberate sabotage, he didn't start the fire.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BASS_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_H: Drops into your lawn with a speaker to send shockwaves.
ZOMBIE_DINO_EGGSHELL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700 (eggshell) + 100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Don’t ask how a Dinosaur had a Zombie as it’s offspring. Seriously, don’t ask. The answer could inflict irreversible brain trauma.
ZOMBIE_DINO_EGGSHELL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His eggshell, other than making him subjectively cuter, provides some defensive use.
ZOMBIE_DINO_EGGSTEALER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}80
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.55
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}This imp was the one who pioneered the technological advances of imp-kind with the introduction of Egg-Tech. He's to be given a Nobel Prize Award thousands of years from now and actually got two for defying time itself to be there to receive his first one.
ZOMBIE_DINO_EGGSTEALER_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Egg Stealer Imps are sneaky little buggers that speed into the lawn. When defeated, they drop an egg that will hatch into an Eggshell Imp.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_BLUE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to Jurassic Panic
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to knockback

{FLAVOR}This zombie was looking for new innovative ways of avoiding getting punched around or eaten by dinosaurs. He decided the best way to handle the situation was to become one with them, which is why he put on the get up. So far it seems to be working, but his friends are all hesitant to tell him that it has more to do with his repugnant body odor than his poorly made dinosaur attire.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_BLUE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Jurassic Imposters utilize their wooden masks to fool dinosaurs into not impacting them.
ZOMBIE_DINO_PTERRY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000 + 1400 (rock)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.145
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes plants with his rock instead of eating, dealing 2 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to knockback

{FLAVOR}The zombie and the little dinosaur go way back. They have an inseparable bond that anyone with a pet would envy. How did this come to be? Well, if you're a smart enough cookie, you can put two-and-two together by looking at that rock he's always carrying around.
ZOMBIE_DINO_PTERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Rock Carrier Zombie carries in a rock. When defeated, he will drop the rock, which blocks damage and crushes plants.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attack can create tombstones

{FLAVOR}What Dr. Zomboss considered to be his first ever failure from his entire time-traveling journey, has been rebuilt from the scraps to once more be the horrible ancient curse put on your lawn.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EGYPT2_DESCRIPTION_HE: The destroyer of plants from ancient sands, reawakened by an ancient curse once more.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannon can rain down imps past your defenses

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss put on a black coat of paint to impose a menacing image: that this ship would be the nightmare of every cargo ship full of plants unfortunate enough to be sailing by. Although, this has more to do with the excessive amount of black paint he stored below the deck that he had no idea what to do with.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_PIRATE2_DESCRIPTION_H: The plant plundering privateer of the high seas, reemerged from the depths to terrorize once again!
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can target mine carts

{FLAVOR}Last time, the addition of a bull was merely an exception: a one off thing for Dr. Zomboss to take great pride in while extirpating your defenses. Now, however, it is the result of losing a bet, one which Dr. Zomboss is very much not proud of.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_COWBOY2_DESCRIPTION_H: The stagecoach of destruction from the western wilds, back for a rematch from its previous defeat.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}missile attacks can destroy Power Tiles

{FLAVOR}Outside of the fact that Dr. Zomboss loves the future for allowing him to reach a conclusion on how to repair his Zombots, he's still peeved that he doesn't feel like he fits in. He's going for a more "techno" and "out of this world" kind of look, but doesn't get the impression anyone appreciates it.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FUTURE2_DESCRIPTION_H: The power tile crushing creator from the further future, renovated.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fire breathing attacks destroy plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbed fireballs can hatch Imp Dragon Zombies

{FLAVOR}Reforged in the depths of a volcano, the dragon was resurrected with a concoction of lava mixed with alchemy juices, 3 bat wings, some funny looking ring, and a strike from a lightning bolt. It's cool looking, and was definitely worth the trouble, but Dr. Zomboss is pretty sure he somehow managed to get his lab keys mixed into that as well.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DARK2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The desolator of all from dark times, back to reclaim its throne.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}mouth turbine can pull plants to it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summoned zombie sharks can consume plants

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss meant it when he said the first iteration of this Zombot was a labor of love. He painstakingly tried to recreate the evil machinations day in and out to produce similar results to his previous attempt, to end up with an even bigger terror of the tides. The non-waterproof paintjob however, was an oversight he's willing to admit.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_BEACH2_DESCRIPTION_HE: The ravenous engine of carnage, back from the murky depths to turn the tide of this battle.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can heal ice barrier over time

{FLAVOR}The synthetic fur was probably Dr. Zomboss' most brilliant idea yet. This time, however, he did not account global cooling into the mix, causing the Zombot to freeze up before he could even take it out for a spin. Dr. Zomboss might be an evil genius, but he'll never admit how scatterbrained he actually is.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_ICEAGE2_DESCRIPTION_H: The mammoth mech with an ice blast from the past, invigorated by the cold of overdue revenge.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_LOSTCITY2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops zombies and bags o’ sand

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss' latest creation involved the implementation of aspects belonging to ancient civilizations, without understanding their historical meaning. Asked in a post-fight interview, Dr. Zomboss stated that he does not care and that it was essential to the machine's look, and shoo'd the press away. Needless to say, these statements are not helping his public image.
The floating fortress from the sky above, ascending once more to take on the challenge.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_EIGHTIES2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speakers do passive damage (except to ground plants and Phat Beet) and send out shockwave attacks

{FLAVOR}They say that you can hear someone's true feelings through a performance of music. Music is the universal language that breaks all language barriers, delivering some of your deepest desires, ambitions, and drive through carefully constructed melodies. All of this was not lost on Dr. Zomboss, though he prefers to just scream into the mic and go with the flow, to an expected disappointment from the crowd.
An intimate comeback for Dr. Zomboss, with his more recent and agonizing explorations.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons dinosaurs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates tar

{FLAVOR}It's funny how the first iteration is now the fossil, considering the look Dr. Zomboss opted for the newer version. Of course, he's really the only one who finds this fact amusing. Others are way more concerned with the fact that a 100 foot long metal dinosaur is now rampaging through the marsh and is about to stomp the life out of them at any moment.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_DINO2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: A mechanical means of dinosaurian destruction, striking the earth once more.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MODERN1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates fireballs and iceballs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}opens portals

{FLAVOR}Truth be told, Dr. Zomboss really can't help but miss the good old days. How he used to terrorize the neighborhood with his giant Zombot, complete with fireballs and an RV dispensary system. Of course, times change and he can no longer afford such a costly project, but he managed to settle with a smaller more compact version of his first ever evil project, now with more time manipulation to boot.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MODERN1_DESCRIPTION_H: The menacing monstrosity of the Modern Day.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Initially apprehensive about joining General Camo's militia, he strapped into action after hearing the promise of an airborne zombie utopia after he achieves complete zombie domination. Say what you will, but Pilot Zombie is pretty simple. Give him a city in the sky and he'll serve you for his unlife.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Ask him about his favorite joke and he'll repeat the same groaner about air traffic. Members of his platoon have heard that the live zombie missile program is open to new members.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His standard issue cone makes him twice as tough as normal pilot zombies.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A zombie with big dreams, Buckethead Pilot Zombie once had a dream to one day get an approval to take care of an AH-6 Little Bird when he enlisted. The birder in him was a bit surprised find something that was not little nor a bird, but some giant metal thing. Thankfully, signing up to the Zombie Aerial Combat Unit has provided him with an unexpected benefit: being able to get close and personal with any flock that happens to be passing by, allowing for some lovely photos for his birdwatching book.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His propeller bucket provides him with great protection and a backup plan for when he runs out of jetpack fuel.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1600 (helmet) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Contradictory to popular belief, he isn't related to Lost Pilot Zombie. The helmet however is. It's his third cousin twice removed.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His pilot helmet provides amazing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (bomb) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}The headwear assigned to these Pilot Zombies were originally designed to explode. That iteration did not last long.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His bomb-shaped headwear provides atomic protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Flag Pilot Zombie easily achieved his rank by not being afraid of most things. The dark? Cramped spaces? That sounds like home to him. He does have a mighty fear of flags however. Don't tell him.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge aerial "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_: Rally Pilot Zombie marks the arrival of an alpha strike of zombies.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_BATTLEPLANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}400 (imp), 750 (plane)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4 (normal), 0.6 (losing control)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bullets deal 10 damage{KEYWORD}
Special: {STAT}loops around to another lane when he reaches the home ship
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}catapults can defeat the pilot, but the plane loses control, rams into your home, dealing 400 damage

{FLAVOR}Some zombies don't have grand reasons for doing what they do. Such as this imp, who rams the trigger to watch the mesmerizing lights in front of him unfold.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_BATTLEPLANE_DESCRIPTION_H: Uses machine gun to attack plants and the home ship.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}The all new Pelican-1 Aircraft was designed to protect all contents within, with an impressive carrying capacity of about 3,000 imps, an ergonomic seat and cup holders, it's no wonder it's currently the bleeding edge when it comes to pelican-based zombie carriers. No matter how much those salty sea dogs try to dispute it, at the very least this behemoth doesn't have to worry about some butter putting a quick stop to its delivery.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PELICAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Flies in to drop off a payload of Paratrooper Imps.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_TWINSPLANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}800 (per cabin)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can only fall after both cabins are destroyed
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}rams into your home, dealing 1000 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}highly resistant to movement impairing effects

{FLAVOR}Double the firepower. Double the airspace superiority. Double the trouble. The only thing they don't like is that they also have to pay double the gasoline cost to get this thing to run. Seriously, they've been waiting on the gasoline price rollback for ages.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_TWINSPLANE_DESCRIPTION_HE: Rams into your home, dealing massive damage.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}plasma balls deal 20 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}connected plasma balls can chill, paralyze, or slowly destroy plants based on the conduction

{FLAVOR}Scientist Zombie earned high status among General Camo's ranks by working as a double agent, pretending to be a member of Zomboss' forces back in the day. One of his greatest achievements was downing an airship around the Cactus Canyon area by acting as an electrical conductor. He does wish he emptied his pockets before he did it, he burnt up a calling card from one of the Landscapers on board and can't help but feel like he's missed out on a pretty good deal.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Uses a lightning gun to attack plants with plasma, causing various effects.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ELECTRIC_VETERAN_DESCRIPT:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}plasma balls deal 20 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plasma balls can arc to other lanes and bypass plants

{FLAVOR}Despite watt one might think, he has no patience for puns.
Uses an advanced lightning gun to attack plants with plasma that either stuns or slowly destroys them.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 0.6 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}"Why not just go inside the house", one of the zombies pondered. "There aren't even any lawnmowers to stop him!" Camo promptly reminded that zombie that he is but a janitor, and that the general knows better.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is ejected past your defenses, then tactically retreats backwards.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with bare hands
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Paratooper Imps when damaged

{FLAVOR}Due to his rather large stature, Colonel Gargantuar is required to pay three times the usual travel fee. Furious, he shouts into the sky, yearning for the carefree life of the imps instead. But... then he looks at his empty wallet, knowing that at least he gets paid for his services, unlike his imp associates, saving his thoughts for another bad day.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HE: Hulking zombie with high command and higher fists.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GAS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}damages plants in a 3x3 area
{KEYWORD}Gas Damage: {STAT}100

{FLAVOR}Being a direct evolution to one of General Camo's most notorious strategies, these combat units are equipped with deadly gas dispensers and are not afraid to utilize their full potential. The imp pilots choose to wear a stylish gas mask in honor of the zombie who put them in the position to create havoc. They say it creates a sense of comradery amongst the zombies, but that sense is quickly undermined by all the "passing gas" jokes made by their colleagues.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_GAS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gas Pod Imps drop in above the skies uninvited and, once ready, periodically unleash deadly doses of gas in an area.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ROCKET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.175
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 1.5 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}launches rockets into plants and into the home ship (rockets deal 300 damage)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}changes trajectory of rockets every shot
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stops moving foward after reaching the sixth column

{FLAVOR}When it came to creating the ideal super soldier for his Zombie Aerial Combat Unit, General Camo decided on something similar to what he remembers seeing one would be like from his time in the present. His ideal soldier is to be trained in a specialized boot camp, in addition to being provided with several action movie flicks and of course, a rocket launcher for good measure. All bases had to be covered when it comes getting first blood in this battlefield.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ROCKET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A zombie with big guns toting a big gun.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARBITER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}rams into your home, dealing 1500 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}highly resistant to movement impairing effects

{FLAVOR}The Arbiter-X ponders General Camo's dilemma. What sort of changes would occur if a zombie with the knowledge of the present was sent so far back in time? What sort of leaps and bounds in technology would happen before they were intended to be? The ship's artificial intelligence attempts to discuss this with the zombie driving, but he's too busy making race car sounds.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_ARBITER_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Creates an invisibility field that cloaks zombies behind it.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 + 500 (force field)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates a spammable shield to protect from incoming attacks

{FLAVOR}When it comes to using an opponent's technology, General Camo would not consider the prospect at all if it didn't entail being another way to one up that bulb-headed Edgar. The ZACU Protector is an energy field manipulator that is able to outmatch whatever Zomboss thinks he has in the year 2323! All it took is some stolen blueprints and a bounty's worth of depleted uranium-235 as it's fuel source. Just don't ask what the conduit tube attached to the helmet is for when you're going to drive this thing, it's highly confidential and the answer is not pretty.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_PROTECTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Creates weaker shields, but regenerates them more often.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_CHICKEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: A flying chicken invader that flies at full speed to peck at your shield.
ZOMBIE_SKYCITY_LAUNCHER_ZOMBIE_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}820
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}missile deals 1600 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to various effects

{FLAVOR}All imp pilots driving these heavy duty weapons share a penchant for senseless destruction, it's practically a requirement. They are also practicing rocket surgeons, an actual requirement needed to operate and operate on these missiles.
If not defeated in time, fires a missile that deals massive damage to the house.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms into a fighter plane on final phase

{FLAVOR}Unlike Dr. Zomboss, General Camo doesn't have any fondness for giant robots as a strategy. He finds them too cumbersome and cost-inefficient, and while him using one would be seen as blasphemy due to his antediluvian style when it comes to conducting his attacks, General Camo has one secret rule that he's lived by from the moment he donned his first mask: the rule of cool is one to triumph all. And you best believe a giant robot vulture is as cool as it comes.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_SKYCITY_DESCRIPTION_H: The great scourge of the skies.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Likes to take long walks, and always dies a few times a day from the smog from work. But always finds himself back where he started.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Being in the Industrial Revolution, Conehead Labor Zombie really thought he was industrially revolting with the whole cone-on-head idea. Sadly, unbeknownst to him, Jurassic Conehead had beaten him to it by a couple geologic periods.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His workshop cone provides state-of-the-art protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Buckethead Labor Zombie is really glad that his stylish headwear can by chance also be utilized for labor. However, he prefers to use his worker caps for more of the dirty work.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His bucket is sure to protect him from damage and will probably cause a fire.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Flag Labor Zombie finds the flag carrying gig to be quite a hassle. He really wants to get a new position, but he's a afraid of the judgement he’ll get. Not just from Dr. Zomboss, but his peers. Every zombie knows, no zombie wants to be the Flag Zombie. It takes commitment, something which a lot of zombies don’t have the capacity of comprehending. If he quits, he may not be accepted anymore. Maybe it would be better to just stick with it for now.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge steamy "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}400 (wheelbarrow) + cart pusher
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with wheelbarrow
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can also come equipped with trusty armor

{FLAVOR}Coal Miner Zombie is actually a super secret acronym for another super secret codename. C.M.Z.: Cyber Moochie Zoborbus. Don’t tell anyone, shhhhhhh!
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_H: Coal Miner Zombies push wheelbarrows of coal. When their carts are busted, burning coal is left behind.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_TRAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}900 (wheelbarrow) + cart pusher
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with wheelbarrow
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can also come equipped with trusty armor

{FLAVOR}A coalition of miners and imps came together to create this new innovation in zombie transportation. No longer would they have to suffer with easily broken handles and an uncomfortable area for cargo. They got the idea for it on the train ride home from their shifts.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_TRAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Coal Train Zombies push coal with industrial grade supplies, making the process slower but more sturdy.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_COAL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 0.25 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to various status effects and knockback

{FLAVOR}Attempting to slack off on the job in a place where no one can find you seemed like the perfect crime, until it got to where you should hide. The worst part? He's STILL on the job. He's still thinking about his contingency plan, because where ever those wheelbarrows were taking him, it's nowhere good.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MINER_COAL_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Coal Imp blocks damage and slowly burns your plants.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_BARREL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15 normally, when exposed runs 1.12% faster
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}when his barrel is destroyed, he gets a massive speed boost

{FLAVOR}Once a wealthy factory owner, this zombie fell from grace when a group of Industrial Imps ripped him off. A story as old as time.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_BARREL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His sturdy barrel keeps him greatly protected from damage.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with wrench
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches backwards Industrial Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}He’s sure to throw a wrench in those plants’ plans. If you don’t laugh at that joke, he will make you. He will. His hands are enormous.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Massive zombie who is sure to rebuild your defenses his way: walking over them.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}570
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stops to eat sun producing plants

{FLAVOR}Gentleman Zombie’s dancing skills are unrivaled by other zombies in his time. His integration of the umbrella is breathtaking, and when he opens it? Total showstopper.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_GENTLEMAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Flies over past defenses and obstacles.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}There isn’t much to say about Industrial Imp. He’s had meetings with 50 different U.S. Presidents, has went to Mars and back, and found the key to immortality, but that’s about it. He’s recently taken on chess, and it’s proven as quite the challenge.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is launched into your defenses, then works his way backwards.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_INVENTOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1650 (flying contraption) + 800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can steal her contraption's mechanical piece

{FLAVOR}Could you guess Inventor Zombie was an inventor? Besides the flying contraption (which her husband recently got stuck on), she's invented tons of other stuff, including (but not limited to): industrial machines, the light bulb, the wheel, and in a cruel twist of fate: the early prototype for the lawnmower.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_INVENTOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Slowly flies over plants with her surprisingly sturdy flying contraption.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}560 (face plate) + 340 (machine)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can steal face plate

{FLAVOR}Made out of only the most refined scrap metal. Programmed to love work and ask no questions. Under no circumstances should the face plate be removed from the model. Two-day delivery - free shipping.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_CLOCKWORK_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Mass-produced machines that are about as unlively (and hungry) as their co-workers.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MECHANIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stands in place, cranking out Clockwork Zombies from his machine

{FLAVOR}The invention of Clockwork Zombies has spurred nothing but controversy among the many zombie labor unions. Some think they're a threat to the very unlivelyhoods that the workplace is meant to provide for. Others are critical of their sudden appearance. In general, a lot of mystery and paranoia surrounds their existence. But none know what Mechanic Zombie knows. None of them have noticed the plummeting number of fish in the River Thames as of recently...
ZOMBIE_STEAM_MECHANIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Produces steam-powered Clockwork Zombies from his mysterious machine.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FURNACE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}will unthaw from chill effects quicker
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}fire attacks do 20% more damage

{FLAVOR}It should be no surprise to learn that a furnace strapped to your back feels quite uncomfortable. Besides all the third-degree burns, it's just heavy! Unfortunately for Furnace Zombie, any type of advanced cooling system won't be invented until another 20 years. Unless the rumored Zomboni project speeds up development, that is.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_FURNACE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hot-tempered zombie with a hot-tempered furnace that combusts and destroys plants in a 3x3 radius upon defeat.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_REPAIRIMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500 + 1000 (repair station)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}repair station will be dropped upon defeat
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}repair station repairs 400 health to machines every 2 seconds in a 3x3 radius
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Dr. Zomboss is grateful for a lot of things, but what he is most grateful for is the lack of imp labor laws during the industrial revolution.
ZOMBIE_STEAM_REPAIRIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Drops a repair station that heals mechanical allies upon defeat.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imps from smokestack

{FLAVOR}Overtaking the position of a wealthy factory owner, Dr. Zomboss had easy access to all the materials and parts he needed to build the Loco-motive. Still having his blueprints for previous spider Zombots, Dr. Zomboss and his underpaid employees went to work, building a budget-friendly alternative to the usually expensive and draining production of one of his Zombots. Not out of a concern for the future prosperity of the workplace, but rather to grab more assets for himself to recover from his previous endeavor. Sure, he might be leaving the factory bankrupt after he leaves, but that's not going to cause any long-term problems, right?
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_STEAM_DESCRIPTION_HEA: The derailer of defenses that's sure to bring the pain train.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}Zombies already hate the Holiday Mashup Initiative Program, but this guy is on a WHOLE other level of hatred. You're telling him that there's an entire holiday to celebrate collecting plants, and that he has to pretend to be happy about it?! Doesn't anyone else see how messed up this is? He'd voice his thoughts on the matter, but the whole initiative is bugged with cameras, and he really doesn't want to end up in an even worse spot.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}He's starting to have his doubts about this whole idea, he bought this cone in hopes of fooling crops into growing elsewhere (as any good law-abiding green would), and even paid extra for the sun-blocking model just so he can stand out there much longer. The other zombies tell him to keep doing it, and they're all having a big laugh about it.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His straw hat cone makes him twice as tough as regular farmer zombies.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}He's been milking and plowing so long, even Dr. Zomboss thinks that his mind is gone!
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His watering bucket gives him excellent protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}His greatest possession is his straw hat, which is a home to a myriad of small insects that whisper into his ears ideas of stealing your belongings, such as this old rake you left in your garage, so now he's aiming for some really big heists with them. Of course, he could stop this at any time, but he really wants to see how far this goes; he's hoping it leads to something VERY funny.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge reapy "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_OUTHOUSE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200 (outhouse) + 290
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185 (inside outhouse), 0.5 (freed)
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}It's been an all-around bad day for her, she thought she would get a lucky shot at hanging with the aquacultural clique on the other side of the yard, but instead they had her eat various worms and bad shrimp, which really did a number on her. After thinking her day couldn't get any worse, the door is jammed! Thankfully, this is just one embarrassing situation, and it probably wouldn't be what she's known for at all.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_OUTHOUSE_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her outhouse greatly protects her but slows down a rather fast zombie.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_PITCHFORK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}blocks incoming projectiles, but is vulnerable to lobbed shots

{FLAVOR}Farming in the Zombie society is a job as important as it is for the living, if not more. You wouldn't believe how much they get paid for uprooting those flowers and vegetables. It makes much more sense when you compare farmers to mercenaries or hitmen. And you bet, Pitchfork Zombie is the biggest shot. Her key to success? She doesn't even lay a finger on her target. All she needs is to relocate it where it would perish from an "accident". Now that sounds much cooler than whatever you imagined farming to be, doesn't it? Although to be fair, you wouldn't have come this far without knowing how to tend to a Peashooter either.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_PITCHFORK_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Digs up plants and throws them behind her.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with a reasonably sized drumstick
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Harvest Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}He's been trying out this whole new type of diet called a "No Greens Diet": the gist of it is, when he sees a plant he says "no" the only way a Gargantuar knows how. You can see the results.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HE: A big guy with an even bigger appetite.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}What came first: the chicken or the egg? Well this little guy really wanted to know, so he became the chicken to find an answer. His results? Nothing, but he met a nice egg friend with a similar passion.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is scrambled into your defenses, then clucks onwards.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_EGGSHELL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700 (eggshell) + 100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection

{FLAVOR}What came first: the egg or the chicken? Well this rapscallion was dire to know, so he became the egg to find out. His conclusion? Undetermined, but he got acquainted with a chicken pal with related interests.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_EGGSHELL_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Hatches from dropped eggs, gaining a subjectively cuter appearance and some defensive protection.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_PTERRY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000 + 1400 (rock)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.145
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes plants with his "gourd" instead of eating, dealing 2 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to knockback

{FLAVOR}Gourd Carrier Zombie is all about that D.I.Y. unlifestyle, on account of the fact that he's a zombie and cannot shop anywhere. On the bright side, he's been saving a ton of money because of it, his car is some wagon he found in a ditch, his ID is a piece of cardboard, and his little buddy was already tarred when he found him in his backyard. He just applied the feathers, this also goes for pretty much anything else he owns.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_PTERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gourd Carrier Zombie carries a (completely legitimate) gourd. When defeated, he will drop the gourd, which blocks damage and crushes plants.
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_EGGSTEALER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}80
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.55
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to plant-based redirection
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}Once a giddy little farm assistant boy helping his old pa out in the farm, until he heard of the most liked photo on Brainstagram. His opportunistic senses told him what he knew he needed to do. He then went on to look for the biggest egg he could find, which led him to a double life at CropCap as an employee and an egg snatcher. He's still waiting for when he'll finally trend on social media... Any minute now...
ZOMBIE_HARVEST_EGGSTEALER_DESCRIPTION_HE: Harvest Egg Stealers are opportunistic little buggers that speed into the corn fields. When defeated, they drop an egg that hatches into what shouldn't have come first.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}It used to take a certain kind of zombie to be a Ducky Tuber. Unfortunately for Ducky Tube Zombie, times have changed, and now all zombies enjoy the water just fine. He's not really over it yet, but he's trying something new to keep himself relevant. Who knows? Maybe this new Ducky Tubing style might catch on.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: With his inflatable duck-like flotation apparatus, the Ducky Tube Zombie can quickly waddle his way through water with ease.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}You can thank Conehead Ducky Tube for enforcing proper boat traffic regulation in the pool. Just don't tell him the obvious. He even brought a cone and everything, as long as the effort's there.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His unfortunately non-inflatable cone makes him twice as protected for the pool party.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}After getting stranded in one of Ancient Egypt's harshest prophesied droughts due to a portal, he successfully found his way back to the Modern Day and has been looking forward to quenching his thirst by bringing a drinking bucket into the pool, then realized he's a zombie. Ah, the wonders of undead fallacy.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His bucket makes him sturdy enough to take on the backyard splash.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (bricks) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Bringing a ducky tube inflatable and having a bunch of bricks on your head is quite the contradictory combo. But hey, he's just extra cautious just in case he somehow hits his head on something other than peas in a pool. Better safe than sorry!
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His brick head serves as an exceptional pool safety precaution.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Compared to some of the other impish construction zombies you may see working in the Time-Space, Construction Zombies like him dabble in much less worldly work, and more in the lines of road work. It's much more mundane, but at least he's got a way to justify the inflated budgets here.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}The sign isn't misplaced, his stupidity is enough to be a workplace hazard but not quite to the point where he'd be fired. Luckily for him, you won't find any replacements this far out.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His stand sign headwear provides him with increased protection.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Construction Buckethead is of the opinion that the buckets from way back in 2013 are increasingly blasé to the average zombie looking for protection. It's time for reinvention, something retro but also modern, something that screams venetian red. He'd go on about it, but there's surprisingly low interest on investing in new buckets in the middle of nowhere.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His paint bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (hourglass) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He's got all the time wasted here on his mind.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His time-appropriate headgear provides great protection.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He always quarrels with architect zombies who provide the flags for him. When asked why, he said that those "Epic Realm" side projects of theirs keep misplacing the construction budget from more important sites.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His flag marks the arrival of a huge work-in-progress "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}He's the lead of the demolition team. If you read his resume submitted to the Braindella company, you might discover why nobody except you remembers Gentleman Zombie wearing a different hat, Explorer Zombie fully engulfed in flames and OSHA certified Toy Car Imps.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Construction Rally Zombie marks the arrival of an eyesore of zombies.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}These guys are Zomboss's right-hand crew, always around to build the paths in every era. They've been off-duty for a very long time, and only recently got back to work when Zomboss decided to visit Steam Ages. But, now? They're taking a break. The other guys have been hard at work on those Epic Realm projects. They've got some time until Zomboss gets impatient with finishing the rest of their map building. Give 'em a couple more months. You'll be amazed what they can do in such a short time.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is NOT tossed into your defenses, but will still construct a path forward regardless.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}smashes plants with shovel
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks lobbed shots, but is vulnerable to incoming projectiles

{FLAVOR}After the failed expedition in Lost City, he had an epiphany. The tried-and-true method of deploying Parasol Zombies to protect zombies like himself was simply inefficient, predictable, easily defeated. And some of those punk plants have built up the immunity to being shoveled, which is INCREDIBLY rude! He came up with the perfect strategy with his Parasol compatriots: what if they switched their roles, tried out something new with their weapons? They pitched the idea to Zomboss on the way back to Modern Day... and were kicked out of his vehicle, left here in this rift. Maybe Zomboss doesn't get it, but they keep trying to show their strategy to anyone who happens to roam by here. Surely, someone, someday, will see their vision.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_EXCAVATOR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shovel provides protection from lobbed projectiles, and can also be used to smash plants.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_JANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}uses parasol to push plants
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage to other obstacles

{FLAVOR}Being left behind in this rift isn't so bad. Sure, she got an awful berating from Zomboss for going along with "such a stupid, idiotic, quite frankly moronic idea," but she's seen lots of exciting stuff! Witnessing the daily work commutes by ZCorp employees, the construction crews build access roads to new time periods, the daily commute of zombies to Piñata Parties, the beautiful traffic jams of Tumble-Weasels every other Tuesday. But she's also seen a lot of weird stuff. She's pretty sure she saw an entire time period change overnight, into some weird futuristic ship in the sky, specifically after some old guy traveling in a massive robot bird took that exit. The others insist it was always like that, but she's convinced she knows what she saw. Maybe the isolation from zociety is getting to her at this point.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Parasol provides protection from incoming projectiles, and can be used to push plants.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGIMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with a 2x4, dealing 7.5 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}He was a prime candidate for some shrink ray experiment called Operation D-S Zombies (short for Dinky-Sized), the end goal was to create a group of portable zombies that would've easily fit into anyone's pockets. Unfortunately, the shrink ray was rife with too many side effects to justify the cost, causing the project's cessation. Gargimp lost his imp along the way and wasn't paid with the gumdrop he was promised. Now he roams the Time-Space smashing things just to pass time. He would've written an autobiography about the whole experience if pens weren't so fun to smash things with.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gargimp is a bit of a small problem.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_SNIFFER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}sniffing does no damage, but helps it block shots for other zombies

{FLAVOR}The Sniffer is a fabled being among zombiekind, originating from ancient Atlantian mythology. Some say that the being is simply a project Dr. Zomboss abandoned to create a zombie of great nose, for whatever purpose that would serve. Others, however, insist that The Sniffer originates from an alternate reality, one where the laws and decorum of polite zociety are left behind in favor of lawlessness, absurdity, and utter nautical nonsense. The Sniffer, however, insists that these factions should not engage in war over its origin, for war does not determine who is right, only who is left.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants, dealing 10 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}These Tumble-Weasels are abnormalities in the weasel process. Dr. Zomboss mandates that these must be dumped into the rift, as they are simply too rotund for his liking. Despite being rare, because so many are dropped off here in the rift, they are a nuisance to travelers, often causing traffic jams and accidents as they roll across the highway. It's really bad during holidays.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Soft, rotund specimen that crushes plants as it rolls down the lane.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}4200
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12 (normal), 0.4 (enraged)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with tuna
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}becomes enraged when damaged, increasing his speed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}highly resistant to movement impairing effects

{FLAVOR}It runs in the family. You think he got it bad? Wait until you meet Kindergartenerface Gargantuar and Teenagerface Gargantuar.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Babyface Gargantuar is seventy-five percent of a big deal.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}gremlins thrown from barrel when destroyed

{FLAVOR}He used to plunder the seas, while wearing a mask to cover his facial features. The mysterious aspect of his impromptu fashion style, as well as his successful pillages, earned him quite a name. He even got invited to a photo shoot. There, he took off his mask and... you can guess what happened next. The editor screamed at the photographer to remove that image, but it was too late. Next thing you know, his face is on all the almanacs everywhere.
ZOMBIE_RIFT_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His rolling barrel crushes plants, spawns strange imp creatures and provides excellent protection. His face does not.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BERSERKER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1400
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.1 (normal), 2.0 (tackling)
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Was told to go to the bench area after committing a penalty barreling through a junior league team called the  Suburban Sprouts, he got lost on the way there pretty bad. The silver lining is that he gets to tackle pretty much anyone he wants, anytime. He views the entire rift as his personal sports arena. They call him the Rift Slammer.
ZOMBIE_MODERN_BERSERKER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: A heavy-duty zombie who charges your defensive line multiple times.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She is trying to replicate the knife tricks that the perfect maid is known to do, but she keeps getting herself cut.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Regular maid serving a higher power.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}Everyone thinks the clock is an attempt at gaining time manipulation, but she's actually just really tardy.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Her time keeping cone keeps her well protected, and on time.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She has heard that the one painted on her bucket can manipulate fate and destiny. Not wanting to keep her own future merely in the hands of whatever zombie is in power, she hopes this tribute will allow her to control her own fate.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Her bucket keeps her well-being and fate well protected.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She wears red because she wants to be just like her hero... the shrine maiden with the red bow, she never could remember her name.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Regular maid serving a higher power, adorning red attire.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}No one has the heart to tell her that her clock is broken.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HE: Her time keeping cone keeps her well protected, and on time. Now adorning red attire.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

{FLAVOR}She owns a prized collection of spears, but she doesn't dare get them dirty on those nasty lawns.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_RED_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HE: Her bucket keeps her well-being and fate well protected. Now adorning red attire.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}320
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects

Many speculate why this happens, but the most common answer is they either come back, or there are so many that they are easily replaceable.

{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.
