{FLAVOR}After unlife long training, Shikaisen Zombie finally managed to cheat undeath. You may think this means he can live at peace, but he is rather paranoid that someone will come to assassinate him. He has lived most of his unlife fear from zombie society for this reason, but he could not ignore the desire for brains forever.
ZOMBIE_DESIRE_SHIKAISEN_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Drops a vase upon defeat, which will revive them if not destroyed quickly.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}demoted plants deal half of their damage until Royal Clan Zombie dies

{FLAVOR}Royal Clan Zombie and Zombie King have always been sworn enemies since the day they met. Both rulers of their own lands, making their armies stronger, and being so lazy they've never walked a day in their unlives. How Royal Clan Zombie can stay so fit only boils Zombie King's blood more.
ZOMBIE_DESIRE_EMPEROR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Promotes zombies to higher rank and demotes plants.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to butter and poison effects

ZOMBIE_SERVANT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The smallest cleaning service you could ever call on. Now adorning red attire and a new hair dye.

{FLAVOR}Maid Gargantuar is a total cuddlebug when it comes to imps, she just can't help but squeeze their adorable little cheeks. Unfortunately for her, imps don't reciprocate that sort of love and would like anything but being caught between her hands.
ZOMBIE_SERVANT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HE: The biggest cleaning service you could ever call on.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Determined to keep the influence of his royal house in his homeworld, him and his colleagues happened to stumble upon the Rainbow Market after an unusual turn of events. Luckily for him, he happened to stumble upon Greedy, and shook hands on a deal that would benefit them both. Despite their universal and temporal differences, they both got along quite well, now ready to spread their wealth and influence to our world. The House of Plantagenet shall now live on through universes.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A royal with a strong sense of fashion and originality. He's enjoyed his affluent unlife believing his cone was the best of them all even across time and after crossing into our world, be the best in the multiverse. This belief was shattered the moment he met the Carnie Coneheads.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HE: His magnificent cone provides twice as much wealth in sturdiness compared to those impoverished in armor.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Extremely displeased at the fact that he needs to pour 0.03% of his wealth just to forge and wear protective armor into battle. That financial hole will never, ever be patched up.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HE: His ornate golden bucket provides splendid protection from barbaric attacks.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Always groaning about how uncivilized it is for him and his fellow nobles are by charging like a mob towards the plants, thinking it's a step back for their royal image as the House of Plantagenet even if they're already dead. Greedy promptly reminded that zombie that he is but a second-rate noble, and that the godfather knows better.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Marks the arrival of a huge luxurious "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_WINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}470
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}throws cups of wine that deal 25 damage and stun plants and other obstacles for 5 seconds
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}slaps plants instead of eating

{FLAVOR}An enthusiast in everything wine, he is a connoisseur in the arts of its brewery. Just don't remind him that most of the drinks he loves come from Grapeshots. He's already breaking enough glass cups as-is.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_WINE_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Throws cups of wine towards plants that deal damage and stun them.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_NOBLEWOMAN_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}flings and destroys plants using gusts whipped up by her fan

{FLAVOR}More concerned about the smell of her perfume than anything else. The maids do a good job with her daily get-up. Though she's still blissfully unaware of the fact the maids applied Perfume-shroom scented perfume over her favorite Iris-scented one.
Maiden of magnificence that flings plants away with her state-of-the-art fan.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws her fans at other zombies after stopping at the eighth column, making them invincible for 10 seconds which also removes most debuffs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}royal aura prevents plants from being planted directly on her tile
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to freeze, stun and stall effects

{FLAVOR}Still looking for an old shoe she lost when she was younger. Has a nagging feeling she accidentally turned it invisible all those years ago. Kids can be quite clumsy after all, royal or not.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_PRINCESS_DESCRIPTION_: Maiden of royalty that blesses her fellow zombies with the gift of invincibility.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}At the face of multiple instances of new competition compared to her original dimension, she started to strive to be the best maid. But when your competition is capable of things like sweeping, superb coordination and EVEN flight, not to mention that some of them also serve tea that invigorates zombies more, she's fighting an uphill battle. Now her only real advantage is her strong will to keep up.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Is deployed past your defenses, then serves forward.
ZOMBIE_PLANTAGENET_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with ladle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Server Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Said to be a master of cuisine back in his home universe. With dishes so good that everyone in the royal house is craving for more, spending much of their money just for a taste. Now that he's here, he's yearning for competition, and he has his sights set on a certain King of the Grill. Will he cook through the competition or get French fried?
Massive zombie that'll make delicious vegan stew out of your plants.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^8600CC^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}leaf blower blows away plants and pushes zombies forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires a tommy gun at plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spawns market cards and maid tables

{FLAVOR}Programming this machine was quite a chore. One bug denied any attempts at subtracting values from Klepto-maton's variables, another one made all pointers refer to themselves, and the script broke the binary system once, with the error log showing "Numbers 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are mine!"
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_MARKET_DESCRIPTION_HE: A sophisticated machine of avarice, expendable for nefarious means.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He keeps hearing other zombies talk about a "poker face." He contemplates every night about this, looking into magic mirrors and wondering what’s wrong with his face.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Regular poker card zombie. Can arrive in one of 4 different card suits.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}With the possibility of receiving a promotion, Poker Conehead Zombie is a bit fearful of what it may present. Not that he’s afraid of moving up in the world, but he worries about parting ways with his best friend. After all, what if he ends up with a DIFFERENT looking cone?! It’s just not right!
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His pawn chess piece provides him with methodical protection. Can arrive in one of 4 different card suits.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Hopes to one day have brains served on his head for his royal subjects to consume and praise him for. The cloche is there to keep any magic dust from fog from getting all over it. As delightful as glittering brains does look, anyone that consumes it will be coughing up nasty spells, something that not even the nastiest zombies would want coming out of their mouths.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His bucket, well, cloche provides excellent protection both for himself and the brains that are supposed to go there. Can arrive in one of 4 different card suits.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Responsible for checking the attendance of everyone involved in daily attacks as mandated by their queen, he always wondered where their "joker card" had gone. Some say they're stuck in darker times, forever bound to being unwanted. This concerns Poker Flag, not because of a genuine care for them, but because he has to keep writing lines of absence for whoever that is. Seriously, it's starting to clog the attendance sheet.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge shuffled "wave" of zombies. Can arrive in one of 4 different card suits.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Had to claw his way through the ranks from originally being the "Royal Flush." It sounds like a prestigious title, but it’s just fancy wording for the janitor.
Marks the arrival of a massive royal flush of zombies. Can arrive in one of 4 different card suits.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_IMP_HEARTS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}These 4 little guys were invited to an extravagant tea party promised to be right out of a wonderland. The invitation asked for guests to be dressed in their best suits.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_IMP_HEARTS_DESCRIPTION_: Is NOT tossed into your defenses, but still shuffles onward. Can arrive in one of 4 different card suits.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1300
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16 (normal), 1 (jousting)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches a flying knight rider over plants 2 tiles forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can activate Diamond Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}Unicorns lend themselves pretty well into having pretty fantastical friend groups when it comes to sports. He knows an actual living yeti, a bridge troll, and a totally tubular gopher. He’s been trying to talk his rider into joining the friend circle, who, despite having a tough knightly schedule, believes he can squeeze in time for some Peggle, too. Things are bound to get awkward when he has to eventually introduce him to the sunflower, however.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_CAVALRY_DESCRIPTION_HEA: A mystical creature that can launch his zombie rider past most of your defenses.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_ARMOR3_CAVALRY_DESCRIPT:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1600 (helmet) + 270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can activate Diamond Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}The finest (and only) member of the less prestigious and rarely documented Knights of the Rhombus Table.
His queen-appointed helm provides amazing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_CHESIRE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}turns invisible until it reaches a plant or obstacle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can’t be targeted by plants when invisible
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can activate Spade Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}Residents of the forest still get into debates on how such a being came to be. Some argued that it was the manifestation of peoples’ mischief. Others opined that it is an unholy, magical fusion of a feline and an imp. Few don't even believe it actually exists, that it’s simply an illusion, a trick of the eye. But one thing that almost everyone agrees on is that, just like real cats, these imps are jerks solely because they think they’re too cute to be held accountable.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_CHESIRE_DESCRIPTION_HEA: An imp that can disappear, leaving only his mischievous grin.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}runs away and calls in a Zombie Unicorn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can activate Heart Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}Made sure she wore the right size shoes before getting escorted. Tripping because one of her shoes fell off while trying to call for help would've been quite embarrassing, especially with her royal status.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dropped from her knight, then tries to run away.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1800 (helmet) + 3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with morningstar
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops Queen Imp when defeated
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can activate Spade Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}A zombie with not much to lose, Guardgantuar decided to enlist as a member of the royal guard to train while tracking the one who took it all from him. "I'll broil him on my toast, I'll have his bones to grind my bread!" He may be overdramatizing, but he still seeks retribution from the one named Jack all the same.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_MIRRORQUEEN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}disables magic mirrors for 20 seconds after stopping at the seventh column
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}if there are no mirrors or all mirrors are disabled, throws poisonous apples at plants that deal 25 damage and put them to sleep for 20 seconds, priority depends on higher cost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can activate Diamond Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}She doesn’t like to talk about how her power was usurped from her. Imagine your grand plans being spoiled by a lousy group of 7 imp miners. On the bright side, she fully embraces this new, up-and-coming queen who REALLY hates imps.
Disables magic mirrors and throws poisonous apples at plants.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_MIRRORQUEEN_VETERAN_DES:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}disables magic mirrors for 25 seconds after stopping at the seventh column
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}if there are no mirrors or all mirrors are disabled, throws poisonous apples at plants that deal 40 damage, put them to sleep for 25 seconds and lower their attack damage by 50% for 40 seconds, priority depends on higher cost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can activate Diamond Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}Once the fairest maiden of them all, she asked her magic mirrors time and time again who that was. Until one day, they gave her a different answer: some smoke-ridden hag. Sensibly, she started a massive anti-mirror campaign across the land. All of them are to be banished to the surrounding weirding woods, shattered and hopefully never to be seen again. She even set up a neighborhood watch to keep alert on any mirrors popping up (they meet at 7 on Tuesdays!).
Disables magic mirrors and throws poisonous apples at plants, now in higher rank.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_WOLF_DESCRIPTION:

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490

{FLAVOR}Like a certain fellow practitioner of magic, many zombies are eluded to why they transform plants into all these random animals. In Frog Sorceress Zombie's case, it's to fulfill her dream of recreating that classic fairytale of a frog turning into a prince after kissing the princess. She may have spent too much time on the frog part and not the princess part...
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_WITCH_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Transforms plants into passive frogs that hop forward.
ZOMBIE_FAIRYTALE_IMP_MINIBOSS_PHASE1_DES:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}10000 (Phase 1), 850 (Phase 2)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25 (Phase 2)
{KEYWORD}Abilities: {STAT}summons Poker Cards, zombies, magic fog, casts a 30 seconds sleeping spell, switches lanes. On phase 2, retreats, removes magic mirrors, calls in 3 Zombie Unicorns. Can activate all Poker Cards
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}75% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}Many people dream of reliving their past, finding it to be more endearing than what their lives have led them to in the present. The regrets that build up, culminating into someone yearning for what once was, even uncaring for what could turn their life around in the future. A cycle of nihility that can only be broken by an impossible dream: return to the past.

What happens when that unreachable star is reached is a firm stance to maintain that illuminating light. And once that star darkens, the eyes of who once dreamed will flare up and dream of a telltale story about stumbling into a wonderful, unrelenting nightmare.
Ruler of the kingdom, arriving to smite all those who forbid her monarchy.
ZOMBIE_ZOMBOSSMECH_FAIRYTALE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}venomballs leave behind poison puddles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}inhales and pulls plants to it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}top head summons magic fog, bottom head shuffles Poker Cards

{FLAVOR}After Dr. Zomboss stumbled upon the magical forest, he immediately fell head over heels for the fantastical behemoth laid before him.

The Queen, however, laughs, thinking to herself how clueless the crazed mad scientist could be to be so easily puppeteered. A dream where the people she has grown to hate the most fight until they can no longer dream. A nightmare they cannot wake up from. Unfortunately, the tale could not end the way she wanted it to. With the beast slain, the queen retreated in solitude. Wandering around as the remaining days of her unlife keep flashing before her eyes. What's left is the same yearning for the past the former queen has always wanted, now devoid of the star she was once illuminated by. The times when she could still smile. When she was still happy.
A manifested creation of nightmares, awoken to tell a tragically ever after.
ZOMBIE_GREATZUCCHINI_BASIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}These zombies mysteriously started cropping up one day with no memories of who they were prior. Many have vague recollections of having some sort of defining headgear or being able to perform something that made them special. The most confusing of all is that their names make no sense at all, they're neither great nor zucchinis, but they all share that title the same. Don't worry, we've got our best P.I.s on the case, and once they stop sending in The Great Zucchini zombies in their place we'll get to the bottom of this case in no time.
ZOMBIE_GREATZUCCHINI_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_H: Zombies converted by The Great Zucchini become The Great Zucchini Zombies.
